descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Global Business Process Specialist (GBPS) – Accounting Tax Integration, you are part of the Global Business Process Management Organization in Roche Service & Solutions. In this position, you report into the Accounting Tax Integration Sub-Chapter Lead within the Finance BPM. You act as Business Process Specialist for the APAC Regional Deployment team in the Finance/ Tax area. You roll-out the Aspire Global Template to the APAC countries, in particular for Chugai company codes in the area of Taxes, including Tax Localization. You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from Finance, Commercials, Demand-to-Pay, Supply Chain and IT, cross divisionally (Pharma and Diagnostics). You will be :
• Responsible for global, cross divisional state-of-the-art process design within their business process area within the E2E proces. Empowered decision making for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Manager (GBPM)
• Work closely with the E2E GBPMs & GBPS network to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions. Supports the SAP S4/HANA Template deployment. Actively pursue the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E GBPO and GBPMs
• Deliver solutions including processes, ICFR, Authorizations, laws and regulations, technology, analytics for own dedicated area, in line with the E2E BPM strategy & guardrails as well as continuous improvements, with support of the GBPM and GBPSs. Support business acceptance globally across divisions and functions on a operating level for the dedicated business process area. Drive and implement the BPM strategy for your own dedicated area
• Roll-out Global template solutions for the area of Finance/ Tax, including solution documentation & implementation, test management, business process operations including integrated training management. Evaluate Local GAP and design localization extensions for the Global Template as part of the deployment activities for the Aspire roll out.
• Safeguard the global template and harmonized processes while collaborating with different project streams and other BPM networks to develop new processes for future releases. You translate local Tax business requirements into IT solutions and manage changes to such specifications. Actively drive and support the project deployment relevant deliverables throughout the full rollout lifecycle.
• Ensuring that all parallel deployments as well as the S/4Hana work package are on track Ensuring, monitoring and optimization of business processes with regards to efficiency and effectiveness. The position may involve a fair amount of travel (up to max. 25%). You liaise with the other stakeholder within the E2E processes. You lead process alignments/solution design with business stakeholders under template governance Who you are:
• A business or finance degree with 4-5 years of relevant work experience. An SAP FI specialist with solid experience in business process management, SAP ERP, S/4Hana, IT, and ERP transformation programs.
• Extensive experience with SAP Tax solutions, covering Indirect Taxes, Withholding Taxes, and Corporate Income Taxes. Deep knowledge of SAP S/4Hana tax solutions, including SAP country versions, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, and implementation of SAP systems, particularly S4 Finance.
• Experience with other SAP Tax solutions like Sovos add-on for tax code determination is advantageous.
• Excellent analytica

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Security Analyst - Penetration Testing Exp- 4 to 7 yers Location- Pune Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Security Analyst to join our cybersecurity team. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across our diverse technology landscape, identifying and documenting security risks to strengthen our overall security posture. Primary Responsibilities
• Conduct thorough penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, and AI/LLM system using industry-standard tools and methodologies
• Perform hands-on security assessments and identify vulnerabilities in web-based systems and APIs
• Execute practical penetration tests against target systems, documenting real-world findings and exploitation methods
• Develop and execute custom exploitation payloads and attack scenarios
• Analyze application logic, authentication mechanisms, and access control implementations
• Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to define scope, validate findings and track remediation efforts
• Maintain detailed testing documentation, evidence of assessments, and proof of concept demonstrations
• Participate in security reviews and contribute to threat modeling exercises
• Stay current with emerging web application security threats and attack vectors
• Quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and emerging security challenges in the threat landscape Required Qualifications Certifications (Mandatory - at least one of the following)
• OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) or
• CPTS (Certified Penetration Testing Specialist) or
• OSCE (Offensive Security Certified Expert) or
• Equivalent recognized penetration testing certification Experience & Technical Skills Primary Expertise (Web Application and LLM - Hands-On Required):
• 3+ years of demonstrated hands-on experience in web application penetration testing
• Proven ability to identify and exploit real-world vulnerabilities in production and pre-production environments
• Practical expertise with OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, including SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication bypass, and API security flaws
• Proficiency with web security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Postman, etc.)
• Experience bypassing security controls and WAF implementations
• Hands-on experience with API penetration testing (REST, GraphQL, SOAP)
• Practical expertise with LLM security assessments, including prompt injection, model manipulation, and output validation weaknesses.
• Understanding of LLM vulnerabilities including prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage, and model poisoning attacks
• Experience evaluating guardrails, content filters, and safety mechanisms in AI systems
• Proficiency with LLM security testing frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)
• Familiarity with LLM penetration testing tools (e.g., Claud CLI, PRFU, Garak, promptfoo, etc.) Required Secondary Skills (Hands-On Demonstrated):
• Mobile Penetration Testing: Practical hands-on experience testing iOS and Android applications, including runtime analysis, reverse engineering, and security assessment of mobile APIs
• Cloud Security: Hands-on experience conducting security assessments on public cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including services like EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, RDS, and cloud misconfiguration identification. Core Competencies:
• Strong understanding of networking, encryption, authentication, and authorization mechanisms

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE , you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide. This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions. This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation. Who We Are At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Step into the Future of IT with Roche! As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward. Your Mission Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction. Your Impact Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues. Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant. By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation. Your Core Responsibilities Reliability Engineering & Architecture
• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams
• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services
• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments
• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives
• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns
• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality) Incident Management & Continuous Improvement
• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation
• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through
• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards
• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effe

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Business Operations Lead A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche . As a Business Operations Lead , you serve as a strategic and tactical partner to the Functional Leadership team, driving strategy and goals in alignment with Site and Network objectives. You are a multi-discipline professional representing the Site Business Support group, working collaboratively to drive excellence in project portfolio management, change leadership, and operational excellence. You play a key role in deploying site-wide business processes and leading strategic projects, such as product technical transfers and business programs. You push boundaries to enable a continuous improvement mindset and implement lean practices that result in quick and efficient innovation. Your Opportunity
• Functional Partnership & Excellence: You drive business results by facilitating functional goal development using lean strategy tools. You manage the functional project portfolio process, leading prioritization to ensure alignment with resource management and business timelines.
• Operational Excellence (OE) Deployment: You act as a strong advocacy and change agent for Lean/OE to build a strong continuous improvement culture. You lead process improvement activities to realize productivity outcomes and coach improvement projects to achieve functional goals.
• Organizational Change Management (OCM): You develop and implement effective change management programs to drive execution excellence. You lead site-wide initiatives to build OCM business processes and change leadership capabilities at both leadership and individual levels.
• Program & Project Management: You provide leadership for site-wide initiatives, including CAPEX and Product Technical Transfers. You ensure due diligence is performed to mitigate risks to safety, quality, compliance, and delivery.
• Coaching & Capability Building: You act as a coach for colleagues, helping them develop skills in project management and change leadership methodologies. You serve as a subject matter expert on continuous improvement methods and tools.
• Communication & Safety: You manage functional communications in line with the site plan, ensuring impactful content and timing. You ensure a safe working environment by complying with all Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements and site security measures. Who You Are
• Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.
• Experienced Professional: You have a minimum of 8 years of related working experience, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment.
• Project Expert: You possess a proven track record of at least 5 years managing small to medium-scale projects of varying complexity. PMP certification is preferred.
• Technical Specialist : You have essential competencies in Project Portfolio and Program Management, and you are a certified Black Belt in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.
• Change Leader: You have experience leading change initiatives on local, regional, or global levels and are familiar with industry change management standards such as PROSCI .
• Strategic Influencer: You possess excellent verbal and written

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Solution Architect (Demand to Pay, Travel & Expense Management) focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex enterprise context. In this role, you will play a critical role in translating complex business requirements into technical designs for the T&E solutions which includes the Concur platform and other systems, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise systems and driving continuous improvement. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for the T&E landscape, and serve as a key leader and point of escalation for Concur-related issues within the organization. Your Responsibilities
• Design T&E solutions that meet product requirements and enterprise standards across a multiple-solution context, managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions while ensuring configurations adhere to data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) and audit requirements.
• Define and drive reference architectures, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), taxonomies, ontologies, and integration pathways are documented and published for the T&E product.
• Develop comprehensive architecture documentation and manage data flows between Concur and other enterprise systems, including Workday, SAP ERP, ServiceNow (EPP), IQVIA, and Oversight.
• Lead the design and management of non-standard integrations utilizing RESTful APIs, WebServices, and secure SFTP, leveraging middleware platforms such as Mulesoft and Denodo.
• Optimize system performance and business objectives by utilizing reporting systems and data platforms, including Concur Intelligence, Snowflake, and standard reporting configurations.
• Proactively contribute to the development of global Architecture Practices and provide technical oversight and mentoring to product teams.
• Maintain the roadmap for T&E solutions, evaluating external technology trends—such as AI-driven expense categorization and RPA— to enhance value and manage technical debt. Who You Are
• You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions within the Concur platform, with at least 5 years focused on integration enhancements to and from Concur Intelligence, Travel, and Expense.
• You possess expert-level knowledge of the Concur modules and a proven track record of integrating them with SAP ERP, HR systems (Workday), and other enterprise applications.
• You are experienced in RESTful API consumption, data transformation via middleware (Mulesoft/Denodo), and creating conceptual and logical data models.
• You are capable of maintaining a vision for multiple solutions and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.
• You bring exceptional negotiation skills and the ability to communicate difficult concepts, influencing stakeholders to adopt different points of view or innovative solutions.
• You have a strong understanding of database concepts, SQL, web services, and XML/JSON data formats.
• You understand financial accounting principles and industry-specific T&E best practices; experience with pharmaceutical industry regulations is a significant plus.
• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; a "Certified Professional - Expense Configuration" credential is preferred. Compensation & Benefits The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Position - Zonal Manager - Molecular Lab Your Opportunity In this role you will be responsible for total account management and selling the full Molecular portfolio. You will have the responsibility to drive molecular business in Bhubaneswar and the states of Odisha, Bihar, and Jharkhand . Understanding of the market and also willingness to travel for better penetration in the given territory will be required. You will manage channel partners. Exposure of working with Molecular segment would be added preference. As part of the Roche Molecular portfolio you will also be positioning IT solutions that will connect instruments across the continuum of care in both inpatient and outpatient settings. This position requires conducting presentations and business reviews to potential customers thereby demonstrating in-depth knowledge of our product line, as well as relevant healthcare/industry trends including related products or services. Role Responsibilities:
• Generates new customer demand and expansion for Molecular products.
• Penetrates large, complex accounts to gain access to and favor with all buying influences and key decision makers.
• Demonstrates strong clinical and financial acuity with ability to listen and understand customer needs and align Roche Molecular products within segment.
• Translates customers’ defined business/technical and personal goals into internal action while balancing key business priorities and goals.
• Balances the need to advocate for customers while also demonstrating the drive and ability to negotiate and achieve strong business results for Roche.
• Develops territory-specific executional strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
• Applies competitive, customer, and product knowledge to establish competitive barriers.
• Works cross functionally with internal colleagues and peers to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.
• Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations.
• Conducts system demonstrations & presentations where applicable; Molecular Committee Meetings, Trade Shows, VIPS, etc. Who you are
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience
• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience Preferred Qualifications
• 5+ years of field sales experience in Molecular Diagnostics/ Oncology
• 5+ years of experience negotiating contracts with Integrated Health Networks
• 5+ years of experience driving revenue growth via strategic territory development Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Purpose Support the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies), to ensure an efficient and effective PV system that complies with global Roche and local legal/regulatory authority PV requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate. Support the execution of IPS & Affiliate’s Patient Safety (APS) strategies, ensuring high-quality implementation of global and local safety solutions, while demonstrating leadership in ownership, collaboration, and decision-making within assigned responsibilities. Key Responsibilities PV System
• Execution of safety-related activities relevant to the PV (Pharmacovigilance) system through partnership with key stakeholders such as Patient Safety Operations and Affiliate PV Net, to ensure monitoring of the safety profile of Roche products and their safety risk management, meeting regulatory requirements, and ensuring license to operate. Proactively identify opportunities to optimize the PV system. Key areas of activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable):
• Individual Case Safety Reports (e.g. data collection)
• Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products
• Aggregate safety reports (e.g. submission to Health Authority)
• Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. PVA, Safety Data Exchange Agreement)
• Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues)
• Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., ICT, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP, Dicela)
• Safety Labeling and PV Commitments
• (Local) Pharmacovigilance System Master File
• As a contributor, shape country PV regulations and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem according to APS grouping, particularly to promote regulatory reliance and international harmonization in partnership with (including but not limited to) local pharma industry associations, healthcare organizations, patient groups etc. (e.g. simplification of local implementation of aRMM together with trade associations and HA). Local Safety Risk Management (according to APS grouping)
• Identify, analyze and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.
• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.
• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team. Further responsibilities may include assuming additional roles (e.g. RMP IC, core or extended member of the Affiliate Safety Disease Area Communities (ASDACs), Safety Responsible for MAP and DiCELA, Disease Area Expert, PV System Expert). Who you are: Education/Qualifications
• Qualification and/or Degree in life science or healthcare-related discipline (e.g., PharmD, MSc, BSc, Nursing, etc.). Experience
• Proven experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting •

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Executivo de Vendas, você será responsável por superar os objetivos comerciais da Roche Diagnóstica por meio do desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias comerciais de impacto. Você irá colaborar para o crescimento do negócio, através de metas que visam garantir a sustentabilidade do negócio e a retenção/conquista de novos clientes, além de assegurar continuamente a melhoria da experiência dos clientes com os nossos produtos e serviços. Você terá também a responsabilidade de apoiar o Gerente de Contas Estratégicas na execução da estratégia nacional voltada ao cliente público, com foco especial no Ministério da Saúde, suas secretarias vinculadas, autarquias reguladoras e centros de referência. Além da atuação comercial, você deverá desenvolver um relacionamento institucional de alto nível, identificar oportunidades estratégicas, apoiar a execução contratual e atuar como elo entre os diversos stakeholders internos e externos, assegurando a sustentabilidade e expansão dos negócios com o setor público. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Identificar oportunidades e promover soluções para sustentar e ampliar a base de clientes, priorizando clientes foco e metas definidas no "Valor em Ação".
• Construir planos de contas com base nas necessidades, metas, estratégias e ambiente de negócios dos clientes, fortalecendo o relacionamento.
• Cumprir metas de desempenho relacionadas a vendas, rentabilidade, NPS e outros indicadores, promovendo iniciativas sustentáveis para aumento de resultados.
• Liderar e executar Planos de Contas Estratégicas alinhados aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa, com foco em impacto de curto, médio e longo prazo.
• Gerenciar informações e contatos dos clientes no CRM, garantindo transparência, consistência e pipeline de vendas atualizado.
• Criar e manter relações transparentes e duradouras com KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) e conectar os clientes a diferentes áreas da Roche.
• Identificar oportunidades em eventos, gerenciar leads e assegurar transições eficazes entre segmentos ou equipes, garantindo excelência no atendimento.
• Prover informações estratégicas, atender auditorias e melhorar KPIs de eficiência operacional para oferecer uma ótima experiência ao cliente. Quem você é:
• Apoio à Estratégia do Ministério: Você irá apoiar o gerente de contas estratégicas na execução da estratégia do MS, identificando sinergias com estados e municípios em ações descentralizadas. Acompanha iniciativas de políticas públicas de saúde que impactam a atuação da empresa, sugerindo ações proativas
• Prospecção de Oportunidades: você vai identificar editais, projetos-piloto, chamadas públicas e parcerias estratégicas, conectadas com a agenda do Ministério da Saúde. Monitorar e relatar iniciativas estaduais e locais alinhadas com diretrizes federais (ex: Planos Estaduais de Saúde, programas estratégicos
• Biologia Molecular: você tem experiência comprovada no segmento de biologia molecular, relacionamento com os principais stakeholders e decisores no Ministério da Saúde, bem como nos centros de referência tais como: INCA, Fiocruz, IAL (Instituto Adolf Lutz, etc). Representa a empresa em reuniões, fóruns, câmaras técnicas e eventos públicos relevantes.
• Execução Operacional e de Contratos: você acompanha a execução técnica de contratos públicos, garantindo aderência aos SLAs e resolução de entraves técnicos e administrativos. Contribuir na coleta de dados para análises de desempenho, elaboração de relatórios, estudos técnicos e processos de ren

To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Opportunity This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, External Manufacturing Services, Logistics, Research & Laboratory Materials, and Engineering (CAPEX). Within Research & Laboratory Materials, we cover two categories:
• Lab Chemicals & Consumables (LCC)
• Lab Equipment & Maintenance (LEM) This structure enables strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers. As a Procurement Manager, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in project management and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third-party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category Strategy Owner in charge of driving, coordinating, and signing the category strategy. You will collaborate with internal procurement functions (such as Business Partners, Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive LEM/LCC sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives. You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to-day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer-oriented projects/solutions. As a Procurement Manager, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and business requirements, including but not limited to:
• You are a category and sourcing subject matter expert, conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source, negotiate, and manage suppliers in this space to maximize value for Roche.
• You are a procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies, and project management s

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Diagnostics Cape Town is seeking a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist to join their team on a 1 year fixed-term contract . As a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist you will conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding, whilst maintaining quality and managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives. You will play a vital role in ensuring the high-quality production of life-saving molecular solutions. You will join a collaborative team where technical precision meets a passion for patient impact. Key Challenges
• Conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding while managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives or schedules.
• Assumes responsibility for the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of production work or testing activities. Summarizes batch or experimental results, and uses technical writing skills to produce clear reports, documents, and summaries.Effectively communicate results/ experimental outcomes and project status to supervisor and/or project leaders, proactively highlighting significant findings or critical problem areas.
• Analyzes and interprets test results, experimental data using various data analysis software, spreadsheets and or applying quantitative methods. Present findings at internal team meetings as required.
• Assumes accountability for batch record, hard copy or electronic lab notebook documentation, ensuring experimental methods and results are recorded timely, accurately and consistently, and according to established formats.
• May troubleshoot issues related to equipment or instrumentation. With guidance, analyzes and brainstorms alternative approaches to solve problems, makes recommendations and implements solutions to solve problems.
• Establish and maintain positive internal, cross-functional, and (where applicable) customer relationships.
• Other duties as assigned by management. Who You Are as an Ideal Candidate Qualifications and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Chemical/Biochemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
• 3 years of relevant industry experience or general laboratory experience In the absence of relevant qualifications, experience in the relevant field and at the relevant level will be considered. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
• Ability to execute relevant laboratory experimentation. Hands-on experience with standard molecular biology and biochemistry lab techniques.
• Demonstrated ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Manufacturing Instructions (MI) and Work Instructions (WI) documents. Working knowledge of relevant international ISO Standards (13485) would be advantageous.
• Demonstrated competency in reading and completing charts, forms, and other documents.
• Ability to use a personal computer with basic word-processing and spreadsheet applications.
• Excellent written and verbal communication and personal task management skills
• Accountability, the ability to multitask, perform consistently under pressure and work without supervision.
• Experience and understanding of protein purification techniques and enzyme analysis. Experience with AKTAs (FPLC) or HPLC w

• 職務内容
• 医療機関の臨床検査室を中心に、生化学(血液検査等)・免疫検査用の試薬・
• 検査機器などの提案営業をお任せします。
• 担当数は10～20施設。
• 病院の経営層(事務長・院長等)や臨床検査技師などの現場担当者と

• ◎モノ売りではなく、自分のアイデアでお客様の課題解決に貢献したい方

• ◎将来はグローバルな視点で活躍したい方

＜必要資格＞
必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You will be:
• Co-ordinate with SSC KL Finance teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T&E, Compliance and Procurement) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with month-end close checklist.
• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE
• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc
• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.
• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.
• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory. Who you are :
• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.
• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.
• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.
• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Ab

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a Customer Account Manager for our Managed Service Contracts in the North region, you will act as the vital link between Roche and our healthcare partners. You will ensure our customers receive a superior experience while bringing their voice directly into our organization to shape the future of diagnostics.
• Build meaningful partnerships: Develop and maintain long-term commercial relationships across all levels of your assigned customer base.
• Drive strategic value: Connect customer business goals with Roche’s product and service suite to support their success during periods of healthcare transformation.
• Lead service delivery: Co-create Strategic account plans and coordinate cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical Services) to ensure seamless execution.
• Manage the lifecycle: Oversee the full customer experience for our Optimall branded Managed Services, serving as the primary point of escalation for Roche and third-party partners.
• Foster a culture of excellence: Champion the "voice of the customer" internally to ensure we continue to "do now what patients need next." Who You Are You are a strategic thinker and a passionate customer advocate who thrives on delivering value and building resilient commercial relationships.
• Experienced Account Manager: You bring a proven track record in contract management and commercial engagement within the healthcare sector.
• Strategic & Analytical: You possess the ability to interrogate large datasets to draw meaningful insights (Advanced Excel) and understand complex business workflows.
• Collaborative Leader: You are skilled at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while working alongside experts in technical support, finance, and marketing.
• Effective Communicator: You are a strong listener who can identify pain points and develop clear solutions, maintaining a professional demeanor under pressure.
• Education: You are educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant field. Together, we’ll create a healthier, brighter future for all. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of Roche Products Ltd. At Roche Products we believe diversity drives innovation and we are committed to building a diverse and flexible working environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion or belief, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, disability or age. We recognise the importance of flexible working and will review all applicants’ requests with care. At Ro

The Position El Especialista en Sistemas de Salud (Healthcare System Partner - HSP) a nivel central es un líder en Roche que trabaja muy de cerca con hospitales privados, aseguradoras, administradoras de salud y ecosistema general mercado privado. Actúa en los diferentes niveles de su ecosistema y con los diferentes actores del cuidado de la salud privado tales como responsables de formular políticas y procedimientos, tomadores de decisión en los sistemas de aseguradoras, personal administrativo y de finanzas, área médica, etc. Construye relaciones confiables y estratégicas con los directivos y administradores en el sector y pueda anticipar las barreras de acceso y cumplir con las agendas, planes y objetivos en este mercado. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Gestiona, administra, genera, prioriza y ejerce los recursos, para impulsar soluciones que entreguen resultados más rápidamente en su ecosistema.
• El Especialista en Sistemas de Salud (HSP) a nivel central para el sector privado, actúa de conformidad con el modelo del líder Visionario, Arquitecto, Coach, Catalizador (VACC), es catalizador y coach interna y externamente.
• Colabora estrechamente y reúne la experiencia de diferentes áreas a nivel local y en la red de Roche, según sea necesario, incluyendo a otros Especialistas en Sistemas de Salud (HSPs) y Especialistas en Experiencia del Paciente (PJPs), MVLs, equipo de economía de la salud, precio, etc.
• Alcanza un profundo entendimiento de su ecosistema, da seguimiento y se actualiza en las tendencias y patrones de los sistemas de salud, particularmente del ecosistema de salud bajo su responsabilidad.
• Provee a Roche del conocimiento de su ecosistema que tiene para trabajar estratégicamente y brindar experiencia, ciencia y conocimiento al Ecosistema bajo su responsabilidad.
• Desarrolla las estrategias y coordina los proyectos de inclusión de los medicamentos e indicaciones terapéuticas nuevas aprobadas por la Cofepris para que el formulario de medicamentos de las aseguradoras cuenten con los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche así como participar en las licitaciones y concretar los contratos y adjudicaciones para los medicamentos de Roche en este sector.
• Coordina el trabajo estratégico para este sector y junto con el chapter médico y el equipo de economía de la salud y de precios brindar la información médica, económica y de precios que apoyen el rápido acceso de nuestros medicamentos en este sector.
• Trabaja junto con los directivos y administradores para detectar posibles barreras para mejorar la calidad de atención de los pacientes y junto con ellas busca posibles soluciones para mejorar los ecosistemas del sector para beneficio de los pacientes a nivel público. Trabaja en forma coordinada con los equipos de Roche en la entrega de los mensajes médicos y FE que sustentan el uso de nuestros medicamentos.
• Participa con los squads para definir y alinear las estrategias de acceso para este sector bajo su responsabilidad, así como la detección de obstáculos y oportunidades para que los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche se incluyan para beneficio lo más rápidamente posible de los pacientes en este sector. Tu perfil: La persona en esta posición tiene la capacidad de colaborar y construir relaciones con diversos actores en el ecosistema de atención médica. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Gestionar y expandir la operación comercial de las cuentas asignadas, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad, alineados con el código de conducta Roche, normativas locales y lineamientos corporativos.
• Liderar negociaciones estratégicas e implementar soluciones integrales adaptadas a las necesidades de los clientes, desarrollando propuestas de valor basadas en un entendimiento profundo de sus operaciones y desafíos.
• Construir y fortalecer relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y stakeholders clave, brindando una experiencia superior de servicio, realizando visitas estratégicas y participando activamente en actividades externas como congresos, talleres y jornadas.
• Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y contribuir al desarrollo de cuentas estratégicas, apoyando procesos de licitación, análisis de mercado, actualización de CRM y colaboración interdisciplinaria enfocada en el paciente y el cliente.
• Impulsar una cultura de trabajo colaborativa y de crecimiento continuo, participando en iniciativas internas, fortaleciendo habilidades comerciales y contribuyendo al desarrollo y capacitación de nuevos integrantes del equipo. Tu Perfil:
• Profesional del área de la salud, idealmente Tecnólogo Médico o Bioquímico, con residencia en Temuco y disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la zona asignada.
• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en el área comercial de soluciones diagnósticas para laboratorio clínico, idealmente en entornos de diagnóstico clínico, equipos médicos o industrias relacionadas.
• Deseable formación en ventas profesionales, manejo de herramientas CRM como Salesforce, y conocimientos comerciales orientados a negociación estratégica y desarrollo de cuentas.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio o avanzado, junto con capacidad de trabajo en equipo, mirada corporativa y pensamiento estratégico orientado a equipos de alto desempeño. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Demand Generation Specialist aplica una profunda comprensión de los productos de la empresa, la industria competitiva y la postura de la empresa en el mercado. Crea informes y realiza análisis a partir de vehículos de seguimiento de alcance/respuesta. Analiza los resultados de las promociones y hace recomendaciones para refinar los esfuerzos para generar mejor la demanda de productos. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Diseñar y orquestar la estrategia omnicanal, actuando como embajador ante el equipo de PJPs para impulsar su adopción.
• Facilitar la conexión y la comunicación entre las especialidades involucradas para asegurar un manejo multidisciplinario integral del paciente.
• Capacitar a los profesionales de la salud (HCPs) en el diagnóstico y la referenciación temprana y oportuna de pacientes con HCC.
• Liderar el seguimiento y la navegación de pacientes desde estas tres especialidades hasta el oncólogo (en sinergia con el equipo PSP y Navegadora).
• Gestionar la realización de pruebas diagnósticas (PSP) para una mayor detección de pacientes elegibles.
• Desarrollar el Account Mastery en cuentas prioritarias y segundos niveles referidores.
• Establecer sinergias con los PJPs del ecosistema para garantizar una navegación efectiva y maximizar el impacto prescriptivo de los oncólogos.
• Identificar nuevas necesidades y oportunidades en el ecosistema. Contribuir a la descentralización de la atención sanitaria para optimizar el manejo de los stakeholders implicados.
• Robustecer el conocimiento del mercado y la estrategia de negocio a través de la generación de insights sólidos y accionables. Tu perfil: La persona en esta posición posee la c apacidad de asumir múltiples funciones y responsabilidades en un entorno complejo y en constante evolución, y habilidad para liderar proyectos interfuncionales sin autoridad formal.
• Formación Académica: Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Salud (Medicina, Biología, Farmacia, Químico Farmacobiólogo) o Licenciatura en Negocios/Administración/Marketing con enfoque o experiencia demostrada en la industria farmacéutica.
• 1 a 3 años en roles dentro de la industria farmacéutica o biotecnológica, espeen el área médica, comercial, acceso a mercado, o roles híbridos médico-comerciales con enfoque en hospitales de alta especialidad
• Experiencia en diseño e implementación de estrategias digitales (CRM, plataformas de engagement , análisis de datos digitales).
• Experiencia demostrada en áreas como Oncología, Hepatología o Gastroenterología.
• Capacidad para analizar datos de mercado y desempeño (KPIs) para la toma de decisiones estratégicas. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Crea informes y realiza análisis a partir de vehículos de seguimiento de alcance/respuesta. Analiza los resultados de las promociones y hace recomendaciones para refinar los esfuerzos para generar mejor la demanda de productos. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Diseñar y orquestar la estrategia omnicanal, actuando como embajador ante el equipo de PJPs para impulsar su adopción.
• Facilitar la conexión y la comunicación entre las especialidades involucradas para asegurar un manejo multidisciplinario integral del paciente.
• Capacitar a los profesionales de la salud (HCPs) en el diagnóstico y la referenciación temprana y oportuna de pacientes con HCC.
• Liderar el seguimiento y la navegación de pacientes desde estas tres especialidades hasta el oncólogo (en sinergia con el equipo PSP y Navegadora).
• Gestionar la realización de pruebas diagnósticas (PSP) para una mayor detección de pacientes elegibles.
• Desarrollar el Account Mastery en cuentas prioritarias y segundos niveles referidores.
• Establecer sinergias con los PJPs del ecosistema para garantizar una navegación efectiva y maximizar el impacto prescriptivo de los oncólogos.
• Identificar nuevas necesidades y oportunidades en el ecosistema. Contribuir a la descentralización de la atención sanitaria para optimizar el manejo de los stakeholders implicados.
• Robustecer el conocimiento del mercado y la estrategia de negocio a través de la generación de insights sólidos y accionables. Tu perfil: La persona en esta posición posee la c apacidad de asumir múltiples funciones y responsabilidades en un entorno complejo y en constante evolución, y habilidad para liderar proyectos interfuncionales sin autoridad formal.
• Formación Académica: Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Salud (Medicina, Biología, Farmacia, Químico Farmacobiólogo) o Licenciatura en Negocios/Administración/Marketing con enfoque o experiencia demostrada en la industria farmacéutica.
• 1 a 3 años en roles dentro de la industria farmacéutica o biotecnológica, espeen el área médica, comercial, acceso a mercado, o roles híbridos médico-comerciales con enfoque en hospitales de alta especialidad
• Experiencia en diseño e implementación de estrategias digitales (CRM, plataformas de engagement , análisis de datos digitales).
• Experiencia demostrada en áreas como Oncología, Hepatología o Gastroenterología.
• Capacidad para analizar datos de mercado y desempeño (KPIs) para la toma de decisiones estratégicas. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Spécialiste du service client Lieu: Campus Roche Diagnostics (Laval) - Hybride Durée : contrat d'un an Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. À faire progresser continuellement la science et à garantir à tous l'accès aux soins de santé dont ils ont besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Nous recherchons un(e) spécialiste du service client pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact significatif sur notre organisation. En tant que spécialiste du service client, vous aurez l'occasion de développer des relations de confiance solides avec nos précieux clients, en veillant à une expérience d'approvisionnement positive. En identifiant proactivement les besoins des clients et en collaborant avec notre équipe, vous contribuerez à améliorer et à adapter l'expérience globale du client. Vos solides compétences en leadership et en influence vous permettront de remettre en question le statu quo et de rechercher l'efficacité, en faisant des recommandations qui garantissent un service fiable et constant. Par-dessus tout, vos compétences exceptionnelles en communication et votre capacité d'écoute active seront la clé de la réussite dans ce rôle. Rejoignez notre équipe et saisissez cette opportunité passionnante pour une croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Postulez maintenant et laissez votre passion pour des expériences client exceptionnelles briller en tant que spécialiste du service client. L'opportunité
• Vous gérez les solutions de lots réservés pour tous les clients du Canada, en veillant au respect des politiques et des procédures de Roche. En collaboration étroite avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurez de l'exactitude des données et de la gestion des demandes des clients, des renouvellements et de la maintenance des contrats pour assurer un flux de commandes efficace.
• Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse et de la communication avec les clients concernant les problèmes de lots réservés, ainsi que de la transmission des besoins des clients à l'équipe de planification.
• Vous gérez des comptes spécialisés avec des exceptions logistiques, en maintenant et en gérant des "accords planifiés" pour tous les clients/territoires afin d'assurer des niveaux élevés d'exactitude des données.
• Vous prenez les appels des clients et apportez un soutien à leurs demandes, en collaborant avec les équipes régionales pour offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement exceptionnelle.
• Vous comprenez les plaintes logistiques des clients et vous efforcez de trouver des solutions satisfaisantes. Vous identifiez et proposez des améliorations aux processus manuels et aux tâches de service client sans valeur ajoutée.
• Vous êtes responsable des ajustements de facture (crédits/débits) conformément aux procédures, le cas échéant.
• Vous analysez les rapports quotidiens, élaborez des plans d'action pour traiter les commandes en cours et communiquez tout retard ou changement de délai de livraison et de traitement aux clients à des fins de planification. Qui vous êtes
• Vous possédez un diplôme collégial ou un diplôme universitaire (administration ou commerce préférable).
• Vous possédez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle dans le domaine des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie.
• Vous faites preuve de compétences en leadership et avez une passion pour la collab

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position El Medical Ecosystem Partner (MEP) está en el centro de la nueva organización en Roche, desafiando el papel que jugamos en la sociedad para pasar de ofrecer medicamentos de clase mundial a construir alianzas, co-crear, innovar y liderar la atención médica. Es directamente responsable de entregar los mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización de una manera más rápida. El objetivo de esta función es también colaborar con la comunidad científica y médica externa para proporcionar información clara, científicamente sólida, coherente y oportuna sobre nuestros productos, servicios y áreas de enfermedad, y recopilar información externa relevante para la estrategia general. La Oportunidad
• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.
• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.
• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.
• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.
• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.
• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”
• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.
• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.
• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.
• Participa de forma significativa con las comunidades globales y regionales pertinentes, participando activamente (compartiendo experiencias y participando en grupos de trabajo) y defendiendo el valor de las redes y la colaboración.
• Trabaja en conjunto con el Squad y el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes y lograr que se generen publicaciones
• Cuenta con entendimiento profundo del ecosistema médico (médico tratante, tomadores de decisión en instituciones públicas y privadas, asociaciones médicas y de pacientes) para encontrar oportunidades y moldearlo, facilitando que más pacientes reciban mejores solucion

• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.
• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.
• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.
• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.
• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.
• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”
• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.
• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.
• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Backlog Elaboration Team Lead The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an accomplished Systems Engineer with a strong background in end-to-end new product development programs and successful launches, you will play the role of Backlog Elaboration Team Lead being at the forefront of leading Roche Tissue Diagnostics’ design & development programs. Using the Agile method of development, you will primarily focus on the prioritization, definition, estimation, tracking and continuous maintenance of solution level backlog by heavily collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders. The Opportunity
• You will facilitate and improve Backlog Elaboration by leading backlog elaboration meetings, ensuring they are productive and owning the project’s backlog elaboration WiKi site.
• You will collaborate and seek guidance from the program’s Solution Train Engineer to continuously iterate and refine processes with a goal to have backlogs sequenced, defined & estimated for confident predictability and project schedule tracking.
• You will manage interdependencies by developing a deep understanding of System, Software, Assay, Consumables and Hardware teams & the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to ensure that all Epics, Capabilities & Features are clearly defined & documented in the backlog.
• You will continually look for ways of enhancing tools (such as Azure DevOps and Lucid) and communication by streamlining our workflow, be the central point of contact for backlog-related communications & engaging with a wide range of stakeholders (including Product Managers, ART leads, and senior leadership) to align everyone towards a unified goal.
• You will strategize and plan for the future by developing and communicating yearly backlog goals that provide clear direction for the teams. This includes implementing Agile SAFe's rolling-wave planning approach involving detailed planning for upcoming Program Increments while keeping a high-level view of future PIs. Over time, this role can grow into co-facilitating PI Planning with the Solution Train Engineer. Who you are
• An Agile & SAFe expert with strong understanding of Agile principles including backlog elaboration, just-in-time planning, and rolling-wave planning. You must know how to apply these concepts to maintain a healthy and predictive backlog.
• An expert at organizational & planning skills to effectively manage complex backlogs, track dependencies across multiple teams (SW, Assay, System, etc.), and maintain the Project Backlog Elaboration wiki. The ability to sequence work and ensure a high-level project schedule will be a direct outcome of this skill.
• While not a developer, you must have a solid grasp of the development lifecycle and key milestone deliverables. This technical acumen & understanding is crucial for effective communication and for ensuring that backlog items are well-defined and feasible.
• Expert in using Azure DevOps and Lucid tools is essential. You'll be responsible for driving tool improvements and using these platforms to manage and visualize the backlog, dependencies, and project flow.
• An excellent facilitator & communicator. This role requires strong skills in facilitating meetings and communicating with diverse stakeholders, from team members

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer. Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story. As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes. The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT. What you will be working on: You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.
• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals
• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals
• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events
• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment
• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience
• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes
• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.
• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics. Who you are: You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:
• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity
• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system
