This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer. Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story. As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes. The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT. What you will be working on: You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.
• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals
• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals
• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events
• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment
• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience
• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes
• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.
• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics. Who you are: You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:
• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity
• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our hubs and nodes.. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role. In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs. We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence! The Opportunity
• End-to-End Inventory Management: Accountable to ensure global product availability across all regional and central warehouse locations for a defined portfolio, including the strategic setting and continuous monitoring of global safety levels.
• Supply Planning & Optimization: Responsible for the creation and accuracy of global supply plans by aligning demand inputs with manufacturing and supplier capabilities; provides robust recommendations regarding Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP).
• Lifecycle & Launch Coordination: Accountable to liaise with functional leads and lifecycle teams to manage complex product transitions, ensuring seamless availability during critical launch and phase-out periods.
• Operational Execution & Data Integrity: Responsible for the ongoing optimization and accuracy of MRP master data and executes logistics interventions, including batch reservations, to guarantee uninterrupted product flow during emergencies.
• Crisis Management & S&OP Leadership : Serves as the primary lead for initiating escalation

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Anatomic Pathology Solutions Manager L'opportunità Il responsabile delle soluzioni di patologia anatomica nella diagnostica dei tessuti è responsabile della protezione e della crescita delle porzioni IHC, H&E e Special Stains del business insieme a piattaforme aggiuntive, guidando il business stesso e attraverso altri. Si tratta di un ruolo specifico per le vendite dei singoli collaboratori con responsabilità di leadership informali. Attuazione piani di vendita progettati per raggiungere i ricavi consolidati e obiettivi finanziari. Conosce e comprende il panorama competitivo Advanced Stain, inclusi prodotti, strumenti di vendita e prezzi per RTD e tutti i concorrenti. Leva le relazioni commerciali attuali per mantenere e crescere la base clienti attuale. Lavora in coordinamento con Account Manager e Strategic Account Managers per chiedere ai clienti attuali e prospettici. Ha una conoscenza completa dei prodotti e dei servizi aziendali, e visto come un esperto della società e dei clienti. Può essere incaricato di vendite di prodotti nuovi o strategici. Funziona su problemi di varia portata in cui l'analisi dei dati richiede la valutazione di fattori identificabili. Dimostra buon giudizio nella scelta di metodi e tecniche per ottenere soluzioni. Reti con personale interno ed esterno nella propria area di competenza. Si concentra su conti critici, grandi, complessi, ad alta visibilità, strategici o tatticamente importanti. Agisce indipendentemente per determinare metodi e procedure su incarichi nuovi o speciali. Fatti di lavoro:
• Responsabile del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso azioni quotidiane.
• assume un ruolo di leadership attivo durante lo sviluppo e l'attuazione delle strategie di vendita di attrezzature di capitale per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita assegnati. Intimazia con società e dinamica di mercato competitiva.
• Fornisce una leadership professionale nella pianificazione, nell'organizzazione e nel controllo della crescita delle vendite equilibrata, della penetrazione continua del conto e della soddisfazione del cliente.
• Utilizza una forte conoscenza del prodotto/mercato e un'esperienza di vendita per gestire le vendite complesse e risolvere le domande e le preoccupazioni del cliente.
• Costruire costantemente la conoscenza delle attuali tendenze del settore, delle informazioni concorrenziali e delle conoscenze e delle azioni industriali/tecniche con altri colleghi Roche.
• Responsabile della gestione efficace dell'imbuto di vendita mediante l'identificazione delle opportunità e la creazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni.
• Stabilisce e lavora con Account Manager e Strategic Account Manager per costruire forti relazioni con i clienti che consentono crescita, redditività e prevedibilità. Comunica con altre funzioni Roche rilevanti per garantire il supporto di vendita necessario e la consegna di programmi / prodotti.
• Utilizza efficacemente i team di supporto per le vendite e le operazioni interne per far avanzare la vendita. Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea o un'esperienza equivalente
• Ha 5 anni di vendite rilevanti o esperienza equivalente Preferito:
• Competenza in attività e strumentazione competitiva, paesaggio di rimborso e tutte le altre linee di prodotto.
• Presenza di leadership e acume aziendale con una comprensione del paesaggio di laboratorio IHC e Anatomic Pathology e la capacità di creare/fornare soluzioni con gli altri.
• Deve avere dimostrato successo nella precedente capacità di vendita, utilizzando competenze di vendita consultive, insieme con la leadership dimostrata e l'eccellenza della comunicazione.
• Presenza e capacità di comunicazione necessaria con la capacità di creare e presentare presentazioni di gruppo impattanti. Questa è una posizione basata sul campo - il

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Gestionnaire de solutions de pathologie anatomique L'opportunité Le gestionnaire de solutions de pathologie anatomique en diagnostic tissulaire est chargé de protéger et de développer les parties de l'entreprise IHC, H&E et Special Stains ainsi que de regrouper d'autres plateformes, de conduire les affaires elles-mêmes et par l'intermédiaire d'autres. Il s'agit d'un rôle individuel de spécialiste des ventes avec des responsabilités de leadership informelles. Mettre en oeuvre des plans de vente conçus pour atteindre les objectifs financiers et financiers établis. Connaître et comprendre le paysage concurrentiel Advanced Staining, y compris les produits, les outils de vente et les prix pour la RDT et tous les concurrents. Exploiter les relations d'affaires actuelles pour maintenir et accroître la clientèle actuelle. Travailler en coordination avec les gestionnaires de comptes et les gestionnaires de comptes stratégiques pour faire appel à la perspective et aux clients actuels. A une connaissance complète des produits et services de l'entreprise, et considéré comme un expert par l'entreprise et les clients. Peut être chargé de la vente de produits nouveaux ou stratégiques. Travaille sur des problèmes de portée diverse où l'analyse des données nécessite une évaluation de facteurs identifiables. Démontrer un bon jugement dans le choix des méthodes et des techniques pour obtenir des solutions. Réseaux avec du personnel interne et externe dans son propre domaine d'expertise. Se concentre sur des comptes critiques, importants, complexes, à haute visibilité, stratégiques ou d'importance tactique. Agir de manière indépendante pour déterminer les méthodes et procédures applicables aux affectations nouvelles ou spéciales. Faits sur l'emploi :
• Responsable du maintien et de l'amélioration continue du système de qualité et de la réalisation des objectifs de qualité par des actions quotidiennes.
• Suppose un rôle de leadership actif lors de l'élaboration et de la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de vente d'équipement pour atteindre les objectifs de vente assignés. Intimité avec l'entreprise et dynamique du marché concurrentiel.
• Fournit un leadership professionnel dans la planification, l'organisation et le contrôle de la croissance équilibrée des ventes, la pénétration continue des comptes et la satisfaction des clients.
• Utilise une solide connaissance des produits/marchés et une expérience de vente pour gérer les ventes complexes et résoudre les questions et les préoccupations des clients.
• Développer continuellement la connaissance des tendances actuelles de l'industrie, de l'information concurrentielle et des connaissances industrielles/techniques et partager avec d'autres collègues de Roche.
• Responsable de la gestion efficace de l'entonnoir de vente par l'identification des opportunités et la création et la mise en œuvre de solutions.
• Établir et collaborer avec les gestionnaires de comptes et les gestionnaires de comptes stratégiques afin d'établir de solides relations avec la clientèle qui permettent la croissance, la rentabilité et la prévisibilité. Communique avec d'autres fonctions pertinentes de Roche afin d'assurer le soutien des ventes et l'exécution des programmes et des produits nécessaires.
• Utiliser efficacement les équipes internes d'appui aux ventes et aux opérations pour faire avancer la vente. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous possédez un baccalauréat ou une expérience équivalente
• Vous possédez 5 ans ou plus d'expérience pertinente Préféré:
• Expertise en affaires et instruments concurrentiels, paysage de remboursement, et toutes les autres gammes de produits.
• Présence dirigeante et esprit d'entreprise avec une compréhension du paysage de laboratoire de l'IHC et de la pathologie anatomique et la capacité de créer/conduire des solutions avec d'autres.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for an experienced and passionate Legal Counsel to join our Legal team at Roche Diagnostics Turkiye. In this role, you will play a key part in protecting our reputation and supporting strategic decision-making with expert legal guidance. What will you do? As a Legal Counsel, you will be a strategic partner for Roche, providing proactive and commercially focused legal services and solutions. You will oversee legal compliance, mitigate risks, support corporate governance, and advise on business operations. Your role includes managing contracts, handling litigation, monitoring regulatory developments, and ensuring company policies align with legal requirements. Key responsibilities include:
• Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating bilingual legal documents such as contracts and agreements.
• Leading key contract negotiations and maintaining Roche’s contract template pool.
• Keeping company departments updated on changes in laws and recent cases, assessing potential risks, and offering legal solutions.
• Handling litigation to safeguard Roche’s legal rights and interests.
• Managing corporate maintenance topics, including company registration and corporate filings.
• Overseeing external legal counsel on various legal matters.
• Providing legal support for commercial and operational projects.
• Delivering legal training to employees and third parties, such as distributors and suppliers.
• Managing legal department reporting responsibilities and documentation. Who are you? As a Legal Counsel, you are a proactive and business-minded legal professional with a strong ability to navigate complex regulatory environments. You thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic setting, and you bring the following qualifications and skills:
• A Bachelor’s Degree in Law (Master’s preferred).
• At least 6-7 years of experience in contract law, commercial law, and tender law.
• Strong expertise in developing business models and customer solutions that drive superior business results.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus).
• High adaptability and eagerness for continuous learning and self-development.
• Exceptional analytical, investigative, and organizational skills.
• Experience in the healthcare industry is an advantage. Why Roche? At Roche, we believe in fostering a culture of learning, innovation, and collaboration. We offer an environment where you have the freedom to shape your role in a way that aligns with your strengths and ambitions. Diversity and inclusion are at the core of our identity, and we encourage you to bring your authentic self to work every day. What do we offer?
• A dynamic and market-leading company with national and international career opportunities.
• A chance to make a meaningful impact by improving the lives of patients worldwide.
• An agile and people-focused work environment, where autonomy and decision-making are valued.
• Opportunities for personal and professional growth, with Roche investing in your development. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions h

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for a SHE & Site Security Officer at Roche Diagnostics to lead and execute SHE (Safety, Health and Environment) and Site/Office Security agenda in the business. In this role, you will:
• Lead SHE and Site Security agenda in the business, provide SHE and Site Security guidance to GM and LT
• Responsibility for establishing, leading and delivering SHE management systems (incl. organization, documentation, goals and performance management, audits, CAPA, training awareness, communication, incident and emergency management, fire protection, security management, operational safety, environment, SHE business partner's management, product stewardship, etc.)
• Promote SHE and Site Security in the company based on local / Group Roche SHE objectives and goals. Ensure a safe environment for employees
• Communicate local and corporate SHE and Site Security requirements within the site and help to ensure compliance
• Ensure compliance with local legal SHE legislation and regulations, with Roche SHE directives and provisions, Roche Security requirements (K19), processes and policies so company, employees and customers are kept safe and secure
• Ensure that a Risk management and risk assessment process is implemented and documented, organize periodic SHE and Site Security inspections. Report critical SHE situations and critical security incidents to CSO
• Monitor, document and report SHE KPIs, trends towards SHE goals, implementation of SHE programs and action plans
• Being responsible for delivery of regular SHE/SS Onboarding training of new employees and regular trainings of the whole affiliate as per legal and Group SHE requirements
• Having responsibility for managing of Occupational Health agenda, including Medical checks; ensure close cooperation with People&Culture Department.
• Ensure regular communication of SHE related information, manage regular communication with Group SHE team
• Support BCM (Business Continuity Management) process, be an active member of the emergency management team
• Ensure Pandemic planning and plan activation in case of a need
• Manage critical issues / cases related to security of the company / site (including participation in investigations)
• Manage financial provisions for legacy health and environmental liabilities, together with the finance department
• Establish and maintain contacts with the local SHE authorities, professional organizations and associations, scientific bodies and the public, with law enforcement authorities / police.
• Manage and guide security/safety aspects of car fleet/company car usage. Close communication/collaboration with purchasing department in terms of car selection process from safety/emission/environment perspective
• Supporting procurement team in office landlord relations and future office strategy in context of Roche ways of working Qualification and Experience:
• University degree (preferably from engineering faculty)
• More than 5 years in a similar role and technical leadership experience
• Occasional travel is required for this role
• Spoken and written English & Turkish
• Project and change management skills
• Substantial experience working with diverse senior leaders
• Experience working in a matrix and multi-cultural environment
• Location: Istanbul/Turkey Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for gen

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Le Centre régional d'assistance à la clientèle basé à Burgess Hill, au Royaume-Uni, fournit un soutien technique et scientifique à notre clientèle à travers le Royaume-Uni, l'Irlande, le Danemark, la Finlande, la Norvège et la Suède. Ce poste est offert comme un rôle de soutien à distance basé en Finlande, idéalement proche de la Roche Diagnostics Bureau d'Oy Espoo, ou encore un bureau basé au Royaume-Uni, Burgess Hill (où l'attente est d'être dans un délai d'une heure de trajet et être dans le bureau la majorité du temps). Le rôle consistera principalement à fournir un support de performance à distance pour notre portefeuille d'instruments et de solutions SWA et Near Patient Care (NPC), ainsi que pour la formation des clients et des employés. Le champ de l'aide comprend les clients et les collègues de Roche au Royaume-Uni, en Irlande, au Danemark, en Finlande, en Norvège et en Suède. Vous excellerez dans l'art de dépanner et vous-même de fournir un excellent service à la clientèle. L'opportunité
• Dépanner les problèmes complexes d'analyse et de système à distance, en fournissant des résolutions rapides et efficaces pour protéger les opérations de laboratoire.
• Mener une formation technique et des produits de haute qualité à l'intention des clients et des collègues internes, à distance et sur des sites de formation désignés.
• Gérer et documenter avec diligence les demandes de renseignements et les plaintes des clients, en assurant l'alignement absolu sur notre système de qualité.
• Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes de terrain et les directeurs commerciaux pour améliorer la satisfaction de la clientèle et optimiser la rétention.
• Participer activement à l'examen des plaintes, à l'analyse des tendances et au suivi des résultats afin d'améliorer continuellement le service.
• Aider les équipes commerciales lors des appels d'offres en leur fournissant des démonstrations d'instruments et des réponses techniques. Il y aura une formation initiale intensive pour les six premiers mois du poste, dont certains seront dans nos centres de formation européens. Par la suite, vous devrez également suivre une formation périodique sur les opérations de soutien à la clientèle et les offres de produits à divers endroits. Qui vous êtes
• Contexte éducatif : vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en sciences biomédicales ou d'un domaine scientifique équivalent.
• Expérience de l'industrie: vous apportez une expérience pratique dans un environnement de laboratoire de diagnostic ou d'hôpital clinique, en mettant l'accent sur la chimie clinique ou l'immunologie.
• Résolveur de problèmes d'analyse: Vous possédez un état d'esprit de dépannage, avec la capacité d'aborder des problèmes de laboratoire complexes méthodiquement et travailler sous pression.
• Client Champion & Communicator: Vous êtes motivé par le dépassement des attentes, le partage des connaissances et le travail efficace dans un environnement riche et multiculturel.
• Connaissance de la langue: Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le finnois et l'anglais. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est la Finlande. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dedi

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who we are The internal value chain (IVC) for digital solutions team is acting as a linking pin across the organization to support global lifecycle teams and affiliates in the commercialization of digital solutions. The team is working on building the backoffice foundations for a successful digital business, along the customer journey “Subscribe-to-retire” digital products. The team provides the organization with fit-for-digital operational processes, innovative technology, analytics and global services. Responsabilities
• The position is part of the Internal Value Chain for Digital Solutions and integrated into the IVC Services Chapter
• Perform daily operational business services for digital products
• Collaborate with and provide services to lifecycle teams and affiliates
• Improve and standardize service processes for digital products
• Perform quality checks and measure service maturity
• Safeguard best-in-class operational support for our internal customers
• Provide project support focusing on the Services Responsibility of Operational Services for Lifecycle Teams
• Support product lifecycle teams with day-to-day operational back office processes:
• Material master data management: global master data creation and maintenance in DMS for digital products and services; maintenance of material master extension workflows for operations sites; support in the regional affiliates SAP systems
• Digital products access management: maintain unique form and process for affiliates to request access to cloud-based products; create and maintain admin/user accounts for end-customers; reconcile and extend/terminate accounts based on license agreements
• 3rd party management: execute ordering of integration services from 3rd party supplier per product; coordination and tracking of all steps / stakeholders involved in the process
• UDI & labeling: manage the E2E process for UDI and labeling, work with LCTs to gather all relevant information, create templates and submit data packages Responsibility of Operational Services for Affiliates
• Support affiliates with day-to-day operational back office processes
• Customer-related activities: regular monitoring of the process designed for digital products & services; training of the affiliates; execution of centralized services such as equipment creation
• First level support: support process execution in SAP/REXIS and other linked systems; monitoring of generic support mailbox; train selected key users
• Global commercial backoffice: generation of commercial documents in related systems, such as contracts, equipments, scheduling agreements
• Service quality measurement: calculate KPIs and perform quality checks to ensure effective and efficient service according to the agreed SLAs Responsibility of IVC Project Support
• Support the transformation of current operations to a global, centralized service organization
• Adapt new ways of working in an agile project environment
• Document processes and procedures for business services
• Support training and testing phases
• Identify improvement potential for effective & efficient service operations Who you are:
• Bachelor in Business Economics and / or Business Informatics / Information Technology and / or any corresponding study or practical experience
• Master’s degree preferred
• Fluent in English, additional languages beneficial Skills / Experience:
• Min 1-3 years of professional experience in:
• Commercial and/or finance functions
• Business pr

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE , you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide. This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions. This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation. Who We Are At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Step into the Future of IT with Roche! As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward. Your Mission Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction. Your Impact Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues. Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant. By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation. Your Core Responsibilities Reliability Engineering & Architecture
• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams
• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services
• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments
• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives
• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns
• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality) Incident Management & Continuous Improvement
• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation
• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through
• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards
• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effe

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Impacto sostenible Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones. La Oportunidad En Roche Diagnóstica buscamos un/a New Account Manager en Lima, Perú, con la misión de conquistar nuevas cuentas y expandir el acceso de más pacientes a soluciones médicas de alta calidad. A través de propuestas de valor disruptivas y modelos comerciales innovadores, serás el motor que impulse soluciones integradas en beneficio de los pacientes, el sistema de salud y la sostenibilidad de nuestra compañía. Responsabilidades:
• Estrategia y análisis de mercado: Evaluar el potencial del mercado, prospectar y segmentar clientes para diseñar estrategias de conquista personalizadas junto a los squads de trabajo.
• Liderazgo de propuestas de valor: Liderar la creación y ejecución de ofertas comerciales integradas que sumen consultoría, soluciones digitales, marketing y disease management .
• Crecimiento de negocio y Market Share: Identificar, desarrollar y cerrar oportunidades de negocio incremental, enfocándose en ganar cuentas de la competencia y expandir la participación de mercado.
• Modelos de negocio innovadores: Colaborar en la implementación de nuevas soluciones de valor y modelos comerciales adaptados a las necesidades específicas del cliente.
• Gestión de visitas clave: Planificar y ejecutar visitas de venta estratégicas bajo el enfoque One Roche Solutions , coordinando con otros roles para unificar mensajes clave y ofertas diferenciadoras.
• Gestión integral de ofertas: Supervisar la preparación de propuestas y ofertas comerciales en conjunto con el equipo de contratos para asegurar cierres exitosos.
• Coordinación interna y campo: Liderar la interacción de los squads de trabajo y coordinar con todas las áreas de la compañía para asegurar la firma del contrato, manteniendo cobertura nacional mediante visitas de campo. Quién eres:
• Título de 3er nivel en ciencias de la salud, negocios, marketing o similar es requerido, Título de 4to nivel de preferencia y nivel medio-alto de idioma inglés.
• Experiencia de 3 años en la industria de la salud, específicamente en diagnóstico. Experiencia de 3 años en funciones comerciales y apertura de nuevos clientes.
• Conocimiento de la dinámica y los participantes del mercado de IVD y de la industria: la problemática y soluciones para el laboratorio. Amplio conocimiento de la tecnología y marcas de los competidores.
• Conocimiento e interés de las áreas analíticas de laboratorio y sus tendencias y actualizaciones. Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La divisione “Pharma Site Services” di Roche Pharma è responsabile della progettazione e realizzazione di progetti di investimento innovativi, economici e orientati al GMP presso il sito Basel/Kaiseraugst. Con la logistica della posizione ci preoccupiamo anche di merci e spedizioni che vengono nella zona, sono memorizzati e distribuiti qui o lasciare la posizione. Inoltre, l'area rende la costruzione e l'ingegneria operativa, la gestione della qualità tecnica ed è responsabile per la risoluzione e la manutenzione dei problemi affidabili, compreso il funzionamento dell'infrastruttura richiesta. Sosteniamo la nostra gestione e i nostri clienti in impianti di produzione biotecnologica, chimica e galenica, edifici di laboratorio e edifici amministrativi. La divisione “Energies & Utilities” è responsabile a Basilea e Kaiseraugst per garantire l’approvvigionamento energetico e dei media, garantire il funzionamento dell’edificio e fornire servizi nel settore della manutenzione. Il Circle “Energies & Utilities – Operation E2E” garantisce il funzionamento affidabile, regolamentare e conveniente dei mezzi di riscaldamento, raffreddamento e processo, inclusi lo smaltimento e lo smaltimento. In questa posizione, garantire la disponibilità, il funzionamento normativo ed economico dei sistemi e mantenere i sistemi per conto dei nostri clienti. Sono responsabili per il funzionamento degli impianti, la risoluzione dei problemi, la manutenzione, le ottimizzazioni continue (energia, costi) e il supporto esterno dell'azienda. Si dovrebbe anche essere disposti a fornire servizio pict e lavorare su progetti. Possibilità:
• Sistemi di produzione di aria e di processo + reti di gas (N2, Co2, Arg) ecc. Manutenzione, gestione aziendale, miglioramento e sviluppo di sistemi e sistemi
• guida e gestione dei logbook
• Iniziazione dell'ammodernamento e dell'assistenza nella pianificazione dei costi
• Gestione della continuità aziendale per impianti e sistemi
• Gestione dei pezzi di ricambio
• interpretare il consumo energetico e ricavare misure
• Servizio Pikett nell'approvvigionamento energetico dell'area di Basilea (pressione, aria di processo, acqua fredda e produzione di salamoia e vari sistemi termici (40°C, acqua di raffreddamento 95°C Chi sei:
• Almeno tre anni di esperienza professionale nel funzionamento e nella manutenzione di apparecchiature di processo in un ambiente GMP
• L'esperienza pratica nell'approvvigionamento energetico è vantaggiosa.
• Nel funzionamento dei sistemi di controllo di processo di questi sistemi si pratica.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Role Purpose The Contract Record Processor is responsible for the upload of contract documents into the global contract database tool (GRACE/Contract Now or MyBuy). This ensures a compliant documentation of all contractual obligations of suppliers and Roche and makes contract related information available throughout the Global Procurement organization. By transmitting relevant contract data into transactional procurement systems this role is also responsible for enabling Shopping Cart and PO processing as well as automated contract call-offs. Thus, the role contributes to overall increase of transparency, data consistency and efficiency, in line with Procurement Strategy and Category objectives. During daily work the Contract Record Processor interacts with other roles to make sure that processes are running smoothly, especially with: Contract Requestor, Transactional Buyer, Contract Manager as well as Contract Record Teamlead and Contract Record SME. Primary responsibilities
• Continuous service delivery: Execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective contract management process and sub-processes. These activities comprise esp. the following:
• Assess contract upload/ update requests.
• Archive contract document by uploading it into contract database.
• Activate contract info.
• Transmit contract data into the operational procurement system, if relevant.
• Maintain contract records.
• Following working instructions: Follow the instructions of the Team Lead regarding the daily work coordination.
• Performance improvement: Contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of the team, by constantly gathering experience and improving the quality of task execution.
• Ticketing tool handling: Utilizing ticketing system for incoming requests and issues during daily service delivery.
• Support end-users and requestors: Support end users and requesters on system related questions, proper system usage, searching contract documents in the system, ensure relevant system usage and solve simple issues, etc.
• Channel process/ system change requests: Route request to relevant colleagues.
• Initiate supplier onboarding: trigger supplier registration in the vendor master data management system. Education, Experience and Skills Required
• Technical High School Diploma or Student of a Professional Career (+1 Year) - (Administration, Finance, Accounting, Industrial Engineer, Supply Chain or similar).
• 2+ years of experience on transactional Demand-to-Pay Process (Procurement buyer, Accounts Payable, Master Data, Contract Management) or Compliance/Legal positions.
• MS Office knowledge.
• Demonstrated problem solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills to varied stakeholder audiences.
• Team player with demonstrated strong interpersonal skills.
• Strong collaborator in a multi-cultural environment.
• Experience implementing legal records governance, classifying documents, archiving, and providing end user training across a broad region
• Requires expertise in working with electronic and hard copy information, and classifying information regardless of medium
• Strong computer skills; familiarity with Microsoft Office and Google suite and database functionality/concepts.
• Strong focus on collaboration and customer service
• Written and spoken fluency in English required Desired
• Experience with Procurement systems e.g. SRM.
• +2 years’ experie

The Position As an Regulatory Program Manager, you will play a crucial role in bringing innovative treatments to patients by shaping and executing global regulatory strategies. You will join a dynamic, collaborative global team, leading impactful interactions with Health Authorities and industry experts to ensure timely approvals across our product lifecycles. This unique opportunity allows you to influence the broader healthcare environment while fostering a supportive culture of continuous improvement and regulatory excellence. The Opportunity:
• Drive the submission of high-quality CMC regulatory documents to global health authorities, ensuring strict compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) and international standards.
• Lead strategic informational and pre-submission meetings with global Health Authorities and partners to facilitate optimal regulatory pathways and accelerate patient access.
• Partner with diverse, cross-functional stakeholders to guide synthetic and biologic products across their lifecycle, ensuring the accuracy of data in regulatory information management systems.
• Ensure that cross-functional team deliverables are completed thoroughly, compliantly, and in a high-quality, timely manner to support the successful approval of Roche products.
• Contribute to regulatory excellence by identifying growth opportunities, mitigating risks, and proactively optimizing departmental business processes.
• Manage and deliver timely, strategic responses to questions received from major global regulators to maintain our right to operate. Who You Are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a life science discipline (a postgraduate degree is a plus) and bring a minimum of 3 years of industry experience in technical regulatory, manufacturing, or quality fields within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology sectors (biologics experience is highly desired).
• You have a deep technical understanding of drug development, biologics manufacturing, critical quality attributes, control systems, and commercial lifecycle management.
• You are experienced in developing global regulatory strategies, conducting robust risk assessments, and successfully navigating interactions with international Health Authorities.
• You possess outstanding communication and organizational skills, allowing you to synthesize complex issues, make confident decisions, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

The Position People & Culture Enabling Support Specialist The Opportunity The P&C Enabling Support Network (ESN) is a global network of P&C professionals supporting the People & Culture organization through operational excellence, collaboration, coordination, and organizational enablement activities. As a member of the Enabling Support Network, you will contribute to and benefit from a broader ecosystem of enabling support functions across the P&C organisation in Roche, strengthening organizational capabilities and cross-functional alignment at scale.The P&C Enabling Support Specialist acts as a key connector across local and global P&C teams, Organizational Enablement teams, business stakeholders, and chapter organizations. The role supports alignment across the matrix organization by enabling collaboration, supporting follow-ups, coordinating actions, and helping ensure smooth communication and execution across teams. The role also supports the operational effectiveness of the RSS P&C Leadership Team through coordination, communication, follow-up, and organizational enablement activities across cross-location initiatives and stakeholder groups. This position is ideal for a proactive, organized, and collaborative professional who enjoys working in a dynamic global environment, connecting stakeholders, and enabling teams to operate effectively together.
• Act as the central coordination point between RSS P&C teams, global P&C stakeholders, Organizational Enablement teams, and business partners, serving as the primary contact point for cross-functional alignment and information flow
• Orchestrate and facilitate all collaborative forums and events including coordination of meetings, workshops, governance forums, and cross-functional discussions with full lifecycle support (agenda preparation, documentation, action tracking, and follow-up)
• Drive alignment and follow-through across RSS P&C leadership and cross-location initiatives by facilitating communication, collaboration, and coordination to ensure organizational and P&C priorities are understood and executed consistently
• Maintain comprehensive visibility and tracking of priorities, timelines, deliverables, and agreed next steps, proactively identifying and escalating dependencies, potential blockers, and risks to relevant stakeholders
• Identify and support operational improvements and continuous enhancement by partnering with P&C teams to surface alignment opportunities, streamline processes, and support transformation activities across local and global stakeholders
• Prepare and consolidate all supporting materials and insights including presentations, dashboards, reports, and stakeholder updates that enable informed leadership discussions and support organizational initiatives
• Execute administrative and coordination activities with excellence in a fast-paced global matrix environment, ensuring all work adheres to company guidelines, SOPs, and compliance expectations Who You Are
• Formal education and relevant professional background: University degree or commercial diploma (or equivalent work experience) with demonstrated experience in People & Culture, business support, professional assistance, event management, dynamic project coordination, or organizational enablement
• Foundation for success in matrix and global environments: Proven ability to navigate complex matrix organizations, connect stakeholders across different reporting lines and geographies, and work effectively in global and/or cross-fun

Sustain a win-win relationship with external vendors, as well as monitor the vendor performance through routine and /or project work. Initiate or participate in squad teams based on business needs to deliver required business outcomes. Responsibilities Leadership, People and Culture
• Lead and facilitate people processes in line with Roche Leadership commitments, People Practices and policies. Build a strong competitive team based on identified HR Support Solutions/PSS core and functional competencies as well as Roche values.
• Role Model our people practices and Roche operating principles and ensure they are fully embraced and lived by the team. Drive employee retention, engagement and talent management. Coach team members regarding their individual development and career plan & ensure succession plans. Create safe and positive team environment and ensure team demonstrating the right mindset and attitude (Trust, growth mindset, customer centricity, E2E accountability, problem solving). descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il gruppo Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals è responsabile per lo sviluppo di prodotti farmaceutici parenterali molecole sintetiche dalla fase 1 al lancio. Le attività comprendono la formulazione e lo sviluppo del processo di produzione per tutte le fasi cliniche e del mercato, il trasferimento di prodotto e processo a siti di produzione commerciale, così come lo sviluppo di estensione della linea. Stiamo cercando un esperto esperto esperto di svolgere un ruolo di ancoraggio nello sviluppo e nel lancio di formulazioni di peptide parenterali, in particolare all'interno del gruppo Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) a Basilea. L'opportunità: La posizione richiede una profonda esperienza scientifica e una visione strategica per supportare il portafoglio di sviluppo della droga (perizia CMC) e guidare l'innovazione all'interno di team multifunzionali.
• Sviluppare la roadmap tecnica che definisce le attività per la prontezza dell'industrializzazione del portafoglio peptidi attraverso la collaborazione strategica con gli stakeholder globali
• Consigliare e coordinare i team CMC per lo sviluppo di formulazioni robuste e processi produttivi che gestiscono rischi e mitigazioni per il portafoglio di molecole sintetiche DP parenterali, garantendo una tempestiva consegna delle attività tecniche
• Rimani aggiornato sui progressi nella ricerca del peptide, nella scienza della formulazione e nello sviluppo della droga parenterale per consigliare sulle pratiche all'avanguardia.
• Guidare strategie scientifiche e processi decisionali per fornire piani di sviluppo e di ricerca ottimizzati.
• Personale di mentore e allenatore in preparazione e autore di CTA e nuove applicazioni di droga (NDA).
• Collaborare con gli stakeholder interfunzionali per affrontare le sfide e garantire il successo nei programmi di ricerca e sviluppo. Chi sei?
• Ha un dottorato o master in chimica, chimica / ingegneria del processo, o campi correlati, con un minimo di 6 anni di esperienza nel settore nella formulazione e sviluppo di processo per le forme di dosaggio genitoriale peptide.
• Regime di traccia comprovata dell'autorizzazione delle sezioni di un NDA per i prodotti peptide e dello sviluppo e del lancio di prodotti di combinazione peptide per uso parenterale.
• Profonda competenza in chimica, caratterizzazione a stato solido e campi scientifici correlati.
• Esperienza nelle tecniche analitiche peptide, nei processi produttivi asettici, in scala, nei trasferimenti tecnologici e nella comprensione dei requisiti normativi e di qualità.
• Esperienza diretta nella scrittura e nella revisione dei documenti di origine e presentazione CMC normativi, con una capacità dimostrata di valutare i rischi di programma e di presentazione da una formulazione del prodotto farmaceutico e prospettiva di produzione.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con una forte gestione degli stakeholder e la capacità di pensare end-to-end e globalmente.
• Un collaudato team player con una mentalità di problem solving e una passione per l'innovazione nel campo farmaceutico. Siamo alla ricerca di candidati con sede o disposti a trasferirsi a Basilea , con l'attesa di lavorare dall'ufficio un minimo di tre giorni alla settimana. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività, e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter offrire la vita che cambia guarire

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals group is responsible for the development of parenteral drug products Synthetic molecules from Phase 1 through Launch. Activities encompass formulation and manufacturing process development for all clinical stages and the market , the transfer of product and process to commercial manufacturing sites,as well as line extension development. We are seeking a seasoned expert to play an anchor role in the development and launch of parenteral peptide formulations, particularly within the Pharmaceutical Development DP SM Parenterals group in Pharma Technical Development (PTD) in Basel. The opportunity: The position requires deep scientific expertise and strategic vision to support the drug development portfolio (CMC expertise) and drive innovation within cross-functional teams.
• Develop the technical roadmap defining activities for industrialization readiness for the peptides portfolio through strategic collaboration with global stakeholders
• Advise and coach the CMC teams for the development of robust formulations and manufacturing processes managing risks and mitigations for parenteral DP synthetic molecules portfolio ensuring timely delivery of technical activities
• Stay updated on advancements in peptide research, formulation science, and parenteral drug development to advise on cutting-edge practices.
• Lead scientific strategies and decision-making processes to deliver optimized development and research plans.
• Mentor and coach staff in preparation and authoring of CTA and New Drug Applications (NDAs).
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to address challenges and ensure success in research and development programs. Who You Are:
• You hold a Ph.D. or master’s degree in chemistry, chemical/process engineering, or related fields, with a minimum of 6 years of industry experience in formulation and process development for peptide parenteral dosage forms.
• Proven track record of authoring Drug Product (DP) sections of an NDA for peptide products and developing and launching peptide combination products for parenteral use.
• Deep expertise in chemistry, solid-state characterization, and related scientific fields.
• Experience in peptide analytical techniques, aseptic manufacturing processes, scale-up, technology transfers, and understanding regulatory and quality requirements.
• Direct experience in writing and reviewing regulatory CMC source and submission documents, with a demonstrated ability to assess program and submission risks from a drug product formulation and manufacturing perspective.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to think end-to-end and globally.
• A proven team player with a problem-solving mindset and a passion for innovation in the pharmaceutical field. We are looking for candidates based in or willing to relocate to Basel , with the expectation of working from the office a minimum of three days per week . Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healt

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le groupe Development Pharmaceutical DP SM Parenterals est responsable de la mise au point de produits pharmaceutiques parentéraux. Les activités comprennent la formulation et le développement de procédés de fabrication pour toutes les étapes cliniques et le marché, le transfert de produits et de procédés vers des sites de fabrication commerciaux, ainsi que le développement de prolongements de gamme. Nous recherchons un expert chevronné pour jouer un rôle d'ancrage dans le développement et le lancement de formulations de peptides parentéraux, en particulier au sein du groupe de développement pharmaceutique DP SM Parenterals dans Pharma Technical Development (PTD) à Bâle. L'occasion : Le poste exige une expertise scientifique approfondie et une vision stratégique pour appuyer le portefeuille de développement des médicaments (expertise du CMC) et stimuler l'innovation au sein des équipes interfonctionnelles.
• Élaborer une feuille de route technique définissant les activités de préparation à l'industrialisation du portefeuille de peptides grâce à une collaboration stratégique avec les parties prenantes mondiales
• Conseiller et coacher les équipes du CMC pour le développement de formulations et de procédés de fabrication robustes pour la gestion des risques et des atténuations du portefeuille de molécules synthétiques de PDD parentérales, assurant la prestation rapide des activités techniques
• Restez au courant des progrès de la recherche sur les peptides, de la science de la formulation et de la mise au point de médicaments parentaux afin de vous conseiller sur les pratiques de pointe.
• Diriger les stratégies scientifiques et les processus décisionnels afin d'optimiser les plans de développement et de recherche.
• Mentor et entraîneurs en préparation et en rédaction du CTA et des demandes de drogues nouvelles.
• Collaborer avec les intervenants interfonctionnels pour relever les défis et assurer la réussite des programmes de recherche et de développement. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat ou d'un master en chimie, en génie chimique/procédé ou dans des domaines connexes, avec un minimum de 6 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie dans la formulation et le développement de procédés pour les formes de dosage parentérale peptide.
• Antécédents prouvés de la création de sections de produit pharmaceutique (PD) d'une ADN pour les produits peptides et la mise au point et le lancement de produits combinés peptides pour usage parentéral.
• Expertise approfondie en chimie, caractérisation à l'état solide et domaines scientifiques connexes.
• Expérience des techniques d'analyse des peptides, des procédés de fabrication aseptiques, de l'échelle, des transferts de technologie et de la compréhension des exigences réglementaires et de qualité.
• Expérience directe de la rédaction et de l'examen des documents d'origine et de présentation du CMC, avec une capacité démontrée d'évaluer les risques liés aux programmes et aux présentations du point de vue de la formulation et de la fabrication des produits pharmaceutiques.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration, avec une gestion forte des parties prenantes et la capacité de penser de bout en bout et à l'échelle mondiale.
• Un joueur d'équipe éprouvé avec un état d'esprit de résolution de problèmes et une passion pour l'innovation dans le domaine pharmaceutique. Nous sommes à la recherche de candidats basés dans ou désireux de déménager à Bâle , avec l' attente de travailler du bureau au moins trois jours par semaine . Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des soins qui changent la vie

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti a un team esperto e collaborativo di Global Medical Affairs Leaders in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) presso Roche Diagnostics. Lavorare con il team internazionale di business per la medicina della Fondazione ex-US per lo sviluppo e la commercializzazione di soluzioni complete di genomica e diagnostica molecolare in oncologia ed ematologia. Questa è un'opportunità impareggiabile per lo sviluppo della carriera e la soddisfazione del lavoro, come si aiutano gli avanzamenti nella salute personalizzata in tutto il mondo per migliorare le esperienze e i risultati dei pazienti. La posizione si trova a Basilea, in Svizzera. L'opportunità
• Competenze di materia nel campo della genomica del cancro, dell'oncologia e della diagnostica di ematologia per fornire un contributo strategico medico e scientifico e la leadership nello sviluppo di strategie mediche globali per la generazione di prove integrate, studi di ricerca, collaborazioni di ricerca e comunicazioni mediche, nonché nell'esecuzione di attività mediche tra cui consiglieri, simposi scientifici, formazione medica indipendente o sponsorizzata.
• Costruire partnership forti con comunità mediche e pazienti, tra cui leader di pensiero globale, ricercatori, reti accademiche e società professionali per guidare l'adozione sicura di soluzioni di profilazione genomica complete, garantendo al contempo l'eccellenza operativa e la conformità con le normative del settore e le linee guida di interazione HCP.
• Sviluppare e fornire contenuti per una comunicazione tempestiva ed efficace della scienza e dei dati clinici all'interno e all'esterno dell'organizzazione in programmi educativi, pubblicazioni e presentazioni congressuali.
• Partner tra funzioni, regioni, culture e fusi orari per creare un ambiente di appartenenza e identificare valore reciproco e opportunità di collaborazione.
• Paziente campione e customer-centricity in mentalità, comportamenti e azioni mettendo sempre le esigenze dei pazienti e dei clienti prima.
• Model Roche valori di integrità, coraggio e passione e We@Roche Diagnostics (cultura, mentalità e comportamenti) in tutto quello che fai.
• Atto in linea con gli standard legali, regolamentari e aziendali e i codici di pratica, tra cui il codice di condotta Roche e altre direttive e linee guida pertinenti.
• Assicurare la conformità alle linee guida di interazione HCP, gestire le domande e le considerazioni di conformità, completare tutte le attività di formazione e le responsabilità specifiche richieste oltre la portata standard del lavoro e supervisionare la documentazione e la reportistica appropriate.
• Lavorare autonomamente e autonomamente, fungere da allenatore per i colleghi con meno esperienza. Chi sei Sei qualcuno che vuole promuovere la salute a livello globale e influenzare il proprio sviluppo. Stai cercando una società in cui hai la possibilità di perseguire i tuoi interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie, dove un titolo di lavoro non è considerato la definizione finale di chi sei, ma il punto di partenza.
• Hai una vasta conoscenza e competenza nella genomica del cancro con un grado avanzato (MD e / o PhD) in discipline correlate, così come 5+ anni di esperienza del settore in oncologia e e ematologia questioni mediche o sviluppo che guida la progettazione e l'implementazione di studi clinici, comunicazione scientifica e gli sforzi educativi che aiutano il trattamento su misura per i singoli pazienti.
• Hai una profonda comprensione degli approcci terapeutici guidati dalle molecole e delle linee guida della pratica clinica, traducendo i dati genomici e del mondo reale in azioni clinicamente rilevanti negli ecosistemi sanitari complessi.
• Avete eccellere
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Join an experienced and collaborative team of dedicated Global Medical Affairs Leads in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) at Roche Diagnostics. Work with the International Business team for Foundation Medicine ex-US on the development and commercialization of Comprehensive Genomic Profiling and molecular diagnostics solutions in oncology and hematology. This is an unparalleled opportunity for career development and job satisfaction as you help advancements in personalized healthcare around the globe to improve patient experiences and outcomes. The position is based in Basel, Switzerland. The Opportunity
• Subject matter expertise in cancer genomics, oncology and hematology diagnostics to provide strategic medical and scientific input and leadership developing global medical strategies for integrated evidence generation, investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations and medical communications, as well as executing medical activities including advisory boards, scientific symposia, independent or sponsored medical education or training events.
• Build strong partnerships with medical and patient communities including global thought leaders, investigators, academic networks and professional societies to drive safe adoption of comprehensive genomic profiling solutions while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with industry regulations and HCP interaction guidelines.
• Develop and deliver content for timely and effective communication of science and clinical data within and outside the organization in educational programs, publications and congress presentations.
• Partner across functions, regions, cultures, and time zones to create an environment of belonging and identify mutual value and opportunities for collaborations.
• Champion patient and customer-centricity in mindset, behaviors and actions by always putting the needs of the patients and customers first.
• Model Roche’s values of integrity, courage, and passion and We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mindset and behaviors) in everything you do.
• Act in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice including Roche Code of Conduct and other relevant directives and guidelines.
• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines, handle compliance questions and considerations, complete all required training and specific responsibilities beyond the standard scope of work and oversee appropriate documentation and reporting.
• Work independently and autonomously, act as coach for colleagues with less experience. Who you are You’re someone who wants to advance healthcare globally and influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies, where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.
• You have extensive knowledge and expertise in cancer genomics with an advanced degree (MD and/or PhD) in related disciplines, as well as 5+ years of industry experience in oncology and hematology medical affairs or development leading the design and implementation of clinical studies, scientific communication and educational efforts that help tailor treatment to individual patients.
• You have a deep understanding of molecular-guided therapeutic approaches and clinical practice guidelines, translating genomics and real-world data into clinically relevant actions in complex healthcare ecosystems.
• You have excel
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Begleiten Sie ein erfahrenes und kollaboratives Team von engagierten Global Medical Affairs Leads in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) bei Roche Diagnostics. Arbeiten Sie mit dem International Business Team for Foundation Medicine ex-US zur Entwicklung und Vermarktung von umfassenden Genomic Profiling- und Molekulardiagnostiklösungen in der Onkologie und Hämatologie. Dies ist eine unvergleichliche Gelegenheit für Karriere-Entwicklung und Job-Empfehlung, da Sie bei der Förderung der personalisierten Gesundheitsversorgung auf der ganzen Welt helfen, Patientenerfahrungen und Ergebnisse zu verbessern. Die Position liegt in Basel, Schweiz. Die Chance
• Fachkompetenz in der Krebsgenomik, der Onkologie und der Hämatologiediagnostik, um strategische medizinische und wissenschaftliche Input- und Führungsqualitäten für die Entwicklung globaler medizinischer Strategien für integrierte Beweiserzeugung, investigatorinitiierte Studien, Forschungskooperationen und medizinische Kommunikation sowie die Durchführung medizinischer Aktivitäten, einschließlich Beratungsgremien, wissenschaftlicher Symposien, unabhängiger oder gesponserter medizinischer Ausbildung oder Ausbildungsveranstaltungen zu bieten.
• Aufbauen Sie starke Partnerschaften mit medizinischen und Patientengemeinschaften, einschließlich globaler Denkführer, Ermittler, akademischer Netzwerke und professioneller Gesellschaften, um eine sichere Annahme umfassender genomischer Profilierungslösungen zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die betriebliche Exzellenz und die Einhaltung von Branchenvorschriften und HCP-Interaktionsrichtlinien zu gewährleisten.
• Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von Inhalten für eine zeitnahe und effektive Kommunikation von Wissenschaft und klinischen Daten innerhalb und außerhalb der Organisation in Bildungsprogrammen, Publikationen und Kongresspräsentationen.
• Partner über Funktionen, Regionen, Kulturen und Zeitzonen, um eine Umgebung der Zugehörigkeit zu schaffen und gegenseitigen Wert und Möglichkeiten für Kooperationen zu identifizieren.
• Champion-Patienten und Kundenzentrierung in Gedanken, Verhaltensweisen und Aktionen, indem immer die Bedürfnisse der Patienten und Kunden zuerst gestellt.
• Die Werte von Roche für Integrität, Mut und Leidenschaft und We@Roche Diagnostik (Kultur, Denkweise und Verhaltensweisen) in allem, was Sie tun.
• Gesetz im Einklang mit den gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und Unternehmensnormen und -codes, einschließlich Roche-Code of Conduct und anderen einschlägigen Richtlinien und Richtlinien.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der HCP-Interaktionsrichtlinien, der Umgang mit Compliance-Fragen und -Betrachtungen, der Absolvierung aller erforderlichen Schulungen und spezifischen Aufgaben über den Standardumfang der Arbeit hinaus und der Überwachung geeigneter Dokumentationen und Berichterstattung.
• selbständig und autonom arbeiten, als Trainer für Kollegen mit weniger Erfahrung fungieren. Wer bist du? Sie sind jemand, der die Gesundheitsversorgung weltweit voranbringen und Ihre eigene Entwicklung beeinflussen will. Sie sind auf der Suche nach einem Unternehmen, in dem Sie die Möglichkeit haben, Ihre Interessen über Funktionen und Geographien zu verfolgen, wo ein Jobtitel nicht die endgültige Definition von wer Sie sind, sondern der Ausgangspunkt.
• Sie haben umfangreiches Wissen und Know-how in der Krebsgenomik mit einem fortgeschrittenen Grad (MD und/oder PhD) in verwandten Disziplinen, sowie 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Onkologie und Hämatologie medizinische Angelegenheiten oder Entwicklung führen die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von klinischen Studien, wissenschaftliche Kommunikation und pädagogische Bemühungen, die eine maßgeschneiderte Behandlung für einzelne Patienten helfen.
• Sie haben ein tiefes Verständnis von molekulargeführten therapeutischen Ansätzen und Leitlinien für die klinische Praxis, indem Sie genomische und reale Daten in klinisch relevante Aktionen in komplexen Gesundheitsökosystemen übersetzen.
