descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Joignez-vous à une équipe expérimentée et collaborative de chefs de file en développement clinique et en affaires médicales (CDMA) à Roche Diagnostics. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'affaires internationale de la Fondation Médecine ex-US sur le développement et la commercialisation de solutions de profil génomique global et de diagnostic moléculaire en oncologie et en hématologie. Il s'agit d'une occasion inégalée pour le développement de carrière et la satisfaction au travail que vous aidez à progresser dans les soins de santé personnalisés partout dans le monde pour améliorer les expériences et les résultats des patients. Le poste est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. L'opportunité
• Expertise en génomique du cancer, en oncologie et en diagnostics hématologiques pour fournir une contribution et un leadership médicaux et scientifiques stratégiques en vue d'élaborer des stratégies médicales mondiales pour la production intégrée de données probantes, des études initiées par les chercheurs, des collaborations de recherche et des communications médicales, ainsi que pour l'exécution d'activités médicales, y compris des conseils consultatifs, des colloques scientifiques, des activités d'éducation ou de formation médicales indépendantes ou parrainées.
• Établir des partenariats solides avec les milieux médicaux et les patients, y compris les leaders mondiaux de la pensée, les chercheurs, les réseaux universitaires et les sociétés professionnelles, afin de favoriser l'adoption en toute sécurité de solutions globales de profilage génomique tout en assurant l'excellence opérationnelle et le respect des règlements de l'industrie et des lignes directrices sur l'interaction HCP.
• Mettre au point et diffuser des contenus permettant une communication rapide et efficace des données scientifiques et cliniques à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'organisation dans le cadre de programmes éducatifs, de publications et de conférences.
• Établir des partenariats entre les fonctions, les régions, les cultures et les fuseaux horaires pour créer un environnement d'appartenance et identifier la valeur mutuelle et les possibilités de collaboration.
• Champion patient et centre client dans la mentalité, les comportements et les actions en mettant toujours les besoins des patients et des clients en premier.
• Modèle Roches valeurs d'intégrité, de courage et de passion et We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mentalité et comportement) dans tout ce que vous faites.
• Agir conformément aux normes et codes de pratique juridiques, réglementaires et d'entreprise, y compris le Code de conduite de Roche et d'autres directives et directives pertinentes.
• Assurer le respect des lignes directrices sur l'interaction avec le PCS, traiter les questions et les considérations relatives à la conformité, compléter toute la formation requise et les responsabilités spécifiques au-delà de la portée normale du travail et superviser la documentation et les rapports appropriés.
• Travailler de manière autonome et indépendante, agir comme coach pour les collègues ayant moins d'expérience. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut faire progresser les soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale et influencer votre propre développement. Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers les fonctions et les géographies, où un titre d'emploi n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui vous êtes, mais comme le point de départ.
• Vous avez une vaste connaissance et une expertise en génomique du cancer avec un diplôme avancé (MD et/ou doctorat) dans des disciplines connexes, ainsi que 5+ ans d'expérience de l'industrie en oncologie et en hématologie affaires médicales ou développement menant la conception et la mise en œuvre d'études cliniques, communication scientifique et efforts éducatifs qui aident à adapter le traitement aux patients individuels.
• Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des approches thérapeutiques et des lignes directrices de la pratique clinique, traduisant la génomique et les données du monde réel en actions cliniquement pertinentes dans des écosystèmes de santé complexes.
• Vous avez excelle

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Senior Solution Architect, you will be the key responsible for the SAP Solution Manager 7.2 ecosystem. You are responsible for the end-to-end "Requirements to Deploy" (R2D) framework, ensuring that all SAP changes—from global templates to local rollouts—are governed, tested, and deployed with zero disruption. You will lead the configuration, maintenance and optimization of Focused Build and ChaRM to support high-velocity Agile delivery in a complex, multi-track S/4HANA landscapes. Description of the area Senior Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools. Responsible for the strategic design and operational excellence of all ERP specific ALM capabilities related to the end to end process "Requirements to Deploy", incl. and not limited to Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and aligns with the architecture community for governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the solution. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded.
• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.
• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within a defined Solution Context.
• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Contributes minimally but effectively to Architecture Practices development and mentoring. Qualifications
• ALM Toolset Mastery: 8+ years of hands-on experience with SAP Solution Manager (Focused Build, ChaRM, Solution Documentation, Test Management, Project management), SAP Cloud ALM, Adonis, and Worksoft.
• Release Management: Deep expertise in ERP change management, hybrid environments on CTS, CTS+, cTMS, transport layers, conflict analysis, and downgrade protection.
• Lifecycle Leadership: Proven track record of managing 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles in a global corporate setting with strong stakeholder management skills.
• System Configuration: Extensive experience configuring and adapting SAP Solution Manager to meet complex business needs.
• Process Standards: Strong

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il dipartimento Pharma Technical Development Analytics (PTDA) assume i progetti di ricerca e li sostiene durante lo sviluppo clinico all'approvazione del mercato. All'interno dello sviluppo analitico, il Dipartimento Bioassay supporta l'intero portafoglio Biotech con saggi funzionali. La possibilità:
• Supporto nell'attuazione di un nuovo sistema per la valutazione dei bioassay.
• Validazione dei modelli di documentazione e creazione e collaudo di documenti tecnici nell'ambiente GMP.
• Partecipazione all'introduzione e alla sperimentazione di nuovi strumenti di analisi dei dati (Non-GMP).
• Garantire l'integrità dei dati all'interno dei processi analitici.
• Creazione di documenti di convalida per sostenere lo sviluppo clinico fino all'approvazione del mercato. Chi sei: Stiamo cercando una personalità motivata e consapevole della qualità che combina una comprensione di base dei bioassay con un'affinità per i processi digitali nell'ambiente di laboratorio.
• Istruzione: attualmente ti iscrivi in un corso di laurea o master in bioinformatica, biotecnologia, biologia (con attenzione all'analisi dei dati) o in un campo relativo, o hai completato i tuoi studi fino a 12 mesi prima della data di inizio.
• Know-how: hai una comprensione di base dei dati e puoi valutarlo in modo indipendente (ad esempio con MS Excel, R o JMP). Idealmente, hai già avuto i primi punti di contatto con sistemi assistiti da computer in ambiente di laboratorio.
• Lavoro: Lei lavora strutturato e dettagliato.
• Lingue: Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e buon inglese in parola e scrittura. Processo di applicazione:
• La vostra domanda deve contenere un CV e una lettera di motivazione.
• Si prega di notare che, nell'ambito dei documenti di richiesta, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono presentare un certificato universitario che indica che uno stage è obbligatorio e la durata dello stage obbligatorio. Informazioni aggiuntive:
• La posizione è Basilea
• Stiamo cercando qualcuno che possa sostenerci a tempo pieno
• Questo stage non è adatto per una tesi di laurea / master. Se si desidera sviluppare in un ambiente che promuove il lavoro di squadra e l'innovazione, Roche è la società giusta per voi. Qualsiasi ruolo in Roche aiuta a migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Contatta subito! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The position The Pharma Technical Development Analytics (PTDA) department takes over research projects and supports them during clinical development to market approval. Within the analytical development, the Bioassay Department supports the entire Biotech portfolio with functional assays. The possibility:
• Support in implementing a new system for evaluating bioassays.
• Validation of documentation templates and the creation and testing of technical documents in the GMP environment.
• Participation in the introduction and testing of new data analysis tools (Non-GMP).
• Ensuring data integrity within the analytical processes.
• Creation of validation documents to support clinical development until market approval. Who you are: We are looking for a motivated, quality-conscious personality that combines a basic understanding of bioassays with an affinity for digital processes in the laboratory environment.
• Education: You are currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree program in bioinformatics, biotechnology, biology (with focus on data analysis) or a related field, or you have completed your studies a maximum of 12 months before the start date.
• Know-how: You have a basic understanding of data and can evaluate it independently (e.g. with MS Excel, R or JMP). Ideally, you have already had first contact points with computer-assisted systems in the laboratory environment.
• Working: You work structured and detailed.
• Languages: Very good knowledge of German and good English in word and writing. Application process:
• Your application must contain a CV and a letter of motivation.
• Please note that, as part of the application documents, non-EU/EFTA citizens must present a university certificate indicating that an internship is mandatory and the duration of the compulsory internship. Additional information:
• The location is Basel
• We are looking for someone who can support us full time
• This internship is not suitable for a Bachelor/Master thesis. If you want to develop in an environment that promotes teamwork and innovation, Roche is the right company for you. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an equal opportunity employer.

We are continuously expanding and looking for new talent to join our transforming Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework. The People Support members act as the first point of contact for P&C-related enquiries and services for all Roche people (employees, candidates, contingents, retirees, managers, P&C colleagues, etc.) while executing Employee Lifecycle Management activities and tasks. • Contribute to process documentation (SOPs, work instructions) and knowledge updates.
• Apply customer service principles while engaging with employees and stakeholders.
• Learn to monitor service quality and support compliance with KPIs, SLAs, and data privacy rules.
• Build relationships with P&C colleagues and customers to support effective service delivery.
• Contribute to achieving global consistency and high-quality service through teamwork and collaboration. What can you bring to our team: You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In the Invoice to Pay Business & System Analyst role, you are responsible for the dedication towards undisturbed business activities by committing to Service Level Agreement. In this role you will ensure that technological architecture meets user requirements, and will support invoice handling related queries decreasing cycle time from the point of scanning until invoice payment. Execute the day-to-day activities according to the agreed service level and in compliance with the SOPs of the respective business sub-process. Follow the instructions of the Cluster Section Lead regarding the daily work coordination, and propose process and system improvements across multiple divisions. Contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of the Global Customer Experience End to End Employee Experience Organization. The Opportunity
• Financial Task Execution & System Support: Perform timely and stringent financial tasks, including system analysis, issue resolution within SAP FI, MM, or procurement modules, and handle incidents, especially related to OPT VIM.
• IT Service Management & Compliance: Execute ITIL-based evaluation and management of user requests/incidents, escalate issues to IT, provide solutions/workarounds, and ensure Global KPIs and SLA thresholds are met.
• Process Improvement & Implementation: Participate in the analysis, redesign, and implementation of business and systems processes, identify opportunities for process improvement, and manage related projects/mini-projects.
• Training and Advisory Services: Conduct end-user training (including preparation and delivery of training material), and provide advisory support on SAP Invoice to Pay process changes and Accounts Payable accounting.
• Documentation and Reporting: Maintain and review SOPs, Knowledge Base, and User Guidance, contribute to policy/procedure documentation, and perform reporting for finance management and external requestors.
• Service Transition and Project Participation: Manage or participate in RSS and global technology projects, focusing on functional analysis, testing (including scripted regression and coordination), and providing deployment support.
• Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: Act as an escalation board for IT, establish strong relationships with internal stakeholders, understand business needs, and actively promote effective cooperation across teams. Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
• Essential Skills: Must possess strong communication skills in English (written and spoken), strong customer centricity, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to work effectively both independently and in a team.
• Technical Expertise: Experience in SAP (specifically FI and the Accounts Payable module), coupled with an analytical thinking approach.
• Experience: Requires 1-3 years of related experience in accounts payable and/or financial accounting.
• Process Knowledge: Comprehensive insight into the Demand to Pay (D2P) department's processes.
• Education: A University or College Education, with a concentration in Finance or Accounting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance sc

The Position As a Supply Chain Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Global Supply Chain organization by maintaining the reliability and performance of the equipment utilized within the Hub Operations Americas group located in Indianapolis. Your Opportunity Position’s most important individual tasks:
• Complete preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules.
• Perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning equipment, used within warehousing areas.
• Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.
• Use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild equipment as required.
• Perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by engineers
• Use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.
• Apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments. Who you are: Minimum qualifications:
• High school diploma or equivalency
• 2+ years of related experience in maintenance experience. Preferred Qualifications:
• Associates degree, journeyman’s card or equivalent military training related to maintenance of equipment in an industrial setting.
• At least 5 years of experience in technical support and maintenance roles.
• Preferred credentials: CMRT, CRL, CMRP, etc
• Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems. Preferred experience: familiar with conveyor systems and other equipment used within warehouse operations.
• Proficiency in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, using diagnostic tools, and interpreting equipment manuals and schematics.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, spare parts management, and relevant safety regulations.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing circumstances. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Pay transparency The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson is 54,300.00 - 100,800.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Your Opportunity Position’s most important individual tasks:
• Complete preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules.
• Perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning equipment, used within warehousing areas.
• Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.
• Use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild equipment as required.
• Perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by engineers
• Use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.
• Apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. The Opportunity The Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Applications Specialist you will:
• Acting as the primary liaison/customer representative throughout the implementation process and future histology application support, Includes planning and coordination for the implementation and customer training, as well as problem-solving issues that arise for customers throughout the life cycle of the solution.
• Provide highly visible, self-supervised and self-directed, extensive on-site advisory customer support through the implementation of Roche Tissue instrumentation and tailored customer training on our Roche solutions to meet customer needs based on an individualized assessment of the customer’s personnel, organizational structure, workflow, and maximization of equipment capabilities, which may include: equipment, applications, systems, and IT solutions.
• Act as an advisor on customer issues and drive efficiencies & optimization for the customer and Roche through independent analysis and problem-solving. Additionally, will be responsible for increased sales revenue by identifying opportunities for new system consumables for clients (i.e. reagents, primary antibodies, bio-markers, software). Performs these job duties remotely and independently.
• Advanced and specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system, or equipment with regard to technologically advanced instruments and scientific applications. Requires specific training and certification.
• Utilizes independent judgment and discretion in the analysis of customer particularized needs and issues that arise both during and after the implementation process. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment, and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Independently analyzes and resolves most customer questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.
• Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this highly responsible position. This is a field-based role - the territory is Southwest, 90% travel is expected for this position. • Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biology or Clinical Laboratory or equivalent work experience.
• 3 + years of experience implementing and evaluating complex laboratory, IT products, medical diagnostic equipment, reagents and/or systems. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Histology, Immunohi

The Position Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche. Como um(a) Project Management Specialist , você será o ponto focal da Roche responsável por planejar, executar e monitorar projetos complexos, garantindo a sincronização perfeita entre as atividades internas e as necessidades dos clientes. Você trabalhará em parceria com diversos stakeholders para traduzir a visão estratégica em planos de ação executáveis e robustos. Nessa posição, você será o líder operacional que assegura a governança e a entrega técnica dentro do escopo, prazo e custo. Você terá autonomia para liderar times multidisciplinares, estimulando a colaboração e a agilidade para tomar decisões que gerem impacto direto na modernização e eficiência do ecossistema de saúde. Sobre a Oportunidade:
• Utilizar metodologias de gestão de projetos para o planejamento, execução e monitoramento de cronogramas críticos.
• Garantir a sincronização das atividades internas (Engenharia, TI, Assessoria e Consultoria) e do cliente para o atingimento de indicadores de performance.
• Estabelecer uma governança sólida e dinâmica de trabalho, garantindo clareza de papéis, responsabilidades e engajamento dos times.
• Assegurar uma comunicação efetiva e transparente, tornando o cronograma e as etapas do projeto acessíveis a todos os envolvidos.
• Gerenciar e mitigar riscos de forma proativa, comunicando impactos de escopo, prazo ou custo em tempo adequado para tomada de decisão.
• Promover a busca de soluções criativas e alternativas para problemas ou mudanças que surjam durante a execução do projeto.
• Garantir a rastreabilidade total do processo através da formalização e registro de documentos em ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
• Implementar lições aprendidas e melhorias contínuas, compartilhando insights que sirvam de input para a otimização de processos internos. Quem você é:
• Graduação completa (Pós-graduação ou MBA serão considerados diferenciais).
• Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ativa será um diferencial.
• Possuir experiência relevante em atividades correlacionadas a gestão de projetos complexos de automação e soluções integradas na área de saúde ou diagnóstica.
• Inglês avançado.
• Domínio em ferramentas de gestão como Monday ou similares.
• Conhecimento em metodologias Lean e Agile será considerado um importante diferencial.
• Visão estratégica voltada para resultados, priorizando a excelência na entrega e a satisfação do parceiro externo.
• Habilidade de negociação e liderança de times multidisciplinares para garantir o alinhamento de expectativas.
• Demonstrar alta capacidade de negociação e gerenciamento de conflitos com comportamento proativo e construtivo; possuir habilidade analítica para navegar em ambientes complexos e diferentes níveis hierárquicos, conectando necessidades e soluções de forma sempre colaborativa.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche. Como Parceiro de Jornada do Paciente (Digital) , você terá como missão transformar a forma como a Roche interage com stakeholders, posicionando-se no centro de uma abordagem inovadora e disruptiva. Em um mercado farmacêutico em constante evolução, você atuará como interface buscando trazer a voz do cliente para dentro da empresa utilizando estratégias e inovações omnichannel, aliadas às ferramentas digitais para otimizar as interações com o ecossistema de saúde. O PJP Digital é uma posição estratégica e agnóstica em termos de responsabilidade, focada em criar impacto no ecossistema de saúde, indo além das barreiras geograficas, uilizando estratégias omnichannel e insights baseados em dados para melhorar a tomada de decisões e maximizar a eficiência operacional. Com uma visão 360° das contas e stakeholders, você irá colaborar com outros parceiros de negócio para atender ao potencial das contas e alavancar o acesso, destravando barreiras e otimizando a jornada do paciente nos pilares de Prevenção/Diagnóstico, Decisão Médica, Acesso e Financiamento e Tratamento. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Estabelecer metas desafiadoras e identificar oportunidades de ampliação do acesso a soluções inovadoras em seu território, promovendo maior alcance e impacto para nossos pacientes.
• Gerenciar contas e stakeholders, criando estratégias de engajamento e planos de ação alinhados com os objetivos da Roche, de forma a fortalecer relações e impulsionar resultados consistentes.
• Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos digitais e garantir a eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde, acelerando a entrega de valor e ampliando o acesso às nossas inovações.
• Ser responsável pelo lançamento de informações no EpiCX (CRM) e outras plataformas que otimizem e personalizem a comunicação com profissionais de saúde, garantindo a eficácia das interações e a melhoria contínua dos processos através de visão analítica de dados.
• Contribuir para a ampliação da eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde. Quem é você:
• Graduação completa e inglês intermediário.
• Experiência em relacionamento com clientes e desejável conhecimento em gestão de projetos.
• Visão intermediária multidisciplinar em Acesso, Médico Científico e Gestão de contas, além de conhecimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.
• Experiência com diversos stakeholders do setor de saúde (HCP e HCO), com diferencial para atuação virtual.
• Forte comunicação empática e ativa, com habilidade para engajar de forma omnichannel (repetido no original).
• Mindset multicanal e data-driven, com domínio em marketing digital, mídias sociais e ferramentas como CRM (OCE-IQVIA) (repetido no original).
• Experiência na construção de eventos científicos nos formatos presencial, digital e híbrido (repetido no original).
• Persuasão para transformar interações em oportunidades de negócio, com abordagem criativa, resolutiva, proatividade, foco em resultados e agilidade na tomada de decisão.
• Agilidade cultural/organizacional, facilidade para trabalhar em equipe em ambientes ambíguos, flexíveis e fluidos, mantendo o controle emocional e capacidade de gerenciar expectativas.
• Disponibilidade para atua

titleByLocale.it: Centro di Servizi Associati di Pagamento - 3

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position PROPÓSITO DEL PUESTO Es responsable de asistir a los equipos de estudios clínicos en todas las actividades financieras transaccionales relacionadas con el proceso de pagos de los estudios clínicos gestionados por el Departamento Local de Operaciones Clínicas, en cada uno de los países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Chile, Colombia, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica, Centroamérica y Caribe) y otras tareas de asistencia (de ser requerido). FUNCIONES O RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Estudios clínicos de cada país en la ejecución de las siguientes actividades:
• Verificar la información de visitas completadas y procedimientos adicionales (Adhocs) en CTMS y plantillas excel por parte del CRA (Monitor) (Para Latam) o Generar los reportes necesarios para consolidar una propuesta de pagos por país, donde se incluya la información del Investigador Centro y Paciente según la frecuencia de pagos de cada uno de los países de Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica.
• Cuando se requiera, Confirmar con el Centro de Investigación (para USA) que la información de pagos sea proporcionada de forma exacta y oportuna.
• Gestionar pagos para los Centros de Investigación de Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica a través de los sistemas SAP, CCOPS y CTMS al equipo de Cuentas por pagar.
• Asistir a los Centros de Investigación (Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica) en caso de solicitudes conciliación de cuentas o dudas en relación con temas de pagos.
• Es responsable de solicitar y verificar la creación de los vendor (SAP) relacionados a estudios clínicos (USA).
• Configurar en CCOPS la información requerida para cada centro de Investigación. De acuerdo a las tareas que le sean asignadas, podrá:
• Colaborar con el CSM y CSS para asegurar que se obtengan todas las revisiones y autorizaciones internas adecuadas y requeridas para el proceso de pagos relacionado con los estudios.
• Asegurar el registro de información necesarios en sistemas Roche para generar la propuesta de pagos correspondientes.
• Hacer recomendaciones a los equipos locales del estudio en relación con las soluciones nuevas e innovadoras para los procesos de pagos, pronósticos y recursos que podrían incrementar la precisión, eficiencia y productividad del proceso.
• Brindar apoyo a los equipos locales del estudio en relación con las mejores
• prácticas, acompañando a los CSM en las actividades de pronósticos y el manejo de los gastos relacionados con los proyectos.
• Gestionar soporte al proceso de pagos de los departamentos locales de
• Investigación Clínica en Latam USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica, para asegurar un proceso ágil y eficiente de pago.
• Apoyar en el entrenamiento activo a los miembros del departamento de
• Investigación Clínica sobre uso de herramientas de reporte corporativas y locales desarrolladas por el área de Investigación.
• Asegurar la calidad de la información del sistema manteniendo control de los reportes de discrepancias.
• Mantener los sistemas CTMS/CCOPS actualizados de acuerdo a las fechas calendario clave pre-establecidas para toma de decisiones de los equipos de Investigación clínica de Latam USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica. PERFIL DEL PUESTO – REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS Y PROFESIONALES
• Carrera técnica/Universitaria. (Administración, Finanzas, Contabilidad, o carrera a fin.)
• De 2 a 5 años de experiencia en Accounts Payable.
• Inglés Intermedio-Avanzado (B2) Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe ar

• Configurar en CCOPS la información requerida para cada centro de Investigación. De acuerdo a las tareas que le sean asignadas, podrá:

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love Purpose The purpose of this position is to actively promote Roche DIA product under responsibility to all targeted HCP/Labs. To ensure that all activities are in accordance with the SOP standards & to achieve all set sales budgets of all assigned products on cycle basis. The Position is responsible for sales and profitability objectives from existing and new accounts or clients Your Opportunity Sales Management
• Achievement of monthly/quarterly/yearly sales targets.
• Stock/expiry monitoring at institutional, customer and distributor levels.
• Implementation of marketing strategies and plans.
• Prospecting and developing new client relationships within a defined geography or market
• Build & maintain strong & credible relationships with HCP(s).
• Visit HCP(s) to collect market feedback and build product advocacy.
• Continuously improve the product, disease, market knowledge and promotion skills through self-reading and attending all products, marketing and medical training as assigned by the Management.
• To achieve all the agreed timelines planned for the assigned official tasks.
• Effective & productive database sales call
• Corporate image building with ethics and behaviour.
• In-Dept knowledge of HCPs, Customers, and accounts profile of his territory & update when required
• Focus on developing non-users HCP, customer and accounts
• Preparation/recommendations for tender business
• Maintaining existing accounts
• Regular reporting on day to day activities
• Additional tasks assigned by the management from time to time Performance Management
• Align with supervisor to set mutually agreed objectives and tasks. Resource Utilization
• Strive to the best for utilization of resources provided in the best interest of the business-like; data, team & financial resources etc. Team Coordination
• Interdepartmental & intradepartmental coordination & collaboration to achieve overall business objectives Additional Responsibilities
• Employees are expected to perform their duties to the benefit of the company, using common sense and the best of their knowledge. They are personally responsible for SHE in line with their know-how, skill and experience. They are required to learn and follow all programs, procedures and instructions relating to SHE, to report unsafe conditions or acts and to inform their line managers/supervisors if they are uncertain or unable to deal with a particular situation.
• It is mandatory for all employees to always display the company badge when inside the office, highlight or if necessary, stop or report the unauthorized movement to the site security officer.
• Comply with all applicable guidelines of Symphony, compliance and PRI/PSI Who you are
• University degree (in science / related field/Lab) or
• Marketing degree with an aptitude for medical/technical information Experience and knowledge
• Minimum 3-5 years of sales experience
• Understanding of the Diagnostic Industry
• Product Knowledge
• Market Knowledge
• Computer Literate (especially Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word & Microsoft PowerPoint).
• Sales Data Analysis Competencies
• Roche Leadership Competencies: Job Specific Competencies
• Outstanding written and oral communication skills
• Superior business and negotiation skills
• Extensive industry contacts
• Ability and willingness to travel
• Negotiation & Influencing skills
• Teamwork
• Organization and planning skill

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Was Dich erwartet: Als Systembetreuer Junior (m/w/d) sorgst Du eigenverantwortlich zusammen mit Deinen Teamkolleg:innen im Raum Ingolstadt/Nürnberg/Erlangen für den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice. Von der Installation über die Einarbeitung, Wartung, Modifikation und Störungsbeseitigung begleitest du unsere Systeme über den gesamten Lebenszyklus bei Deinen Kund:innen. Du kümmerst Dich um Analysensysteme, Reagenzien und deren IT-Anbindung und hast folgende Aufgaben:
• In Deinem Betreuungsgebiet bist Du erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für den Service unserer Kund:innen und pflegst einen engen Kontakt mit ihnen im Privatlabor oder Krankenhaus.
• Dein technisches Geschick stellst Du bei der Planung von Geräteinstallationen, Wartungen und Reparaturen unter Beweis.
• Die Analyse und Behebung von komplexen, technischen Fehlern sowie die Durchführung von Test- und Routineläufen gehören zu Deinem Tagesgeschäft.
• Deine Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement baust Du im Rahmen von Automationsprojekten stetig aus.
• Du betreust Roche-Laborsysteme im Bereich der Präanalytik, klinischen Chemie, Immunologie und Gerinnung und berätst die Kund:innen nicht nur bei technischen, sondern auch bei applikativen Fragestellungen.
• Du begleitest die digitale Transformation und bringst Deine IT Kenntnisse im speziellen bei der Netzwerktechnik, bei Installations- sowie internen Projekten ein.
• Du arbeitest eng vernetzt mit unserem Verkauf und dem Innendienst und berätst gemeinsam unsere Kund:innen zu den Themen vorbeugende Wartung, Serviceverträge und Geräteablösungen/-neuanschaffung.
• Deine Leistungen bei den Kund:innen dokumentierst und fakturierst Du in unserem CRM-System.
• Du bringst die Bereitschaft mit, bei Bedarf ca. 30% teamübergreifend und damit deutschlandweit die genannten Servicetätigkeiten zu übernehmen. Wer Du bist: Für die spannende Position als Systembetreuer Junior (m/w/d) bringst Du ein abgeschlossenes Studium im ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Technikerausbildung mit. In den Bereichen Elektronik, Mechanik, Mechatronik, Automatisierungstechnik, Hydraulik, IT & Netzwerktechnik, EDV-Schnittstellen sowie Messtechnik hast Du erste Erfahrung sammeln können. Außerdem begeisterst Du Dich nicht nur theoretisch für technische Fragestellungen, sondern zeigst auch praktisches Geschick. Wenn Du über erste Berufserfahrung im Service-Außendienst oder im Diagnostikumfeld verfügst, ist das von Vorteil. Die ausführlichen Trainings rund um unsere Systeme sowie unsere umfassende Einarbeitung machen Dich nach deinem Start bei Roche zum Experten (m/w/d) in unserem Umfeld. Diese weiteren Aspekte runden Dein Profil ab:
• IT Themen sind dir vertraut: Du hast Spaß daran Netzwerke, Server, Firewalls, Schnittstellen, etc. aufzusetzen und diese zu managen.
• Medizinische und applikative Aspekte unserer Diagnostik findest Du spannend.
• Du bist sehr gut selbstorganisiert, hast eine hohe Eigeninitiative und kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichsten Hierarchieebenen.
• Deutsch und Englisch sprichst Du fließend, auch im technischen Umfeld.
• Du besitzt einen Führerschein und freust Dich auf Dienstreisen mit Deinem von Roche zur Verfügung gestellten Dienstwagen, der auch privat genutzt werden darf.
• Deine Aktivitäten startest du aus dem Homeoffice heraus und bist bereit Not- und Bereitschaftsdienste auch an Wochenenden und Feiertagen zu übernehmen.
• Du wohnst vorzugsweise bereits in Deinem Betreuungsgebiet im Raum Ingolstadt/Nürnberg/Erlangen Bewer

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche. An exciting opportunity has arisen to take a Medical Enabler role within the Roche Diagnostics Philippines team. The Medical Enabler is a key strategic role that will help identify and address the relevant medical needs of clinical practice, to successfully support the optimal use of Roche diagnostic solutions. In this role, you will provide technical and clinical expertise and advisory to internal and external customers for all Roche Diagnostics products. This role also develops and executes medical initiatives to support medical strategy/medical plan that will drive the growth of the priority products of the affiliate, develops and cultivates strategic relationships with disease area experts and other external influencers and stakeholders, leads KOL development and engagements in a scientific manner, provides medical support on clinical research, data generation and demonstration projects that will drive strategic growth for the affiliate and participates in health authority interactions. Key responsibilities include Development and management of the medical plan
• Align with Commercial Teams: Marketing, Sales and Near Patient Care teams on focused disease areas and products
• Develop local patient journey map and identify diagnostic gaps to position Roche diagnostic solutions
• Align the local medical plan with global medical plan, under the supervision of Head of Access and Medical Affairs Medical expertise and customer insights
• Inspire high levels of medical expertise and a scientific mindset across the affiliate and instil an enabling mindset throughout the affiliate
• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance, ensuring business integrity and company reputation
• Offer expert opinion on scientific medical information to identify and develop effective peer-to-peer relationships to execute our product strategies, while holding high ethical standards, compliance to Roche SOP and local/ international regulations.
• Research, collate, present, and offer data insights related to the dedicated disease area and product(s)
• Manage the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communication both internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes
• Manage Medical Information activities in accordance with regional/ local model, referencing global standard responses
• Develop a customer centricity culture, making sure promotional/ medical/ scientific communications address HCP needs and optimize patient benefit and safety while keeping a fair balance and compliance with regulations and SOPs
• Provide early insights on new products and indications in close collaboration with the Commercial Team KOL development, engagement plan and execution
• Identify and develop scientific relationship with external KOLs/experts who are qualified sources of insight and advice
• Develop and maintain regular contacts with top tier KOLs
• Develop KOL deck on priority and focused disease area
• Ensure that all activities towards external experts/ KOLs are harmonized across the affiliate
• Planning and execution of relevant scientific advisory board and expert meetings
• Conduct of KOL training, scien

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Position Summary As a Transformation and Solution Partner (TSP) , you will engage and partner primarily with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues across all Chapters and business stakeholders globally. Your mission is to govern M&A and transformation data management frameworks with right solution expertise while driving global P&C solution improvements. You will serve as a centre of excellence for transformation ideation, navigating complex business transformations to ensure a seamless partner experience in collaboration with Transformation and Solution Advisor (TSA). You help translate business goals into P&C priorities, leveraging holistic data and historical learning to iterate and improve the overall global transformation flow. Your opportunity as Transformation & Solution Partner
• M&A / Transformation Framework Governance: Lead the governance of transformation frameworks to ensure consistency and excellence across global initiatives.
• Transformation Solution & Framework Expertise: Provide expert guidance and implementation support for digital transformation tools. Serve as a Centre of Excellence for transformation improvement ideations, capturing historical learnings to further iterate and enhance existing transformation experience.
• Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Business Partners and business leaders of globally-scaled transformations to provide framework consultancy, from preliminary until embedment stages.
• Cross P&C Solution Improvement: Drive improvements for the overall global transformation flow, identifying gaps and implementing proactive solutions across the P&C network.Collaborates on complex P&C challenges and demands, connecting with the right P&C chapters to develop an end-to-end solution, determine ownership and drive effective change management.
• Continue Improvement : Proactively identifies customer needs or P&C solutions’ gaps, and translates these needs to change requests and builds cross-functional squads to implement continuous improvements within our P&C network.
• Collaboration & Innovation: Share best practices for emerging technologies, such as AI-driven org design and job design to build Transformation and solution advisory team knowledge and capability. Who you are You bring the following skills and competencies:
• Passion for Change: Deep interest in project management, process improvement, and change management.
• Digital Proficiency: Strong expertise in digital solutions like Airtable and Workday, with the ability to lead the transition from manual spreadsheets to integrated technology platforms.
• Exceptional Stakeholder Management: Ability to represent the P&C/PSS vision and articulate the strategy and “the why” behind complex transformations.
• Agility: Ability to work independently and deliver results in a matrixed, fast-paced environment while balancing competing priorities.
• Influencing Skills: Exceptional communication, consulting, and negotiation skills, with the ability to coach colleagues and lead without direct authority. Further requirements
• Education: University degree or equivalent, HR preferred.
• Experience: Extensive experience (typically 7–8 years) with HR processes, HR shared services, or HR functional expertise, ideally in a global environment.
• Transformation Expertise: Proven track record in managing large-scale global transformations and M&A activities.
• Languages: Fluent in English required; additional languages are a plus.
• Certification: Project management a

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Pharma Technical Operations (PT) coinvolge una serie di attività, dalla Supply Chain agli Affari Regolatori alla Finanza alle Persone & Cultura. Clicca qui per scoprire la gamma dei reparti coinvolti, nonché i progetti precedenti. Questo stage sarà nello spazio della catena di fornitura PTS Pharma e della strategia di prodotto. Incluso nello stage sarà formazione sui concetti di base del lavoro svolto nei rispettivi dipartimenti. Gli stagisti saranno anche in grado di sfruttare le risorse Roche su argomenti come l'intervista, fare presentazioni, gestione del tempo, e altro ancora. Per questo tirocinio, stiamo cercando un ambito più specifico e focalizzato della gestione della supply chain. La Pharma Technical Operations Supply Chain (PTS) è una rete complessa e globale che richiede un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità e una forza lavoro altamente motivata per fornire farmaci ai pazienti in tutto il mondo. L'ufficio capo del personale del PTS svolge un ruolo cruciale nel garantire operazioni di business fluide, guidare iniziative strategiche di leadership e promuovere una forza lavoro altamente impegnata e informata in questa rete globale. La comunicazione efficace e il forte impegno dei dipendenti sono fondamentali per allineare i nostri team globali con la visione strategica di Roche e garantire a tutti di capire come il loro lavoro contribuisce al quadro più grande. L'opportunità Sosterrete direttamente il Capo di Stato Maggiore di PTS, aiutando ad eseguire strategie di comunicazione interna, gestire iniziative di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti globali e ottimizzare le operazioni aziendali quotidiane per il team di leadership.
• Comunicazioni interne: assistenza nella redazione, redazione e pubblicazione di newsletter, articoli intranet, messaggi di leadership e annunci organizzativi per mantenere la comunità globale PTS informata e allineata.
• Engagement & Event Management: Sostenere la pianificazione, il coordinamento e l'esecuzione di eventi interni come le sale comunali globali, i fuorisiti di leadership, le attività di team building e i programmi di riconoscimento dei dipendenti.
• Supporto per le operazioni aziendali: assistere il capo di stato maggiore con la preparazione di presentazioni esecutive, gestire gli ordini del giorno delle riunioni e monitorare il progresso dei principali responsabili strategici per il team di leadership PTS.
• Creazione e progettazione dei contenuti: Sviluppare contenuti multimediali coinvolgenti (presentazioni, grafica, video brevi) per aiutare a tradurre la catena di fornitura complessa e argomenti strategici in messaggi accessibili e ispiranti per l'organizzazione più ampia. Chi sei Attualmente si sta perseguendo un Bachelor o Master, idealmente in Comunicazioni, Business Administration, Marketing, Risorse umane, Relazioni pubbliche, o Psicologia organizzativa. Inoltre, siete:
• Proficiente nelle applicazioni Microsoft/Google, in particolare PowerPoint/Slides. L'esperienza con piattaforme intranet (ad esempio, Google Sites, SharePoint) o strumenti grafici/multimediali di base (ad esempio, Canva) è un vantaggio forte.
• Keenly interessato alle comunicazioni aziendali, al comportamento organizzativo, alla strategia aziendale e a come operano i team di leadership.
• Un giocatore di squadra altamente organizzato e creativo con eccezionali capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali. Si dovrebbe portare un atteggiamento proattivo, una forte attenzione ai dettagli, e la fiducia di interagire con gli stakeholder a vari livelli di leadership.
• Proficiente in inglese. Ulteriori informazioni
• Data di inizio: agosto 2026
• Carico di lavoro: 100%
• Durata: minimo 3 mesi, fino a 6 mesi
• Posizione: in loco o ibrida
• Non è possibile scrivere una tesi durante lo stage. Processo di applicazione
• Invia la tua app
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) involves a range of activities, from Supply Chain to Regulatory Affairs to Finance to People & Culture. Click here to find out the range of departments involved, as well as previous projects worked on. This internship will be in the space of the PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy. Included in the internship will be training on the basic concepts of the work done in the respective departments. The interns will also be able to take advantage of Roche resources on subjects such as interviewing, making presentations, time management, and more. For this internship, we are looking into a more specific and focused scope of supply chain management. The Pharma Technical Operations Supply Chain (PTS) is a complex, global network that requires seamless coordination and a highly motivated workforce to deliver medicines to patients worldwide. The PTS Chief of Staff office plays a crucial role in ensuring smooth business operations, driving strategic leadership initiatives, and fostering a highly engaged and informed workforce across this global network. Effective communication and strong employee engagement are critical to aligning our global teams with Roche’s strategic vision and ensuring everyone understands how their work contributes to the bigger picture. The Opportunity You will directly support the Chief of Staff of PTS, helping to execute internal communication strategies, manage global employee engagement initiatives, and optimize day-to-day business operations for the leadership team.
• Internal Communications: Assist in drafting, editing, and publishing newsletters, intranet articles, leadership messages, and organizational announcements to keep the PTS global community informed and aligned.
• Engagement & Event Management: Support the planning, coordination, and execution of internal events such as global town halls, leadership offsites, team-building activities, and employee recognition programs.
• Business Operations Support: Assist the Chief of Staff with preparing executive presentations, managing meeting agendas, and tracking the progress of key strategic deliverables for the PTS leadership team.
• Content Creation & Design: Develop engaging multimedia content (presentations, graphics, short videos) to help translate complex supply chain and strategic topics into accessible, inspiring messaging for the broader organization. Who You Are You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in Communications, Business Administration, Marketing, Human Resources, Public Relations, or Organizational Psychology. Furthermore, you are:
• Proficient in Microsoft/Google applications, especially PowerPoint/Slides. Experience with intranet platforms (e.g., Google Sites, SharePoint) or basic graphic design/multimedia tools (e.g., Canva) is a strong plus.
• Keenly interested in corporate communications, organizational behavior, business strategy, and how leadership teams operate.
• A highly organized, creative team player with exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You should bring a proactive attitude, strong attention to detail, and the confidence to interact with stakeholders at various levels of leadership.
• Proficient in English. Additional information
• Start Date: August 2026
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: Minimum 3 months, up to 6 months
• Location: on-site or hybrid
• It is not possible to write a thesis during the internship. Application process
• Please submit your app

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Pharma Technical Operations (PT) umfasst eine Reihe von Aktivitäten, von der Supply Chain bis zu Regulatory Affairs bis hin zu Finanzen bis hin zu People & Culture. Klicken Sie hier, um die Palette der beteiligten Abteilungen zu finden, sowie frühere Projekte gearbeitet. Dieses Praktikum wird im Raum der PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy sein. Im Praktikum werden die Grundkonzepte der in den jeweiligen Abteilungen geleisteten Arbeit trainiert. Die Praktikanten werden auch in der Lage sein, die Roche-Ressourcen zu Themen wie Interview, Präsentationen, Zeitmanagement und mehr zu nutzen. Für dieses Praktikum suchen wir ein spezifischeres und fokussiertes Angebotskettenmanagement. Die Pharma Technical Operations Supply Chain (PTS) ist ein komplexes, globales Netzwerk, das eine nahtlose Koordination und eine hoch motivierte Belegschaft benötigt, um Medikamente für Patienten weltweit zu liefern. Der PTS-Vorstand des Personals spielt eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Geschäftsbetriebs, der Förderung strategischer Führungsinitiativen und der Förderung einer hoch engagierten und informierten Belegschaft in diesem globalen Netzwerk. Effektive Kommunikation und ein starkes Mitarbeiterengagement sind entscheidend, um unsere globalen Teams mit Roches strategischer Vision auszurichten und sicherzustellen, dass jeder versteht, wie ihre Arbeit zum größeren Bild beiträgt. Die Chance Sie werden den Chief of Staff of PTS direkt unterstützen, interne Kommunikationsstrategien durchführen, globale Mitarbeiterengagement-Initiativen verwalten und den täglichen Geschäftsbetrieb für das Führungsteam optimieren.
• Interne Kommunikation: Assist bei der Erstellung, Bearbeitung und Veröffentlichung von Newslettern, Intranet-Artikeln, Führungsnachrichten und organisatorischen Ankündigungen, die PTS Global Community informiert und ausgerichtet zu halten.
• Engagement & Event Management: Unterstützung bei der Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von internen Veranstaltungen wie globalen Stadthallen, Führungsplätzen, Teambuilding-Aktivitäten und Mitarbeitererkennungsprogrammen.
• Business Operations Support: Betreuen Sie den Stabschef mit der Vorbereitung von Executive-Präsentationen, der Verwaltung von Meeting-Agenda und verfolgen Sie den Fortschritt der wichtigsten strategischen Lieferungen für das PTS-Führungsteam.
• Content Creation & Design: Entwickeln Sie ansprechende Multimedia-Inhalte (Präsentationen, Grafiken, kurze Videos) um komplexe Supply Chain und strategische Themen in zugängliche, inspirierende Messaging für die breitere Organisation zu übersetzen. Wer bist du? Sie verfolgen derzeit einen Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss, ideal in Kommunikation, Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Personal, Public Relations oder Organisationspsychologie. Darüber hinaus sind Sie:
• Proficient in Microsoft/Google-Anwendungen, insbesondere PowerPoint/Slides. Erfahrung mit Intranet-Plattformen (z.B. Google Sites, SharePoint) oder grafischen Grund- und Multimedia-Tools (z.B. Canva) ist ein starkes Plus.
• Keenly interessiert sich für Unternehmenskommunikation, Organisationsverhalten, Geschäftsstrategie und wie Führungsteams arbeiten.
• Ein hoch organisierter, kreativer Teamplayer mit außergewöhnlichen schriftlichen und verbalen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Sie sollten eine proaktive Haltung, eine starke Liebe zum Detail und das Vertrauen, mit Interessenvertretern auf verschiedenen Ebenen der Führung zu interagieren.
• Proficient auf Englisch. Weitere Informationen
• Startdatum: August 2026
• Workload: 100%
• Dauer: Mindestens 3 Monate, bis 6 Monate
• Standort: vor Ort oder hybrid
• Es ist nicht möglich, eine Dissertation während des Praktikums zu schreiben. Anwendungsprozess

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opération technique Pharma (PT) comprend une gamme d'activités, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement aux affaires réglementaires aux finances aux gens et à la culture. Cliquez ici pour connaître la gamme des ministères concernés, ainsi que les projets antérieurs. Ce stage se déroulera dans l'espace de la PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy. Le stage comprendra une formation sur les concepts de base du travail effectué dans les différents départements. Les stagiaires pourront également profiter des ressources de Roche sur des sujets comme l'entrevue, la présentation, la gestion du temps, etc. Pour ce stage, nous examinons un champ plus spécifique et ciblé de la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. La chaîne d'approvisionnement Pharma Technical Operations (PTS) est un réseau mondial complexe qui nécessite une coordination transparente et une main-d'œuvre hautement motivée pour fournir des médicaments aux patients du monde entier. Le bureau du chef d'état-major du STP joue un rôle crucial dans la bonne marche des opérations, dans la conduite des initiatives de leadership stratégique et dans la promotion d'une main-d'oeuvre hautement engagée et informée dans ce réseau mondial. Une communication efficace et un engagement fort des employés sont essentiels pour aligner nos équipes mondiales sur la vision stratégique de Roche et faire en sorte que tout le monde comprenne comment leur travail contribue à l'image globale. L'opportunité Vous soutiendrez directement le chef de cabinet de PTS, aidant à exécuter des stratégies de communication interne, à gérer des initiatives globales d'engagement des employés et à optimiser les activités quotidiennes de l'équipe de direction.
• Communications internes : aider à rédiger, éditer et publier des bulletins d'information, des articles intranet, des messages de leadership et des annonces organisationnelles afin de tenir la communauté mondiale du PTS informée et alignée.
• Engagement et gestion des événements : Appuyer la planification, la coordination et l'exécution d'événements internes tels que les mairies mondiales, le leadership hors site, les activités de renforcement d'équipe et les programmes de reconnaissance des employés.
• Soutien opérationnel : aider le chef de cabinet à préparer des exposés, à gérer les ordres du jour des réunions et à suivre l'avancement des principaux résultats stratégiques pour l'équipe de direction du STP.
• Création et conception de contenu: Développer des contenus multimédias (présentations, graphiques, vidéos courtes) pour aider à traduire la chaîne d'approvisionnement complexe et les sujets stratégiques en messages accessibles et inspirants pour l'organisation en général. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) involves a range of activities, from Supply Chain to Regulatory Affairs to Finance to People & Culture. Click here to find out the range of departments involved, as well as previous projects worked on. This internship will be in the space of the PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy. Included in the internship will be training on the basic concepts of the work done in the respective departments. The interns will also be able to take advantage of Roche resources on subjects such as interviewing, making presentations, time management, and more. For this internship, we are looking into a more specific and focused scope of supply chain management. The PHM focus area within the Pharma Technical Operations (PT) focuses on driving the E2E capabilities required to have robust, timely and compliant mitigation of risks across the product’s lifecycle. This role is dedicated to ensure that products and supply chains are designed to deliver a competitive advantage and proactively manage product health from initial launch through late life cycle. You will help build the guidance that enables product teams to measure health, set targets and document it in the existing tools so that we can generate strategic portfolio insights. The Opportunity
• Framework Evolution : adapt the comprehensive guidance to measure Product Health (PH), including re-definition of metrics and setting the corresponding targets to track how well products meet market needs.
• Digital Implementation : support the gathering of PH metrics and actions in Monday.com as the central monitoring platform and support creating dashboards that visualize PH and their link to brand forecasts.
• Training : design and execute a training plan for the product teams to be able to run their second iteration of PH assessment following the adapted guidance and documentation in Monday.com.
• Execution : conduct the next PH assessment and consolidate the results for the next Portfolio Health Review.
• Strategic Visibility : gain deep exposure to product strategy, portfolio management, and cross-pharma "winning solution" generation.
• Technical Skill Building : develop high-demand skills in digital tool implementation (Monday.com) and the definition of a guide that assesses product management performance.
• Lasting Impact : Establish the oversight mechanism that enables data-driven decision-making for the organization's entire product portfolio. Who you are You are currently studying for a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with an interest in healthcare technical operations. Furthermore, you have
• A strong technical interest in business processes, digital dashboards, and product strategy.
• Proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications. Experience with data visualization and storytelling is a plus.
• Proficiency in English.
• A creative mindset, and approach challenges with a constructive attitude. In addition, you are a proactive learner and problem-solver. Additional information
• Start Date: August 2026
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: Minimum 3 months, up to 6 months
• Location: on-site
• It is not possible to write a thesis during the internship. Application process

• Renforcement des compétences techniques : développer des compétences à forte demande dans la mise en œuvre des outils numériques (Monday.com) et la définition d'un guide qui évalue les performances de gestion des produits.

Inoltre, i contraffatti sono realizzati con sostanze tossiche o preparazioni inefficaci che possono causare gravi malattie o addirittura la morte. La contraffazione è un'attività illegale che ha gravi conseguenze per la salute pubblica e la sicurezza dei pazienti. L'Opportunità Sosterrete il team GRACC nell'eseguire strategie anti-contraffazione vitali, assicurando l'integrità della nostra catena di fornitura globale e aiutando a proteggere i pazienti dai pericoli dei farmaci contraffatti. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Counterfeit medicines and diagnostic products pose a significant risk to the safety of patients. Counterfeit products can be found in any country and often look identical to authentic versions, making them difficult to detect, particularly for patients. Patients believe they are taking the right treatment, but they are actually at risk. The counterfeits may contain too much or too little of the active ingredients, or none at all, preventing patients from receiving the proper treatment. Even worse, counterfeits are made with toxic substances or ineffective preparations that can cause serious illness or even death. Counterfeiting is an illegal activity that has serious consequences for public health and patient safety. That’s why Roche is fully committed to working with health authorities and law enforcement agencies worldwide to aid their investigations into the source of counterfeits and prevent their distribution. We employ several anti-counterfeit strategies to combat this global threat to public health and help ensure the integrity of our products, and we are committed to giving healthcare professionals and patients the information they need to safely access them. The opportunity You will support the GRACC team in executing vital anti-counterfeiting strategies, ensuring the integrity of our global supply chain, and helping to protect patients from the dangers of counterfeit medicines. Furthermore, you will
• Assist in the ongoing development and monitoring of Roche's anti-counterfeit strategies and supply chain security initiatives.
• Support the creation of educational materials and communications aimed at healthcare professionals and patients to help them recognize authentic products and avoid counterfeits.
• Help coordinate efforts between internal teams, health authorities, and law enforcement agencies to aid in tracking and investigating counterfeit sources.
• Assist in tracking global counterfeiting trends and data to help the team identify potential vulnerabilities in the market. Who you are You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (ideally in Public Health, Supply Chain Management, Life Sciences, Law, or Business). In addition, you have:
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications (Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint). Experience with data tracking or risk analysis tools is a plus.
• A strong interest in patient safety, global supply chain security, regulatory affairs, and public health policy.
• A team player mindset who thinks outside the box, shares their ideas, and has a strong ethical commitment to safeguarding patient health and well-being.
• Proficiency in English. Additional information
• Start Date: August 2026
• Workload: 100%
• Duration: Minimum 3 months, up to 6 months
• Location: on-site
• It is not possible to write a thesis during the internship. Application process
• Please submit your application, including a CV and a motivation letter.

• For non-EU/EFTA citizens: Certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory (required due to regulations). Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you.
