At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Territory Manager - Vadodara A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche . As a Territory Manager - Vadodara , you are responsible for managing the sale of the organization’s products through distribution and retail channels across the Vadodara geographic area. You serve as a strategic partner to the Area Sales Manager (ASM), providing critical market insights to estimate product demand and drive the organization’s growth. You apply new approaches to merchandising and field activation to increase brand visibility and ensure that our life-changing products reach the customers and patients who need them. You work collaboratively with distributors and dealers to break down barriers to access, ensuring that our sales plans are executed with precision and operational excellence. Your Opportunity
• Territory Planning & Execution: You drive business results by providing information on the market environment to help estimate yearly product demand. You ensure the monthly achievement of SKU-wise sales plans and targets by generating secondary sales in the market.
• Distribution Management: You monitor distributor performance, reviewing the existing network to propose the appointment of new partners or the termination of non-performing ones. You motivate distributors and dealers through regular communication, sorting out issues regarding accounts, pricing, and schemes.
• Sales Promotion & Merchandising: You prepare and execute sales promotion plans through field activation and merchandising activities designed by the Marketing Team. You maintain rigorous records of these activities, tracking expenses and sales generated to provide feedback on program efficacy.
• Market Intelligence: You monitor competitor information and feedback within your category. You provide regular reports to the ASM on competitor activities and stock availability of promotional materials to ensure Roche remains competitive in the landscape.
• Customer Excellence: You address all complaints and suggestions from distributors and customers by coordinating with customer care. You organize dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies to ensure brand consistency and strong partnerships.
• Financial Oversight: You ensure timely monthly collections through continuous follow-ups and submit inventory requirements at the distributor level as per the sales plan. You maintain disciplined daily reporting of customer visits as per established work norms. Who You Are
• Qualified Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Science or Pharmacy . A post-graduate qualification is considered an additional advantage.
• Industry Experience: You have a minimum of 2-3 years of experience with a proven track record in FMCG, OTC, or Retail sales .
• Regional Expert: You possess a deep understanding of the Vadodara/Surat market environment and have experience managing independent representatives, distributors, or agents.
• Strategic Partner: You have demonstrated the ability to assist leadership in planning and executing complex sales promotion plans with a focus on productivity and efficiency.
• Analytical & Disciplined: You rely on data to track sales performance and inventory, with a high degree of accountability for daily reporting and meeting monthly sales targets.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams. Your tasks and Responsibilities
• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.
• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.
• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.
• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness. Who you are
• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a key contributor in chemistry and biology. Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will help bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables. The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, performing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles. Your Role and Responsibilities:
• You will contribute to efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems.
• You will support the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.
• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance, solving potentially complex problems by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedents.
• You will conduct early-stage troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.
• You will act as a technical resource for colleagues with less experience, serving as a go-to person for explaining complex molecular biology and sequencing chemistry concepts to a team of talented engineers.
• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware. A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company. This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA. Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role. Who You Are (Required):
• You have a PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering (or a closely related discipline) with 3+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Master's degree in one of the above disciplines with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of relevant industry experience.
• You possess a strong understanding of the fundamental principles of chemistry and molecular biolog

descriptionByLocale.it:
Who We Are Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories, and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites. Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. ( Please note that this vacancy is currently not linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.) The Position In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a System Integration Troubleshooter, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development or product care of complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidcs, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements. As System Integration Troubleshooter, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):
• Conducting root-cause investigations of systemic issues found during development or escalated from field or Operations in all lifecycle phases (from early feasibility to product care), and collaborate with other functions do develop solutions for complex issues
• Building up subject matter expertise and providing support to the RMD Development Teams (Assay-, Software- and Instrument-Development), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) and Operations. This requires close cross-department interaction to gather all information needed to ensure high-quality support.
• Responsible for internal repair visits, retrofitting of mechanical parts, configuration management monitoring and tracking and installing or updating of the Instrument Software.
• Independent Planning of assigned Workpackages and continuously monitoring and tracking of the working progress.
• Conduct integration development activities on system component level, thereby closely interact with project teams, and participating and coordinating with other internal groups and departments.
• Performing statistical data analysis to support root-cause investigation & problem solving, risk assessment, product development and process improvement. Who you are You’re someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies. Where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point. To be successful in this role (you provide):
• Degree in Biomedical or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
• Ability to work independently, handling cross-departmental development tasks
• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and German
• Strong analytical and interdisciplinary thinking
• Experience in statistical data analysis Who we are At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche Diagnostics International in Rotkreuz is a leading provider of diagnostic systems solutions, and the largest manufacturer of fully automated in vitro diagnostic systems in Switzerland. We are more than 2’700 passionate colleagues from over 65 nationalities. Find out more abo

The Position In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a System Integration Troubleshooter, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development or product care of complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidcs, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements. As System Integration Troubleshooter, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):
• Conducting root-cause investigations of systemic issues found during development or escalated from field or Operations in all lifecycle phases (from early feasibility to product care), and collaborate with other functions do develop solutions for complex issues
• Building up subject matter expertise and providing support to the RMD Development Teams (Assay-, Software- and Instrument-Development), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) and Operations. This requires close cross-department interaction to gather all information needed to ensure high-quality support.
• Responsible for internal repair visits, retrofitting of mechanical parts, configuration management monitoring and tracking and installing or updating of the Instrument Software.
• Independent Planning of assigned Workpackages and continuously monitoring and tracking of the working progress.
• Conduct integration development activities on system component level, thereby closely interact with project teams, and participating and coordinating with other internal groups and departments.
• Performing statistical data analysis to support root-cause investigation & problem solving, risk assessment, product development and process improvement. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose In this very versatile position you act as supporter, trainer and coordinator at the pivotal point between our global affiliates and our internal departments. You will be responsible of:
• Technical Support: Provide high-level (Tier 2) remote and on-site support to resolve technical issues and minimize product downtime.
• Knowledge Management: Maintain an updated product knowledge base and create essential service documentation, manuals, and technical notifications.
• Training & Education: Develop learning paths and conduct training sessions for customers and internal staff, including managing trainer certifications.
• Strategic Optimization: Define service concepts and optimize support processes to improve overall quality, efficiency, and regional cooperation.
• Product Launch Support: Assist with product pilots, prepare preliminary documentation for new launches, and handle up to 30% international travel. Your Profile:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, MIS, or a medical-technical field with strong IT knowledge.
• Experience & Expertise: Proven background in software support and training, backed by high subject matter expertise.
• Communication Skills: Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus) and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for others.
• Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with a deep focus on customer service and teamwork.
• Adaptability: Comfortable working in global matrix structures, self-managed teams, and culturally diverse environments. Following Knowledge Domains and Experience are additional assets:
• Healthcare environments like Lab Middlewares, LIS or HIS.
• Interoperability standards IHE, HL7v2, HL7 FHIR or similar.
• Cloud Architectures and Networks.
• Observability platforms and toolkits like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or Splunk.
• High Level programming languages like Python or similar. Location You will be based in Sant Cugat, Spain. As this position is a global role, international business travel will be required depending on ongoing business project activities. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Roche is an equal opportunity employer. Do you dare to contribute? Apply now! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability. As a Senior Safety Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence. The Opportunity:
• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)
• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.
• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.
• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).
• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.
• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).
• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data. Who you are:
• Qualified healthcare professional or Life Sciences graduate and a minimum 10+ years of drug development experience in pharmaceutical or related industry, including at least 5 years in drug safety; expert-level understanding of scientific aspects of safety, pharmacovigilance, and clinical/patient risk management with demonstrable knowledge of GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements;
• 10+ years of clinical drug development experience in the biopharmaceutical industry or a related sector (e.g. academia; CRO; etc); preferably including at least 5 years of experience in a clinical drug safety-related role.
• Demonstrate expert understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV and clinical/patient risk management (e.g. via demonstrable knowledge of the application of GVP, GCP & CTR requirements) is essential.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence, with and without authority, in a global matrix envir

In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability. As a Senior Safety Medical Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence. The Opportunity:
• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)
• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.
• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.
• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).
• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.
• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).
• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data. Responsibilities due to medical qualifications:
• Interpret emerging safety data in the context of clinical medical practice experience and define safety questions/issues requiring specific clinical medical safety assessments.
• Perform medical practice impact assessments for product quality safety issues.
• Determine potential clinical medical impact of non-clinical safety findings and interpret associated product risks.
• Advise on and interpret how risks may affect the overall clinical risk-benefit balance, considering real-world clinical practice.
• Make formal company medical assessments regarding the causal relationship between reported events and treatment (e.g., for Individual Case Safety Reports).
• Review clinical study plans, protocols, and documentation to ensure appropriate design and feasible risk management measures consistent with current clinical medical practice. Who you are:

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di supporto commerciale (CRM Product Manager)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a Commercial Support Expert (CRM Product Manager) , you will provide hands-on execution support for ongoing CRM product activities. Your role is critical in bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution, focusing on day-to-day support by translating complex business needs into functional requirements and ensuring a healthy, prioritized product backlog. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Product & Delivery Support: Assist with requirements clarification and documentation, creating detailed user stories with clear use cases and acceptance criteria. You will develop business process flow documents and maintain product backlogs and JIRA stories.
• Operational & BAU Support: Support ongoing CRM enhancements, minor configuration requests, and release activities—including release notes and deployment readiness. You will help track dependencies and risks across workstreams and support the triage of requests from business stakeholders.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as a key point of contact between CRM operations, developers, QA teams, and vendors. You will participate in agile ceremonies (stand-ups, grooming, sprint reviews) and maintain project documentation in Confluence and JIRA.
• Quality & Testing: Support SQA and UAT planning, coordination, and defect tracking to ensure high-quality delivery.
• Data & Reporting: Assist with basic CRM reporting needs and validate data outputs, ensuring all documentation aligns with necessary compliance and audit requirements. Who you are: You are a highly organized professional with strong communication skills, capable of working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment to turn business vision into technical reality. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: University degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Experience: 5+ years of experience supporting Veeva CRM platform ideally within the Life Sciences, Commercial, or Medical sectors.
• Technical Skills: Strong Product Management expertise with experience writing functional requirements and user stories.
• Hands-on experience with JIRA and Confluence .
• Deep familiarity with Agile / Scrum delivery models.
• Competencies: Ability to translate business needs into technical specifications.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
• A proactive approach to problem-solving and backlog hygiene. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Foodlicious è la nostra attività quotidiana In oltre 30 anni, Taverne Roche ha sviluppato un'azienda gastronomica di successo. Tavero AG è una controllata al 100% di F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Nei siti di Basilea e Kaiseraugst utilizziamo circa 350 dipendenti provenienti da oltre 41 nazioni. La nostra offerta comprende sia i ristoranti del personale che offrono una varietà di piaceri, così come i ristoranti di Fine Dining con cucina raffinata e un servizio eccellente. Inoltre, ci sono ristoranti con prelibatezze da tutto il mondo, caffè in tutte le varianti, incantati dai nostri baristi, così come i saloni più alti in Svizzera – posti di lavoro fantastici sui tetti della città. Grab'n'Go offre da sushi a Burger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta. Inoltre, offriamo ai nostri ospiti sala riunioni e catering per eventi fino a 1.500 persone. La gastronomia pubblica, lo Schöpfli nel parco e il Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely completano la nostra offerta. Mansion - responsabile della lavanderia - Lavori quotidiani di pulizia e manutenzione secondo il concetto di pulizia o oltre e cura di tutte le cucine ChiMOs - corretta pulizia di piatti, vetreria e utensili da cucina - pulizia, fornitura e cura di piani da tavolo e piatti neri - azione indipendente in conformità con i requisiti di igiene e sicurezza Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Contatto Roche è un datore di lavoro di pari opportunità.

Descrizione
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

La Posizione
Foodlicious is our daily business

In over 30 years, Taverne Roche has developed a successful gastronomy company. Tavero AG is a 100% subsidiary of F. Hoffmann-La Roche. At the Basel and Kaiseraugst sites we employ about 350 employees from over 41 nations.
Our offer includes both Staff restaurants that offer a variety of pleasures, as well as Fine Dining restaurants with fine cuisine and excellent service. In addition, there are restaurants with delicacies from all over the world, coffee in all variants, enchanted by our baristi, as well as the highest-lying lounges in Switzerland – fantastic afterwork spots over the rooftops of the city. Grab'n'Go offers from sushi to Burger and the first and only club in Roche's history complement our offer.
In addition, we offer our guests meeting room and event catering for up to 1,500 people. The public gastronomy, the Schöpfli in the park and the Chez Jeannot in the Museum Tinguely complete our offer.

Mansioni
- Responsible for the laundry room
- Daily cleaning and maintenance work according to cleaning concept or beyond and care of all kitchen inventory
- Correct cleaning of dishes, glassware and kitchen utensils
- Cleaning, provision and care of table top and blackware
- Self-employment in compliance with hygiene and safety requirements, quality requirements and legal regulations
- Support during cleaning/cleaning of the guest area
- Work ready for use in various restorations
- readiness for special services outside the usual working hours (MO – FR, 07.00 – 17.00)

Requisiti
- Experience in the office area (wash-out kitchen)
- Gastronomy is your passion & satisfied guests are your daily destination
- Good and safe handling
- You have an independent way of working and take responsibility
- Team skills and reliability are of course for you
- You have good knowledge of German in word and writing
- In a digital world, we also wish to have computer user knowledge

Chi Siamo
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. En outre, nous offrons à nos invités une salle de réunion et un événement pour accueillir jusqu'à 1 500 personnes. La gastronomie publique, le Schöpfli dans le parc et le Chez Jeannot dans le Musée Tinguely complètent notre offre.

Mansioni
- Responsable de la buanderie
- Nettoyage et entretien quotidiens selon le concept de nettoyage ou au-delà et entretien de tous les stocks de cuisine
- Nettoyage correct de la vaisselle, de la verrerie et des ustensiles de cuisine
- Nettoyage, fourniture et entretien du plateau de table et des articles de toilette
- Travail indépendant dans le respect des exigences d'hygiène et de sécurité, des exigences de qualité et des réglementations légales
- Soutien pendant le nettoyage/nettoyage de la zone d'accueil
- Travaux prêts à être utilisés dans diverses restaurations
- préparation aux services spéciaux en dehors des heures de travail habituelles (MO – FR, 07.00 – 17.00)

Requisiti
- Expérience dans le bureau (cuisine à laver)
- Gastronomie est votre passion et les invités satisfaits sont votre destination quotidienne
- Manipulation saine et sûre
- Vous avez une façon indépendante de travailler et d'assumer la responsabilité
- Compétences d'équipe et fiabilité sont bien sûr pour vous
- Vous avez une bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture
- Dans un monde numérique, nous souhaitons également avoir une connaissance utilisateur d'ordinateur

Chi Siamo
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions au plus haut niveau, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Contatto
Roche est un employeur à chances égales.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione Importante: Dopo la tua applicazione ti contatteremo per e-mail entro pochi giorni. Per assicurarti di non perdere alcun messaggio importante, ti chiediamo di controllare la cartella spam o spazzatura accanto alla tua casella di posta. Se non si sente da noi entro una settimana, si prega di contattare basel.berufslehre@roche.com . Sai già cosa farai dopo la tua laurea? diventare un miglioramento del mondo o salvavita? Non solo devi reinventare il tuo futuro. Anche noi. Noi di Roche lavoriamo con un obiettivo - sviluppare test e medicine innovativi e utilizzare i dati in un nuovo modo per aiutare le persone a vivere più a lungo e meglio. Lasciatevi ispirare chi siamo, cosa facciamo e come lo facciamo. Completa la tua formazione a Roche e fai un contributo decisivo al benessere del paziente! Imparare. Futuro. Roche. Argomenti principali per il lavoro • Produci farmaci per la produzione biotecnologica e chimica • Nella produzione farmaceutica, si elaborano questi principi attivi in farmaci (articolo) • Nella produzione biotecnologica vengono utilizzati organismi viventi, ad esempio le cellule vengono digerite, aumentate e purificate. Nella produzione chimica, si effettuano reazioni chimiche, desolate, estratti, centrifughe e si asciugano i principi attivi prodotti • Nella produzione farmaceutica, i principi attivi precedentemente preparati sono mescolati con additivi, granulati, compressi, vaccinati o anche soluzioni di iniezione sono preparati. Sei responsabile della pianificazione, preparazione e realizzazione di processi biotecnologici, chimici e farmaceutici • Monitorare e servire impianti altamente complessi • Effettuate un lavoro analitico di processi in corso e siete responsabili di tutte le questioni di qualità e sicurezza Hai già pensato a processi e relazioni scientifiche e tecniche? descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wichtig: Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage per E-Mail bei dir. Um sicherzustellen, dass du keine wichtige Nachricht verpasst, bitten wir dich, neben deinem Posteingang auch den Spam- oder Junk-Ordner zu prüfen. Falls du innerhalb einer Woche nichts von uns hörst, melde dich unter basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Weisst Du bereits, was du nach deinem Abschluss machen wirst? Weltverbesserer oder Lebensretterin werden? Nicht nur Du musst Deine Zukunft neu erfinden. Auch wir. Wir bei Roche arbeiten mit einem Ziel - innovative Tests und Medikamente zu entwickeln und Daten auf neue Weise zu nutzen, um Menschen zu einem längeren und besseren Leben zu verhelfen. Lass Dich inspirieren, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun. Absolviere Deine Ausbildung bei Roche und leiste damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Wohle des Patienten!

Lernen. Zukunft. Roche.

Top Argumente für den Job

• Du stellst Wirkstoffe für Medikamente in der biotechnologischen und chemischen Produktion her

• In der pharmazeutischen Produktion verarbeitest du diese Wirkstoffe zu Medikamenten (Arzneiform)

• In der biotechnologischen Produktion wird mit lebenden Organismen gearbeitet, so werden beispielsweise Zellen aufgetaut, vermehrt und aufgereinigt

• In der chemischen Produktion führst du chemische Reaktionen durch, destillierst, extrahierst, zentrifugierst und trocknest die hergestellten Wirkstoffe

• In der pharmazeutischen Produktion werden die zuvor hergestellten Wirkstoffe mit Hilfsstoffe gemischt, granuliert, tablettiert, kapsuliert oder auch Injektionslösungen hergestellt

• Du bist zuständig für die Planung, Vorbereitung und Durchführung biotechnologischer, chemischer und pharmazeutischer Prozesse

• Du überwachst und bedienst hochkomplexe Anlagen

• Du führst analytische Arbeiten der laufenden Prozesse durch und bist verantwortlich für alle Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbelange

Dein Profil

Du hast dir schonmal Gedanken über naturwissenschaftliche und technische Prozesse und Zusammenhänge gemacht? Prima!
Du bist schonmal gescheitert, wieder aufgestanden und hast weitergemacht? Perfekt!
Du möchtest dein Wissen rund um die Gebiete der chemischen-, biotechnologischen- und pharmazeutischen Produktion ausbauen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Was du mitbringen solltest:

• Dich fasziniert die Kombination von Naturwissenschaft und Technik und du möchtest bei der Herstellung von Wirkstoffen und Medikamenten an vorderster Front stehen

• Du hast Spass an der Arbeit mit grossen und hochkomplexen Apparaturen und Maschinen, die zur Herstellung von Produkten und Zwischenprodukten benötigt werden

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team, beteiligst dich aktiv an Diskussionen und hast Spass daran eigene kreative Lösungsansätze zu finden

• Zuverlässigkeit und Präzision sind zwei wichtige Fähigkeiten die man mitbringen sollte

• Gute Leistungen in Mathematik und in naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern

• Mindestens Schulniveau Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Mittlere Reife (D) oder höhere Schulstufen

• Deutsch: Muttersprache oder Niveau B2

Deine Vorteile

• Du arbeitest in einer internationalen Umgebung und erhältst erstklassige Einblicke in die Firma und den Berufsalltag

• Du besuchst eine praxisorientierte Werkschule

• Du arbeitest mit hochmodernen Anlagen, Geräten und zukunftsorientierten Einrichtungen

• Wir unterstützen dich nach der Ausbildung weiterhin und dir stehen verschiedene Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten offen

• Du hast die Möglichkeit in Basel ein Zimmer im Roche Wohnhe

The Position
Misión
En Roche Diagnostics, estamos comprometidos no solo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.

En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

El Field Service Engineer presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente, garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. The Position
Mit seinen 1400 Mitarbeitenden stellt das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst (PTM) die ununterbrochene Patientenversorgung sicher. Im Bereich DOI (Digital, Operational Excellence & Innovation) im Team Business Automation Support (BAS) bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, die digitale Integrität unserer Verpackungsanlagen auf ein neues Level zu heben.

Die Möglichkeit

• In diesem Praktikum bist du an der vordersten Front des Produktionssupports tätig. Dabei schlägst du die Brücke zwischen hochmoderner Automatisierung und strengen regulatorischen Vorgaben.

• Unterstützung: Du unterstützt das Team von DOI Business Automation Support im Daily Business im Verpackungsbetrieb und in der sterilen Produktion.

• Technische Dokumentation: Du erstellst neue Anleitungen für verschiedene Betriebssysteme (Windows, Linux und Legacy-Systeme wie DOS) und führst selbständig GMP Assessments durch.

• Schnittstellenmanagement: Du koordinierst die Durchführung der GMP Assessments gemeinsam mit den Schnittstellen QA, Betrieb und Engineering vor Ort.

Wer Du bist

• Studium: Du studierst Pharmatechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medizintechnik, oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang oder Du hast Dein Studium innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor dem Startdatum abgeschlossen.

• GMP-Interesse: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) oder Data Integrity gesammelt oder möchtest erste Erfahrungen sammeln.

• Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, präzise und behältst auch bei einer grossen Anzahl von Aufgaben den Überblick.

• Prozessoptimierungen :: Starke Durchhaltefähigkeit bei repetitiver Arbeit und entsprechende Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu optimieren.

• Kommunikation: Du bist ein Teamplayer und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte sowohl für Techniker an der Linie als auch für die Qualitätssicherung verständlich formulieren.

• IT-Affinität: Du hast einen versierten Umgang mit Betriebssystemen (Windows, Linux) und keine Berührungsängste mit älteren Systemumgebungen.

• Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Vorteile

• Einblick in das weltweit grösste und innovativste Verpackungszentrum der Roche.

• Verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem Projekt mit hoher Sichtbarkeit.

• Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Ingenieuren, IT-Experten und Qualitätsmanagern.

• Die Chance, theoretisches Wissen über Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) und Computerized System Validation (CSV) direkt in die Praxis umzusetzen.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Avec ses 1400 employés, le centre de production Kaiseraugst (PTM) assure des soins continus aux patients. Dans le domaine de la DOI (Digital, Operational Excellence & Innovation) chez Team Business Automation Support (BAS), nous vous offrons la possibilité de porter l'intégrité numérique de nos systèmes d'emballage à un nouveau niveau.

La possibilité

• Dans ce stage, vous travaillez à l'avant du support de production. Ce faisant, vous dormez le pont entre l'automatisation de pointe et des exigences réglementaires strictes.

• Support: Vous aidez l'équipe de DOI Business Automation Support dans le Daily Business dans l'emballage et la production stérile.

• Documentation technique : Obtenez de nouvelles instructions pour différents systèmes d'exploitation (Windows, Linux et systèmes existants tels que DOS) et effectuez des évaluations GMP indépendamment.

• Gestion des interfaces: Vous coordonnez la mise en œuvre des évaluations des BPF avec les interfaces QA, exploitation et ingénierie sur le site.

Qui vous êtes

• Etude : vous étudiez la technologie pharmaceutique, la technologie d'automatisation, l'informatique, l'informatique commerciale, la technologie médicale, ou un diplôme comparable ou vous avez terminé vos études dans les 12 mois avant la date de début.

• GMP-Interesse: Idéalement, vous avez déjà collecté les premiers points de contact avec les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) ou l'intégrité des données ou souhaitez acquérir de premières expériences.

• Les talents organisationnels : Vous travaillez structuré, précis et suivez un grand nombre de tâches.

• Optimisation des processus: remettre en question et optimiser une forte résilience dans le travail répétitif et les processus correspondants.

• Communication: Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe et pouvez facilement formuler des problèmes complexes tant pour les techniciens en ligne que pour l'assurance qualité.

• IT-affinité: Vous avez une gestion expérimentée des systèmes d'exploitation (Windows, Linux) et aucune crainte de toucher avec les environnements système plus anciens.

• Langues: Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais dans la parole et l'écriture.

Vos avantages

• Découvrez le plus grand et le plus innovant centre d'emballage de Roche dans le monde.

• Tâches sensibles dans un projet à haute visibilité.

• Coopération avec une équipe interdisciplinaire d'ingénieurs, d'experts en informatique et de gestionnaires de qualité.

• La possibilité de mettre en pratique directement des connaissances théoriques sur les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) et la validation informatisée des systèmes (CSV).

Processus de demande

• Votre demande doit contenir un CV et une lettre de motivation.

Informations complémentaires

• Veuillez noter: En raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent présenter un certificat universitaire indiquant qu'un stage est obligatoire et la durée du stage obligatoire.

• Ce stage peut être complété à temps partiel et à temps plein.

Si vous voulez vous développer dans un environnement qui favorise le travail d'équipe et l'innovation, Roche est la bonne entreprise pour vous. Tout rôle dans Roche contribue à améliorer la vie des patients. Prenez contact !

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet motivierten Talenten die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen in der pharmazeutischen Industrie zu sammeln und dabei einen positiven Beitrag für Umwelt und Gesellschaft zu leisten. Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben? In diesem Praktikum analysierst Du das Potenzial dezentraler Wärmepumpenlösungen in Niedertemperatur-Netzen an Roche-Standorten in Deutschland. Ziel ist es, bislang ungenutzte Energiepotenziale in Gebäuden zu identifizieren und nachhaltige Konzepte zu entwickeln, um Wärme- und Kühllasten effizienter zu decken. Dabei untersuchst Du, wie Abwärme aus bestehenden Abluft- und Kühlsystemen genutzt werden kann, um CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren und den Einsatz primärer Energien zu senken. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate sollst Du konkrete Potenziale bewerten, ein geeignetes Pilotgebäude identifizieren und ein erstes Konzept für eine Pilotlösung mit Wärmepumpe entwickeln. Darüber hinaus leistest Du einen direkten Beitrag zu Roches Net-Zero-Ambitionen, indem Du die Grundlage für einen skalierbaren Rollout an weiteren Standorten schaffst. Das Praktikum bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, an einem Thema mit hoher Sichtbarkeit zu arbeiten und einen messbaren Einfluss auf zukünftige CO2-Reduktionen zu erzielen. Die Möglichkeit
• Du analysierst Gebäudeautomationsdaten sowie Energieverbräuche von Medien- und HLK-Systemen in Gebäuden
• Du berechnest Heiz- und Kühllasten bestehender Gebäude sowie deren Gleichzeitigkeit
• Du bewertest, inwieweit Heiz- und Kühllasten durch Wärmepumpen abgedeckt werden können
• Du recherchierst geeignete am Markt verfügbare Wärmepumpenlösungen und vergleichst sie mit den identifizierten Potenzialen
• Du identifizierst ein geeignetes Pilotgebäude und erarbeitest ein Pilotkonzept auf konzeptioneller Ebene
• Du schätzt den lokalen und globalen Wirkungspotenzialbeitrag für Roche weltweit ab
• Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung eines möglichen Rollout-Plans für verschiedene Standorte Wer Du bist Du bist an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert und studierst im Master oder MBA, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energieversorgung, Automatisierung, Energiemanagement, Thermodynamik, Physik, Nachhaltigkeitsmanagement oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld anwenden. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:
• Erfahrung in der Analyse großer Datenmengen
• Idealerweise erste Kenntnisse in der Berechnung von KPIs, Energiebilanzen oder energietechnischen Auswertungen
• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Deutschkenntnisse; gesprochenes Deutsch ist von Vorteil Eine kollaborative Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Schnittstellen
• Flexibilität sowie Interesse daran, nachhaltige technische Lösungen mitzugestalten Wenn Du die meisten, aber nicht alle Qualifikationen mitbringst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über Deine Bewerbung. Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2.268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum
• 37,5h die Woche
• Flache Hierarchistufen trotz Konzernstruktur
• Mitarbeitervergünstigungen (Corporate Benefits) Deine Bewerbung Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten w

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

In qualità di catalizzatore integrato dell'impegno medico, si svolgerà un ruolo vitale nel sostenere l'esecuzione e il progresso di queste iniziative strategiche. Questa posizione si concentra sull'applicazione pratica di nuovi strumenti di comunicazione e quadri, assicurando che siano robusti, user-friendly, e fornire valore misurabile alla comunità medica. Come contributore chiave, vi aiuterà a consentire la necessaria evoluzione di come i dati scientifici sono condivisi e sperimentati a livello globale.

• Innovare l'impegno medico: Immaginare e abilitare l'evoluzione dei modelli di fidanzamento medico, assistendo nello sviluppo pratico di nuovi strumenti, modelli e piattaforme.

• Esecuzione dell'azionamento: Piombo e abilitare la consegna di nuovi quadri per la comunicazione medica, la gestione dei flussi di lavoro del progetto e la garanzia di raggiungimento delle pietre miliari e che le "noci e bulloni" operative dei nuovi modelli di comunicazione e di impegno funzionino efficacemente per l'eccellenza operativa dell'utente finale per l'utente finale.

• Scale Experiments: testa esperimenti di fidanzamento innovativi, progettando percorsi per standardizzare e scalare modelli di successo in tutta la rete medica globale.

• Foster Collaboration: lavorare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne e le agenzie esterne per facilitare l'implementazione di nuovi standard e risolvere le barriere di implementazione.

• Assicurare l'integrità tecnica: assicurarsi che tutti i nuovi quadri e tecnologie aumentano l'impatto del cliente, pur rimanendo facili da adottare per le squadre di Medical Affairs.

• Rispettare la conformità: assicurarsi che tutte le attività seguano i codici legali, normativi e aziendali, comprese le direttive Roche e le politiche di impegno HCP.

Chi sei

Sei un professionista proattivo con una passione per "Scientific Storytelling". Si prospera in un ambiente dinamico e trasformazionale. Si guarda oltre i processi attuali per risolvere i punti di dolore ed evolversi per il futuro. Sei un comunicatore collaborativo, fluente in inglese, che può navigare in ambienti di matrice e costruire partnership significative tra team interni ed esterni.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:

• Competenza qualificata: Preferito un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (PhD, PharmD, o MD) con 2-3 anni di profonda conoscenza negli Affari Medici (Comunicazioni Scientifiche, Istruzione Medica, o Medicina di Campo).

• Agilità strategica: forti capacità di gestione del progetto con la capacità di priorizzare più obiettivi in un ambiente frenetico.

• Conoscenza dell'industria: una forte comprensione dell'ambiente bio-farmaceutico regolamentato e un impegno ad elevati standard etici.

• Mindset orientato al futuro: una passione per l'innovazione e la capacità di semplificare i messaggi complessi per il pubblico diverso.

• Spirito collaborativo: un comprovato record di lavoro in modo efficace all'interno di team globali e interfunzionali.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As an Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst, you will play a vital role in supporting the execution and advancement of these strategic initiatives. This position focuses on the practical application of new communication tools and frameworks, ensuring they are robust, user-friendly, and deliver measurable value to the medical community. As a key contributor, you will help enable the necessary evolution of how scientific data is shared and experienced globally.

• Innovate Medical Engagement: Envision and enable the evolution of medical engagement models, assisting in the hands-on development of new tools, templates, and platforms.

• Drive Execution: Lead and enable the delivery of new frameworks for medical communication, managing project workstreams and ensuring ensuring milestones are met and that the operational "nuts and bolts" of new communication & engagement models function effectively for the end-useroperational excellence for end-user.

• Scale Experiments: Test innovative engagement experiments, designing pathways to standardise and scale successful models across the global medical network.

• Foster Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to facilitate the rollout of new standards and troubleshoot implementation barriers.

• Ensure Technical Integrity: Ensure all new frameworks and technologies increase customer impact while remaining easy for Medical Affairs teams to adopt.

• Uphold Compliance: Ensure all activities follow legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice, including Roche directives and HCP engagement policies.

Who You Are

You are a proactive professional with a passion for "Scientific Storytelling". You thrive in a dynamic, transformational environment. You look beyond current processes to solve pain points and evolve for the future. You are a collaborative communicator, fluent in English, who can navigate matrix environments and build meaningful partnerships across internal and external teams.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Qualified Expertise: An advanced life-science degree (PhD, PharmD, or MD preferred) with 2-3 years of deep knowledge in Medical Affairs (Scientific Communications, Medical Education, or Field Medical).

• Strategic Agility: Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple goals in a fast-paced environment.

• Industry Knowledge: A strong understanding of the regulated bio-pharmaceutical environment and a commitment to high ethical standards.

• Future-Oriented Mindset: A passion for innovation and the ability to simplify complex messages for diverse audiences.

• Collaborative Spirit: A proven track record of working effectively within global, cross-functional teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Die Chance

Als Integrierter Medical Engagement Catalyst werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung dieser strategischen Initiativen spielen. Diese Position konzentriert sich auf die praktische Anwendung neuer Kommunikationsinstrumente und -rahmen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie robust, benutzerfreundlich sind und der medizinischen Gemeinschaft messbare Werte liefern. Als wesentlicher Beitrag helfen Sie, die notwendige Entwicklung der Weitergabe und Erfahrung von wissenschaftlichen Daten weltweit zu ermöglichen.

• Innovate Medical Engagement: Vergewissern Sie sich und ermöglichen die Entwicklung von medizinischen Eingriffsmodellen und unterstützen Sie bei der praktischen Entwicklung neuer Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und Plattformen.

• Drive Execution: Führen und ermöglichen die Bereitstellung neuer Frameworks für die medizinische Kommunikation, das Management von Projekt-Workstreams und die Sicherstellung von Meilensteinen und dass die operativen "Nüsse und Bolzen" von neuen Kommunikations- & Engagement-Modellen effektiv für die Endbenutzer-Exzellenz für Endbenutzer funktionieren.

• Scale Experiments: Erprobte innovative Engagement-Experimente, die Wege zur Standardisierung und Skalierung erfolgreicher Modelle im globalen medizinischen Netzwerk.

• Foster Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Interessenvertretern und externen Agenturen zusammen, um das Ausrollen neuer Standards und die Fehlerbehebung der Implementierungsbarrieren zu erleichtern.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die technische Integrität: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle neuen Rahmenbedingungen und Technologien die Auswirkungen des Kunden erhöhen, während Sie für die Teams von Medical Affairs leicht bleiben.

• Einhaltung der Einhaltung: Gewährleistung aller Aktivitäten, die den Rechts-, Rechts- und Unternehmenskodizes der Praxis entsprechen, einschließlich Roche-Richtlinien und HCP-Vermittlungspolitiken.

Wer bist du?

Sie sind ein proaktiver Profi mit einer Leidenschaft für "Scientific Storytelling". Sie blühen in einer dynamischen, transformierenden Umgebung. Sie schauen über aktuelle Prozesse hinaus, um Schmerzpunkte zu lösen und entwickeln sich für die Zukunft. Sie sind ein kollaborativer Kommunikationspartner, fließend auf Englisch, der Matrixumgebungen navigieren und sinnvolle Partnerschaften über interne und externe Teams aufbauen kann.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:

• Qualifizierte Expertise: Ein fortgeschrittener Life-Science-Abschluss (PhD, PharmD oder MD bevorzugt) mit 2-3 Jahren tiefem Wissen in der Medizin (wissenschaftliche Kommunikation, Medizinische Bildung oder Feldmedizin).

• Strategische Agilität: Starke Projektmanagementfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Ziele in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu priorisieren.

• Branchenwissen: Ein starkes Verständnis der regulierten biopharmazeutischen Umgebung und ein Engagement für hohe ethische Standards.

• Future-Oriented Mindset: Eine Leidenschaft für Innovation und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Botschaften für unterschiedliche Publikum zu vereinfachen.

• Collaborative Spirit: Eine bewährte Erfolgsbilanz der effektiven Arbeit innerhalb globaler, funktionsübergreifender Teams.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben.

Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft.

Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'opportunité

En tant que catalyseur d'engagement médical intégré, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'exécution et l'avancement de ces initiatives stratégiques. Cette position met l'accent sur l'application pratique de nouveaux outils et cadres de communication, s'assurant qu'ils sont robustes, conviviaux et offrent une valeur mesurable au milieu médical. En tant que contributeur clé, vous contribuerez à l'évolution nécessaire de la manière dont les données scientifiques sont partagées et vécues à l'échelle mondiale.

• Innovez l'engagement médical : envisagez et activez l'évolution des modèles d'engagement médical, contribuant au développement pratique de nouveaux outils, modèles et plateformes.

• Exécution de l'entraînement: Diriger et permettre la mise en place de nouveaux cadres pour la communication médicale, gérer les flux de travail des projets et veiller à ce que les étapes soient franchies et que les "écrous et boulons" opérationnels des nouveaux modèles de communication et d'engagement fonctionnent efficacement pour l'excellence opérationnelle de l'utilisateur final.

• Expériences à l'échelle : Tester des expériences d'engagement innovantes, concevoir des voies pour normaliser et évaluer des modèles réussis dans le réseau médical mondial.

• Favoriser la collaboration: Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes internes et les organismes externes pour faciliter le déploiement de nouvelles normes et résoudre les obstacles à la mise en œuvre.

• Assurer l'intégrité technique : veiller à ce que tous les nouveaux cadres et technologies accroissent l'impact client tout en restant faciles à adopter par les équipes des affaires médicales.

• Maintien de la conformité : Veiller à ce que toutes les activités respectent les codes de pratique juridiques, réglementaires et d'entreprise, y compris les directives Roche et les politiques d'engagement du HCP.

Qui vous êtes

Vous êtes un professionnel proactif avec une passion pour « Scientific Storytelling ». Vous prospèrez dans un environnement dynamique et transformationnel. Vous regardez au-delà des processus actuels pour résoudre les points de douleur et évoluer pour l'avenir. Vous êtes un communicateur collaboratif, parlant couramment l'anglais, qui peut naviguer dans les environnements matriciels et construire des partenariats significatifs entre les équipes internes et externes.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :

• Expertise qualifiée : Diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie (PhD, PharmD ou MD préféré) avec 2-3 ans de connaissances approfondies en affaires médicales (communications scientifiques, éducation médicale ou médecine de terrain).

• Agilité stratégique : Des compétences solides en gestion de projet avec la capacité de prioriser plusieurs objectifs dans un environnement rapide.

• Connaissance de l'industrie : une bonne compréhension de l'environnement biopharmaceutique réglementé et un engagement envers des normes éthiques élevées.

• L'esprit d'avenir : une passion pour l'innovation et la capacité de simplifier des messages complexes pour divers publics.

• L'esprit collaboratif : une expérience éprouvée de travail efficace au sein d'équipes globales et interfonctionnelles.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche: Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad:
• Título del Puesto: Becario / Practicante de Farmacoeconomía
• Departamento: Acceso al Mercado / Farmacoeconomía
• Reporta a: Gerente de Farmacoeconomía
• Propósito del Puesto: Brindar soporte técnico y analítico al equipo de Farmacoeconomía en la generación de evidencia local, optimizando los tiempos de entrega de los dosieres de valor y materiales económicos necesarios para el posicionamiento de las terapias de Productos Roche. Responsabilidades:
• Investigación y análisis de datos: Realizar búsquedas sistemáticas de literatura científica, guías clínicas y datos epidemiológicos o de costos locales en fuentes oficiales.
• Soporte en Modelaje: Apoyar en la adaptación, control de calidad y actualización de modelos de impacto presupuestal y costo-efectividad.
• Desarrollo de Entregables: Colaborar en la redacción y armado de secciones técnicas de los dossiers de valor para sometimientos institucionales.
• Gestión de Información: Mantener actualizadas las bases de datos internas del área (precios, competidores, resoluciones institucionales). Quién eres:
• Educación: Estudiante activo de los últimos semestres (con al menos 6 meses a 1 año restante de carrera) en Licenciaturas de Economía, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines con un fuerte enfoque analítico.
• Habilidades Técnicas: * Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas).
• Comprensión de lectura técnica en inglés (indispensable para la revisión de artículos científicos).
• Deseable (no exclusivo): Conocimiento básico o interés en estadística o economía de la salud.
• Competencias: * Atención al detalle y rigurosidad analítica.
• Proactividad y alta capacidad de organización.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position 职位名称：罗氏制药生物统计分析实习生 工作地点：上海 实习部门/团队介绍: 整合证据生成与合规团队 (Integrated Evidence Generation and Compliance) 隶属医学事务部，致力于整合临床与真实世界数据，通过科学研究填补证据缺口，论证产品医学价值，赋能医学策略与临床决策。 加入该项目你将：
• 深度参与前沿研究： 与统计师及数据科学家协作，处理多元化的真实世界数据，支持高标准的医学证据生成。
• 统计分析实战： 运用常规及探索性统计方法，完成从数据清洗、标准化到核心分析代码（SAS/R）的编写与调试。
• 工具创新与优化： 运行并优化现有分析工具，针对特定医学需求开发自动化分析插件或模型。
• 数据洞察可视化： 参与构建数据可视化看板（Tableau），将复杂结果转化为直观的科学洞察。 我们期待这样的你：
• 专业背景： 公共卫生、生物统计学、数据科学或相关专业在校研究生。
• 技术能力： 熟练掌握 SAS 或 R 语言进行统计建模；具备 Tableau / PowerBI 经验者优先。
• 办公技能： 精通 Excel（数据处理）及 PPT（可视化呈现）。
• 时间要求： 7月至9月期间，每周至少保证 3天 线下办公（到岗）。
• 核心素质： 具备严谨的科学思维、出色的逻辑分析能力及良好的团队协作精神。 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate.
