At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Delivery Services Manager leads the delivery and operational continuity of digital solutions supporting Pharma Technical Development (PTD) systems transitioning to RDT TechOps. In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery management of a portfolio of GMP and non-GMP applications – ensuring service stability, compliance readiness, and stakeholder alignment throughout the knowledge transfer and steady-state operations. You will also act as IT Product Owner for your assigned systems, bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as: Service Manager, Delivery Service Manager, and Technical Product Owner. The Opportunity In this role, you will be responsible for:
• Delivery & Service Ownership: Lead the end-to-end delivery and operational management of assigned PTD systems – including GMP-critical applications clinical manufacturing solutions at the intersection of process development and manufacturing – ensuring continuity, compliance, and performance throughout and after the transition from PTD to RDT TechOps.
• IT Product Ownership: Act as IT Product Owner for assigned systems, defining and prioritizing the product backlog, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring delivery is aligned with business value and regulatory requirements.
• GMP Compliance Awareness: Operate with a strong understanding of GMP-regulated environments, ensuring that all delivery activities, system changes, and documentation practices meet applicable quality and compliance standards.
• Knowledge Transfer Leadership: Drive structured knowledge transition from outgoing PTD resources, ensuring documentation, runbooks, and operating procedures are captured and validated before go-live.
• Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong working relationships with PTD business stakeholders, TechOps leadership, MSP vendors, and RDT product teams – acting as the primary point of contact for your assigned systems.
• Vendor & MSP Coordination: Manage third-party service providers and system integrator partners supporting your portfolio, ensuring SLA adherence and value delivery.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify and drive process improvements across delivery operations, contributing to the maturity of the broader RDT TechOps model.
• Agile Execution: Apply Agile methodologies to manage delivery cadence, facilitate ceremonies, and maintain transparency across workstreams. Who you are You are a delivery-oriented professional with a hands-on approach and a passion for operational excellence in regulated digital environments. You bring:
• Proven experience in a Delivery Management or Service Management role, ideally within a pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry context.
• A University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Information Technology, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience managing GMP or GxP-regulated systems, with an understanding of validation requirements and change control processes.
• Strong IT Product Owner capabilities, including backlog management, stakeholder prioritization, and vendor governance.
• Experience managing third-party technology providers and system integrator partners.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As an Operational Specialist in Treasury & AR , you will play a vital role within our Finance Shared Service Center. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial transactions while supporting the broader Treasury and Accounts Receivable functions. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is committed to continuous process improvement. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Operational Execution: Coordinate and support stringent financial tasks, including daily bank postings, interface controls, manual corrections, and the reconciliation of bank and bank suspense balance sheet accounts.
• AR & Treasury Management: Execute customer direct debit payments, cash allocation, and the clearing of AR and bank suspense accounts. You will be responsible for posting and reconciling treasury and AR transactions.
• Accounting & Compliance: Perform day-to-day activities according to agreed service levels and SOPs. This includes AR manual invoicing, GL journal posting, account reconciliations, and FX revaluation.
• Reporting & Communication: Manage intercompany reconciliation and reporting. You will handle incoming calls and emails from stakeholders in a timely, professional manner.
• Team Collaboration: Proactively seek opportunities for effective cooperation across teams and geographies. Provide support to team members to balance workloads and foster a positive team environment.
• Continuous Improvement: Propose process and system improvements and contribute to the overall performance of the Shared Service Center (SSC) through active participation in workshops and meetings. Who you are: You are a finance professional with a solid understanding of accounting processes, a customer-service mindset, and the ability to work effectively with limited direction. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: University or College degree, with a concentration in Finance or Accounting .
• Experience: 3-5 years of experience in Finance and Accounting .
• Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Finance Shared Services and operational accounting processes. Knowledge of technology systems such as SAP and BlackLine is highly desired.
• Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Proficiency in Portuguese and/or French is a plus.
• Skills: * Strong ability to prioritize and organize work to meet tight deadlines.
• Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication skills.
• Ability to multitask and manage up effectively.
• High level of integrity and commitment to complying with corporate guidelines. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The Head of US Government Affairs & Policy leads Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and public policy strategy, shaping the legislative and regulatory environment to advance innovation, protect market access, influence healthcare policy, and mitigate risk. Based in Washington, D.C., this executive serves as Roche Diagnostics’ principal representative to policymakers, regulatory agencies, trade associations and external stakeholders, while acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on political and policy developments affecting the business. This role reports to the Global Head of Quality, Regulatory & External Affairs, with a dotted-line relationship to the President and CEO, Roche Diagnostics North America. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Policy Strategy & Advocacy
• Develop and lead Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and policy strategy aligned with business priorities.
• Influence federal and state policy impacting diagnostics, reimbursement, healthcare innovation, trade and regulatory matters.
• Anticipate risks and opportunities and shape advocacy strategies to support growth and patient access.
• Serve as a strategic partner ensuring the US Government Affairs agenda is co-created with commercial leaders; translate complex political and regulatory shifts into strategic implications that inform business planning and investment decisions. Strategic Trade Association Leadership:
• Evaluate and recommend Roche Diagnostics’ participation in industry trade associations;
• Direct executive engagement within these forums to lead cross-industry efforts on critical medical technology and policy issues. Government & Stakeholder Engagement
• Serve as Roche’s senior liaison with Congress, Administration officials, federal agencies and state policymakers.
• Lead engagement with key trade associations, coalitions, patient groups and external stakeholders to advance Roche’s policy agenda. Partners with external stakeholders, as appropriate, to build alignment with Roche Diagnostics’ policy positions and encourage external advocacy efforts consistent with those positions. (e.g., non-profit associations, industry organizations, think tanks, coalitions).
• Lead Roche’s presence in government forums and strategically deploy internal subject matter experts (from manufacturing to R&D) to testify, brief officials, and provide technical guidance that advances the company's policy objectives. Strategic Counsel & Business Partnership
• Advise senior leaders on political, legislative and policy developments affecting Roche Diagnostics.
• Bring external insights into business strategy and translate policy developments into actionable implications.
• Support executive engagement with policymakers and key public affairs opportunities. Policy Leadership in Partnership with Commercial Organization
• Lead customer communications on policy in partnership with the US commercial team.
• Engage with policy counterparts from key customers as well as laboratory industry trade associations.
• Participate in US Commercial leadership forums including USLT (US Leadership Team) and ELT (Enterprise Leadership Team). Team Leadership & Capability Building
• Lead and develop a high-performing US Government Affairs and Policy team, including talent development, succession planning, coaching and organizational capability building.

titleByLocale.it: Biostatistica senior per gli Algoritmi Clinici

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your Department We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights. Your Team Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development. Your Main Objectives and Tasks
• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.
• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.
• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.
• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams. Who You Are
• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.
• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.
• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.
• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt. Dein neues Team: Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:
• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.
• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.
• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.
• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.
• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.
• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:
• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.
• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.
• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.
• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.
• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 10.06.2026 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position YOUR TEAM You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams. ROLE PURPOSE As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations. WHAT YOU WILL DO
• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).
• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China
• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.
• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.
• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)
• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS
• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.
• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.
• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.
• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.
• DEMONSTRATE AGILITY AND ABILITY TO PERFORM IN A HIGHLY FAST-PACED, MATRIX ENVIRONMENT WHERE CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION IS CRUCIAL. Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills to motivate teams, neg

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Mit der Zukunft im Blick gestalten wir den Standort von Roche in Rotkreuz aktiv weiter. Einen wichtigen Beitrag hierzu leistet die Abteilung Engineering & Project: Hier liegt die Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Standortes und sämtliche Investitionen in Gebäude und Anlagen. Dazu gehören Bauprojekte im Bereich Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit, Sicherheit, Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit und Wirtschaftlichkeit. In dieser anspruchsvollen Schlüsselfunktion bist du die zentrale Instanz für die operative Exzellenz und die baurechtliche Strategie auf dem Areal Rotkreuz. Du vereinst tiefgreifendes technisches Verständnis mit strategischem Prozessmanagement und repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Behörden und Partnern. Die Möglichkeit Strategisches Construction Management
• Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung globaler Standards für die Auswahl, das Onboarding und die Steuerung von CM-Partnern, Generalplanern und Unternehmern.
• Schnittstellenmanagement: Agieren als entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Vendor Management und Projektleitung zur Sicherstellung prozesskonformer Projektabläufe.
• Beratung: Fachspezifischer Input bei komplexen Ausschreibungen und strategische Beratung der Projektleiter in allen Belangen des Construction Managements. Bebauungsplanung & Bewilligungsmanagement
• Arealstrategie: Verantwortung für die Einhaltung und strategische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Bebauungspläne in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.
• Process Ownership: Zentrale Steuerung sämtlicher Baubewilligungsprozesse sowie Definition standortweiter Bewilligungsstrategien für alle Investitionsprojekte.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Als Pharmafacharbeiter Ansatz / Abfüllung (m/w/d) bist Du für die Vorbereitung, Überwachung, Reinigung und Desinfizierung der Abfüllmaschine, der Gefriertrocknungsanlage und den optischen Kontrollmaschinen verantwortlich. Verantwortlichkeiten In dieser Rolle bist Du für die sichere Durchführung von Standardaufgaben und komplexen Prozessen in der Wirkstoffverarbeitung verantwortlich:
• Du gewährleistest den reibungslosen Ablauf der Abfüllung von sterilen Lösungen in Vials unter Berücksichtigung aseptischer Arbeitsweise nach Herstellanweisung und Einhaltung von GMP- und Hygienevorschriften
• Du führst mikrobiologische Umgebungskontrollen durch und bist verantwortlich für die Störungsbeseitigung auch von schwierigen Störungen an der Abfüll- und Gefriertrocknungsanlage
• Ein wichtiger Bestandteil Deiner Aufgabe besteht zudem in der GMP-gerechten Dokumentation und Kontrolle der durchgeführten Arbeiten in Herstellprotokollen (zukünftig elektronisch), elektronischen Logbüchern sowie Belegbüchern etc.
• Im Rahmen der Arbeitsvorbereitung reinigst, desinfizierst und sterilisierst Du Geräte und Kleinteile
• Du bist für die kontinuierliche Pflege und Aktualisierung von SOPs im Arbeitsbereich zuständig und unterstützen bei der Erstellung von GMP-Dokumenten (SOPs, Formulare)
• Darüber hinaus engagierst Du dich im Rahmen unseres KVP-Prozesses zur Verbesserung unsere Arbeitsabläufe
• Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und verfügst generell über ausgezeichnete kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Als Teamplayer bist du in der Lage, effektiv mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln. Das bringst du mit
• Du hast idealerweise eine dreijährige abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemikant, Pharmakant oder Pharmazeutisch-technischer Assistent (PTA) (m/w/d).
• Deine mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, ggf. Berufserfahrung in der Parenteralia-Herstellung zeichnet Dich aus.
• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Hygienebereich und in der Einhaltung der GMP-Richtlinien sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
• Du bist routiniert im Umgang mit Dokumentationsarbeiten und gängigen IT-Anwendungen (insbesondere MS Office, MES, Unilab).
• Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für die Bedienung und Kenntnis von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und überzeugst durch deine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
• Fähigkeit und Offenheit, die Chancen und die Vorteile von Veränderungen zu erkennen und das Warum zu vermitteln.
• Du begegnest allen Mitarbeitenden offen mit Respekt und Wertschätzung.
• Es besteht die Bereitschaft, in flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen eingesetzt zu werden. Darüber hinaus bist Du bereit, in Schichtsystemen mit Früh/Spät/Nacht zu arbeiten. Bei der Schichtplanung ist uns Deine Gesundheit wichtig und wir achten ebenso auf faire Zulagen Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet! Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 05.06.2026 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. To

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Payroll, Time and Benefits Senior Team Lead What we do: The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We work closely together as a team to ensure strong employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Your day to day responsibilities: As a Payroll Time & Benefits Team Lead, you are responsible for leading a Payroll Time & Benefits Operations (PTB) team across multiple countries (a country cluster) and performing all people leadership activities in line with Roche People Practices. You will ensure local PTB performance targets are met at both the team and individual levels, and that regular operations reviews are held internally, as well as externally with relevant stakeholders. As a Qualified Lead you are:
• Leading and managing the Payroll Time and Benefits Operations (PTB) team by delivering best services and solutions towards the clients.
• Ensuring delivery of services in accordance with agreed performance levels (KPI) and in line with legal/regulations (compliance), continuously driving improvement activities/projects (simplification, standardization, automation) for service excellence and consistent customer experience.
• Working in line with overall People Support Solutions strategy, seeking better/creative solutions to support business needs as well as leveraging advanced technology to continually drive teamwork efficiency and enhance customer experience.
• Leading and facilitating people processes in line with Roche Leadership commitments, People Practices and policies, Roche values.
• Role Modeling our people practices, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions.
• Developing team member’s knowledge, skills, capabilities in line with the Roche People Practices to retain and develop talented staff.
• Driving employee retention, engagement and talent management.
• Creating a safe and positive team culture and environment, ensuring the team is demonstrating the right mindset and attitude (trust, growth mindset, customer centricity, E2E accountability, problem solving).
• Ensuring consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced, maintaining strong customer satisfaction within the area of responsibility, pro-actively providing feedback/inputs to stakeholders from a service perspective.
• Setting and monitoring team working plan, resource allocations, workload.
• Seeking, identifying and driving continuous service and process improvement (in terms of standardization, automation, and simplification), and service enhancement based on monthly performance, customer feedback.
• Sustaining a win-win relationship with external vendors, as well as monitor the vendor performance through routine and/or project work.
• Collaborating with peers within the region and globally PTB community and achieving our People Support Solutions vision by driving global consistency through collaboration.
• Partnering with other Service teams (e.g. Advisory, People Support, Employee Lifecycle teams) for cross functional end to end service delivery and process improvement.
• Actively contributing to the global PTB program and People & Culture transformation to ensure the defined strategy is successfully implemented within the assigned countries. What you bring to our team: ​ We are looking for someone who is self-motivated,

Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit für die Freiheit in der Arbeit, wo Ihr Unternehmen und Ihr Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste de la paie, du temps et des avantages sociaux, vous vous assurerez que les gens de Roche travaillent de façon transparente pour l'entreprise en gérant l'exécution de bout en bout de la paie, de l'impôt et de l'assurance sociale. Vous jouerez un rôle vital en fournissant un soutien consultatif et en maintenant l'intégrité des données tout en maintenant les principes axés sur le client au cœur de chaque interaction.
• Exécuter de bout en bout des activités de paie, y compris la maintenance des données pour l'impôt, l'assurance sociale, et l'administration des prestations locales/mondiales avec une grande précision.
• Fournir un service à la clientèle expert en résolvant les demandes complexes, en gérant les demandes et en dépannant les problèmes liés à la rémunération, au temps et aux avantages.
• Superviser la gestion du temps et de l'absence, collaborer avec les gestionnaires pour assurer le respect des politiques locales et l'exactitude des dossiers des employés.
• Gérer les flux de données techniques , surveiller les intégrations Workday et traiter les fichiers de téléchargement de masse pour assurer l'exactitude du fournisseur et le traitement en temps opportun.
• Assurer le respect de la réglementation dans divers pays et juridictions, en tenant compte de l'évolution des exigences juridiques et de la documentation interne.
• Favoriser les relations avec les principaux intervenants, établir des partenariats proactifs avec les chapitres sur les P et C et fournir des conseils aux équipes de soutien de premier niveau pour améliorer la prestation des services.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en participant à des projets mondiaux et en mettant en œuvre des initiatives visant à optimiser les performances et la qualité des services. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel axé sur les détails avec une forte mentalité analytique et une passion pour la centricité des clients. Vous prospèrez dans des environnements multiculturels et rapides et vous êtes pleinement responsable de la prestation de résultats cohérents et de haute qualité au-delà des frontières.
• Expérience professionnelle: Vous apportez de 1 à 3 ans d'expérience dans les services de paie et l'administration des prestations, idéalement dans un environnement de centre de services partagés.
• Compétences linguistiques: Vous maîtrisez couramment l'allemand et l'anglais
• Compétence technique : vous avez des compétences Excel avancées (v-lookup, tables pivotantes) et une bonne compréhension du cycle de paie et des processus RH.
• Capacité d'analyse : Vous avez un excellent œil pour les détails et pouvez naviguer dans des structures de données complexes pour résoudre les erreurs et assurer l'exactitude.
• Collaboration matricielle : Vous avez fait la preuve de vos résultats dans une organisation matricielle et vous êtes à l'aise de travailler indépendamment avec des priorités concurrentes.
• Orientation à la solution: Vous démontrez de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes, en utilisant l'écoute active et la pensée critique pour conduire à des améliorations de processus.
• Growth Mindset: Vous êtes adaptable au changement, profitez de l'apprentissage de nouveaux outils (comme Workday ou ServiceNow), et prospèrez dans des situations ambiguës. En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constantes, des cours de langues et de formation gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position interne et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.
• Excellents avantages: Forfait de salaire et de cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, possibilité de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.
• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'occasion de la liberté dans le travail, où votre vie privée et d'entreprise coexistent en harmonie.
• Une communauté mondiale inclusive, où nous

title: Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery

titleByLocale.it: Capo Team PT Insights & Data Delivery
titleByLocale.en: Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe PT Insights & Data Delivery

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery (Product Manager) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. Description of the area PT Insights and Data Delivery focuses on the reliable delivery of high quality data combined with the use of data in analytics solutions for both existing and anticipatory business needs with a cross-functional scope and mandate. The role will lead a team of over 20 people to bring the following key benefits to PT
• Reusable and scalable systems that are efficiently operated
• Faster and more robust solutions to meet business challenges
• Reliable delivery of key metrics and performance indicators
• Identifying areas for cost savings and where to invest
• Data/evidence driven decisions
• Process enabling efficient maintenance of reliable enterprise data The role will need knowledge and experience in the following areas Analytics excellence for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality
• Supports business process from Make, Assess to Release
• GMP and Non-GMP Reporting
• Different Levels of Views (Helicopter vs Front Line)
• Enhanced Business Planning
• Self service reporting
• Reducing workload for knowledge workers
• Drive towards actionable insights
• Reliable key performance indicators and metrics
• Comparison across manufacturing sites Data Delivery for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality
• Reliable and high quality delivery of core manufacturing, supply chain and quality dataDevelopment and support of FAIR data pipelines and data products across PT
• Efficient and reliable DataOps
• Brings together information from multiple systems, so that interdependencies between data can be managed and resolved Job Responsibilities
• Strategy & Vision Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.
• Customer-Centricity Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.
• Product Lifecycle Mgmt. Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its gro

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Payroll, Time & Benefits Team focuses on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business. The Opportunity As a Payroll Time Benefits Specialist - French speaking , you are responsible for payroll, time, benefits data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner. You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the People Support Solutions delivery. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation.
• Performing a variety of payroll, time and benefits administrative and analytical activities in support of the EMEA countries/affiliates and serving as a Tier 2 point of contact for all payroll, time & benefits customer inquiries
• Interpreting People & Culture policies and practices for EMEA payroll administration and ensuring Roche local time & absence policies are met
• Providing timely responses to customer payroll inquiries by using an internal case management system and proactively identifying and troubleshooting payroll issues to determine root cause and solutions for resolution
• Analyzing multiple payroll audits during processing to ensure accuracy and validity and corresponding with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time & absence entry
• Managing, processing and reconciling mass upload files for all pay frequencies and supporting inquires resolution, escalating requests to the appropriate resources as necessary
• Monitoring data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy and ensuring integrations are processed timely and resolving any errors ensuring accurately processed
• Analyzing and controlling payroll processes, accruals and employer obligations for EMEA countries and actively participating in the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiative ​ Who you are
• We are seeking an individual with 2+ years of experience in payroll services, in a shared service center environment preferably
• Strong communication skills in English and French (written and spoken) is essential.
• High learning agility on different payroll country practice and able to provide remote support in payroll, time, benefits administration operations with timely manner
• Excellent attention to detail and analytical ability
• Advanced Excel skills (pivot table, v-lookup, etc.) ​ In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di campagne digitali globali - TALENT POOL
titleByLocale.en: Global Digital Campaign Expert - TALENT POOL
titleByLocale.de: Global Digital Campaign Expert - TALENT POOL
titleByLocale.fr: Global Digital Campaign Expert - TALENT POOL

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest! The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design. As a Global Digital Campaign Expert in the Digital Campaigns Chapter, you are central to global campaign content planning, creation, activation, and reuse. You establish and maintain key relationships with stakeholders across the global Pharma or Diagnostics networks, ensuring effective communication between brand and production teams. Your strategic insight allows you to offer crucial recommendations on content development, co-create omnichannel strategies, and drive content reuse across Roche. You leverage your knowledge of the Life Science industry to ensure global campaigns are strategically aligned and adaptable to evolving needs. You coordinate production of assets to support the global product strategy, ensuring asset quality and brand consistency. You manage global campaign asset creation by preparing briefs, coordinating production, and validating with stakeholders. You track content adoption and localization through reports, and dashboards, ensuring that existing assets are effectively utilized. Additionally, you forecast demand, schedule content creation and reuse, and manage global-to-local calendar mapping. You pilot new content services, ensuring high adoption and effective reuse. You oversee end-to-end campaign content production and serve as the main contact for global brand teams, creative teams and production teams, managing expectations and business discussions and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery. You coordinate a team of Campaigns Delivery specialists, facilitate regular communication and monitor progress, ensuring their priorities are clear and processes are aligned. The Opportunity:
• Establish and maintain relationships with stakeholders across global Pharma or Diagnostics networks, ensuring effective communication between brand and production teams.
• Provide strategic recommendations on content development, co-create omnichannel strategies, and drive content reuse across Roche.
• Utilize Life Science industry knowledge to ensure global campaigns are strategically aligned and adaptable to evolving needs.
• Coordinate production of assets to support the global product strategy, ensuring asset quality and brand consistency, and manage global campaign asset creation, including preparing briefs and validating with stakeholders.
• Track localization and adoption of content across affiliates, ensuring effective utilization of existing assets and oversee end-to-end campaign content production, serving as the main contact with global brand teams.
• Forecast demand, schedule content creation and reuse, and manage global-to-local content calendars, providing recommendations on KPIs and metrics across customer journey touchpoints.
• Support the Digital Campaigns Network by driving best practices, continuous improvement, feedback, and facilitating regular communication within a team of Digital Project delivery specialists to ensure priorities are clear and processes are aligned. Who you are:
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In the area of Invasive Sensor Development, we shape the future of continuous monitoring systems at Roche. Our team works at the fascinating and technologically demanding interface between medical technology and the human organism. We research and develop innovative devices worn on or in the body, taking a deep dive into biological interfaces. We are characterized by an open culture, a strong team spirit, and a shared focus on significantly improving the quality of life for patients worldwide. The Opportunity / Your Tasks In this versatile role, you will contribute your profound expertise to decisively advance both existing products and our development pipeline:
• Driving Trends & Research: You identify scientific and technological trends and recognize forward-looking research areas for our strategic value streams.
• Leading Research Projects: Working closely with internal colleagues and external research institutions, you lead and conduct basic as well as applied research in the field of invasive sensors.
• Shaping the Pipeline: You support the organization with your expertise in making well-founded directional decisions within our complex product development pipeline.
• Product Development & Optimization: You integrate your expertise directly into the new development of products and simultaneously ensure that existing systems and the underlying development processes are continuously optimized.
• Interface Management: You steer and monitor work packages assigned to external research partners and ensure a seamless end-to-end (E2E) process chain. Who You Are You are a passionate, structured individual who is enthusiastic about scientific innovation and knows how to clearly comprehend complex technical and biological systems:
• Education: You have successfully completed a Master’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, or a related discipline – ideally, you also hold a PhD.
• Professional Experience: You possess several years of relevant professional experience following your graduation, enabling you to act fully independently and to provide technical guidance to other team members.
• System & Process Understanding: A strong understanding of systems and processes is a prerequisite for this position. As a systems thinker, you confidently navigate complex structures, understand the interaction between device and organism, and have the ability to clearly structure scientific workflows and interfaces.
• Mindset & Business Acumen: Strategic and creative thinking form the foundation of your excellent customer understanding and your strong business acumen.
• Competencies: Thanks to your strong communication skills, decisiveness, and organizational talent, you analyze and solve challenges in multidisciplinary teams quickly and effectively.
• Language Skills: You are entirely fluent in English, both written and spoken. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Oportunidad: El becario apoyará al área de logística en actividades administrativas y operativas dentro del proceso de entrega y retiro de instrumentos acorde al marco de cumplimiento siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos dentro de las políticas con la finalidad de concretar proyectos y cumplir con los objetivos de venta. Responsabilidades:
• Coordinar con las diferentes áreas la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos de diagnóstico en base a las políticas, con la finalidad de concretar proyectos y cumplir con los targets de venta.
• Solicitar la compra de equipos/accesorios de diagnóstico de acuerdo a la demanda del área comercial.
• Coordinar con el área de servicios y logística el retiro de los instrumentos de diagnóstico.
• Mantener la base instalada (actualización de proyectos, actualización de instrumentos de acuerdo al sitio de instalación) - SAP.
• Llevar el seguimiento a los indicadores del proceso.
• Mantener un control sano de inventarios de instrumentos Quien eres: Pasión por el propósito: Te motiva saber que tu trabajo detrás de cámaras permite que un paciente reciba un diagnóstico a tiempo. Agilidad: Te adaptas rápido a los cambios y tienes facilidad para priorizar tareas en un entorno dinámico. Integridad : El cumplimiento de normas y políticas es fundamental para ti; eres ético y responsable con el manejo de información e inventarios. Analítico : Te gusta trabajar con datos e indicadores para medir el éxito de tus actividades. Resiliencia y Enfoque: Entiendes que la logística tiene retos inesperados; mantienes la calma ante la presión y te enfocas en encontrar soluciones efectivas en lugar de detenerte ante los obstáculos (tolerancia a la frustración). Mentalidad de Innovación: No te conformas con "así se ha hecho siempre". Buscas constantemente formas de simplificar y automatizar tareas operativas para hacer los procesos más eficientes y libres de errores. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Você auxilia na revisão, no acompanhamento e no controle das propostas com os clientes, contribuindo ativamente para o cumprimento das cláusulas financeiras estabelecidas.
• Você gerencia stakeholders de diferentes áreas e realiza conexões com marketing, vendas e finanças para garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais da companhia.
• Você apoia o uso de ferramentas para o gerenciamento e acompanhamento contínuo dos indicadores gerenciais (KPIs).
• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários e atua diretamente nas suas implementações.
• Você colabora com a equipe de pricing na execução, análise e definição das estratégias de precificação para produtos e serviços.
• Você suporta o time de finanças na preparação das análises de rentabilidade e de preços.
• Você prepara apresentações e mantém uma interface clara e contínua com a equipe de liderança. Quem você é:
• Você possui habilidade colaborativa, gosta de lidar com pessoas, tem comunicação clara e assertiva e se adapta facilmente a contextos de mudanças.
• Você demonstra agilidade no aprendizado, foco e organização nas atividades processuais, e proatividade para buscar melhorias.
• Você está cursando o Ensino Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 2º ano de formação).
• Você possui forte habilidade analítica, facilidade com números e dados, e extrema atenção aos detalhes.
• Você tem conhecimento intermediário em Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, etc.) e valoriza o trabalho em equipe em seu dia a dia. Diferenciais:
• Você tem conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL, Python, R).
• Você possui nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado para interações corporativas. Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga. A Oportunidade:
• Auxilia na preparação e análise de dados de preços e realiza a monitorização ativa de contratos.
• Colabora diretamente com as equipas de vendas para desenvolver estratégias de gestão de faturação e pagamentos.
• Participa ativamente na preparação de relatórios e apresentações para a gestão sénior.
• Ajuda na implementação de medidas de eficiência e monitoriza a sua execução no dia a dia.
• Dá suporte à manutenção de sistemas de preços e ferramentas analíticas vitais para a equipa.
• Lidera o processo de implementação de reajustes com uma vasta carteira de clientes.
• Contribui com impacto em projetos especiais relacionados com preços, custos e reajustes. Quem você é:

• Ferramentas: Excel do nível intermediário ao avançado .
• Possui forte capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes na execução das suas tarefas.

titleByLocale.it: Specialist de Compliance, Rischi e Auditoria
titleByLocale.en: Especialista de Compliance, Riscos e Auditoria

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Especialista de Compliance, Riscos e Auditoria, você irá atuar como um parceiro estratégico que assegura a conformidade com frameworks globais e legislação local. Você será responsável por monitorar o ciclo de riscos, conduzir auditorias e promover uma cultura de integridade, transformando análises complexas em planos de mitigação práticos e melhorias contínuas que protejam o negócio e suportem a tomada de decisão da liderança . Sobre a oportunidade:
• Coordenação do ciclo anual de Riscos e Oportunidades, garantindo que a metodologia esteja alinhada às estratégias globais e locais.
• Suporte às áreas de negócio na identificação de riscos e no desenvolvimento de planos de ação para ameaças estratégicas, operacionais e de compliance.
• Acompanhamento constante da implementação das melhorias e reporte estruturado da evolução dos riscos para a alta liderança.
• Revisão de políticas internas para garantir conformidade regulatória e condução de auditorias temáticas com foco em recomendações práticas.
• Atuação como principal ponto de contato com o time global (Assuntos Governamentais e Assuntos Regulatórios), assegurando o alinhamento de diretrizes e a atualização de ferramentas corporativas.
• Execução do programa local, com foco em due diligence , análise de riscos de parceiros e implementação de métricas de efetividade.
• Revisão contínua de políticas e procedimentos internos para garantir total alinhamento entre as normas globais e as legislações locais.
• Promoção da cultura de integridade por meio de treinamentos, campanhas de engajamento e planos de lessons learned baseados em desvios identificados. Habilidades e Experiências desejadas:
• Graduação completa em Contabilidade, Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas;
• Inglês avançado e Espanhol desejável.
• Experiência em Auditoria, Riscos e Compliance
• Proficiência em normas e regulamentos de compliance, bem como em metodologias de gestão de risco
• Conhecimento em frameworks (COSO, ISO), SAP, ferramentas de análise de dados e governança corporativa
• Experiência em gestão de projetos;
• Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido (3x na semana no escritório - Zona Sul de São Paulo) Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein neues Team: Du wirst Teil unseres "Simplify Implementation Teams" innerhalb des Vertriebs Services. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team von Spezialist:innen, das in ganz Deutschland unterwegs ist, um unsere Diagnostiksysteme bei unseren Kunden (z. B. in Krankenhäusern und Laboren) zu implementieren. Als Team arbeiten wir eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig bei komplexen Installationen und teilen unser technisches Wissen. Du bist ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt zwischen unseren Kund:innen, dem Vertrieb und dem technischen Service, um eine reibungslose Inbetriebnahme sicherzustellen. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich Dein Fokus liegt auf der erfolgreichen Implementierung unserer Diagnostiksysteme. Dabei übernimmst du folgende Tätigkeiten:
• Du übernimmst die fachgerechte Aufstellung, Installation und Modifikation unserer Standard-Diagnostikgeräte direkt beim Kunden.
• Du führst eigenständig Testläufe durch, nimmst Applikationseinstellungen vor und stellst sicher, dass alle Systeme vom Start weg reibungslos funktionieren.
• Du bist der Schlüssel zu zufriedenen Kund:innen. Du übergibst das betriebsbereite System an das Laborpersonal und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Start.
• Falls bei der Installation technische oder applikative Fehler auftreten, bist Du zur Stelle. Du analysierst die Ursache und behebst Störungen im Rahmen der Implementierung.
• Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sorgfältig im CRM-System und handelst stets im Einklang mit den gesetzlichen Vorgaben (z.B. als Medizinprodukteberater:in). Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Neben einer erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Ausbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in oder ein Studium (z.B. FH) in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung bringst Du idealerweise erste praktische Berufserfahrung (z.B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine technische Ausbildung) im Umgang mit komplexen technischen Systemen mit - sei es in der Elektronik, Hydraulik oder Messtechnik. Folgende Punkte runden Dein Profil ab:
• Aufgrund der regionalen Einsatzplanung und der Fahrzeiten lebst Du im Raum Hannover und bist bereit regelmäßig deutschlandweit zu reisen.
• Du bewegst dich sicher im Umgang mit Steuerungs- und Betriebssoftware und verstehst die IT-Anbindung moderner Analysesysteme.
• Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse (ca. B1/B2-Niveau), um technische Dokumentationen zu verstehen und dich im Team auszutauschen.
• Ein chemisches und technisches Grundverständnis hilft dir, die Funktionsweise unserer Diagnostiksysteme schneller zu erfassen.
• Du arbeitest eigenständig sowie ergebnisorientiert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und schätzt den engen fachlichen Austausch innerhalb unseres deutschlandweiten Teams.
• Du überzeugst durch eine ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, professionell sowie zielgerichtet mit Kunden zu kommunizieren. Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse & Nachweise Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewirb Dich jetzt – wir freuen uns! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a dedicated and experienced professional to join our team as a Senior Administrative Assistant / Event Planner. Your Opportunity The responsibilities for this role include: Corporate Event Management:
• Lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of various and complex events, such as inaugurations, town halls, global leadership team meetings, and other engagement or business events.
• Coordinate and manage facilities required for engagement events, including arrangement of cleaning, dining needs (e.g., coffee, tea), and other necessary resources.
• Liaise with suppliers and vendors for service contracts, event material procurement, and other necessary engagements.
• Create and manage budgets for events, track expenses, and ensure cost-effectiveness.
• Address and resolve any issues that may arise during event planning and execution.
• Develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal departments and external partners.
• Oversee all logistical aspects, such as transportation, accommodation, and on-site event setup and teardown.
• Arrange for audiovisual equipment, staging, and other technical requirements needed for the event.
• Act as the main point of contact for event stakeholders, including speakers, sponsors, and partners.
• Negotiate contracts with vendors, venues, and service providers to secure favorable terms and conditions.
• Develop and implement contingency plans to address potential risks and issues that may arise before and during the event.
• Conduct post-event evaluations to gather feedback from attendees, vendors, and team members.
• Analyze event success metrics, compile evaluation reports, and provide insights for future improvements.
• Support occupational health needs, participate in or provide input to the Emergency Committee and SHE (Safety, Health & Environment). Administrative Support:
• Manage calendars, workshops, and events for the organization.
• Handle financial support tasks, such as processing purchase orders (POs), invoices, and statements of work.
• Plan and schedule diverse types of meetings (e.g., events, offsites, interviews, stakeholder meetups) across multiple time zones for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring high confidentiality.
• Provide administrative support for business operations, including financial management processes, onboarding/offboarding activities, relationship management, learning management support, and department organization. Communication & Collaboration:
• Maintain relationships and information flow with the global management team.
• Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, ensuring effective teamwork.
• Skillfully manage the expectations and needs of internal and external stakeholders. Operational Efficiency:
• Schedule appointments, manage travel itineraries, and coordinate related arrangements.
• Prepare and manage expense reports through to settlement.
• Attend meetings, record and distribute meeting minutes.
• Prepare and analyze complex trends, reports, and presentations using data from various sources.
• Assist in preparing budget and project reports as required.
• Research, collect, compile, and analyze diverse data and information requests.
• Identify bottlenecks in administrative processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency. Quality & Improvement:
• Continuously improve quality and objectives.
• Manage all purchasing activities from order to execution of POs in the system.
• Review invoices

The Position Job Summary The SHE Intern will support the Safety, Health, Environment, and Security team in the continuous improvement of the SHE management system. This role provides hands-on SHE documentation, contributing to a strong safety culture across the organization. Key Responsibilities
• Support with critical thinking the identification of occupational health and safety risks.
• Assist in the development, review, and documentation of Critical Tasks procedures, safe work instructions and chemical management
• Collaborate in the development of SHE related documentation.
• Assist in chemical documentation processes, including inventories, labeling SGA, safety data sheets (SDS), and storage compliance.

• Currently enrolled student in Occupational Health, Occupational Safety Engineering, or related field.
• Ability to critically identify, analyze, and anticipate occupational safety hazards and risks.
• Understanding of critical tasks, safe work procedures and chemical management.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work collaboratively.
• Intermediate level of Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive). Preferred Skills
• Basic knowledge of SHE standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 45001, ISO 14001, NFPA).
• Experience with documentation control or process mapping Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. As an R&D Scientist in our NGS Library Preparation and Target Enrichment team, you will be a key player in executing sample preparation workflows . You will work within a dynamic environment dedicated to advancing molecular biology research and contributing to innovative development efforts . This is an opportunity to thrive in a collaborative team that values technical excellence and scientific curiosity . The Opportunity
• Execute NGS library preparation from diverse sample types using various construction methods .
• Perform DNA and RNA extraction from biological samples, optimizing protocols for high yield and purity .
• Quantify nucleic acids accurately using instruments like Qubit and NanoDrop .
• Operate and troubleshoot sequencing platforms for routine laboratory runs .
• Conduct quality control for nucleic acids and libraries utilizing Agilent TapeStation .
• Maintain precise experimental records in laboratory notebooks and digital formats .
• Analyze experimental data to contribute to technical reports and team presentations .
• Collaborate with cross-functional team members on experimental design and troubleshooting . Who you are
• You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field .
• You possess 2-4 years of relevant laboratory experience, ideally within an industry setting .
• You have hands-on experience with NGS library preparation protocols such as DNA-seq or RNA-seq .
• You are proficient in PCR, nucleic acid extraction, and standard molecular biology techniques .
• You demonstrate strong critical thinking skills and meticulous attention to detail in a fast-paced environment . Preferred
• Experience with advanced DNA QC instruments like Tapestation and Nanodrop .
• Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team .
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills to meet project timelines . Relocation benefits are not available for this posting .
