descriptionByLocale.it:
Roche - Posizione Manager QA Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista impegnato e esperto come QA Manager per rafforzare il nostro team nella gestione del ciclo di vita di attrezzature, dispositivi e sistemi. Il nostro team IMP Quality - Qualification/Validation svolge un ruolo centrale nel garantire la conformità GMP delle attrezzature e dei sistemi utilizzati per la produzione di Medicinali Investigazionali (IMP) a Basilea e Kaiseraugst. Il team copre le apparecchiature di produzione per la sintesi chimica, la formulazione solida, il riempimento sterile, l'imballaggio e l'analisi, così come i sistemi CSV. In questo ruolo diverso, sarete responsabili della garanzia della qualità e del monitoraggio dei processi di qualificazione e validazione complessi per garantire standard GMP globali sono soddisfatti nei nostri siti. Possibilità Per avere successo in questo ruolo e portare avanti i nostri standard di qualità, si assumerà le seguenti responsabilità chiave: - QA Oversight: Assicurare la garanzia di qualità per le attività di qualificazione e validazione per le attrezzature e i sistemi GMP-relevant (attenzione su dispositivi di laboratorio, sistemi informatici "off-the-shelf" e semplici sistemi CSV secondo GAMP 5 categoria 1 & 3). - Document Review: Responsabilità per la revisione e l'approvazione di documenti GMP critici come piani di qualificazione, rapporti, SOP e analisi dei rischi. - Gestione della Qualità: Controllo e approvazione della gestione dei cambiamenti e delle deviazioni, CAPAs, e la condotta di analisi approfondite cause radice per risolvere problemi complessi. - Compliance & Data Integrity: Sostenere l'attuazione dei requisiti di integrità dei dati (DI) e mantenere il "Right to Operate" attraverso attività cGMP end-to-end. - Ottimizzazione: Guidare attivamente le ottimizzazioni del processo e le attività di miglioramento nell'area Qualità IMP. - Interfaccia: Chiudi la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni per raggiungere obiettivi comuni. - Audit & Inspection Support: copertura rappresentativa della vostra area di responsabilità durante le verifiche interne e le ispezioni da parte delle autorità sanitarie.
• Requisiti Come candidato ideale, si porta una forte consapevolezza di qualità e il seguente profilo: - Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea accademica in ingegneria, chimica, scienze della vita, farmacia (o equivalente) e almeno 5 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (di cui almeno 2 anni in QA). - Esperienza di qualificazione: conoscenza pratica completa delle attrezzature e della qualificazione dei dispositivi e validazione secondo l'allegato 15. - CSV & Data Integrity: Solid experience in Computerized Systems Validation (CSV) secondo l'allegato 11 e una profonda comprensione dei requisiti attuali di integrità dei dati. - Audit Expertise & GMP: Una solida conoscenza della qualità globale e dei requisiti GMP e del successo dimostrato nei controlli GMP e nelle ispezioni delle autorità. - Soft Skills & Languages: Forte giocatore di squadra con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e di influenza; competenze fluenti tedesco e inglese (spoken e scritto) sono necessari. Contatto Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità!
descriptionByLocale.en:
# Roche - QA Manager Position ## Descrizione At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. ## Mansioni We are looking for an engaged and experienced professional as QA Manager to strengthen our team in the Lifecycle Management of Equipment, Devices, and Systems. Our IMP Quality - Qualification/Validation team plays a central role in ensuring the GMP compliance of equipment and systems used for the production of Investigational Medicinal Products (IMPs) in Basel and Kaiseraugst. The team covers production equipment for chemical synthesis, solid formulation, sterile filling, packaging, and analytics, as well as CSV systems. In this diverse role, you will be responsible for the quality assurance and monitoring of complex qualification and validation processes to ensure global GMP standards are met at our sites. ## Possibilità To succeed in this role and drive our quality standards forward, you will take on the following key responsibilities: - **QA Oversight**: Ensure quality assurance for qualification and validation activities for GMP-relevant equipment and systems (focus on laboratory devices, "off-the-shelf" computer systems, and simple CSV systems according to GAMP 5 category 1 & 3). - **Document Review**: Responsibility for reviewing and approving critical GMP documents such as qualification plans, reports, SOPs, and risk analyses. - **Quality Management**: Control and approval of change and deviation management, CAPAs, and the conduct of in-depth root cause analyses to solve complex problems. - **Compliance & Data Integrity**: Support the implementation of data integrity (DI) requirements and maintain the "Right to Operate" through end-to-end cGMP activities. - **Optimization**: Actively drive process optimizations and improvement activities within the IMP Quality area. - **Interface**: Close collaboration with internal stakeholders to achieve common goals. - **Audit & Inspection Support**: Representative coverage of your area of responsibility during internal audits and inspections by health authorities. ##
• Requisiti As the ideal candidate, you bring a strong quality awareness and the following profile: - **Education & Experience**: Academic degree in engineering, chemistry, life science, pharmacy (or equivalent) and at least 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry (of which at least 2 years in QA). - **Qualification Expertise**: Comprehensive practical knowledge in equipment and device qualification and validation according to Annex 15. - **CSV & Data Integrity**: Solid experience in Computerized Systems Validation (CSV) according to Annex 11 and a deep understanding of current data integrity requirements. - **Audit Expertise & GMP**: Solid knowledge of global quality and GMP requirements and proven success in GMP audits and authority inspections. - **Soft Skills & Languages**: Strong team player with excellent communication and influencing skills; fluent German and English skills (spoken and written) are required. ## Contatto Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Roche - Poste de gestionnaire de l'AQ Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Mansioni Nous recherchons un professionnel engagé et expérimenté en tant que gestionnaire d'AQ pour renforcer notre équipe dans la gestion du cycle de vie des équipements, des appareils et des systèmes. Notre équipe Qualité PIM - Qualification/Validation joue un rôle central dans la conformité des BPF des équipements et systèmes utilisés pour la production de médicaments expérimentaux (PIM) à Bâle et Kaiseraugst. L'équipe couvre les équipements de production pour la synthèse chimique, la formulation solide, le remplissage stérile, l'emballage et l'analyse, ainsi que les systèmes CSV. Dans ce rôle diversifié, vous serez responsable de l'assurance qualité et du suivi des processus complexes de qualification et de validation afin de s'assurer que les normes mondiales des BPF sont respectées sur nos sites. Possibilità Pour y parvenir et faire avancer nos normes de qualité, vous assumerez les responsabilités clés suivantes : - Surveillance de l'AQ : Assurer l'assurance de la qualité des activités de qualification et de validation des équipements et des systèmes pertinents aux BPF (axer les efforts sur les appareils de laboratoire, les systèmes informatiques « hors service » et les systèmes CSV simples selon les catégories 1 et 3 du GAMP). - Examen des documents : Responsable de l'examen et de l'approbation des documents essentiels sur les BPF, comme les plans de qualification, les rapports, les PON et les analyses des risques. - Gestion de la qualité : Contrôle et approbation de la gestion des changements et des écarts, des APC et de la conduite d'analyses approfondies des causes profondes pour résoudre des problèmes complexes. - Conformité et intégrité des données : Appuyer la mise en oeuvre des exigences relatives à l'intégrité des données (ID) et maintenir le « droit de fonctionner » au moyen d'activités de bout en bout du GMPc. - Optimisation: Diriger activement les optimisations de processus et les activités d'amélioration dans la zone Qualité IMP. - Interface : Collaboration étroite avec les intervenants internes pour atteindre des objectifs communs. - Soutien à l'audit et à l'inspection : couverture représentative de votre domaine de responsabilité lors des audits internes et des inspections effectuées par les autorités sanitaires.
• Requisiti En tant que candidat idéal, vous apportez une forte sensibilisation à la qualité et le profil suivant: - Formation et expérience : Diplôme universitaire en génie, chimie, sciences de la vie, pharmacie (ou équivalent) et au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique (dont au moins 2 ans en QA). - Expertise en matière de qualification: Connaissances pratiques complètes en matière de qualification et de validation des équipements et des dispositifs conformément à l'annexe 15. - CSV & Data Integrity: Solide expérience en validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV) selon l'annexe 11 et une compréhension approfondie des exigences actuelles en matière d'intégrité des données. - Expertise en vérification et BPF : Bonne connaissance des exigences mondiales en matière de qualité et de BPF et succès prouvé dans les audits des BPF et les inspections d'autorité. - Soft Skills & Languages: Joueur d'équipe solide avec une excellente communication et d'influencer les compétences; compétences couramment en allemand et en anglais (parlé et écrit) sont nécessaires. Contatto Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante!

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem-solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care. The Opportunity: Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist:
• You will travel and showcase your expertise in technical repair and installation for Roche assigned product lines.
• You will offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.
• The role involves routine technical support, on-site service, repair, and installation of Roche products.
• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.
• The position requires diagnosing and resolving mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.
• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction. This is a field-based role that requires daily travel and up to 50% overnight travel. Our ideal candidate would reside in the Nashville/Davidson area or the surrounding counties. Who You Are:
• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.
• 5 years of progressive experience in repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking is necessary. Alternatively, a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 1-2 years of progressive experience will suffice.
• Successful completion of training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy is mandatory.
• The ability to travel, including overnight travel, is a requirement for this role. Preferred Qualifications:
• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.
• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.
• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. This is a temporary or secondment position As Global Business Process Specialist—Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division. The Opportunity:
• Lead and drive the deployment of large-scale SAP S4 initiatives, owning key areas such as Asset Accounting, CAPEX, and Lease Accounting while ensuring successful project delivery and integration.
• Execute and continuously enhance end-to-end business process management (E2E BPM) strategies, delivering integrated solutions across processes, technology, and analytics while enabling global business adoption.
• Design and redesign global, cross-divisional processes to be standardized, lean, and fit-for-purpose, ensuring alignment with best practices and organizational goals.
• Govern business processes by prioritizing and implementing change requests, ensuring effective execution, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement, while creating meaningful impact across both business and IT. Who You Are:
• You bring a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a related field, along with 5–7 years of experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or similar functions.
• You possess strong technical and process expertise, including deep knowledge of end-to-end processes, IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, procurement, and hands-on experience in asset and lease accounting within SAP environments.
• You demonstrate a strong methodological foundation (BPM, Six Sigma, Lean, Scrum, PDCA, Kaizen) combined with an agile, customer-centric mindset and high attention to detail and quality.
• You excel in stakeholder management, communication, and leadership, with a proven ability to influence, manage change, navigate ambiguity, and collaborate effectively across global, multicultural, and matrixed organizations, with business-fluent English. Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunit

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Release Train Engineer (RTE): AlgoSuite Platform Engineering

Description:

As a Senior Software Delivery Manager you will be responsible to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions or products of high complexity. This senior-level position involves advanced leadership in agile processes, technical project activities, and strategic improvement initiatives. Additionally, it includes influencing and harmonizing across teams and projects within your organization.
Main tasks and duties:

• Lead and mentor the agile team to foster a positive spirit and collaboration.

• Closely collaborate and align with the key engineering roles working together in the product or solution.

• Act as the primary engineering leader for product delivery with IBL or Product Manager and Program Leader.

• Provide leadership in sprint planning, task estimation, and retrospectives.

• Organize and facilitate sprint presentations and retrospective meetings.

• Continuously evaluate and refine agile processes and ways of working.

• Ensure best practices for engineering are implemented and followed.

• Contribute with new and improved ways of visualizing project metrics, harmonize across projects.

• Oversee the configuration and management of quality and vulnerability tools.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and QMS.

• Identify and implement opportunities for reusing software modules/components.

• Define, review, and adapt team structures for optimal performance.

• Influence and harmonize best practices and processes across multiple teams and projects.

• Lead support for system tests and the overall product delivery process.

• Drive continuous improvement of agile and engineering processes with a constant eye on

• harmonization and alignment.

• Identify, assess, and mitigate risks to ensure project success.

• Develop and deliver regular status reports to senior management and stakeholders.

• Facilitate effective communication within the team and across departments.

Skills & Competencies:

• Agile Mindset: Bringing together people, processes, connectivity, and technology to identify the most effective way of working to accomplish a task, adapting to the needs of time and place.

• Conflict management: Having the awareness and skills needed to work through conflict successfully and efficiently.

• Collaboration & Teamwork: Team player, effective inclusion of team members, holding team members accountable.

• Impact & Influence: Having the ability to influence, persuade, or convince others to adopt a specific course of action, utilizing persuasive techniques or negotiation skills to achieve desired results.

• Technology & Tools: Knowledge and expertise in programming skills, tools, and applications, specific to the needs of each chapter.

• Engineering Methodologies: Understanding of the current framework to efficiently navigate the intricacies of the design and development process.

• Project Management: Management of time, resources, and budget within a project to ensure successful delivery.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering/Com

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

The Diagnostics Solution Implementation Manager leads a high-performing technical solution team to implement and install complex diagnostic systems. The mission is to bridge the gap between the plan and the reality of installation, ensuring every deployment is executed with precision, minimal downtime, and maximum client satisfaction. They are the guardian of the "first impression," transforming a sold contract into a functional, life-saving clinical tool.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

• Recruit, mentor, and technically upskill a field engineering team to handle evolving diagnostic hardware and software middleware

• Conduct performance coaching, including "ride-alongs" and technical audits to provide real-time feedback to engineers in clinical environments

Operational Management

• Act as the single point of contact for resource management on installation projects

• Map out technical experts' deployments across multiple geographic territories based on site readiness and technician expertise

• Monitor KPIs such as Mean Time to Install (MTTI), first-time-fix rates, and customer effort scores

• Manage travel, expense budgets, and specialised tool inventory for the field team

Technical & Compliance Oversight

• Ensures site readiness assessments by reviewing facility blueprints, network requirements, and power specifications

• Audit installation logs and validation protocols to ensure compliance with Quality Management System (QMS) requirements

• Consolidate field data on component failures to provide the organisation with actionable insights for product improvements

Strategic Collaboration

• Act as the primary liaison between project management, the field teams and customers

• Contribute to defining the Laboratory Transformation Leadership team strategy and oversee project prioritisation

• Serve as the final point of technical and operational escalation for complex site issues

Who You Are

Experience & Credentials

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related field (MBA or Master's in Project Management highly preferred)

• Proven experience in a people-management or team-lead role within an engineering environment

• Proven experience managing a portfolio of projects with cross-functional teams of 10+ people

• Demonstrated success in implementing new organisational processes or migrating teams to new project management methodologies

• Valid driving licence

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.
• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments
• Manage vendor accounts
• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution
• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries
• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams
• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer Who you are:
• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience
• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage
• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues
• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment
• Proficiency in English and Polish In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position What we do: The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas. The Opportunity: As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization. Your day to day responsibilities are:
• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.
• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.
• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.
• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application. ​ Who You Are:
• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.
• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.
• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.
• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.
• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.
• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.
• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures. In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position What we do: The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Join us now and be part of our unique transformational journey: we are building a global People & Culture (P&C/HR) Center of Excellence by bringing in talented HR professionals in order to cover complex and challenging HR functions and areas. The Opportunity: As a German speaking People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner (Advisory) you partner flexibly and mostly virtually with leaders across the globe, offering on-demand, ad-hoc support on Business Partnering topics that need more immediate or short-term guidance and value creation. With a good understanding of the business needs and the business context and an excellent ability to apply key P&C concepts, policies and processes, you provide coaching, guidance and support to leaders to help them diagnose and translate their business needs into immediate P&C approaches and ensure effective implementation of solutions in partnership with other chapters. You are a trusted member of the Business Partner Chapter and closely integrated into the PSS organization. Your day to day responsibilities are:
• Strategic Guidance: Provide on-demand coaching and advisory to global leaders on critical P&C topics, including talent management, succession planning, performance management, and organizational design.
• Transformation Support: Lead and advise on complex organizational changes, transformations, and employee representation topics, ensuring risk-based decision-making and compliance with established policies.
• Global Rollouts: Deliver first-class support and coaching during the implementation of new global processes and projects, such as global grading systems or new system launches.
• Data-Driven Insights: Analyze P&C metrics and business data to recommend innovative solutions and provide insights that support our culture and strategic direction.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global/regional squads and PSS chapters to ensure the seamless execution of P&C initiatives and consistent policy application. ​ Who You Are:
• Experienced HR Professional: You bring 3–7 years of experience in similar roles such as HR Business Partnering, People Relations, or Labor Law.
• Bilingual Expert: You possess an excellent written and spoken command of both English and German, enabling you to support the DACH region and global stakeholders effectively.
• Skilled Coach & Communicator: You have a proven ability to provide difficult feedback, resolve conflicts, and influence leaders at all levels of management.
• Strategic Thinker: You can thoughtfully diagnose business needs, weigh the risks and benefits of various options, and propose fit-for-purpose HR approaches.
• You demonstrate strong knowledge in interpreting employment laws and policies, ensuring all solutions are legally sound and culturally sensitive.
• Agile Mindset: You thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, demonstrating high customer centricity, end-to-end accountability, and a passion for continuous learning.
• Relationship Builder: You are a natural networker who excels at navigating complex, matrixed reporting relationships across multiple cultures. In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity. The opportunity As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist. R2R
• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.
• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting
• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.
• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.
• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions. DtP
• Handling all accounts payable related matters Master Data
• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Other
• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits
• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting
• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs Who you are:
• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage
• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience
• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage
• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office
• Demonstrates effective leadership abilities and advocacy, while empowering colleagues in decision-making
• Proven track record in relationship and stakeholder management across diverse groups, with strong negotiation and influencing skills
• Proficiency in English and Bulgarian In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support fle

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Product Owner Security Insights is responsible for the architectural design and delivery of security analytics, security risk insights, and data product development. This means you leverage data to understand security trends, ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, and build data-driven tools to enhance the security posture. The role provides valuable intelligence and technical blueprint to proactively identify and mitigate security risks, demonstrate compliance with industry standards, and develop innovative AI powered solutions to strengthen the overall security posture. Security risk insights are enabling business functions and RDT to make data-informed decisions and stay ahead of evolving cyber threats. . The Product Owner is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation, planning and architectural definition through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. You will own the roadmap, data modelling, and delivery for how we transform security, privacy, and compliance data into a proactive risk-management engine that protects our global assets and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Strategy & Vision: Accountable for setting the direction for the product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and security objectives. Defines the product roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user and user needs. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.
• Customer-Centricity: Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.
• Data Architecture & Engineering Leadership: Serve as the primary Data Architect for the security insights product, designing and owning the end-to-end technical structure within the DataOne ecosystem. You are responsible for designing high-quality Data Products following Data Mesh principles, providing expert guidance to data engineers on the implementation of pipelines (Talend, Snowflake, dbt, Python, DataOps@Roche) and advanced visualizations (Tableau, ThoughtSpot). Your architectural leadership ensures the data foundation is scalable, secure, and optimized for both executive reporting and AI/Machine Learning initiatives.
• Product Lifecycle Mgmt : Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its growth and adoption. Manage the product in compliance with emerging regulations.
• Stakeholder Collaboration : Expand collaboration to a broader set of cross-functional teams and be responsible for aligning these teams around the product roadmap. Clearly communicate the product roadmap, timelines, and potential trade-offs to various stakeholders to manage their expectations effectively.
• Performance & Optimization: Define success metrics, analyse user behavior, and identify opportunities for optimization to achieve business goals. Translate data into actionable insights and regularly communicate product performance to stakeholders and the wider team. Qualifications Education / Experience
• University degree in a technical or analytical field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or Engineering)
• P

The Position The Senior Solution Architect will design business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions to enable Roche’s omnichannel orchestration capabilities. This role focuses on building and scaling an integrated ecosystem leveraging Adobe Experience Platform (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and governance standards. You will operate within a complex, multi-solution environment, driving the architecture vision across data, platforms, and activation use cases. The role requires balancing current delivery needs with long-term scalability, while ensuring robust handling of non-functional requirements (NFRs), data privacy, and system performance. • Define end-to-end omnichannel architecture aligned with business and enterprise standards
• Establish data models, identity frameworks, and integration patterns
• Manage NFRs (performance, scalability, security, compliance) Data & Integration
• Integrate CRM, MDM, consent, and web/app event data Enable unified customer profiles and audience segmentation
• Ensure data quality, governance, and privacy compliance Platform (Adobe Stack)
• Architect and guide implementation of RT-CDP, AJO, and CJA
• Enable real-time segmentation, journey orchestration, and activation
• Ensure seamless integration with enterprise systems Real-time & Orchestration
• Design event-driven and streaming architectures
• Enable multi-channel activation (email, paid media, others)
• Establish reusable audience and journey frameworks Strategy & Delivery
• Define architecture roadmap and support delivery across use cases
• Identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities
• Drive adoption of best practices, patterns, and new technologies Stakeholder Management
• Collaborate across business, product, and tech teams
• Communicate complex concepts clearly and drive alignment Qualifications Experience
• Proven experience in solution architecture within data and martech ecosystems
• Experience with CDPs and omnichannel platforms (Adobe preferred)
• Experience working in global, cross-functional teams
• Certifications on Adobe stack - (AJO, CJA and RT-CDP) Technical Skills
• Strong understanding of:
• Customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation
• Event-driven / streaming architectures
• Integration with CRM, MDM, consent systems
• Experience with APIs, cloud data platforms, and data governance concepts (GDPR) What Success Looks Like
• Scalable omnichannel architecture aligned with enterprise standards
• Reliable data foundation enabling unified profiles and segmentation

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Liaison médicale scientifique (région du Centre-Ouest, États-Unis) Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. La possibilité : La Liaison Scientifique Médicale (LSM) est un chef de file scientifique sur le terrain qui représente Roche Affaires Médicales et Scientifiques auprès des intervenants en laboratoire et cliniques de votre région. Dans ce rôle, vous serez un partenaire de confiance pour les directeurs de laboratoire, les cliniciens et les décideurs clés. Vous allez traduire des données diagnostiques et cliniques complexes en un dialogue significatif qui fait progresser les soins aux patients et informe la stratégie médicale régionale et nationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec Sr. Scientific Managers et Sr. Medical Managers pour aider à façonner et à exécuter un plan médical intégré basé sur des idées du monde réel provenant du terrain. Vous apporterez la voix du client à notre plan et stratégie médicale. Votre point de vue influencera directement la façon dont nous priorisons les initiatives éducatives, soutenons les laboratoires et accélérons l'accès aux diagnostics innovants pour les patients. Ce rôle fait partie de l'équipe Cardiométabolism/Neurologie (Core Lab et NPC) des Affaires Médicales et Scientifiques et nécessite une profondeur scientifique, une curiosité intellectuelle et la capacité d'engager des pairs dans des discussions cliniques et techniques de haut niveau. Bien que vous puissiez apporter une expertise profonde dans un domaine spécifique de la maladie, vous devez être à l'aise d'étendre à une variété de sujets de la maladie et de renforcer continuellement votre base scientifique et de connaissances. Il s'agit d'un rôle pour quelqu'un qui prospère dans l'engagement indépendant sur le terrain tout en contribuant de façon significative à une équipe médicale collaborative et axée sur la stratégie. Rôles et responsabilités clés :
• Engagement stratégique : servir de partenaire scientifique principal pour les KOL, les laboratoires et les intervenants cliniques régionaux.
• Gestion des relations : établir et maintenir des partenariats fiables à long terme pour comprendre l'évolution des besoins et des lacunes des clients.
• Insight Generation: Diriger des échanges scientifiques de grande valeur afin de recueillir des informations concrètes qui éclairent la stratégie médicale et la planification du portefeuille.
• KOL Mapping & CRM Excellence: Identifier les leaders émergents et maintenir une documentation précise et opportune des interactions et des idées dans la SFDC.
• Échanges scientifiques et éducation : offrir une éducation pertinente et non promotionnelle aux cliniciens et aux travailleurs (en personne et virtuellement).
• Soutien éducatif adapté : évaluer les besoins et fournir des ressources personnalisées (p. ex. présentations, mises à jour des pipelines, programmes de conférenciers, PACE).
• Expertise médicale et conformité : maintenir des connaissances thérapeutiques approfondies et répondre aux demandes non sollicitées et non étiquetées conformément aux normes de conformité.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle: partenariat avec des équipes médicales et interfonctionnelles pour exécuter des plans régionaux, soutenir les lancements et contribuer aux activités des conseils consultatifs et des congrès.
• L'excellence médicale et la contribution de l'équipe : assurer l'exactitude scientifique, partager les meilleures pratiques, le soutien à bord et favoriser l'amélioration continue de la MSA. Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes un expert scientifiquement crédible, prêt sur le terrain qui est à l'aise d'engager les directeurs de laboratoire, les directeurs médicaux, les spécialistes cliniques et les principaux intervenants cliniques en tant que pairs. Vous travaillez de façon indépendante, pensez stratégiquement et traduisez des données diagnostiques et cliniques complexes en dialogue significatif

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Security Engineer Job description The Mission: You will be a key member of the SIEM team, contributing to the engineering and strategic evolution of our global Security Log Management and Vulnerability Scanning services. This is an end-to-end ownership role: from defining the roadmap and architectural strategy to hands-on engineering and operational excellence. You will ensure our security infrastructure is not only reliable and scalable but also optimized for the modern era of federated data and AI-driven automation. Description of the area Key Responsibilities:
• Service Ownership & Strategy: Drive the end-to-end lifecycle of our Security Log Management (Splunk & Cribl) and Security Scanning (Tenable) platforms.
• Service Reliability: Ensure the high availability and performance of our security services globally, acting as an escalation point for complex technical challenges.
• System Interconnectivity: Develop and manage sophisticated API integrations to ensure seamless data flow between the security scanning (Tenable) and logging (Splunk/Cribl) tiers.
• Next-Gen Security Log Architecture: Drive the transition from a traditional "index-all" logging approach to a "data-tiering" mindset. You will focus on cost optimization and performance across all data lifecycle phases: routing, filtering, storing and searching, ensuring security data is accessible and cost-effective.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Orchestrate the evolution of our security infrastructure by managing all configurations via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub, Ansible, and Python), to ensure a fully automated and version-controlled environment.
• AI-Augmented Engineering: Actively integrate AI Agents and MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers into daily operations. You will build agentic AI workflows to automate configuration, troubleshooting, and complex interconnectivity, while simultaneously improving service offerings and user experience.
• Mentorship: Act as a technical catalyst for the team, mentoring colleagues in the art of prompt engineering, agentic AI development, and advanced AI ecosystems.
• Technical Leadership: Serve as a technical lead, defining implementation plans and driving continuous process improvements.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Effectively manage relationships across functional teams, acting as a clear communicator and advisor to ensure alignment on security goals and project delivery. Technical Requirements & Expertise:
• Security Service Depth: Deep conceptual understanding of the SIEM/Log Management lifecycle (Collection, Indexing, Storage, Retention and Searching) and Vulnerability Management.
• Networking Fundamentals: Expert understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Load Balancing, Firewalls) as it relates to high-volume security data transport.
• Coding & API Mastery: Strong experience with Python and interacting with complex REST APIs. Proven ability to interconnect disparate technologies via APIs and custom integrations.
• Modern DevOps: Strong experience with Ansible and GitHub for managing infrastructure.
• Advanced AI/Automation: Proven experience or deep project work building Agentic AI workflows. Practical expertise in MCP (Model Context Protocol) or building custom LLM-based tools to automate technical tasks.
• Tooling (Preferred): Experience with Cribl, Splunk, or Tenable is a plus, but the ability to rapidly upscale and automate these via AI is essential. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 10

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• The Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing is a pivotal executive role within the Roche Turkey Leadership Team, entrusted with holistically architecting, leading, and executing the commercial vision and go-to-market strategies for the company's entire pharmaceutical portfolio. This role functions as the "Chief Commercial Conductor," orchestrating and unifying both the strategic business units (Disease Area Teams) and the central marketing capabilities that serve them (Marketing Leads / Marketing Chapter) under a single, cohesive vision. This leader directly manages and develops two distinct leadership groups: the Disease Area (DA) Leads and the Marketing Leads. Through the DA Leads, they hold ultimate accountability for the therapeutic area strategies and full P&L outcomes. Concurrently, through the Marketing Leads, they are responsible for embedding marketing excellence, fostering state-of-the-art capabilities, and ensuring the agile, strategic allocation of marketing resources across the entire Organization. The fundamental purpose of this role is to build a seamless bridge between high-level strategy and flawless execution. By leveraging a deep strategic partnership with the Medical, Access, Regulatory & Government affairs, as well as the Business Excellence Division, this leader will ensure Roche achieves its ambitious market leadership and patient impact goals. Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities 1. Integrated Commercial, Access, Medical, and Government Affairs strategy & execution:
• Architect and drive the overarching commercial strategy for all Disease Areas, ensuring the creation of integrated, omnichannel marketing and sales plans that are executed with excellence in the field.
• Lead portfolio-level strategic planning, including lifecycle management, competitive readiness, and new asset launch sequencing to maximize the long-term commercial value and patient impact of Roche’s portfolio.
• Assume ultimate ownership of commercial forecasting in partnership with finance, resource allocation, and budget management to ensure financial targets are met, and investments yield maximum ROI.
• 2. Disease Area (DA) P&L and Performance Leadership:
• Provide strategic direction, coaching, and empowerment to the DA Leads, holding full P&L accountability for the entire commercial organization. Drive the achievement of ambitious revenue growth, market share, and profitability targets.
• Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and urgency within the DA teams, ensuring they remain laser-focused on overcoming obstacles and achieving their strategic objectives.
• Ensure DA teams have the necessary resources, capabilities, and cross-functional support to win in their respective markets.
• 3. Marketing Capability & Excellence (Marketing Lead) Leadership:
• Lead and cultivate the central Marketing Leads (Marketing Chapter) team, acting as the chief steward of marketing talent and capability within the organization.
• Take direct responsibility for the professional development, career progression, performance management, and succession planning for the marketing talent pool.
• Implement a dynamic resource allocation model, ensuring marketing expertise is deployed fluidly and effectively to the highest-priority strategic initiatives within the DA teams.
• Champion and embed a culture of marketing excellence across the organization, setting the gold standard for brand planning, digital marketing, data analytics, customer journey mapping,

descriptionByLocale.it: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Head of Project Management for Roche Information Solutions (RIS), you will be at the heart of our digital transformation. You will lead a high-performing chapter of project management experts dedicated to delivering life-changing digital healthcare products. In this role, you will: - Shape Strategy : Partner with the Portfolio & Project Management Leadership Team to design and execute mid-to-long-term strategies that drive excellence across Roche Diagnostics. - Lead with Vision : Act as the primary expert for digital product development project management, ensuring our capabilities evolve with industry trends. - Empower People : Serve as a VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leader, mentoring Sub-Chapter and Network Leads to reach their full professional potential. - Optimize Resources : Collaborate across functions to break down silos, ensuring the right expertise is allocated to the most impactful organizational priorities. - Drive Innovation : Champion the evolution of our Digital Foundation, leveraging data, systems, and AI to enhance project execution. - Build Partnerships : Cultivate trusting relationships with executive stakeholders, influencing global alignment to achieve our Diagnostics Vision. Who You Are You are a proactive, strategic leader who thrives on building diverse teams and navigating complex, global environments. You bring a coaching mindset and a passion for developing talent in a networked organization. To be successful in this role, you bring: - Extensive Leadership Experience : Significant track record in line management and leading diverse, international teams within a technology-driven industry. - Digital Expertise : Over 15 years of experience in project management specifically for software and digital products, ideally within Life Sciences or Diagnostics. - Methodological Mastery : Deep knowledge of project management frameworks, including proficiency in Scaled Agile (SAFe) and regulated product development. - Strategic Mindset : Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and challenge the status quo with innovative ideas. - Global Collaboration: Excellent communication skills in English and the flexibility to partner with teams across Europe and US time zones, including 10-20% travel. Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position The (Sr.) Data Expert is responsible for advancing the ASPIRE/S4 master data framework while driving data quality, consistency, and security. This role will spearhead Commercial Master Data Governance, including defining governance rules for the Data Competence Center and the Tagging Ecosystem. Furthermore, the role leads the Master Data Governance Community. By translating business strategies into data rules, managing the tag lifecycle, and empowering Business Data Owners (BDOs) through community leadership, the expert will enable precise omnichannel engagement and data-driven decision-making. This position requires strong governance expertise, analytical skills, and cross-functional leadership. Key Responsibilities Master Data Governance Architecting
• Fully implement ASPIRE/S4 Master Data governance in alignment with global standards to support decision-making within Roche's Digital Backbone.
• Define and harmonize Commercial Data Governance rules with master data community to ensure architectural consistency with the Data Capability Center to achieve a Single Source of Truth.
• Standardize end-to-end lifecycle management for master data to ensure cross-system consistency and regulatory compliance.
• Conduct upstream and downstream lineage analysis for master data across systems, monitor data quality, and drive continuous improvement. Mater Data Community Leadership and Organization
• Lead and facilitate the Master Data Community to foster a cross-functional, data-driven culture.
• Act as the core liaison across strategic, tactical, and operational layers to ensure the implementation of the Master Data Management Policy.
• Continuously upskill BDOs through practical capability-building initiatives.
• Project Management: Lead data governance/analytical governance and other relevant projects by applying professional methodologies (e.g., BPM, Lean, Six Sigma, or PMP).
• Benchmarking: Serve as a liaison to the global master data team and benchmark pharmaceutical industry practices to support future corporate needs.
• Stakeholder Influence: Influence stakeholders to adopt new approaches and data-centric mindsets. Qualifications and Education Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree above preferred
• Pharma industry experience preferred
• 3-5 years’ experience in data management, system development or relevant experience
• 1-3 years’ experience in process, project management and digital transformation experience
• Professions in Process management, Data Governance , Project management and lean methodologies
• Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills.
• Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence others and achieve results in complex environments.
• Business acumen and solid business knowledge in pharma industry
• DAMA, PMP and Six Sigma certificate will be a plus Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Fin dalla sua approvazione dieci anni fa, ocrelizumab si è affermata come uno standard di cura per la relapsing e forme progressive di sclerosi multipla (MS). Il nostro lavoro, tuttavia, è in corso. Il team di scienza clinica ocrelizumab continua a concentrarsi sul miglioramento dell'esperienza del paziente e sull'espansione dell'accesso. Stiamo attualmente cercando uno scienziato clinico per unirsi al nostro team globale con sede a Basilea, Welwyn e negli Stati Uniti. Questo ruolo sosterrà principalmente le nostre ultime priorità di sviluppo. Siamo un team dedicato e collaborativo focalizzato sulle innovazioni significative del ciclo di vita che influiscono direttamente sulla comunità MS. Questa posizione offre l'opportunità di contribuire alla scienza consolidata, affrontando le esigenze insoddisfatte nella comunità MS e servendo le popolazioni più giovani dei pazienti. L'opportunità
• Fornire supporto nello sviluppo e/o nella preparazione di informazioni scientifiche cliniche per l'inclusione nel Piano di Sviluppo Clinico.
• Guidato dallo scienziato clinico Lead/Senior, contribuire al protocollo/ICF (scrittura o modifica), costruire CRF appropriati e coordinare cross-funzionalmente.
• Guidato dallo Scienziato Clinico Lead/Senior, contribuire a presentazioni e comunicazioni cliniche interne/esterne (ad esempio incontri di ricerca, interazioni dei siti di studio, informazioni dei pazienti, newsletter di studio). Presente a riunioni interne appropriate, ad esempio il Team di Leadership di Studio. Contribuisce a astratti, manifesti, contenuti per incontri scientifici.
• Lavorare con Lead/Senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors e gruppi interfunzionali per eseguire il Medical Data Review Plan, l'interpretazione dei dati e contribuire allo studio di reportistica.
• Con l'orientamento, contribuire all'applicazione clinica di prova (CTA)/Comitato di etica (CE) interazioni scritte, pacchetti di briefing, risposte scritte alle domande dell'Autorità sanitaria (HA), dati/preparazioni di scienze cliniche per le interazioni HA e l'inserimento dei dati clinici alle presentazioni regolamentari. Chi sei
• Corso di laurea richiesto (la scienza della vita preferito). Advanced Clinical/Science Degree è altamente preferito (ad esempio PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, ecc.).
• da 0 a 3 anni di esperienza di sviluppo clinico. Mentre l'esperienza precedente è un plus, stiamo principalmente cercando qualcuno con alto potenziale, forte motivazione, e una volontà di imparare
• La familiarità con le leggi, i regolamenti, le linee guida sull'esecuzione di prova clinica globale è necessaria e una certa conoscenza degli aspetti medici di GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (Conferenza internazionale sull'armonizzazione dei requisiti tecnici per la registrazione dei farmaci per uso umano), FDA, EMA e altre linee guida e regolazione rilevanti.
• Buona comprensione delle funzioni multidisciplinari coinvolte nello sviluppo della droga. Un'area terapeutica pertinente esperienza di sperimentazione clinica o un chiaro potenziale per assimilare con qualche supporto.
• Forte capacità di collaborazione con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente all'interno di un team globale geograficamente distribuito. Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. The Position Since its approval ten years ago, ocrelizumab has established itself as a standard of care for relapsing and progressive forms of Multiple Sclerosis (MS). Our work, however, is ongoing. The ocrelizumab clinical science team continues to focus on improving patient experience and expanding access. We are currently seeking a Clinical Scientist to join our global team based in Basel, Welwyn, and the US. This role will primarily support our latest development priorities. We are a dedicated, collaborative team focused on meaningful lifecycle innovations that directly impact the MS community. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to established science while addressing unmet needs in the MS community and serving younger patient populations. The Opportunity
• Provide support in developing and/or preparing clinical science information for inclusion into the Clinical Development Plan.
• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to protocol/ICF (writing or amendment), construct appropriate CRFs and coordinate cross-functionally.
• Guided by the Lead/senior Clinical Scientist, contribute to internal/external clinical presentations and communications (e.g. investigator meetings, study site interactions, patient information, study newsletters). Present at appropriate internal meetings, e.g. Study Leadership Team. Contributes to abstracts, posters, content for scientific meetings.
• Work with Lead/senior Clinical Scientists/Medical Directors/Clinical Directors and cross-functional groups to execute the Medical Data Review Plan, data interpretation and contribute to study reporting.
• With guidance, contribute to Clinical Trial Application (CTA)/Ethics Committee (EC) written interactions, briefing packs, written responses to Health Authority (HA) questions, clinical science data/preparations for HA interactions and clinical data input to regulatory submissions. Who you are
• Bachelor’s Degree required (life sciences preferred). Advanced Clinical/Science Degree is highly preferred (e.g. PhD, PharmD, MSN, MPH, etc.).

• Familiarity with governing laws, regulations, guidelines on global clinical trial execution is required and some knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonization of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA and other relevant guidelines and regulation.

Nous cherchons actuellement un Clinical Scientist pour rejoindre notre équipe mondiale basée à Bâle, Welwyn et les États-Unis. Ce rôle appuiera principalement nos dernières priorités de développement. Nous sommes une équipe de collaboration dévouée axée sur des innovations significatives du cycle de vie qui ont une incidence directe sur la communauté de la SP. Ce poste offre l'occasion de contribuer à la science établie tout en répondant aux besoins non satisfaits dans la communauté de la SP et au service des jeunes patients. L'opportunité
• Fournir un appui pour l'élaboration et/ou la préparation d'information scientifique clinique à inclure dans le Plan de développement clinique.
• Guidé par le chef/chercheur clinique principal, contribuer au protocole/ICF (écriture ou modification), construire des CRF appropriés et coordonner de manière transversale.
• Guidé par le responsable/chercheur clinique principal, contribuer aux présentations et communications cliniques internes/externes (p. ex. réunions des chercheurs, interactions avec les sites d'étude, information des patients, bulletins d'étude). Présenter aux réunions internes appropriées, p. ex. Équipe de leadership d'étude. Contribue aux résumés, aux affiches, au contenu des réunions scientifiques.
• Collaborer avec les scientifiques cliniciens principaux/directeurs médicaux/directeurs cliniques et les groupes interfonctionnels pour exécuter le plan d'examen des données médicales, interpréter les données et contribuer à la production de rapports d'études.
• Avec des conseils, contribuer à la demande d'essai clinique (DEC)/Comité d'éthique (CE) des interactions écrites, des dossiers d'information, des réponses écrites aux questions de l'Autorité sanitaire (HA), des données/préparations scientifiques cliniques pour les interactions avec les AP et des données cliniques entrées dans les présentations réglementaires. Qui vous êtes
• Baccalauréat requis (les sciences de la vie préférées). Le diplôme de clinicien/science avancé est très préféré (p. ex. doctorat, doctorat en médecine, MSN, MPH, etc.).
• 0 à 3 ans d'expérience clinique. Bien que l'expérience antérieure soit un atout, nous cherchons surtout une personne qui a un potentiel élevé, une forte motivation et une volonté d'apprendre.
• Il est nécessaire de se familiariser avec les lois, les règlements et les directives régissant l'exécution des essais cliniques à l'échelle mondiale et de connaître certains aspects médicaux du GCP (bonnes pratiques cliniques), de l'ICH (Conférence internationale sur l'harmonisation des prescriptions techniques relatives à l'enregistrement des produits pharmaceutiques à usage humain), de la FDA, de l'EMA et d'autres directives et règlements pertinents.
• Bonne compréhension des fonctions multidisciplinaires liées au développement de la drogue. L'expérience d'essais cliniques pertinents dans certains domaines thérapeutiques ou un potentiel évident d'assimilation avec un certain soutien.
• De solides compétences en collaboration avec la capacité de travailler efficacement au sein d'une équipe mondiale géographiquement répartie. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés à la promotion de la science, garantissant à tous l'accès aux soins de santé
