The Position The Opportunity As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts. As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization. You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business. You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.
• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.
• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.
• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.
• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.
• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.
• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies. Who you are
• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.
• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.
• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.
• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.
• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity. In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a Cluster Section Lead in the Global Finance Support organization, you will be responsible for establishing and leading day-to-day Finance Technical support, working with the respective Global Cluster Lead. The role has a strong focus on people management, compliance and operational excellence. In this position you will drive operational excellence to achieve the objectives of the Global Product Line, leading a team of Finance Business and System Analysts. As a people manager you will inspire and help to shape the future of our organization. You will actively coach and foster the development of the team members, help remove siloes and support your team to evolve with the organic development of the business. You will lead the collaboration across clusters, as well as, across Global Product Lines, and Global teams.
• Strategic Talent Management: Lead the full employee lifecycle by managing recruitment with P&C, overseeing onboarding/integration, and ensuring comprehensive training through various learning channels.
• Performance & Development: Motivate and develop team members by setting clear goals, documenting performance, and providing proactive coaching and feedback.
• Operational Excellence: Drive service quality in Finance Business Support by meeting KPI targets, ensuring high end-user satisfaction, and maintaining a deep understanding of end-to-end finance processes.
• Collaboration & Communication: Foster a culture of teamwork and transparency by proactively sharing information, project roadmaps, and business knowledge across global and functional boundaries.
• Continuous Improvement: Partner with enabling functions to implement best practices and identify system/process enhancements that drive automation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
• Stakeholder & Risk Management: Manage key business relationships and collaborate with leadership to set performance targets, manage team workloads, and mitigate operational risks.
• Values-Driven Leadership: Serve as a role model by embodying Roche values and Leadership Commitments while promoting Agile, LEAN, and ITIL methodologies. Who you are
• Strategic Leadership & Change Management: Proven ability to lead projects in complex matrix organizations, drive organizational change, and mentor/coach team members to success.
• Operational Excellence & Metrics: Extensive experience in customer support (preferably Finance) with a focus on meeting department KPIs, managing escalations, and utilizing reporting tools for data-driven decisions.
• Stakeholder & Account Management: Expert in demand and relationship management, possessing exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and communication skills to navigate a dynamic international environment.
• Agile & Structured Methodologies: Proficient in implementing support processes through modern ways of working, such as Agile, ITIL, and LEAN, while maintaining a strong sense of urgency.
• Results-Oriented Professionalism: Highly accountable and resourceful problem-solver with a university degree and the ability to manage multiple priorities with composure and integrity. In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Product Information/Labels Specialist you are responsible for projects within Global Labeling Near Patient Care. The Opportunity:
• Responsible for generating, tracking, coordinating, evaluation, reporting metrics, scheduling, and managing project documentation according to policies and procedures.
• Reviews and maintains project related data ensuring that it is valid, accurate, and timely.
• Contributes independently or with a team towards project and departmental goals.
• Interfaces with internal customers and cross functional areas.
• Demonstrates strong communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills.
• Has the ability to multi-task and adjust rapidly to new priorities.
• Displays excellent organizational and analytical skills.
• Demonstrates competency in taking initiative.
• Work is varied and assists project managers. Additional responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Opening of labeling jobs
• Distributing Labeling to appropriate systems.
• Writing and distribution of change orders
• Distribution of status reports
• Following up on project priorities
• Participating in team status meetings
• Supporting documentation preparation and processing Who you are:
• University degree.
• Experience in a Regulatory Environment
• Attention to Detail
• Ability to work in a dynamic flexible work environment
• Building strong relationships with business partners
• Excellent Communication Skills-Written and Verbal
• Team oriented Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Indianapolis, is 55,40 0.00 - 102,800.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws. If you have a disability and need an accommodation in relation to the online application process, please contact us by completing this form Accommodations for Applicants .

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Estagiário(a) de Supply Chain, você fará parte de uma equipe colaborativa focada em otimizar nossos processos de Planejamento de Demanda . Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para aplicar suas habilidades analíticas na prática . Venha se desenvolver profissionalmente em uma cultura que valoriza a inovação e a melhoria contínua . A Oportunidade
• Você apoia o time de Planejamento de Demanda nas rotinas analíticas e no ciclo de S&OP .
• Você trabalha com um grande volume de dados, realizando o tratamento, a consolidação e a análise constante de informações .
• Você desenvolve dashboards, relatórios e indicadores de performance essenciais para a área .
• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos e contribui ativamente para a padronização e otimização de fluxos .
• Você apoia a estruturação e o acompanhamento de projetos estratégicos, expandindo seu impacto na organização . Quem você é
• Você cursa graduação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Matemática, Supply Chain ou áreas correlatas, com previsão de conclusão a partir de 2027 e vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino .
• Você tem disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos, com uma carga horária de 6 horas diárias .
• Você possui Excel avançado e grande facilidade para trabalhar com análise e tratamento de dados .
• Você demonstra forte capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e mantém um perfil estruturado, organizado e com visão processual .
• Você se comunica muito bem e tem a habilidade de transformar dados complexos em informações claras e assertivas . Preferencial
• Você tem conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares) e noções de S&OP / Planejamento de Demanda .
• Você conhece metodologias de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, Scrum ou similares) .
• Você possui alguma experiência prévia com análise de dados ou iniciativas de melhoria contínua . *Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Oportunidad Esta es una oportunidad de aprendizaje dentro de nuestro departamento de Finanzas , específicamente en los procesos de cobranza y control financiero. Aquí desarrollarás experiencia técnica con capacitación y acompañamiento continuo, en un ambiente profesional, innovador y colaborativo. Responsabilidades
• Gestión de Cartera: Administrar la recuperación oportuna de la cartera de clientes de acuerdo con la política de crédito y cobranza.
• Control de Pedidos: Ejecutar la liberación de pedidos en el sistema, revisando importes, límites de crédito y vencimientos, gestionando las autorizaciones necesarias.
• Maestro de Datos: Asegurar que la creación y mantenimiento de clientes sea correcta en el sistema, colaborando estrechamente con RSS, área comercial, contratos y squads.
• Procesos Administrativos: Generación de Notas de Crédito (NDC) por descuentos comerciales. Para integrarte a nuestro equipo de Finanzas , buscamos el siguiente perfil:
• Perfil Académico: Ser estudiante activo de la carrera de Finanzas , Contaduría, Administración o afines.
• Disponibilidad: Capacidad para realizar la pasantía por un periodo mínimo de 1 año y medio (18 meses) .

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
羅氏大藥廠-真實世界數據研究實習課程

課程目標
• 以真實世界證據專案（real-world evidence project）為主軸，讓實習生在 6 週內 (2025/7/6-
• 8/14) 完成從「研究問題形成 → 研究設計 → 數據分析 → 結果解讀 → 報告→ 教材輸出」的閉環
• 訓練，並實際參與跨國藥廠的研究協作模式。
• 課程大綱
• 本課程旨在引領實習生深度參與真實世界證據的完整產製流程。學員將從文獻回顧與法規研析
• 出發，學習如何從真實世界數據中挖掘洞見，並歷經研究問題定義、研究設計至統計分析的實
• 戰演練，進而掌握 RWE 在藥業的核心價值。
• 課程內容
• 實習生於六周實習結束後完成:
• 1 份可執行的研究設計文件（研究問題、族群定義、暴露/結局、偏差或敏感度分析規劃）
• 1 套可重現的分析程式（R 或 SAS）＋ 資料處理與描述性分析輸出
• 1 份結果簡報（含主要結果、限制、建議下一步）
• 1 份內/外部 RWE 教學材料（例如：演講投影片）
• 預期收穫
• ● 實際接觸國內外大型真實世界數據資料庫
• ● 參與藥廠真實世界數據研究案
• ● 了解藥業文化與工作方式，幫助職涯探索
• ● 學以致用，將學校所學技能應用至藥業
• 實習規劃及名額
• ● 實習單位: 羅氏大藥廠/醫藥事務部 (115臺北市南港區經貿一路170號10樓)
• ● 實習規劃: 6周，週數可依照專案進度，於取得主管與學生共同同意後彈性增加。
• ● 實習期間: 2025/7/6-8/14
• ● 實習名額: 2-3名
• ● 授課對象: 藥學系5-6年級學生且有RWE相關經驗者尤佳或臨藥所碩博班學生
• ● 甄選方式: 請於4/13下午五點前用email方式寄送個人書面履歷 (格式不拘，信件主旨: [
• 暑期實習申請] 姓名) 到進行shih-chieh.shao@roche.com初審，4/17將用email通知初
• 審結果及複審口試細節。甄選評估項目包含是否具備運用R或SAS進行數據分析能力及
• 基本藥物流行病學知識，以及相關個人特質 (例如: 具備發掘、分析與解決問題，善於
• 溝通與表達，並能參與團隊合作)
• 其他注意事項
• ● 羅氏大藥廠保有最終修改及解釋本實習計畫書內容之權利

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design. The Opportunity: We are looking for an upbeat, dynamic, innovative and creative individual who is highly involved and very passionate about Digital Marketing and Project Management. As a Digital Campaign Intern you will be responsible for supporting our Delivery Managers to deliver on campaign objectives for various affiliates globally. You will be at the forefront of our project deliveries and the work you'll do will directly impact the way affiliates will interact with our teams. In this position you will be focusing on :
• Assisting in project managing various digital campaigns to enhance customer satisfaction during asset delivery operations through the DIA Content Lab
• Managing updates of marketing materials in a timely manner in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders depending on the updates incl. communication/coordination with requestors (from the affiliates)
• Managing tickets within our project manager system, coordinating the organization of source files and asset managements for seamless identification and reuse within our global network.
• Staying curious, open-minded, and always willing to do more. Who you are:
• You have ongoing studies at any Hungarian University /college in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
• You are available at least 20-25 hours per week
• You are passionate about project management
• You're organized, detail-oriented, self-motivated, with the ability to easily transition between multiple tasks and problem solve thoughtfully
• You have highly developed interpersonal and communication skills
• You are a quick learner, proactive, flexible and curious with an an innovative mind
• You are a strong team player with ability to work in a virtual team environment
• English proficiency is a must. Any other language is a big plus. In exchange we provide you with: Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career. A global community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Explore what the Global Digital Hub is about. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide. Over the course of your one-year assignment, your core responsibilities will include:
• Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.
• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.
• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.
• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.
• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling. How would your day to day look like? As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization. Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. You might spend the morning organizing workshops or refining assets that help teams navigate Roche's complex solution portfolio. This involves a high degree of ownership, as you structure complex information into clear, high-quality tools for country organizations. In the afternoon, you shift focus toward process optimization and change management. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The role ​ You’ll work alongside a dynamic team in a fast paced environment shaping how AI can enhance the strategic capabilities of Business Development. This is an opportunity to blend business insight, creativity, and technical curiosity to help build a next-generation partnership and insights platform within Roche. Responsibilities
• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across multiple departments to clearly define project requirements, implement use cases, and validate AI-driven applications.
• Design and build lightweight, no-code/medium-code generative AI tools and assistants to automate or enhance internal workflows and processes.
• Develop and refine AI-enhanced solutions that support diverse corporate use cases, enhancing efficiency and strategic decision-making.
• Provide comprehensive training and ongoing support to users and teams to ensure successful adoption and effective use of AI-based applications.
• Troubleshoot and optimize solutions based on continuous user feedback and emerging business requirements.
• Continue to maintain and update AI capabilities within corporate business development applications, maintaining awareness of emerging trends and best practices
• Develop and update documentation and knowledge bases for corporate business development AI tools Who You Are
• Recent graduate in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field
• Experience using GenAI tools like ChatGPT (Custom GPTs), Gemini (Gems), or other AI assistants, and building data visualizations, such as Tableau dashboards
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially for documenting AI use cases and translating between technical tools and business needs
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail
• Collaborative mindset with experience working effectively across multiple teams in a fast-paced, dynamic corporate environment
• Familiarity with Salesforce Sales Cloud (preferred) Who We Are At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. At Roche, we believe diversity and inclusion are essential values for our success. We have a special interest in integrating people with disabilities into our teams. Are you ready to apply? We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You will join the Customer Experience, Research & Strategy team at Roche Diagnostics in Sant Cugat. This team sits at the heart of how Roche understands and designs for the people who rely on diagnostic solutions — from lab professionals to clinicians and patients. The team combines rigorous research with strategic design to shape services and experiences across digital and physical touchpoints. About the role As a Service Design intern you will contribute to real research and design projects from day one. Working alongside senior designers and researchers, you will help map the end-to-end experiences of Roche's customers, conduct user research, and explore how conversational interfaces — chatbots, voice assistants, and AI-powered agents — can better serve the needs of healthcare professionals. Over the course of a full year you will move through the entire design cycle — from discovery and research through to prototyping and delivery — building a rich, evidence-based portfolio in one of the most complex and meaningful design contexts there is. What you'll do Research support
• Assist in planning and facilitating user interviews, contextual enquiries, and usability sessions with healthcare professionals
• Help synthesise qualitative findings through affinity mapping and insight frameworks
• Contribute to personas, journey maps, and mental model documentation
• Support the team in maintaining research repositories and knowledge assets Service design
• Contribute to service blueprints and experience maps that reveal systemic friction
• Participate in co-design workshops with internal teams and external stakeholders
• Help build and iterate on prototypes for concept testing
• Document design decisions and produce artefacts that communicate intent clearly Conversational design
• Support the design of dialogue flows and conversation scripts for chat and voice interfaces
• Help define tone of voice guidelines for automated interactions in a healthcare context
• Assist in evaluating conversational prototypes with real users and documenting findings
• Research best practices in NLP, intent design, and accessible conversational UX Collaboration
• Work in cross-functional squads alongside product managers, engineers, and clinical experts
• Present work-in-progress in team reviews and design critiques
• Contribute to team rituals: stand-ups, retrospectives, and design community sessions
• Bring fresh perspective and curiosity to a team that values diverse viewpoints Who we're looking for
• Currently enrolled in a degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, HCI, UX, or a related field
• Genuine interest in human-centred research — you are curious about people and why they behave as they do
• Exposure to conversational design, dialogue writing, or NLP through coursework or personal projects
• Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to ask good questions in complex environments
• Clear communication in English (working language of the team); Spanish is a plus
• A portfolio or project work demonstrating research and/or design thinking Nice to have
• Familiarity with tools such as Figma, FigJam, Miro, or Dovetail
• Interest in healthcare, diagnostics, or life sciences
• Exposure to systems thinking, service blueprinting, or design research methods
• Any experience with chatbot platforms or voice assistant design
• Strong visual communication skills — the ability to make complexity legible What we offer: The internship experience
• A full

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position At the heart of this internship, you will collaborate with our Simulation Teams to architect the future of System & Solution Design. As a key contributor, you will help build and validate ‘Digital Twins’ for our next-generation core lab solutions. Your work won’t just be theoretical, it will directly shape the physical architecture and the logical “brain” of cutting-edge, end-to-end laboratory systems. Your Key Responsibilities
• Model & Maintain: Create and maintain complex scenarios for software and hardware simulations.
• Execute & Analyze: Run simulations and perform deep-dive analyses of the results to identify system behaviors.
• Evolutionary Support: Provide status updates and issue notifications to support the continuous evolution of our simulators.
• Collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve departmental operations and project delivery. What You Will Learn & Develop
• Advanced Simulation: Gain hands-on experience with Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using tools like Simio or AnyLogic.
• Systems Engineering: Understand the "big picture" of how hardware, software, and logistics integrate into massive diagnostic solutions.
• Algorithmic Thinking: Design and implement efficient heuristics for real-time decision-making in robotics.
• Data Science: Use Python to transform raw simulation outputs into powerful, data-driven visual stories.
• Software Development: Level up your OOP (C# or Java ) skills by extending simulation logic.
• Global Collaboration: Experience working across borders with engineers and product owners in an international environment. Who You Are You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.
• Education: Mechanical Engineering, SW Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Industrial Engineering.
• Programming: Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C# or Java).
• Data Tools: Knowledge of SQL, Python, and Pandas for data management.
• Simulation: Familiarity with Discrete Event Simulations and statistical modeling.
• Communication: Fluent in English; able to present complex data with clarity.
• Mindset: You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.A strong willingness to learn and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Building software products is great, but working on software with a purpose is even better! As a Software Engineer in Test, you’ll work on a product that helps people with the most precious thing they have — their health. Main responsibilities:
• Confirm the correctness of requirements-driven tests, utilizing diverse testing approaches such as exploratory, white box, and black box testing.
• Execute tests across multiple testing levels , including end-to-end, system, integration, and unit testing.
• Perform various testing types , such as functional, performance, resiliency, and scalability testing, to ensure robust product quality.
• Automate and execute front-end and back-end tests for platforms and web applications .
• Develop and automate deployment and testing pipelines, supporting multiple project branches and stages.
• Track and report quality metrics , contributing to the maintenance and improvement of quality dashboards .
• Conduct root cause analyses of defects and newly discovered issues to continuously improve testing practices.
• Design and implement automation frameworks and validate toolchains to support testing processes.
• Ensure compliance with regulatory standards for all quality engineering deliverables.
• Collaborate closely with Test Architects, Test Leads, Test Managers, as well as designers, architects, and developers.
• Share, coach, and train the built-in quality mindset throughout the organization. How would your day to day look like? At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Department Summary We are seeking a highly motivated professional with experience in Security and Privacy to join our dynamic team. As a Junior Penetration Tester, your main responsibilities will include supporting and assisting in penetration testing activities to ensure the security of Roche products and solutions. This role involves collaborating with Product Teams, executing predefined test strategies, and documenting the results. You will play a crucial role in identifying vulnerabilities and aiding in the reporting process. The Opportunity
• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).
• Conduct cybersecurity penetration testing activities across various technology layers, assessing the criticality of vulnerabilities for adequate prioritization, and providing suitable remediation recommendations to product teams.
• Maintain and utilize the repository of penetration testing methods and tools to ensure consistency and standardization in testing practices.
• Create detailed reports and present findings, associated risks, and recommendations to product teams and management.
• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.
• Support the Incident Response team during incidents.
• Contribute to initiatives aimed at integrating defense capabilities into products in collaboration with other PSPO colleagues.
• Develop, maintain, and continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools to enhance penetration testing efficiency and effectiveness. Program Highlights
• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).
• Competitive salary and benefits package.
• Location in Sant Cugat del Valles, On Site.
• Access to training and development opportunities.
• Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry. Who You Are (Required)
• Must have graduated from a University degree program.
• Must have attained a Bachelor's degree.
• Experience or familiarity with cloud computing technologies, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.
• Knowledge of automating security controls through scripting languages such as shell scripting and Python.
• Understanding of information security and privacy risks.
• Problem solving abilities, communication, teamwork, flexibility and adaptability.
• Team player, proactive, self-driven, solution-oriented, and hands-on. Required Majors: Information Systems, Computer Science or a related relevant area of study. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation in diagnostics. As part of our Start Tech Program , we are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join our team in Sant Cugat and contribute to cutting-edge diagnostic development. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic laboratory environment while working alongside experienced professionals in the field. Your Responsibilities As a Start Tech Graduate Intern, you will support the development of diagnostic solutions and contribute to laboratory operations. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Participating in the development of diagnostic assays, including clotting, enzymatic, and immunological methods
• Independently supporting the execution of analytical experiments, including data analysis, interpretation, and presentation of results
• Assisting in the planning, implementation, evaluation, and documentation of development activities, including literature research
• Contributing to general laboratory tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
• Taking responsibility for the proper use and maintenance of assigned laboratory equipment What We Are Looking For
• Recent graduate in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field
• Strong interest in diagnostics and laboratory-based research
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
• Good communication skills and willingness to learn What We Offer
• Hands-on experience in a leading global healthcare company
• Exposure to innovative diagnostic technologies and methodologies
• A collaborative and international work environment
• Opportunities for learning, growth, and future career development within Roche If you are eager to start your career in diagnostics and want to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Présentation de l’équipe: sous la responsabilité de l’Ingénieur Réseau Terrain et du Responsable Régional Equipe Service, tu seras Rattaché(e) à l’équipe Service Excellence. En lien étroit avec les équipes supports et commerciales, tu seras amené(e) à travailler sur des missions liées à l’installation et aux maintiens des réseaux instruments Roche dans les laboratoires d’analyses médicales privés et hospitaliers. Quel sera ton impact? ● Assurer la conception des schémas réseau et déploiement . ● Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes en collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Ingénieur ITWF. ● Garantir les plans d’actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. ● Effectuer les retrofits hardware / software IT réseau roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions en place chez nos clients. ● Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche. ● Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting des interventions et upgrades réalisés. Ton ADN: ● Tu recherches une alternance pour ton Bac+4 ou 5 de 12/24 mois à compter de septembre 2026 ● De formation école d’ingénieurs spécialisé en informatique et réseau et cyber résilience, tu possède également une appétence dans le domaine de la santé. ● Tu as le sens de l’écoute et le sens des responsabilités . ● Autonomie et rigueur te caractérisent, tu aimes travailler en équipe. ● Tu possèdes un bon niveau d’anglais (B2). ● Tu aimes te déplacer et tu es titulaire du permis B depuis plus de 2 ans. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? - Cette alternance va te permettre de développer des compétences concrètes et solides en sécurités et architectures informatique et de découvrir le monde de la santé à travers les laboratoires d’analyses médicales. - Nous considérons les alternants et les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes. - Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler. - Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact pour la santé de tous. Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Quel sera ton impact? ● Assurer la conception des schémas réseau et déploiement . ● Installer et maintenir le réseau IT Roche toutes gammes en collaboration avec les équipes Ingénieur Service et Ingénieur ITWF. ● Garantir les plans d’actions en lien avec la cybersécurité. ● Effectuer les retrofits hardware / software IT réseau roche, la maintenance des réseaux instruments et les mises à jour des solutions en place chez nos clients. ● Installer et tester les solutions de télémaintenance Roche. ● Assurer la traçabilité et le reporting des interventions et upgrades réalisés. Ton ADN: ● Tu recherches une alternance pour ton Bac+4 ou 5 de 12/24 mois à compter de septembre 2026 ● De formation école d’ingénieurs spécialisé en informatique et réseau et cyber résilience, tu possède également une appétence dans le domaine de la santé. ● Tu as le sens de l’écoute et le sens des responsabilités . ● Autonomie et rigueur te caractérisent, tu aimes travailler en équipe. ● Tu possèdes un bon niveau d’anglais (B2). ● Tu aimes te déplacer et tu es titulaire du permis B depuis plus de 2 ans. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? - Cette alternance va te permettre de développer des compétences concrètes et solides en sécurités et architectures informatique et de découvrir le monde de la santé à travers les laboratoires d’analyses médicales. - Nous considérons les alternants et les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes. - Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler. - Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact pour la santé de tous. Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Siamo in EFG Nel sito Management Mannheim/Penzberg, siamo ben 1300 specialisti per una vasta gamma di infrastrutture e servizi professionali che li forniscono per i siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo una cooperazione senza soluzione di continuità tra aree e funzioni aziendali, offriamo soluzioni innovative e migliorare l'ambiente di lavoro dei dipendenti nelle sedi di Mannheim e Penzberg - dove formiamo attivamente il futuro. La nuova struttura organizzativa In questa funzione fai parte delle Operazioni del Sito e appartieni alla Gestione del Fornitore di Servizi di Team. responsabilità Ti aspetti Nel ruolo Lei è responsabile della gestione strategica e del monitoraggio dei servizi integrati di gestione degli impianti (servizi morbidi) da parte di fornitori esterni. Questo consente di eseguire le seguenti attività interessanti
• Controllo del fornitore: Si controlla e controlla i fornitori di servizi IFM esterni per una posizione definita e garantire prestazioni efficienti.
• Gestione della qualità: monitora la conformità agli accordi di livello dei servizi (SLA) e agli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e avvia misure correttive proattive per le deviazioni.
• Responsabilità finanziaria: Lei è responsabile del monitoraggio e della previsione dei bilanci per i servizi FM e identifica le potenzialità per ridurre i costi e aumentare l'efficienza.
• Responsabilità dell'operatore: in qualità di garanzia della conformità giuridica, l'utente garantisce che tutti gli obblighi legali e interni dell'operatore siano rispettati dai fornitori di servizi.
• Gestione dei progetti: conduce progetti indipendenti per l'ottimizzazione dei processi e l'implementazione di nuovi concetti di servizio con visione digitale.
• Gestione delle interfacce: moderando come driver di collaborazione centrale Tra le esigenze degli utenti interni e le possibilità operative dei partner esterni. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta
• Hai completato con successo un Master/Diplom in Facility Management, Industrial Engineering o Supply Technology o hai una qualifica simile con una formazione a lungo termine (ad esempio uno specialista:in/master:in).
• Hai più di 5 anni di esperienza professionale consolidata nella gestione delle strutture, nella gestione dei fornitori di servizi esterni (gestione dei fornitori) e nella gestione dei progetti.
• L'utente fornisce una conoscenza approfondita del diritto contrattuale e del diritto degli appalti, nonché una solida conoscenza della gestione delle infrastrutture e della responsabilità dell'operatore.
• Sei sicuro nel gestire i sistemi CAFM e SAP e ha una forte mentalità di crescita per aiutare i cambiamenti proattivi in un ambiente dinamico.
• Si parla inglese e generalmente hanno eccellenti competenze comunicative. Come giocatore di squadra, si è in grado di lavorare efficacemente con diversi stakeholder e di comprendere relazioni complesse.
• Le missioni locali, principalmente tra le nostre sedi a Mannheim e Penzberg, possono essere considerate come arricchimento. Cosi' bene? E' meglio. Vi offriamo una varietà di migliori raccordi nelle nostre sedi. Solo con voi possiamo migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Si rende Roche unico con il vostro contributo. Ecco perché offriamo benefici eccezionali che ti sostengono, la tua vita, le tue finanze e la tua salute

titleByLocale.de: Data Transfer and Migration Lead - Mergers & Acquisitions
titleByLocale.fr: Data Transfer and Migration Lead - Mergers & Acquisitions

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche we believe it’s critical to deliver medical solutions now — even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives and creating a healthier future for all. The IT Data Transfer and Migration Lead plays a critical role in supporting Roche’s Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives by leading enterprise-scale data migration and transfer strategies across complex systems and environments. This role partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure scalable, compliant, and efficient data migration solutions that support business continuity and operational excellence. Your Opportunity As a Data Transfer & Migration Lead, you will lead the design and execution of migration strategies for acquired and partnering organizations, ensuring data transfer activities are delivered efficiently, securely, and in compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards. In this role, you will:
• Lead the design, execution, and lifecycle management of enterprise-scale data transfer and migration strategies for Mergers & Acquisitions initiatives
• Design and implement scalable data architectures, advanced ETL/ELT frameworks, and automation tools to improve migration efficiency and reliability
• Drive technical excellence by mentoring engineering teams, setting architectural standards, and guiding complex technical decision-making
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners, and technical teams to define migration rules aligned with Roche’s enterprise architecture and compliance requirements
• Ensure data infrastructure and migration platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, and compliant with applicable standards including GxP where required
• Oversee system ownership and lifecycle management of data migration platforms, tools, and related operational processes
• Partner with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to align migration strategies with organizational priorities and business objectives Who you are You are a strategic and technically strong data engineering leader who thrives in complex, enterprise environments. You bring strong stakeholder management capabilities, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to lead high-impact transformation initiatives across global teams. To be successful in this role, you have:
• 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data migration, or enterprise data architecture within complex global environments
• Deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud data platforms, and advanced ETL/ELT patterns, with the ability to architect scalable data warehouses and data lakes
• Strong understanding of enterprise system interoperability, including platforms such as Veeva, SAP, ServiceNow, and related ecosystems
• Proven experience leading high-impact data migration or transformation projects with strong focus on governance, security, and operational resilience
• Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, mentor engineers, and influence architectural decisions across cross-functional stakeholders
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering with senior leadership on data strategy and execution
• Experience with event-driven architectures, streaming technologies, or AI-enabled data capabilities is considered an advantage Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

The Position Mission As a GPC Global Compliance Assurance Lead, you will play a key role in ensuring the GPC - Global Patient Care Organization has the highest quality standards and remains compliant at all times. You will lead and manage a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Compliance Assurance Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists. You will ensure Roche and partners' products and solutions meet global regulations, corporate standards, and expectations by overseeing the monitoring, reviewing, and timely reporting on the quality of interactions. You will help maintain an effective quality management system and governance, globally, and continually improve the governance to meet evolving business and compliance needs. Together with your team, you will implement a common quality framework across the GPC Hubs. You will analyze results regularly, conceive corrective and preventive measures in case of findings, and collaborate in the design of training concepts to overcome identified knowledge gaps. You will ensure the GPC Organization complies with regulatory requirements and corporate standards. You will communicate significant quality, or regulatory issues and risks that may impact operations or regulatory compliance to local, regional or global management. In addition, you will be accountable for the preparation, coordination, and conduct of audits, ensuring the GPC Organization operates in an “inspection ready” manner and that audit measures are strictly implemented. Key Accountabilities
• Effectively lead and develop a team of GPC Compliance Assurance Leads, Specialists and PRI & Case Monitoring Specialists.
• Design, implement, and continuously improve the Global Compliance Governance Model and related monitoring standards.
• Accountable for the end-to-end audit process, including preparation work, managing the audit schedule, and ensuring the timely implementation of audit-related measures.
• Implement and follow up on measures to continuously maintain or optimize the overall compliance of GPC in the processing and documentation of customer concerns.
• Act as a contact person and expert with the different interfaces for all quality and compliance topics, proactively and in an advisory manner.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Responsibilities:
• The HSP partners with healthcare system stakeholders to drive healthcare system innovation and unlock possibilities to deliver value for the ecosystem and society
• As part of this, the HSP contributes to identifying, mapping, engaging and managing ecosystem stakeholders.
• The HSP acts as trusted partner and the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche. She or he shares the stakeholder community vision and value internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• The Healthcare System Partner lives the Visionary, Architect, Coach, Catalyst (VACC) model, acts as catalyst and coach externally and internally.
• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other Healthcare System Partners and Patient Journey Partners.
• The HSP looks across the individual ecosystem and catalyzes our ability to see broader trends and patterns in healthcare systems. They need to bring outside insights into Roche to influence strategy AND to bring our expertise, science and knowledge out to the ecosystem Experiences, Knowledge and Qualifications: Skills & Experience:
• Deep understanding of healthcare system, processes and governance
• Excellent customer engagement and management skills
• Experience leading cross functional teams is required. Cross-functional leadership experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is desirable.
• System thinker and deep listener
• A sensitive leader who senses, reflects and responds
• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization and customer experience excellence
• Ability to understand and leverage digital means and tools for the benefit of all stakeholders is highly desirable.
• Able to manage complex projects Knowledge
• Broad understanding of Roche’s present portfolio and future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions Capabilities:
• Fluent in local language. Proficient in English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise is highly desirable. Preferred Qualifications:
• University degree (scientific, economic, or business degree). An advanced degree in Life science and/or MBA is a plus.
• Practical understanding of digital innovation methodologies
• Education in health policy
• CCXA Academy (desirable) Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solutions Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising larger solutions with multiple components (digital products, physical products, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As a Technical Solution Management Associate you will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation of our solutions portfolio. You will work hand in hand with our team and different Solution Teams in the organization to support them with the automation of processes, contributing to the alignment with organizational objectives. Your main area of responsibility will be the application of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence technologies to design and develop tailored tools to bring the end-to-end management of digital solutions to the next level. Main responsibilities As a Technical Solution Management Associate, your core responsibilities will include:
• Contribution to Ideation and Design: Actively participate in the ideation, analysis, and evaluation of solutions within the team's scope with the objective of optimizing processes and augmenting transparency and traceability with data.
• Process Optimization Tool Development: Identify opportunities for improvement and enhance solution management by leveraging data analytics and AI tools for diverse stakeholder groups (e.g., solution teams, affiliate members, or the broader organization). Additionally, identify inefficient processes and create tools to automate or streamline them.
• Team management (e.g. lean portfolio management, Aha! Automation, etc.)
• Technical solution management (e.g. requirements, version control,...)
• End-to-End solution management (e.g. coordination of solutions portfolio, traceability,...)
• Solution Lifecycle Management Support: Assisting with the administrative and documentation tasks related to the different stages of the lifecycle of complex software solutions.
• Reporting and Metrics Creation: Supporting the creation of data-driven tools to track the performance and adoption of key organizational solutions.
• Sustainable Development: Define the necessary maintenance and sustainability tasks to ensure the continued relevance and accuracy of the developed tools by e.g. enabling seamless retraining with new or updated training data. How would your day to day look like? As Technical Solution Management Associate in the Diagnostics Insights Solutions team, you'll work closely with our team members (Business Solution Managers and Technical Solution Managers) as well as cross-functional partners from across the organization. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including product managers, marketing leads, definition teams, engineering teams and subject matter experts. The successful candidate will play a dual role, handling management and administrative support tasks related to organizational solutions, while also developing and implementing tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our internal processes. title: Internship in Innovation & Sustainability - Mission Eco-Possible

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world. Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within? As an intern, you will contribute to Mission Eco-Possible, an active initiative designed to align CAC DIA operations with Roche’s global sustainability strategy and support a 25% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030. The project focuses on turning the affiliate’s emissions baseline into a practical roadmap for action, with particular attention to Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the Central America and Caribbean context. Within your first months, you are expected to help design and implement an internal environmental sustainability campaign, support the definition of a feasible action plan and investment needs for emissions reduction, and develop an emissions reporting tool aligned with Roche Group guidelines. Your work will help translate global sustainability commitments into local action, strengthen reporting transparency, and mobilize the organization around a shared environmental mission. This internship offers a valuable opportunity to combine sustainability strategy, analytics, and culture change in a high-impact regional setting. The Opportunity
• Design and implement an internal cultural campaign focused on environmental sustainability and the 2030 Eco-Mission
• Support the definition of a feasible action plan to reduce Scope 1 and Scope 3 emissions in the CAC regional context
• Assess investment needs and support feasibility analysis for proposed sustainability initiatives
• Develop an emissions reporting tool for the affiliate aligned with Roche Group guidelines
• Analyze current emissions drivers, including fleet operations, refrigerants, business travel, and e-waste
• Translate sustainability data into clear dashboards, reports, and visual materials for internal use
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support implementation and engagement across the organization
• Help connect local actions to Roche’s broader net-zero and SBTi-aligned commitments Who You Are You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program at a university in your final years , preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering or related and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of 6 months. Furthermore you are
• Proficient in advanced Excel, Power BI, or Tableau and able to create strong reporting and visualization tools
• Knowledgeable in ESG principles and greenhouse gas accounting frameworks such as the GHG Protocol
• Able to conduct technical and financial feasibility analyses for sustainability projects and investment decisions
• A strong communicator who can turn complex data into compelling stories and work effectively with different stakeholders
• Fluent in Spanish and English.
• Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable driving initiatives in a dynamic regional environment If you meet most but not all qualifications, we still encourage you to apply. Additional information
• The internship is expected to start between 1 and 16 July 2026 and will last 6 months.
• Work term: full

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. Who We Are: Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years. In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients. As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. Roche PHCS brings unmatched value as a collaborative partner to pharmaceutical organizations developing treatments across critical areas of highest unmet medical need. The Opportunity: As an International Product Manager (IPM) within the PHCS Lifecycle Team, you are the primary driver of our mission. You sit at the critical intersection of diagnostics and therapeutics, transforming complex technology into clinical reality. Your primary responsibility is to drive the global commercialization of our Companion Diagnostics (CDx) portfolio related to Tissue Diagnostics in direct partnership with pharmaceutical customers. Beyond the core product management of the Tissue Diagnostic portfolio, you will act as a strategic leader, driving initiatives that grow the PHCS organization and innovative pipeline, and support the broader Roche Diagnostics network. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• External Pharmaceutical Partnering: Act as the dedicated commercial lead for pharmaceutical partners. Co-create and align CDx launch plans with drug therapy timelines to ensure seamless "day-one" testing readiness.
• Country & Regional Collaboration: Partner with Roche Diagnostics regional and country stakeholders to drive successful CDx pull-through. You will help markets overcome barriers to adoption, deliver pharmaceutical partner objectives and ultimately drive precision medicine innovation.
• Commercial Strategy Leader: Drive the commercial strategy for IHC-based companion diagnostics, ensuring our value proposition resonates with pathologists, laboratory managers, and pharma stakeholders.
• End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Provide technical and strategic guidance throughout early assay development and lead commercial product delivery from concept to commercialization. Responsible for on-market product strategy, supply topics, quality issues, incorporating global regulatory updates, label expansion and end-of-life product management.
• PHCS Strategy Leadership: Lead design and execution of our overarching strategy in collaboration with PHCS leadership and senior stakeholders. Analyze global market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to define long-term strategies.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive high-impact growth projects that define how Roche Diagnostics delivers value beyond the individual test, collaborating closely with lifecycle teams and stakeholders across the organization. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position International Product Manager – Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. Who We Are: Advancing precision medicine through diagnostics for over 25 years. In collaboration with leading pharmaceutical companies, Roche Personalised Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) identify and develop innovative precision diagnostics to help radically improve the lives of patients. As the global diagnostic partner of choice, we deliver diagnostic confidence through a broad menu of high medical value assays across Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ hybridization (ISH), PCR and NGS. We are a global partner of choice in Oncology, including tissue diagnostics, as well as Neurology & Cardiology. Roche PHCS brings unmatched value as a collaborative partner to pharmaceutical organizations developing treatments across critical areas of highest unmet medical need. The Opportunity: As an International Product Manager (IPM) within the PHCS Lifecycle Team, you are the primary driver of our mission. You sit at the critical intersection of diagnostics and therapeutics, transforming complex technology into clinical reality. Your primary responsibility is to drive the global commercialization of our Companion Diagnostics (CDx) portfolio related to Tissue Diagnostics in direct partnership with pharmaceutical customers. Beyond the core product management of the Tissue Diagnostic portfolio, you will act as a strategic leader, driving initiatives that grow the PHCS organization and innovative pipeline, and support the broader Roche Diagnostics network. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• External Pharmaceutical Partnering: Act as the dedicated commercial lead for pharmaceutical partners. Co-create and align CDx launch plans with drug therapy timelines to ensure seamless "day-one" testing readiness.
• Country & Regional Collaboration: Partner with Roche Diagnostics regional and country stakeholders to drive successful CDx pull-through. You will help markets overcome barriers to adoption, deliver pharmaceutical partner objectives and ultimately drive precision medicine innovation.
• Commercial Strategy Leader: Drive the commercial strategy for IHC-based companion diagnostics, ensuring our value proposition resonates with pathologists, laboratory managers, and pharma stakeholders.
• End-to-End Product Lifecycle Management: Provide technical and strategic guidance throughout early assay development and lead commercial product delivery from concept to commercialization. Responsible for on-market product strategy, supply topics, quality issues, incorporating global regulatory updates, label expansion and end-of-life product management.
• PHCS Strategy Leadership: Lead design and execution of our overarching strategy in collaboration with PHCS leadership and senior stakeholders. Analyze global market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to define long-term strategies.
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Drive high-impact growth projects that define how Roche Diagnostics delivers value beyond the individual test, collaborating closely with lifecycle teams and stakeholders across the organization. Who You Are: Candidates should exhibit a strong track record in product commercialization, strategic design and execution alongside exceptional co

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Gestionar, coordinar y ejecutar actividades de proyectos relacionados con sistemas e infraestructura IT para proporcionar y asegurar un servicio de calidad a nuestros clientes. Ejecutar actividades de soporte de segundo nivel local. Ser referente técnico a nivel local. Identificar y dar solución a problemas complejos asociados a las plataformas informáticas. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Liderar la ejecución de proyectos de IT relacionados con instalación, integración y mejoras de sistemas (hardware y software), asegurando cumplimiento en alcance, tiempos, calidad y coordinación con áreas internas y clientes.
• Brindar soporte técnico de segundo nivel en soluciones informáticas, resolviendo incidencias complejas, configuraciones avanzadas, integraciones con sistemas host y conexión de instrumentos, priorizando la resolución remota.
• Gestionar y ejecutar entrenamientos técnicos, manteniendo actualización continua en sistemas e infraestructura IT, y asegurando el cumplimiento de programas de formación corporativos.
• Asegurar una comunicación efectiva con stakeholders y participar en el diseño de soluciones IT, contribuyendo con información técnica para propuestas, licitaciones y evaluación de riesgos.
• Garantizar la operación y soporte continuo de sistemas IT mediante monitoreo, mantenimiento preventivo, gestión de casos y documentación, asegurando cumplimiento de SLAs, políticas de compliance y normativas corporativas. Tu Perfil:
• Título universitario o técnico en Informática, Sistemas, Tecnólogo Médico o carreras afines.
• Experiencia de al menos 2 años en el área de informática, idealmente con conocimiento en sistemas de salud.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio-avanzado.
• Conocimiento en manejo de sustancias peligrosas. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
