descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Account Executive - Tissue Diagnostics The Opportunity: This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. This is a field based role: the territory includes North and Central Illinois (Chicago down to Springfield) and the state of Iowa. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. You must live within 50 miles of the territory border. We prefer the candidate to reside in the greater Chicago area. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.
• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.
• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.
• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.
• Communicates competitive market information internally.
• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• You hold 3 years relevant sales or equivalent experience
• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellows

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Sei parte di un team di alto livello e ad alto impatto che co-crea e implementa la strategia Roche Diagnostics per realizzare la nostra visione “innovare la diagnostica, plasmare la salute, cambiare la vita”. Si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella massimizzazione del valore complessivo di consegna della strategia Diagnostica per i nostri clienti e pazienti e nello sblocco della potenza dell'organizzazione per i nostri clienti e pazienti. Nell'ambito del team Diagnostics Strategy, guiderai iniziative strategiche chiave, come le integrazioni M&A o i cambiamenti del Modello Operativo che consentono la realizzazione della Strategia Divisionale. Hai l'opportunità di plasmare e guidare attività di strategia, metodologie e best practice al fine di raggiungere una comprensione e competenze strategiche critiche in tutta l'organizzazione. Quando un M&A è deciso, guiderà o parte del team di integrazione M&A che sta definendo l'approccio di integrazione e svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel rendere l'integrazione un successo raggiungendo gli obiettivi definiti dello stato finale. Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con una varietà di stakeholder senior provenienti da diverse parti dell'organizzazione Diagnostics e riferire in un Team Lead Strategy. Le aree di responsabilità previste includono la guida e l'attuazione di iniziative strategiche tra le funzioni, ma non sono necessariamente limitate a quelle descritte di seguito: L'opportunità
• Ampia comprensione del business Diagnostics come prerequisito per progettare la vestibilità per il modello operativo, la progettazione organizzativa e gli approcci di integrazione
• Conoscenza di più aree e aspetti di integrazione M&A (come: fasi di integrazione M&A, Org.Design, Integrazione di sistema o considerazioni legali e fiscali)
• Utilizzare la conoscenza delle conoscenze di business e integrazione, metriche, competenze e principi decisionali per diagnosticare efficacemente gli argomenti di integrazione con una vasta gamma di complessità.
• Proattivamente costruisce la conoscenza dell'ambiente esterno per diagnosticare e implementare efficacemente le strategie per aiutare a guidare le decisioni di integrazione.
• Conduce e/o supervisiona e coordina il lavoro di progettazione o integrazione del Modello Operativo dalla pianificazione all'implementazione, tra cui l'individuazione di opportunità e rischi, sviluppando e supervisionando piani d'azione per affrontarli. Sviluppa e conduce/coordina il programma/progetto
• comprovata capacità di influenzare i leader aziendali e i decisori per raggiungere i risultati necessari.
• Sviluppare e perfezionare ulteriormente gli aspetti del nostro overarching design organizzativo e modello operativo (ad esempio, strutture, ruoli, interfacce, ecc.), eseguire controlli sanitari dell'organizzazione
• Guidare la comprensione delle scelte di progettazione organizzativa In un ambiente altamente interfunzionale, fornirete anche la leadership di progetto e matrice coerente con i valori Roche, le capacità di leadership e la mentalità. L'incumbent cercherà di ispirare e accendere la passione in altri per creare un cambiamento sostenibile e sfruttare gli sforzi di una vasta gamma di persone e team. Chi sei

• Esperienza in una società di consulenza o sviluppo strategico e attuazione in un ruolo di strategia aziendale o globale &
• Esperienza comprovata con integrazioni post-merger all'interno o supporto in/con società di diagnostica
• pensiero strutturato, comprovate capacità di problem solving e record rack di successo progetto e gestione dei programmi

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You are part of a high-performing and high-impact team that co-creates and implements the Roche Diagnostics strategy in order to realize our vision “innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare, changing lives”. You play a pivotal role in maximizing the overall value delivery of the Diagnostics strategy for our customers and patients and in unlocking the power of the organization for our customers and patients. As part of the Diagnostics Strategy team, you will lead key strategic initiatives, like M&A Integrations or Operating Model changes that enable the realization of the Divisional Strategy. You have the opportunity to shape and drive strategy activities, methodologies, and best practices with a view to reaching a critical strategy understanding and expertise throughout the organization. When an M&A is decided you will lead or be part of the M&A integration team that is defining the integration approach and will play a key role in making the integration a success by reaching the defined end state objectives. You will collaborate closely with a variety of senior stakeholders from different parts of the Diagnostics organization and report into a Strategy Team Lead. Expected areas of accountability would include driving and implementing strategic initiatives across functions, but are not necessarily limited to those outlined below: The Opportunity
• Broad understanding of the Diagnostics business as a prerequisite to design the fit for purpose operating model, Organisational Design and integration approaches
• Knowledge of multiple M&A Integration areas and aspects (like: M&A Integration phases, Org.Design, System Integration or legal and tax considerations)
• Use of knowledge of business and integration insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose integration topics with a wide range of complexity.
• Proactively builds knowledge of the external environment to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive integration decisions.
• Leads and/or oversees and coordinates the Operating Model design or integration work from planning to implementation including identifying opportunities and risks while developing/overseeing action plans to address them. Develops and leads/coordinates program / project planning
• Proven ability to influence business leaders and decision makers to achieve required outcomes.
• Further develop and refine aspects of our overarching organisational design and operating model (e.g., structures, roles, interfaces, etc.), run health checks of the organization
• Drive the understanding of the organisational design choices In a highly cross-functional environment,you will also provide project and matrix leadership consistent with the Roche values, leadership capabilities and mindset. The incumbent will seek to inspire and ignite passion in others to create sustainable change and to leverage the efforts of a diverse range of people and teams. Who you are
• University degree level qualification in a relevant discipline, typically with 5-7+ years of experience, preferably in large matrix Diagnostics or Medical Device CompaniesIndustry
• Experience in a consultancy company or strategy development and implementation in a corporate or global strategy role &
• Proven experience with post-merger integrations inside or supporting in/with diagnostics companies
• Structured thinking, proven problem-solving skills & t rack record of successful project & program management-
• Highly developed

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. • Ein umfassendes Verständnis des Diagnostics-Geschäfts als Voraussetzung für die Gestaltung der Passform für zielorientiertes Betriebsmodell, Organisationsdesign und Integrationsansätze

Entwickelt und führt/Koordinaten Programm / Projektplanung

• Führen Sie das Verständnis der organisatorischen Gestaltungsoptionen aus In einer hoch funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung bieten Sie auch Projekt- und Matrixführerschaft im Einklang mit den Roche-Werten, Führungsfähigkeiten und Denkweisen. Der Incumbent wird versuchen, Leidenschaft in anderen zu inspirieren und zu entzünden, um nachhaltige Veränderungen zu schaffen und die Bemühungen einer Vielzahl von Menschen und Teams zu nutzen. Wer bist du?
• Hochschulabschluss-Qualifikation in einer relevanten Disziplin, typischerweise mit 5-7+ Jahren Erfahrung, vorzugsweise in der großen Matrix Diagnostics oder MedizinprodukteunternehmenIndustrie
• Erfahrung in einem Beratungsunternehmen oder Strategieentwicklung und Umsetzung in einer Corporate oder Global Strategie Rolle &
• Erprobte Erfahrung mit Post-Merger-Integrationen innerhalb oder Unterstützung in/mit Diagnostik-Unternehmen
• Strukturiertes Denken, bewährte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten & t Rack Rekord von erfolgreichem Projekt- & Programmmanagement-
• Hochentwickelt
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Vous faites partie d'une équipe à haut rendement et à fort impact qui co-crée et met en œuvre la stratégie de diagnostic Roche afin de réaliser notre vision, d'innover le diagnostic, de façonner les soins de santé, de changer les vies. Vous jouez un rôle central en maximisant la valeur globale de la stratégie Diagnostics pour nos clients et patients et en débloquant la puissance de l'organisation pour nos clients et patients. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de la Stratégie diagnostique, vous dirigerez des initiatives stratégiques clés, comme les intégrations de M et A ou les changements du modèle opérationnel qui permettent la réalisation de la Stratégie divisionnaire. Vous avez l'occasion de concevoir et de diriger des activités stratégiques, des méthodologies et des pratiques exemplaires en vue d'atteindre une compréhension et une expertise stratégiques essentielles dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Lorsqu'une M&A est décidée, vous dirigerez ou participerez à l'équipe d'intégration des M&A qui définit l'approche d'intégration et jouera un rôle clé pour faire de l'intégration un succès en atteignant les objectifs définis de l'état final. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec divers intervenants chevronnés de différentes parties de l'organisation Diagnostics et vous ferez rapport en chef d'équipe stratégique. Les domaines de responsabilisation prévus comprendraient la conduite et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives stratégiques dans toutes les fonctions, mais ne se limitent pas nécessairement à ceux décrits ci-dessous : L'opportunité
• Une compréhension large de l'activité Diagnostic comme préalable à la conception de l'ajustement à des fins de modèle opérationnel, conception organisationnelle et approches d'intégration
• Connaissance de multiples domaines et aspects d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions (comme les phases d'intégration des fusions et acquisitions, la conception, l'intégration des systèmes ou des considérations juridiques et fiscales)
• Utilisation des connaissances sur les perspectives d'affaires et d'intégration, les paramètres, l'expertise et les principes de décision pour diagnostiquer efficacement les sujets d'intégration avec un large éventail de complexité.
• Développer activement les connaissances sur l'environnement extérieur afin de diagnostiquer et de mettre en œuvre efficacement des stratégies permettant d'orienter les décisions d'intégration.
• Dirige et/ou supervise et coordonne les travaux de conception ou d'intégration du modèle d'exploitation, de la planification à la mise en oeuvre, y compris la détermination des possibilités et des risques tout en élaborant ou supervisant des plans d'action pour y remédier. Élaborer et diriger/coordonner la planification des programmes et des projets
• Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les chefs d'entreprise et les décideurs pour obtenir les résultats requis.
• Développer et affiner les aspects de notre conception organisationnelle globale et de notre modèle opérationnel (par exemple, structures, rôles, interfaces, etc.), effectuer des contrôles de santé de l'organisation
• Favoriser la compréhension des choix de conception organisationnelle Dans un environnement hautement interfonctionnel, vous assurerez également un leadership de projet et de matrice conforme aux valeurs de Roche, aux capacités de leadership et à l'état d'esprit. Le titulaire cherchera à inspirer et à susciter la passion chez d'autres pour créer un changement durable et pour tirer parti des efforts d'un éventail varié de personnes et d'équipes. Qui vous êtes
• Diplôme universitaire dans une discipline pertinente, généralement avec 5-7 ans d'expérience, de préférence dans une grande matrice Diagnostics ou entreprises d'instruments médicaux
• Expérience d'une société de conseil ou d'une stratégie de développement et de mise en œuvre dans un rôle de stratégie d'entreprise ou globale &
• Expérience éprouvée des intégrations post-fusion à l'intérieur ou en support dans/avec des entreprises de diagnostic
• La pensée structurée, les compétences éprouvées de résolution de problèmes et l'enregistrement de la réussite de projet et de gestion de programme-
• Hautement développés

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Introduction The Digital Integration Engineer takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and skillfully navigates group dynamics, fostering strong collaboration and acting as a technical mentor. In this role, you will lead small to medium (S/M) initiatives, effectively prioritize with stakeholders, and maintain a "bigger picture" view of how various components align with the overall strategic goals. You will leverage extensive experience to design, develop, and implement complex, end-to-end integrations primarily leveraging ServiceNow platform capabilities (e.g., IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, REST/SOAP APIs) with various external enterprise systems. The Opportunity:
• Drive ownership of ambiguous tasks and "grey zone" topics, successfully leading small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the project, squad, or product level.
• Engineer end-to-end integrations by leveraging ServiceNow capabilities including IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP APIs with external systems.
• Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing by navigating group dynamics in diversified settings and acting as a technical mentor for the team.
• Lead feasibility studies and technical evaluations to ensure all integration solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant.
• Manage stakeholders effectively by prioritizing demands and maintaining a "bigger picture" view of how components fit the overall product strategy.
• Influence platform governance through enterprise-level technical decision-making and the formulation of global integration strategies.
• Champion technical excellence by sharing knowledge at internal events such as DevOps Days, Tech Talks, and Tech Live sessions.
• Ensure documentation integrity by developing comprehensive data maps, API specifications, and ServiceNow Update Set best practices. Who you are:
• Proven Integrator: You have extensive experience in designing, developing, and implementing ServiceNow integrations and complex platform solutions.
• Educated & Experienced: You are educated to a degree level in a relevant field and bring a strong track record of driving technical initiatives.
• ServiceNow Specialist: You possess deep expertise in ServiceNow technical architecture and multiple modules, including ITSM, HRSD, and CSM.
• Technical Leader: You are a recognized mentor capable of aligning development plans with global strategies and fostering a collaborative team environment.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to challenge the status quo and navigate complex group dynamics to achieve engineering quality.
• Integration Expert: You have deep proficiency in IntegrationHub, MID Servers, and scripted integrations, with a focus on security and performance.
• Communication Pro: You are a skilled communicator who can simplify complex technical strategies and manage senior stakeholder expectations effectively. #RDT2026 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportun

• Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos, asegurando el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, así como la correcta trazabilidad de la información técnica.

• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ***12 Month Opportunity*** Roche is a global healthcare leader at the forefront of innovation, dedicated to improving the lives of patients through the development of groundbreaking medicines and diagnostic tools. With a heritage spanning over 125 years, we are committed to sustainable healthcare and delivering medical solutions that address some of the world’s most complex health challenges. Our Global Clinical Supply Chain Organization is the backbone of our clinical research, ensuring that no patient goes without treatment and no clinical trial is delayed. By joining our newly expanded team in Mississauga, Canada, you will be part of a strategically significant hub that fosters agility, cross-functional collaboration, and the delivery of life-saving biopharmaceuticals to more than 100 molecules across 600+ clinical trials globally. The Opportunity
• You will take ownership of the clinical study supply chain for Investigational Medicinal Products (IMP), ensuring effective and cost-conscious delivery across diverse disease areas.
• You will execute end-to-end demand and supply planning within ERP systems, such as SAP, to maintain robust aggregate and long-range program oversight.
• You will lead the alignment of key activities and timelines across cross-functional teams to ensure every clinical trial is supplied in strict accordance with agreed scopes.
• You will strategically forecast, plan, and initiate the procurement of comparator drugs and other study materials required for complex clinical protocols.
• You will integrate all relevant regulatory and quality requirements into the supply plan to ensure compliance with international standards and GMP environments.
• You will drive business excellence by owning and optimizing Clinical Supply Chain processes, influencing change, and ensuring global system integration.
• You will collaborate with Technical Development Teams and Clinical Operations to bridge the gap between drug development and patient-centric delivery. Who you are
• You possess a minimum of five years of experience in Clinical Supply Chain, Planning, or Manufacturing, ideally within the Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical industry.
• You hold an academic degree in Life Sciences, Business, or Engineering, complemented by a solid understanding of clinical trial design and drug technical development.
• You are skilled at navigating ERP systems and IRT functionalities to manage complex inventory and supply chain optimization simulations.
• You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in GMP environments, with a keen eye for quality assurance, regulatory affairs, and budget planning.
• You are a confident stakeholder manager who excels at building customer focus and earning respect through impactful, needs-driven actions.
• You possess an agile mindset, showing a willingness to experiment with new ideas and lead process improvement activities in a self-directed team environment.
• You are an action-oriented professional with the ability to influence others, make decisive choices, and travel internationally to support global operations. *** Relocation not available for this position*** The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 115,328.00 and 151,368.00 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This

• You will take ownership of the clinical study supply chain for Investigational Medicinal Products (IMP), ensuring effective and cost-conscious delivery across diverse disease areas.

• You will strategically forecast, plan, and initiate the procurement of comparator drugs and other study materials required for complex clinical protocols.

• You possess a minimum of five years of experience in Clinical Supply Chain, Planning, or Manufacturing, ideally within the Biotechnology or Pharmaceutical industry.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Business Analyst , you will independently manage end-to-end workstreams, tackling complex business problems with emerging ambiguity to drive Quote Management initiatives and Diagnostics commercial launches . You will act as a trusted advisor to leadership and Diagnostics affiliate commercial teams, shaping stakeholder perspectives and translating requirements into strategic implementation plans . Join us to lead the design of effective solutions and shape best practices within our global digital landscape . Description of the area The Quote Management team is part of DIA Commercial Operations, a strategic global function within Roche Digital Technology (RDT) and is at the heart of our Diagnostics digital landscape. We are responsible for developing, globally rolling out, and continuously evolving technology solutions that enhance the experience of healthcare providers and patients. Serving as a link between global business units - such as Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), Roche Information Solutions (RIS), and Commercial Enablement - and their operational goals, we design the digital architecture that enables Roche to scale its impact across APAC, EMEA/LATAM, and NAM. The Opportunity:
• Drive Strategic Delivery : Act as the RDT delivery lead for Quote Management initiatives and enable high-impact commercial product launches across global markets .
• Orchestrate End-to-End Workstreams : Autonomously manage complex BA workstreams from discovery to implementation while navigating high-ambiguity environments .
• Translate Business Needs : Gather complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable user stories and robust technical solution designs in partnership with Architects .
• Execute System Rollouts : Take ownership of system functional definitions and execute complex configurations to drive successful regional rollouts .
• Serve as a Trusted Advisor : Facilitate high-level workshops to shape strategy and resolve complex stakeholder conflicts, aligning regional expectations with global roadmaps .
• Optimize Solution Value : Contribute to long-term solution roadmaps and ensure every initiative delivers demonstrable business value and technical scalability .
• Bridge Technical Gaps : Act as the direct technical liaison between affiliate business stakeholders and offshore managed services to ensure seamless execution .
• Ensure Quality Excellence : Define clear acceptance criteria and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate that solutions meet rigorous business standards . Who you are:
• Experienced Professional : Proven track record of managing complex BA workstreams independently, driving regional rollouts in the APAC region, and making localization system configurations. You bring 7+ years of Business Analysis experience managing end-to-end IT workstreams, including 4+ years in MedTech or Healthcare Life Sciences .
• Domain Expert : You possess deep functional and technical knowledge of the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) and Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) commercial sales domains .
• Technically Proficient : You have hands-on experience with Conga CPQ and Salesforce (SFDC) , with familiarity in Jira and SAP S/4HANA (ASPIRE) .
• Academic Background : You hold a Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field .
• Agile Practitioner : You have practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum/SAFe); professional certifications like CBAP or IIBA AAC are highly preferre

• Process Account receivable, treasury and inter-company task as per Service level Agreement. Process all cash application and remittance reconciliation for assigned countries accurately and within specific timescales. Prepare and follow up unidentified open items in clearing account when execute daily/monthly bank reconciliation.
• Liaise with the stakeholder for preparation and transaction posting of Inter-company non trade related debit and credit notes. Preparation of monthly reconciliation, highlight and rectify anomalies encountered. Generate statement of accounts to the customers. Track and resolve disputes and route to local affiliates as and when required
• Attend to all matters requested for accounts receivable when required. Initiate the dunning process and generate reminders for overdue accounts. Prepare regularly the details of unallocated and unidentified receipts for stakeholder further actions. Execute month end, quarter end and year end closing activities for countries assigned. Manage Cash pool account reconciliation
• Prepare preliminary and final Inter-company Account Receivable balances to reconcile against counterparty balances. Ensure timely and accurate deal settlement and posting of treasury related transactions including Inter-company foreign exchange, loan, accrual and actual interest, bank charges and etc.Creation and maintenance of the customer master data records in system. Credit management – Perform and responsible for credit analysis on customer according to company credit policy and procedures. Reviewing credit risk for new and existing customers by carry out credit worthless checks and make credit limit recommendation.
• Collection management – Ensure customers pay within agreed payment terms, contacting sales team and customer on collection activities if necessary as per company’s debt collection procedure.. Demonstrated good customer service skills while initiating outbound calls and received inbound calls with customer. Handling of AR bad debt allowance and write off management. First point of contact for operational support and issue solving Liaise with customer for balance confirmation and monitoring of daily sales order status. Who you are
• Ensure all work documentation and work processes are updated and meet with Internal Control Financial Reporting (ICFR), group policies and guidelines, local statutory and legal requirements within agreed service timelines.
• Perform back up function and other duties, including job rotation to other functional teams as and when required. Participate in internal and external compliance audit queries
• Transformation/ Continuous Improvement Implementations : Work collaboratively with Country Chief Accountant and stakeholders. Engage and support the teams in the implementation of continuous improvement project
• Proactively to identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation
• Assist to ensure effective knowledge transfer as for sustainable development knowledge and sharing of best practices within the team ​ Thank you for your application. titleByLocale.it: Technical Services Project Manager and Capo Team
titleByLocale.en: Technical Services Project Manager and Team Lead
titleByLocale.de: Technical Services Project Manager and Teamleiter
titleByLocale.fr: Technical Services Project Manager and Chef d'équipe

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Professional Technical Services team (Field Service Engineering) in Hungary is a dedicated group of experts committed to delivering high-quality engineering and technical solutions in the field of in vitro diagnostics (IVD) . As part of Roche Diagnostics, the team focuses on creating long-lasting partnerships with healthcare providers by ensuring our diagnostic systems are installed and maintained to the highest standards, ultimately supporting reliable patient results across the country. The Opportunity As a Technical Services Project Manager and Team Lead, you will play a dual role that balances high-level project execution with people leadership. You will be responsible for ensuring compliant, professional services for our customers while developing a high-performing team of Field Service Engineers. In this role, you will split your focus between driving complex technical implementations (60-70%) and mentoring your team (30-40%). You will be the bridge between technical excellence and strategic growth, ensuring our laboratory solutions are delivered seamlessly while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. As a Technical Project Manager (60-70%):
• You will manage the full project lifecycle for laboratory implementations, from initial tender to handover.
• You will conduct on-site technical assessments, develop and execute detailed project plans to meet stakeholder expectations, identify and mitigate risks.
• You will oversee the installation of systems, testing, and reagent applications, ensuring all deliverables are met on time and within scope. As a Team Lead (30-40%):
• You will lead, coach, and develop a customer-focused, future-ready and high-performing Field Service Engineering team, attract and retain top talent, and foster a continuous learning culture.
• You will manage resource planning and workload, oversee the business portfolio (SWA, NPC, M&TD), monitor team KPIs and service data to ensure high-quality technical support for Hungarian customers. Who you are
• Experienced Leader: You have a proven track record in leading and developing teams, with the ability to motivate others and facilitate professional growth.
• Technical Expert: You hold a BSc/MSc in Engineering (e.g. Electrical, Mechatronical, Mechanical, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, etc) and have 3-5 years of experience in laboratory technology or medical devices.
• Project Specialist: You are proficient in project management methodologies and tools, with a focus on delivering outcomes in complex, changing environments.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess a growth mindset and the ability to think at an enterprise level, identifying business development opportunities within the healthcare system.
• Strong Communicator: You are fluent in Hungarian and proficient in English, with the interpersonal intelligence needed to build sustainable relationships with diverse stakeholders.
• Mobile and Flexible: You are willing to work in a field-based environment across Hungary to support our customers where they need us most. Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. Questo è ciò che ci guida. In People & Culture la nostra visione è quella di portare a vita il nostro scopo Roche sbloccando la grandezza in tutta la nostra gente e organizzazione. Costruiamo la fiducia proteggendo e creando valore attraverso la nostra partnership con i clienti per fornire non solo servizi, ma esperienze di impatto. Siamo un catalizzatore per consentire prestazioni elevate, alimentando un senso di appartenenza e una cultura inclusiva dove possiamo prosperare quando scopriamo le migliori idee e sviluppiamo soluzioni veramente innovative per i pazienti e il futuro successo di Roche. In qualità di Lead & Organisation Development Community Lead, formerai la visione strategica di come trasformiamo la nostra organizzazione per realizzare le Ambizioni di 10 anni di Roche. Leader della Global Consulting Practice, tu e il tuo partner di squadra con i team di leadership senior per migliorare le prestazioni e la salute organizzative, utilizzando competenze profonde nella trasformazione, progettazione organizzativa, efficacia del team di leadership e formazione della cultura. Come membro del team di abilitazione del capitolo P&OG, creerai e garantirai una visione del capitolo, una strategia e priorità che forniscono valore e impatto aziendale. La tua opportunità In questo ruolo, guiderai la direzione strategica per la nostra pratica di consulenza:
• Guidare il Global Consulting Practice of Organizational Development (OD) professionisti per supportare i leader con il design organizzativo, l'efficacia del team, la formazione culturale e la trasformazione.
• Collaborare con i leader aziendali per co-creare strategie che supportano la trasformazione delle imprese su larga scala.
• Costruire le capacità di consulenza in tutta l'organizzazione, assicurando ai nostri partner gli strumenti e le competenze per guidare il cambiamento.
• Promuovere una forte rete di esperti, garantendo un costante trasferimento di conoscenze e lo scambio di migliori pratiche a livello globale.
• Guidare l'armonizzazione dei processi e definire standard di alta qualità e KPI per la pratica.
• Catalizzare l'azione formando squadre agili per fornire iniziative ad alta priorità.
• Allenare e sviluppare i membri del capitolo, garantendo una pipeline diversificata e pronta di talento. Chi sei Sei un pensatore strategico che prospera in ambienti complessi e multiculturali ed è appassionato di leadership inclusiva. Porti una mentalità di crescita e le seguenti qualifiche:
• 10+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo organizzativo, nello sviluppo di Leadership o in un campo relativo.
• 5+ anni di ruoli di leadership, in particolare leader di team globali o comunità di esperti.
• Competenza nella progettazione organizzativa e nella realizzazione di trasformazioni di grandi dimensioni.
• Prova capacità di consultare le prestazioni organizzative, lo sviluppo della leadership, la dinamica del team e l'apprendimento degli adulti.
• Mindset agile con la capacità di navigare in ambiguità e influenzare gli stakeholder in un ambiente a matrice. Questa posizione è aperta a seguito di una promozione esterna, riflettendo il nostro impegno a sviluppare leader che sono riconosciuti sia all'interno che al di là della nostra organizzazione. Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Basilea. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienc

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ça qui nous pousse. Dans People & Culture, notre vision est de donner vie à notre but Roche en débloquant la grandeur de notre peuple et de notre organisation. Nous renforçons la confiance en protégeant et en créant de la valeur grâce à notre partenariat avec nos clients pour offrir non seulement des services, mais aussi des expériences pertinentes. Nous sommes un catalyseur pour permettre des performances élevées tout en nourrissant un sentiment d'appartenance et une culture inclusive où nous pouvons tous prospérer alors que nous découvrons les meilleures idées et développons des solutions vraiment innovantes pour les patients et le succès futur de Roche. En tant que chef de file communautaire de la pratique de conseil et du développement de l'organisation, vous façonnerez la vision stratégique de la façon dont nous transformons notre organisation pour réaliser les ambitions de 10 ans de Roche. Diriger la Global Consulting Practice, vous et votre équipe vous associez à des équipes de direction pour améliorer la performance organisationnelle et la santé, en utilisant une expertise approfondie dans la transformation, la conception organisationnelle, l'efficacité de l'équipe de leadership et l'élaboration de la culture. En tant que membre de l'équipe habilitante du chapitre P&OG, vous créerez et assurerez une vision, une stratégie et des priorités chapitre qui offre de la valeur et un impact opérationnel. Votre opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'orientation stratégique de notre pratique de consultation :
• Diriger la Global Consulting Practice of Organizational Development (OD) pour aider les dirigeants à concevoir l'organisation, à améliorer l'efficacité de l'équipe, à façonner et à transformer leur culture.
• Collaborer avec les chefs d'entreprise pour co-créer des stratégies qui soutiennent la transformation des grandes entreprises.
• Développer les capacités de consultation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, en veillant à ce que nos partenaires disposent des outils et des compétences nécessaires pour favoriser le changement.
• Favoriser un solide réseau d'experts, assurant un transfert constant des connaissances et l'échange des meilleures pratiques à l'échelle mondiale.
• Favoriser l'harmonisation des processus et définir des normes de qualité et des ICR pour la pratique.
• Catalyser l'action en formant des équipes agiles pour réaliser des initiatives hautement prioritaires.
• Coach et développer les membres du chapitre, en assurant une gamme variée et prête de talents. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur stratégique qui prospère dans des environnements complexes et multiculturels et qui est passionné par le leadership inclusif. Vous apportez un état d'esprit de croissance et les qualifications suivantes:
• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en développement organisationnel, en leadership ou dans un domaine connexe.
• 5 ans et plus dans les rôles de leadership, en particulier les équipes mondiales ou les communautés d'experts.
• Expertise en conception organisationnelle et en transformation à grande échelle du changement.
• Capacité éprouvée de consulter sur la performance organisationnelle, le développement du leadership, la dynamique d'équipe et l'apprentissage des adultes.
• Un état d'esprit agile avec la capacité de naviguer l'ambiguïté et d'influencer les parties prenantes dans un environnement matriciel. Cette position est ouverte à la suite d'une promotion externe, reflétant notre engagement à développer des leaders reconnus au sein et au-delà de notre organisation. Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Bâle. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100'000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés à l'avancement scienc

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an Inte rn – Access and Policy based in Dhaka , you will play a vital role in supporting Roche Bangladesh Limited’s mission to shape the healthcare ecosystem. You will assist in building strategic partnerships and navigating policy frameworks to ensure our innovative solutions reac h the patients who need them most—helping to unlock possibilities that deliver value for both the healthcare system and society. The Opportunity
• You assist in coordinating partnerships and engagements with Development Organizations, Patient Advocacy Groups (PAGs), Societies, and Foundations to support access and policy initiatives.
• You support the team in developing and maintaining strategic partnerships within government and industry to effectively communicate Roche’s positions.
• You contribute to identifying, mapping, and managing key ecosystem stakeholders to ensure alignment with our corporate strategies.
• You act as a facilitator for collaboration between external stakeholders and internal Roche teams, helping the department serve as a trusted partner.
• You assist in broadening the company's corporate and non-governmental network through market analysis, stakeholder mapping, and outreach support.
• You execute day-to-day departmental operations and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to build trusted internal and external partnerships.
• You commit to a minimum 6-month internship duration, allowing you to gain deep, hands-on experience and make a meaningful impact within the Access and Policy functions. Who You Are
• You are a fresh graduate , or a current student pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, Business Administration, Pharmacy, or a related field.
• You are a proactive individual with a genuine passion for pursuing a career in Healthcare Policy, Access, or Public Affairs.
• You possess excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and are confident in engaging with diverse stakeholders.
• You have basic IT skills and a strong proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a high level of attention to detail.
• You are available to work fully on-site at the office every day and are comfortable working in a structured, fast-paced environment.
• You uphold high ethical standards, maintain confidentiality, and thrive in a collaborative teamwork setting. Why Join Us? At Roche, we endeavor to provide a meaningful and enriching experience that ensures our interns gain valuable industry insights, hands-on knowledge, and the opportunity to build a solid foundation for a career in Access and Policy. What we offer Roche offers rewarding growth opportunities, a competitive remuneration package and a collaborative culture where people are united in purpose and will stretch you to be brave, speak up and think differently. Feel empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes, supported by accessible and inspiring leaders. Roche encourages a high-performance culture where you are empowered and trusted to make decisions. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Das Arbeitsumfeld Die Einheit Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) stellt die technische und strategische Kompetenz für die Bereitstellung der klinischen Pipeline sowie Einführung und die Unterstützung der kommerziellen pharmazeutischen Produktion für unsere Patienten sicher. Die Abteilung MSAT Process Automation bietet für die Herstellung, Bewertung und Freigabe hochwertiger Produkte im GMP-Bereich den technischen Support, Engineering, Daten und Dokumente. Dabei sind produktionslinienbezogene Gruppen für die Konfiguration und den Support der Produktions-Automationssysteme verantwortlich; technische Chapter stellen die standardisierte Nutzung der Systeme sicher und tragen zu effizienten Produktionsprozesstransfers bei. Kernthemen, mit denen wir uns in MSAT Process Automation befassen:
• Umsetzung von Herstellvorgaben in Checkpläne, Batch- und MES-Rezepte
• End-to-End Direct Support und Configuration Management für Automationssysteme der Produktion
• Herstellprozessbezogene Datenbereitstellung & Analyse
• Anwendertraining
• Anforderungsmanagement für alle Produktions-Automationssysteme und Datenreports
• PLS (PCS7) Umsetzung und Support
• Application Administration für prozessnahe Automation
• Business Process Oversight, Data Oversight und Configuration Oversight für alle automatisierten Herstellprozesse von Transfer, Make, Assess und Release Dein zukünftiges Team Wir sind ein gut eingespieltes, selbstständig agierendes Team und fühlen uns überwiegend im Manufacturing Produktionsumfeld als Rezeptersteller und 1st Level Support für die Produktionssysteme zu Hause. In diesem agilen Umfeld ist es für uns eine Selbstverständlichkeit, kunden- und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten und dabei viele Schnittstellen zu bedienen. Deine Aufgaben
• Rezepterstellung für pharmazeutische Entwicklungs- und Marktprodukte: Planung und Umsetzung von beschriebenen Herstellprozessen in automatisierte Produktionsabläufe auf MES- und Batchebene
• Konfiguration von Prozess- und Stammdaten
• 1st Level Support und Fehleranalyse (24/7) für automatisierte Produktionssysteme
• Analyse und Bereitstellung von Prozessdaten
• Standardisierung von Prozessen, Rezepten, PLS-Phasen und Konfigurationen
• Anforderungensmanagement für Produktionssysteme
• GMP-gerechte Dokumentation sämtlicher Arbeitsaktivitäten Dein Profil passt gut zu uns, wenn
• Du Dein naturwissenschaftliches Studium (Bachelor oder Master) erfolgreich abgeschlossen hast oder alternativ tiefgreifende Erfahrung aus der pharmazeutischen Produktion vorweisen kannst,
• Du über fundierte verfahrenstechnische oder biotechnologische Kenntnisse verfügst und es Dir Spaß macht, diese in die Sprache der Prozessautomation zu übersetzen,
• Du GMP-Dokumentation als wichtig empfindest und bereit bist, Deine Expertise jederzeit in der sicheren Bedienung des Sematic Batch Client sowie in Routine-GMP-Prozessen (z.B. Abweichungen und Changes) sowie in Audits und Inspektionen einzubringen,
• Du praktische Erfahrung im GMP-Bereich von Labor oder Produktion mitbringst,
• Du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement gesammelt hast,
• You are fluent in German and English, both written and spoken and you are able to influence at all levels,
• Du idealerweise eine Affinität zu Lean Methoden besitzt,
• Du gerne Dein Wissen erweiterst (z.B. durch externe Seminar- und Kongressbesuche) und dieses mit Deinen Kollegen und den Anwendern in den Produktionsbetrieben teilst,
• Du ein wahrer Teamplayer bist, über Durchsetzungsvermöge

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Nel campo di Engineering & SHE in Kaiseraugst, troverete numerose possibilità per conoscere il campo di attività nel campo della produzione farmaceutica di forme farmaceutiche solide e liquide. Engineering & SHE è l'area centrale per la calibrazione dei nostri sistemi di produzione GMP (ad esempio temperatura, pressione, massa) e supporta il sito Kaiseraugst in conformità ai requisiti di produzione GMP. La possibilità: come specialista di calibrazione, il vostro campo di attività comprende i seguenti compiti:
• Coordinamento auto-organizzato delle tarature - monitoraggio, documentazione e implementazione tempestiva delle calibrazioni
• mantenimento dello stato di stabilimento qualificato delle apparecchiature di misura supervisionate
• gestione dei documenti – creazione, revisione e aggiornamento dei documenti
• implementazione orientata al GMP e documentazione dei vostri compiti
• sviluppo di proposte e coordinamento delle misure per migliorare la qualità, la sicurezza, l'efficienza dei processi di calibrazione e la riduzione dei costi Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As Global Business Process Specialist - Capital Investment Finance , you are part of the Business Process Management Finance team at Roche Services & Solutions. This position actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy and is responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design related to financial processes in the domains of asset accounting, CAPEX & Lease accounting. The person in this role is the empowered decision-maker for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Managers. This position works closely with various stakeholders in the Business Process Management organization & beyond, with the goal to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions and contributes as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in an ongoing large scale global SAP S4 deployment across our Pharmaceutical and Diagnostics Division. Disclosure Note: The position is open on a fixed-term basis until 31/12/2029. The Opportunity
• Project Management and Contribution: Drive deployment of large scale SAP S4 project, responsible for areas in and around Asset Accounting, CAPEX & Lease Accounting
• Business Process Strategy: Actively pursues the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, delivers solutions including processes, technology, and analytics, and supports global business acceptance for their dedicated area.
• Business Process Design: Responsible for global, cross-divisional, state-of-the-art process design and redesign, ensuring processes are fit for purpose, lean, and standardized.
• Business Process Governance: Manages the prioritization and implementation of change requests, ensures robust process execution, documents process requirements, and drives automation and improvements.
• Strong Business and IT Knowledge: Requires strong knowledge in both business and IT to effectively discuss and justify business requirements and assess the feasibility of technical solutions.
• Strong Stakeholder Management Skills: Needs strong skills in communication, change management, and negotiation to discuss complex topics with various stakeholders across the organization.
• Overarching Impact: Has a significant global impact on both business and IT through the design, governance, and implementation of standardized processes.
• Agile Leadership and Coaching: Has a good understanding of SAFe principles, contributes to advancing agile ways of working, assumes agile roles (e.g., product owner, scrum master), and provides guidance and coaching to other specialists and colleagues. Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:
• Education and Experience: A bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable field is required, along with 5-7 years of professional experience in business process management, finance, accounting, or an equivalent function.
• Technical and Process Expertise: The role demands a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, deep process knowledge, and technical expertise in areas like IFRS Accounting, SAP FI/CO, ICFR, Procurement, and various laws and regulations. Past experience as functional consultant and/or end user in asset & lease accounting i

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of priorities related to content. You are responsible for supporting Roche disease area teams in translating their brand strategy into content. In addition, you work with relevant stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that all content related activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs. This position has a global scope. Your Opportunity In the position of Digital Content Strategist in the area of Immunology/CVRM you will be focusing on:
• Aligning content strategy across disease area teams to ensure business objectives flow seamlessly through the full content supply chain
• Developing customer engagement goals and driving customer-centric content planning that solves identified business problem
• Building integrated omnichannel plans by collaborating with strategy leads, insights teams, and data analytics experts to ensure content reaches customers effectively
• Auditing and optimizing content by identifying gaps, repurposing existing assets across new channels and formats, and maximizing content value
• Fostering cross-functional collaboration across commercial, medical, corporate communications, and global teams to co-create innovative content strategies
• Measuring content performance through KPIs and A/B testing, while building a repository of best practices tailored to customer segments
• Driving continuous improvement by establishing governance principles, encouraging experimentation, and recommending enhancements to service and responsiveness for business partners Who you are You are an upbeat, dynamic individual who is highly involved and passionate about planning, creating and executing content strategies. As a Digital Content Strategist you are an accomplished expert, with a deep knowledge of digital content and demonstrated success executing content strategies and providing high quality enablement of customer engagement. You are a proactive, innovative problem-solver with a focus on sustainable and scalable solutions. You are passionate about personal growth and learning, constantly focusing on improvement of our customer's experience. You have:
• Degree in Life sciences or healthcare experience (considered as a plus) with 3–5 years digital marketing experience
• Content Development experience: Create resonant digital content across multiple channels (email, paid media, congresses)
• Rapid Learning: Quickly master disease areas, competitive landscapes, and brand-specific marketing challenges
• Strong planning, influencing, and cross-functional facilitation skill
• Fluent English; excellent presentation, customer service, and team alignment abilities
• Detail-oriented, organized, independent problem-solver; adaptable to pressure and international schedules; tech-savvy quick learner In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave f

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Design Project Coordinator (DPC), you are the end-to-end owner of design tickets. You act as a central point of contact from ticket intake to delivery, handling all project management, Workfront administration, designer allocation, stakeholder communication. Your mission is to protect creative time for designers and ensure smooth, timely execution across all project types. Your Opportunity: This role demands a proactive approach to project management, including the screening and delegation of incoming tasks, constant communication to optimize project delivery, and the maintenance of a balanced and productive team environment. In this position you will be focusing on:
• Oversee the full lifecycle of assigned Workfront tickets, from intake to closure.
• Review ticket briefs, clarify missing or unclear information with stakeholders.
• Assign designers based on availability and expertise.
• Manage Workfront administration, including metadata, timelines, task transitions, and documentation.
• Act as the single point of contact between stakeholders and designers.
• Coordinate kick-off calls for complex or high-priority projects, and route feedback to designers.
• Ensure timely deliveries, update stakeholders, close tickets, escalate blockers, and track team progress. Who you are:
• 2+ years of professional experience in project management or workflow management, preferably in a design area or similar fast-paced business.
• Exceptional time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
• Demonstrated ability to organize and manage time efficiently, prioritizing tasks to handle multiple projects concurrently.
• Skilled in fostering client relationships through initial project discussions, ongoing updates, and setting realistic expectations, ensuring smooth project execution. In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits & flexibility: Roche Annual Bonus, Monthly transportation allowance, Home Office set - up equipment, Health Insurance, Life/Accident insurance, Full salary when on sick leave for the first 9 days, Eyeglasses settlement, One-time payment options for various events in the life e.g. wedding, childbirth, Service Awards: We value loyalty with additional holidays and bonus payment, Work in a hybrid model (2 days/week from the office)
• A global diverse community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/monthly. Final salary depends on the successful candidate's level of experience, skills and qualifications. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver l

The Position The Opportunity The Executive Business Coordinator & Biosafety Specialist serves as a strategic collaborator to the Country Manager and the Leadership Team. This role combines high-level executive support and organizational management with the specialized responsibility of serving as the site Biosafety Officer (BSO). The position ensures operational excellence, seamless leadership coordination, and full compliance with biological safety standards. Main
• Responsibilities Executive Support & Leadership Management - Executive Assistant to the CM: Act as the primary point of contact and gatekeeper for the Country Manager; managing complex calendars, travel, and high-priority communications. - Leadership Team Coordination: Support the leadership team’s administrative activities, including preparing agendas, documenting meeting minutes (when applicable), and tracking action items to ensure organizational alignment. - Strategic Liaison: Facilitate communication between the CM and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring the CM is briefed and prepared for all engagements. Organizational Business Management & Events - Event Management: Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of organizational events, including town halls, leadership retreats, and corporate functions. - Operational Oversight: Manage administrative workflows and special projects as assigned by the CM to improve organizational efficiency. - Collaboration with finance and procurement team for purchase requisition creation - Establish a good relations with service providers and negotiate to maintain expenses within the defined budget - Ensure good record management of all contracts, according to the record management SOP - Ensure contracts are executed until service delivery and partners payment Biosafety Management (Biosafety Officer Duties) - Policy Development: Create, develop, and revise local biosafety policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with local laws, Roche Group requirements (K17), and industry standards like the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual. - Risk Management: Partner with line management to ensure risk assessments for potentially infectious materials are performed and periodically revised. - Compliance & Inspections: Conduct regular inspections and surveillance of workplaces handling contaminated instruments to ensure compliance with biosafety levels and legal requirements. - Safety Programs: Organize health programs for employees, specifically managing Hepatitis B vaccinations and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). - Training & Reporting: Support line management in delivering documented biosafety training and maintaining procedures for reporting incidents or accidents involving infectious materials. - Waste & Vendor Management: Ensure procedures are in place for the legal disposal of biological waste and assist in qualifying outsourced vendors according to K15 and K17 standards. - Regulatory Liaison: Coordinate interactions between the site, local biosafety authorities, and Group SHE, ensuring all notifications and permits are fulfilled. - Self-Assessment: Perform regular self-assessments to verify program compliance and report biosafety metrics, risks, or gaps to site leadership. In the capacity of Biosafety Officer, this role holds the following specific authorities: - Work Stoppage: Authority to stop any activity immediately in the event of imminent danger related to biological exposure. - Regulatory Issuance: Authority to issue detailed biosafety regulations specific to

Missions Princiaples Garantir la réalisation des actions techniques du SAV, leur traçabilité et le niveau de satisfaction des clients sur son secteur - Réalise l’installation technique des systèmes sur les sites clients, l’exécution des maintenances préventives et curatives ainsi que les mises à jour des systèmes installés. - Réalise également les désinstallations et réinstallations des systèmes sur site. - Porte une attention particulière à la qualité des actions techniques et administratives réalisées, en respectant le cadre défini par le groupe et la (Valeurs, Contrat, Normes ISO, recommandations Constructeur, cadre réglementaire…) pour parvenir à l’obtention des objectifs fixés. - Contribue aux plans d’action « Satisfaction Client » de son secteur et est responsable de l’exécution de ceux qu’il initie. - Contribue activement aux différents processus ou méthodes mis en place pour conquérir de nouveaux clients, fidéliser et développer nos clients existants. - Renseigne, quantitativement et qualitativement en temps réel, l’ensemble des interventions dans les outils mis à sa disposition et les qualifie selon les règles en cours. Assurer la mise en œuvre d’actions d’amélioration et de fiabilisation des systèmes installés - Remonte les informations techniques à son responsable et alerte celui-ci en cas de difficulté particulière. - S’informe sur les informations diffusées par les supports techniques et les applique dans son activité. - Conçoit ses actions en intégrant systématiquement l’amélioration de la Satisfaction Clients. Garantir le respect des normes et des règles - Connaître les règles et procédures QSE qui impactent son activité - Relayer l’information en termes de Qualité, Sécurité, Hygiène et Environnement et donne l’alerte en cas de manquement - S’assurer de la bonne application des directives et instructions dans son périmètre de travail Garantir la transversalité, la synergie et la communication au sein de l’entreprise - Echange avec les collègues d’autres services et contribue à renforcer la culture d’entreprise. - S'assurer que toutes les activités menées respectent les exigences de qualité et les réglementations en vigueur. Qui Vous Etes? descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet engagierten Talenten eine besondere Gelegenheit, praktische Erfahrungen in der Pharmaindustrie zu sammeln und gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag für die Welt zu leisten. Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben? In diesem Praktikum arbeitest Du an der datenbasierten Optimierung von HVACR-Systemen, um Energieverschwendung in Gebäudebetrieben sichtbar zu machen und gezielt zu reduzieren. Du analysierst bestehende Facility-Daten von mehr als 100 Assets, identifizierst ineffiziente Betriebsweisen wie gleichzeitiges Heizen und Kühlen oder unnötige Laufzeiten und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate erstellst Du ein Mapping der zehn energieintensivsten Assets, entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung von Ineffizienzen und erarbeitest einen priorisierten Optimierungsplan für das lokale Facility Management. Damit trägst Du direkt zur Priorität Environment in Roche’s Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie bei, insbesondere zu Climate Change und Sustainable Operations. Die Rolle bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, mit Daten sofort messbare Umweltwirkung und Kosteneinsparungen in einer komplexen Infrastruktur zu erzielen. Deine Aufgaben
• Du analysierst historische Facility-Daten, um Muster von Energieverschwendung und ineffizientem Anlagenbetrieb zu identifizieren
• Du erstellst ein Mapping und Inventar der zehn energieintensivsten Assets auf Basis von Datenmustern
• Du entwickelst standardisierte Regeln zur Erkennung betrieblicher Ineffizienzen, zum Beispiel für HVACR-Unstimmigkeiten oder Abweichungen von Produktionsplänen
• Du bewertest bestehende Daten nach definierten Kriterien und leitest daraus Optimierungspotenziale ab
• Du schlägst Anpassungen von Produktionszeiten und HVACR-Betriebszeiten vor, um unnötigen Energieverbrauch zu vermeiden
• Du quantifizierst das Einsparpotenzial jeder Maßnahme in Bezug auf Energieverbrauch, Kosten und CO₂-Fußabdruck
• Du erarbeitest einen umsetzbaren Optimierungsplan mit einer priorisierten Liste technischer Anpassungen für das lokale Facility Management
• Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf und stimmst Dich mit relevanten Stakeholdern ab Wer Du bist Du bist aktuell an einer Universität in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energiemanagement, Energietechnik, Maschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt HLK/Gebäudetechnik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Umwelttechnik oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums einbringen. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:
• Du hast Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und kannst mit größeren Datensätzen sicher arbeiten
• Du verfügst über ein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis von HVACR-Systemen und deren Zusammenspiel in industriellen oder großtechnischen Gebäuden
• Du hast ein Basisverständnis von Gebäudeautomationssystemen und davon, wie Facility-Daten erfasst und gesteuert werden
• Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und lösungsorientiert
• Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und verfügst über gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse Auch wenn Du nicht alle Qualifika
