title: Team Lead, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz

titleByLocale.it: Capo Team, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz
titleByLocale.en: Team Lead, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe, RDT Onsite Services Rotkreuz

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee-facing products, services, and experiences within RDT, delivering digital tools and support to empower our workforce globally. Within WE, the Onsite Enablement organization acts as the heartbeat of our physical presence, serving as the bridge between digital strategy and local execution. We ensure that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. Our ultimate mission is to provide a frictionless workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives. As the Team Lead for RDT Onsite Services in Rotkreuz (Engineering Manager), a role requiring your presence five days a week on-site, you will be accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high-quality offering for our employees. You will focus on developing your team members' capabilities, encouraging them to self-define their career journeys while supporting them by removing roadblocks and setting clear performance goals. By fostering healthy dynamics, a sustainable pace, and the right skill sets, you will oversee a team of individual contributors to lead software and service delivery, manage stakeholders, and create efficiencies in collaboration to ensure onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and an optimal user experience. The Opportunity
• Team Development & Culture: Proactively identify future-focused capabilities, oversee technical and soft skill development (including emotional intelligence), and mentor team members on their career paths while fostering a culture of radical candor, accountability, and psychological safety.
• Health, Sustainability & Change Leadership: Establish team health metrics, design initiatives to improve collaboration, resolve complex systemic impediments, and guide distributed, multi-time-zone teams through organizational shifts, site transitions, or critical system failures while maintaining morale and operational consistency.
• Product Vision & Service Delivery: Co-create the long-term technical vision for the product portfolio, ensure successful delivery and feature shipment, manage technical priorities and dependencies, and ensure deliverables align with both local business needs and global standards.
• Performance & Process Optimization: Define success metrics, lead significant process re-engineering efforts spanning multiple development teams to create step-change improvements, and present technical insights and optimization strategies to senior leadership.
• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the team's budget, headcount planning, operational costs (OPEX), infrastructure upgrades (CAPEX), and vendor contracts to ensure maximum ROI, while supporting business cases for large initiatives and optimizing resource allocation across projects.
• Stakeholder Management & Influence: Manage relationships with senior-level stakeholders, translate complex IT requirements into business value for site heads, negotiate priorities, and tactically shield the team from scope creep while breaking down organizational silos.
• Cross-Functional Enablement: Empower teams to act autonomously, drive initiatives to improve engineering processes, manage the talent pipeline for future needs, and resolve cross-functional roadblocks blocking agile release trains or program teams. Who You Are
• Experienced Leader: You bring 10+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Solution Architect for ERP Application Lifecycle (ALM) Processes, Framework and Tools is the primary technical authority responsible for architecting the transition from legacy SAP Solution Manager to a modern, future-proof ALM ecosystem. In this role, you will lead the strategic design and operational excellence of the global "Requirements to Deploy" process, ensuring that our delivery pipeline remains robust during a period of significant technological shift. Your core mission is to navigate the complexities of SAP’s Cloud ALM offering while maintaining the flexibility to custom-build proprietary solutions when standard tools lack the necessary influence on design or functional depth. As part of your daily remit, you will: Architect the Pivot: Actively evaluate the functional gaps within SAP Cloud ALM and decide where the organization must "Build" rather than "Buy." You will be responsible for the high-level design of custom ALM modules (potentially on SAP BTP or other cloud-native platforms) to ensure our specific business requirements are met. Design the "Requirements to Deploy" Lifecycle and Lead Technical Decisioning: You will orchestrate the end-to-end framework including Business Process Modelling, Requirements, Change, Transport, Release, Test, Defect and System Documentation Management. You are not just a tool user; you are the designer of the framework that enables these processes. Govern Hybrid Landscapes: You will define the integration patterns required to link SAP-specific ALM components with the broader enterprise DevOps toolchain, ensuring a "clean core" strategy while managing the decommissioning of legacy SolMan/ChaRM environments. Qualifications
• Mastery of ALM Transition & Toolsets: Expert-level knowledge of legacy ALM (SolMan, Focused Build, ChaRM, Worksoft, Adonis) paired with the ability to architect migrations to SAP Cloud ALM.
• 8+ years of Custom Build & Extensibility Expertise: Proven experience in designing custom-built enterprise software or side-by-side extensions. You must demonstrate an "architectural mindset" capable of building bespoke tools when SaaS products offer limited design influence.
• SDLC & DevOps Proficiency: Deep understanding of ERP change management and transport layers, with a modern approach to API-first design, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release orchestration.
• Advanced competency in using AI-augmented engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, SAP Joule, or equivalent) to improve code quality, automate documentation, and design intelligent extensions that bridge functional gaps in standard SaaS offerings
• Lifecycle Management: Proven track record of managing at least 2–3 full-scale ERP implementation or upgrade lifecycles, specifically focusing on the architectural trade-offs between "Standard" and "Custom" solutions.
• Strategic Compliance: Solid background in IT Service Management / ITIL, alongside experience in Computerized System Validation (CSV) and ICFR, ensuring custom-built ALM tools meet global regulatory standards.
• Global Architectural Leadership: Experience working in a large global company, demonstrating the ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders
• English Communication: Superior command of the English language (both written and verbal) is essential for collaborating with global stakeholders and presenting complex ALM strategies to leadership.
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equ

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'opportunità Il nostro team di sviluppo clinico ha una fantastica opportunità per un (Lead) Direttore Clinico di aderire al franchise neurologico per sostenere studi clinici di fine fase. Questa posizione offre un'opportunità unica per svolgere un ruolo cardine nel promuovere lo sviluppo clinico di Trontinemab , il primo anticorpo anti-amiloide nelle prove per utilizzare la tecnologia del cervello per trattare la malattia di Alzheimer. In questo ruolo sarete:
• Supporta la strategia di sviluppo clinico per uno o più test di fine stadio (Phase II–III) nella malattia di Alzheimer
• Guidare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di studi clinici, assicurando rigore scientifico, integrità etica e allineamento normativo chiaro
• Fornire un monitoraggio medico per gli studi in corso e garantire la sicurezza e la qualità dei dati dei pazienti
• Collaborare con team interfunzionali tra cui le operazioni normative, cliniche, sicurezza, biomarcatori, biostat e ricerca precoce
• Mentore e allenatore Scienziati Clinici all'interno del team
• Impegnarsi con parti interessate esterne come consiglieri, investigatori chiave e autorità sanitarie
• Contribuire alle pubblicazioni scientifiche e condurre la presenza di Roche in neurologia attraverso conferenze chiave e impegno comunitario
• Fornire input clinici ai programmi precedenti per rafforzare la pipeline di neuroscienze di Roche Chi sei Sei un leader medico guidato dalla missione che combina competenze scientifiche con il pensiero strategico. Tu porti:
• Un MD o MD/PhD , con formazione clinica in neurologia o demenza, preferibilmente con profonda esperienza nella malattia di Alzheimer
• Solida esperienza di ricerca clinica, compresa la leadership nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di prove (preferibilmente nell'industria farmaceutica)
• Una solida comprensione del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del farmaco, dagli studi di prima fase al post-marketing
• Un comprovato record di impatto scientifico, dimostrato attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni o contributi consultivi
• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di influenzare in un ambiente matrixed e cross-functional
• Una passione per l'innovazione e la risoluzione dei problemi collaborativi, sempre con il paziente al centro Se sei emozionato dall'opportunità di contribuire alla scienza pionieristica con un impatto diretto sui pazienti, applica ora e aiutaci a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo! Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Le dichiarazioni di cui sopra sono destinate a descrivere la natura generale e il livello di lavoro che vengono eseguiti dai dipendenti, e non devono essere interpretate come un elenco esaustivo di responsabilità, doveri e competenze richieste dal personale così classificato. Inoltre, essi non stabiliscono un contratto di lavoro e sono soggetti a modifiche a discrezione di Roche Products Lt
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity Our Clinical Development team has a fantastic opportunity for a (Lead) Clinical Director to join the neurology franchise to support late-stage clinical studies. This position offers a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in advancing the clinical development of Trontinemab , the first anti-amyloid antibody in trials to use brain-shuttle technology to treat Alzheimer’s disease. In this role you will:
• Supports the clinical development strategy for one or more late-stage (Phase II–III) trials in Alzheimer’s disease
• Drive clinical trial design and execution, ensuring scientific rigor, ethical integrity, and clear regulatory alignment
• Provide medical monitoring for ongoing studies and ensure patient safety and data quality
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including regulatory, clinical operations, safety, biomarkers, biostats, and early research
• Mentor and coach Clinical Scientists within the team
• Engage with external stakeholders such as advisory boards, key investigators, and health authorities
• Contribute to scientific publications and lead Roche’s presence in neurology through key conferences and community engagement
• Provide clinical input to earlier-stage programs to strengthen Roche’s neuroscience pipeline Who You Are You are a mission-driven medical leader who combines scientific expertise with strategic thinking. You bring:
• An MD or MD/PhD , with clinical training in neurology or dementia, preferably with deep expertise in Alzheimer’s disease
• Solid clinical research experience , including leadership in trial design and execution (preferably in the pharmaceutical industry)
• A solid understanding of the drug development lifecycle , from early-phase studies to post-marketing
• A proven track record of scientific impact , demonstrated through publications, presentations, or advisory contributions
• Exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence across a matrixed, cross-functional environment
• A passion for innovation and collaborative problem-solving , always with the patient at the centre If you're excited by the opportunity to contribute to pioneering science with a direct impact on patients, apply now and help us to do now what patients need next! Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Die Chance Unser Klinisches Entwicklungsteam hat eine fantastische Gelegenheit für einen (Lead-)Klinischen Direktor, sich der Neurologie-Franchise anzuschließen, um klinische Studien in der Spätphase zu unterstützen. Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, eine zentrale Rolle bei der Förderung der klinischen Entwicklung von Trontinemab zu spielen, der erste Anti-Amyloid-Antikörper in Versuchen, um Gehirn-Shuttle-Technologie zur Behandlung der Alzheimer-Krankheit zu verwenden. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Unterstützt die klinische Entwicklungsstrategie für eine oder mehrere Spätstadien (Phase II–III)-Studien bei der Alzheimer-Krankheit
• Führen Sie die klinische Studienplanung und -durchführung aus, um wissenschaftliche Strenge, ethische Integrität und klare regulatorische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten
• Bereitstellung einer medizinischen Überwachung für laufende Studien und Sicherstellung der Patientensicherheit und Datenqualität
• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, einschließlich regulatorischer, klinischer Operationen, Sicherheit, Biomarker, Biostaten und Frühforschung
• Mentor und Coach Klinische Wissenschaftler im Team
• Mit externen Akteuren wie Beratungsräten, zentralen Ermittlern und Gesundheitsbehörden vertraut zu machen
• Beitrag zu wissenschaftlichen Publikationen und führender Roche-Präsenz in der Neurologie durch wichtige Konferenzen und Gemeinschaftsengagements
• Bereitstellung von klinischen Input für frühere Programme zur Stärkung der Neurowissenschaften-Pipeline von Roche Wer bist du? Sie sind ein missionsgetriebener medizinischer Leiter, der wissenschaftliche Expertise mit strategischem Denken verbindet. Sie bringen:
• Ein MD oder MD/PhD mit klinischer Ausbildung in der Neurologie oder Demenz, vorzugsweise mit tiefem Know-how in der Alzheimer-Krankheit
• Solide klinische Forschungserfahrung, einschließlich Führung in der Versuchsplanung und -durchführung (vorzugsweise in der Pharmaindustrie)
• Ein solides Verständnis des Lebenszyklus für die Drogenentwicklung, von Studien in der Frühphase bis zur Nachvermarktung
• Erprobter Überblick über wissenschaftliche Auswirkungen, der durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen oder beratende Beiträge nachgewiesen wird
• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einer Matrix zu beeinflussen, funktionsübergreifende Umgebung
• Leidenschaft für Innovation und kollaborative Problemlösung, immer mit dem Patienten im Zentrum Wenn Sie von der Möglichkeit begeistert sind, mit direktem Einfluss auf die Patienten zur Pionier-Wissenschaft beizutragen, wenden Sie sich jetzt an und helfen uns, jetzt zu tun, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen! Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Welwyn. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Die hier dargelegten Aussagen sollen die allgemeine Art und das Ausmaß der Arbeit beschreiben, die von den Arbeitnehmern geleistet wird, und sind nicht als eine vollständige Liste von Verantwortlichkeiten, Pflichten und Fähigkeiten zu verstehen, die von den so klassifizierten Mitarbeitern benötigt werden. Darüber hinaus stellen sie keinen Arbeitsvertrag fest und können sich nach Ermessen von Roche Products Lt ändern
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opportunité Notre équipe de développement clinique a une excellente occasion pour un directeur clinique (lead) de se joindre à la franchise de neurologie pour soutenir les études cliniques en retard. Cette position offre une occasion unique de jouer un rôle central dans le développement clinique de Trontinemab , le premier anticorps anti-amyloïde dans les essais d'utilisation de la technologie d'essoufflement du cerveau pour traiter la maladie d'Alzheimer. Dans ce rôle, vous:
• Appuie la stratégie de développement clinique pour un ou plusieurs essais en phase tardive (phase II-III) sur la maladie d'Alzheimer
• Conduire la conception et l'exécution des essais cliniques, assurer la rigueur scientifique, l'intégrité éthique et un alignement réglementaire clair
• Assurer un suivi médical pour les études en cours et assurer la sécurité des patients et la qualité des données
• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles comprenant des activités réglementaires, cliniques, de sécurité, de biomarqueurs, de biostats et de recherche précoce
• Mentor et coach Scientifiques cliniques au sein de l'équipe
• Faire appel à des intervenants externes tels que les conseils consultatifs, les chercheurs clés et les autorités sanitaires
• Contribuer aux publications scientifiques et diriger la présence de Roches en neurologie grâce à des conférences clés et à l'engagement communautaire
• Apporter une contribution clinique à des programmes d'étapes antérieures visant à renforcer le pipeline des neurosciences de Roche Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un chef médical axé sur la mission qui combine l'expertise scientifique et la pensée stratégique. Vous apportez :
• Un MD ou un MD/PhD, avec une formation clinique en neurologie ou démence, de préférence avec une expertise profonde dans la maladie d'Alzheimer
• solide expérience de recherche clinique , y compris le leadership dans la conception et l'exécution des essais (de préférence dans l'industrie pharmaceutique)
• Une bonne compréhension du cycle de développement des médicaments, des études en phase initiale à la post-commercialisation
• Une expérience prouvée de l'impact scientifique, démontrée par des publications, des présentations ou des contributions consultatives
• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et capacité d'influencer un environnement matriciel et interfonctionnel
• Une passion pour l'innovation et la résolution collaborative de problèmes , toujours avec le patient au centre Si vous êtes excité par l'occasion de contribuer à la science pionnière avec un impact direct sur les patients, postulez maintenant et aidez-nous à faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin! Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Welwyn. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Ces énoncés visent à décrire la nature générale et le niveau de travail des employés et ne doivent pas être interprétés comme une liste exhaustive des responsabilités, des fonctions et des compétences requises du personnel ainsi classifié. En outre, ils n'établissent pas de contrat de travail et peuvent être modifiés à la discrétion de Roche Products Lt

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Data Center Network Engineer (d/f/m) Introduction At Roche, we believe that every voice matters, and we invite you to bring your unique perspective to our team. As a Senior Data Center Network Engineer, you will join a culture of technical excellence, architecting resilient, high-performance infrastructures that empower our global mission. You will act as a technical expert, leveraging advanced automation to solve critical business challenges and drive our digital evolution. The Opportunity:
• Architect Scalable Networks: Lead the end-to-end design and deployment of "first-time-right" network solutions, specifically focusing on Spine-Leaf topologies and L2/L3 fabrics.
• Drive Technical Leadership: Act as a Solution Architect for large initiatives, managing resource estimation, dependencies, and risk mitigation across technical teams.
• Implement Network as Code: Modernize operations by developing and maintaining Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, repeatable deployments.
• Master Complex Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose complex network incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
• Maximize System Reliability: Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) through advanced telemetry and streaming analytics to ensure "five-nines" availability.
• Influence Strategic Roadmaps: Translate technical roadmaps into business value for stakeholders and steer vendor product evaluations to align with long-term strategy.
• Lead Seamless Migrations: Oversee high-stakes brownfield-to-greenfield migrations with a focus on hitless cutovers and zero-downtime execution.
• Foster Innovation and Growth: Proactively refine fabric performance and mentor junior engineers, contributing to a workplace culture of continuous learning. Who you are:
• Experienced Architect: You bring deep mastery of Arista EOS and EVPN-VXLAN architectures, with a proven track record of designing large-scale fabrics.
• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and bring years of relevant industry experience; CCIE-level expertise is highly desirable.
• Automation Expert: You are proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically using Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines for network automation.
• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to translate complex system concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Resilient Problem Solver: You demonstrate expert-level troubleshooting skills and remain decisive in high-pressure, complex technical scenarios.
• Project Leader: You have significant experience leading technical teams through complex project dependencies and risk management.
• Visionary Engineer: You are a proactive learner who stays ahead of industry trends to maintain architectural excellence in modern fabric environments. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About the role Are you a tech enthusiast eager to bridge the gap between traditional Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our development squads. In this role, you will be part of the team designing cutting-edge solutions for the future Core Laboratory. Your mission will be to help the department explore and implement AI use cases, directly contributing to projects that impact patient lives while developing your skills in a professional, high-tech environment. Main responsibilities
• AI Integration: Participate in initiatives to explore, prototype, and implement AI-driven features within our software ecosystem.
• Development: Support the squad in developing software components using C# and .NET , while leveraging Python for AI-specific implementations.
• Modern Tooling: Work with cutting-edge developer tools like GitHub Copilot and contribute to integrations with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers .
• Collaboration: Work within an Agile squad, participating in ceremonies (Daily, Sprint Planning) and contributing to the team's goals.
• Quality: Produce clean, maintainable code and participate in testing activities to ensure the reliability of our medical instrumentation software. How would your day-to-day look like? You will start your day synced with your squad, discussing progress and tackling challenges. Under the guidance of an assigned mentor , you will transition from your initial onboarding to making real contributions to our codebase. You will spend part of your time investigating how AI can optimize our projects and the other part implementing those solutions within our C#/.NET architecture. It is a balance of autonomous learning, creative exploration of AI, and structured teamwork. This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Logistics Engineer / Project Manager leads the technical evolution and modernization of our 10,000m2 self-operated distribution center. This role is the strategic architect responsible for transforming a complex, legacy-automated environment into a flexible, next-generation fulfillment hub using AMR and advanced robotics. You will bridge the gap between physical hardware and digital systems, managing the transition from a legacy software stack (WMS/WCS/MFC) to a modern SAP eWM environment. Reporting directly to the Head of Supply Chain, you will own the technical roadmap, from ROI analysis and vendor selection participation to on-site project execution lead, ensuring our automation strategy aligns with future business scalability. Your Main Responsibilities
• Creation of holistic view of warehouse operations in terms of automation technology, system landscape and warehouse operator needs. Full understanding & documentation of current bottlenecks in terms of throughput and storage capacity. Create suitable measurements (KPIs) where needed in order to translate requirements and current capacities.
• Automation Transformation & Strategy: Assess and lead the transition from rigid legacy automation to flexible technologies (AMRs, Humanoids, etc.) where required. Take full stock of existing hardware capabilities and map them against future business requirements and market-leading solutions.
• Systems Architecture & Integration: Fully master the current system landscape (WMS, WCS, MFC). Design the integration strategy to link the physical world with the digital world, acting as the lead for the upcoming SAP eWM implementation.
• Financial Stewardship & ROI: Drive rigorous ROI analysis for all automation projects collaborating with finance and site management. Have clear visibility for throughput, storage density, and FTE optimization.
• Material Flow & Process Optimization: Analyze and redesign internal material flows to eliminate bottlenecks. Use data-driven insights to optimize picking strategies, replenishment cycles, and packing efficiency. Processes are redesigned considering sustainability, quality and safety aspects.
• Project Governance: Act as the on-site Project Lead for major technical and system shifts. Manage the end-to-end lifecycle—from concept and vendor assessment to commissioning and structured handover—ensuring minimal disruption to active operations. Interact with global and local project teams.
• Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner with site management to assess new vendors and technologies. Navigate the complex relationship between legacy hardware providers and modern robotics OEMs, ensuring system interoperability.
• Technical Communication: Adapt complex technical concepts for different audiences (“zoom in & out”). Clearly articulate the "why" behind automation shifts to senior leadership while providing granular technical direction to on-site maintenance and IT teams.
• Performance Tracking: Define and monitor KPIs for automated systems, including uptime, cycle times, and error rates. Lead corrective actions when performance gaps occur in the automated flow. Who You Are
• An Analytical Problem Solver: You enjoy the challenge of making legacy systems perform in a modern context. You take ambiguity and uncertainty as an opportunity to bring up proposals.
• A Strategic Executor: You can design a 3-year automation roadmap but are equally willing to be on the warehouse floor during a "Go-Live" to troubleshoot o

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As Team Lead in Network Security Edge Defense you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible. Description of the area The Edge Defense team belongs to the Network Security organization, a cornerstone of Information Security. We provide the technologies and services that protect the entire network against IT Security incidents and digital threats. The core stack of this team includes:
• Perimeter Defense: Network Firewalls and DDoS Mitigation
• Modern Architecture: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) services
• Cloud Network Security in AWS, Azure, GCP ​ Job Responsibilities
• Strategic Edge Vision & Modern Architecture: Define the digital roadmap for Perimeter Defense (Firewalls, DDoS) and Modern Architecture (Zero Trust) across the most external facing network segments, both on-premise and in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Operational Excellence & Automation: Drive an "Automation First" mindset for external network security, leveraging APIs and scripting to replace manual work with scalable security code ("Shift Left").
• Cloud-Native Security: Lead the security strategy for the complex multi-cloud footprint (AWS, Azure, GCP), focusing on securing the perimeter and network edge in the cloud.
• Lifecycle Management & Compliance: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Edge Defense technologies, from discovery to global scale, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, excluding GxP for non-manufacturing focus).
• Business Translation: Connect technical security performance of the external network to broader business outcomes, ensuring security is an accelerator for R&D and other non-manufacturing environments.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Deeply understand customer and business needs to shape the strategic direction and digital roadmap for the Edge Defense product, focusing on delivering high-value outcomes. Who You Are Experience
• 5+ years of experience in Information Security is an asset
• 3+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry is an asset
• 5+ years of experience in people leadership, product/service management, program management or a similar role, with a proven track record of building high performing teams ​ Education
• Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, or a related Engineering field or equivalent experience
• Professional Information Security certifications are a plus (e.g. CISSP, CISM) ​ Technical Skills
• Proven background and solid foundation in Information Security specifically in Network Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet), NAC (e.g., Cisco ISE), and ZTNA solutions
• Experience in multi-cloud environments is a plus
• Operational Excellence: Strong understanding of ITIL frameworks (Incident, Change, and Problem Management) and Continuous Improvement methodologies
• Automation

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein neues Team Als Mitglied des PDG Country Study Start-Up Teams liegt dein Hauptaugenmerk darauf, einen reibungslosen und hocheffizienten Studienstart sicherzustellen, um so die Bereitstellung klinischer Studien für Patient:innen zu unterstützen. Du bringst klinische Studien innovativ auf den Weg: Du deckst den spezifischen Bedarf in der Start-up-Phase über verschiedene Therapiegebiete hinweg und garantierst einen reibungslosen Ablauf für Patient:innen und Prüfzentren. In dieser Schlüsselrolle vernetzt du dich intensiv mit lokalen und globalen Teams sowie unseren CRO Partnern (Auftragsforschungsinstituten). Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle konzentrierst du dich auf die effiziente und rechtskonforme Initiierung von Roche-gesponserten klinischen Studien. Du entwickelst effektive Start-up-Strategien, steuerst die operativen Abläufe und treibst Prozessverbesserungen auf Länder- und Zentren-Ebene voran – immer unter Einhaltung aller regulatorischen Vorgaben.Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:
• Strategische Leitung: Du leitest Teams bei der strategischen Planung der operativen Durchführung des Studienstarts, wobei Du die Verantwortung für Risikomanagement, regulatorische Compliance sowie die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern trägst.
• Operative Exzellenz: Du managst die Start-up-Aktivitäten und stellst eine termingerechte Aktivierung der Prüfzentren sowie die regulatorische Compliance sicher. Du verantwortest und steuerst den gesamten Budget- und Vertragsprozess – von der Erstellung der Budgets über die Vertragsverhandlung und Versicherungsdokumente bis hin zur systemseitigen Datenpflege, um die finanzielle und rechtliche Konformität sowie eine präzise Planung zu gewährleisten.
• Globale Ausrichtung: Du arbeitest mit dem globalen Studienteam zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Zeitpläne eingehalten werden und managst Amendments über den gesamten Studienzyklus hinweg.
• Innovation & Standardisierung: Du identifizierst Chancen zur Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung und arbeitest mit regionalen sowie globalen Partnern zusammen, um Systeme zu harmonisieren und Zeitpläne zu optimieren.
• Behördenkommunikation: Du stehst im Austausch mit Behörden und Institutionen (z. B. Ethikkommissionen und Gesundheitsbehörden), um Richtlinien und Praktiken bei klinischen Studien aufeinander abzustimmen. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Für die Rolle als Study Start Up Lead (SSUL) (m/w/d) bringst du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (MD, PhD, Master oder Bachelor) in den Life Sciences oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Ein weiterführender Hochschulabschluss (Postgraduate/Master) ist dabei sehr wünschenswert. Folgende Punkte runden dein Profil ab:
• Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung im Start-up von klinischen Studien, in regulatorischen Einreichungsprozessen sowie in der cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit.
• Fachwissen: Du besitzt ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis der ICH-GCP-Leitlinien, der EU-CTR sowie der lokalen regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen und hast bereits Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Dienstleistern und CROs gesammelt.
• Methoden & IT: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit klinischen Systemen (z. B. Veeva Vault, CTIS, RIM) und zeichnest dich durch starke organisatorische, analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten aus.
• Mindset: Du bringst eine kollaborative und adaptive Denkweise mit. Es gelingt dir, auch in komplexen, matrixorganisierten und globalen Teams den Überblick zu be

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Salem , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Salem territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a Marketing Lead who will report to the Marketing and Customer Engagement Head and be responsible for the Lung portfolio. As a Marketing Lead, your mission is to create value through meaningful benefits for patients, the business, external stakeholders, and health systems. By working with patient journey partners (PJPs) and healthcare system partners (HSPs), and other cross-functional enablers, value can be added in various ways, such as product innovation, treatment pathway design, a new patient service, technologies/capabilities that improve operational efficiency, global knowledge sharing, or external collaboration. Responsibilities:
• Develop specific marketing strategies for therapeutic areas within the organization, working together cross-functionally with Medical and Access Leads.
• Build and implement an effective plan for Omnichannel engagement via leveraging different channels and tools. Focus on building Omnichannel capabilities internally and externally to provide meaningful customer experiences that add value to patients, collaborating closely with the Digital team.
• Manage P&L to ensure resources are utilized effectively and in accordance with the business outcomes
• Ensure continuous sales and logistics forecasting, working closely with the PJPs and Finance team.
• Interpret and translate scientific data into commercial implications, analyze data, and make strategic recommendations.
• In case of new launches, build and propose a suitable Go-to-Market Strategy via defining pricing, distribution channels, and sales strategies, working with Access and Launch Excellence Leads.
• Provide marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches and monitor budget and expenditures.
• Participate in national and international congresses, scientific meetings, and global implementation/update meetings to keep the knowledge updated for commercialization strategies.
• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, act as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and contribute to creating value to the patient journey through supporting and enabling the PJPs in implementing successful projects for the ecosystem in line with Roche Code of Conduct and principles.
• Working beyond the local organization, align and collaborate with broader networks, provide support to global networks and other affiliates, and be accountable for ensuring collaboration with the networks and local leads to identify new opportunities, initiatives, and solutions to answer stakeholder needs and to drive value for the patients.
• Prepare and update the training materials and provide internal education and training programs to the customer engagement teams and other lead roles in the affiliate when necessary.
• Generate mar-com strategies working together with the communication department. Support the PJPs in setting the Therapeutic Area or other communication strategy and creation/adaptation of local Therapeutic Area messages, materials, and communication content for digital platforms. Mindset and Behaviours:
• We Before Me Mindset: Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand)
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take risks and experiment, and contribute to the learning cycle by sharing knowledge with others inside and outside Roche
• System thinker, self-managed and self-directed - altru

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Con i suoi circa 1.500 dipendenti (PTM), il centro di produzione Kaiseraugst garantisce una cura completa dei pazienti al massimo livello qualitativo. Come il più grande e moderno centro di confezionamento di Roche, Kaiseraugst serve più di 120 paesi e si trova in tutto il mondo per standard eccellenti nella produzione farmaceutica. La possibilità
• Leader leader e responsabilità complessiva per circa 40 dipendenti (compreso il contraente) nonché coaching e sviluppo dei dipendenti
• Responsabilità per il Facility Excellence Team con Asset Excellence Manager, Facility Excellence Manager e il ruolo di Partnering Systems Change Specialist; lo Swisslog Maintenance Team e il MRP per il Manufacturing Support Head
• Garantire la pianificazione e il controllo delle risorse predittive secondo SQDEC (Safety / Quality / Delivery / Engagement / Cost) come parte del team di gestione dei Servizi di Logistica Centrale
• Applicazione dei metodi LEAN per il miglioramento continuo e l'utilizzo della gestione visiva per il controllo dei processi tramite KPI;
• Responsabilità per la pianificazione degli investimenti logistici per CLS, coordinamento della roadmap logistica e configurazione logistica per nuovi prodotti farmaceutici presso il sito Kaiseraugst
• Garantire e privilegiare gli adeguamenti del sistema in coordinamento con gli obiettivi locali e globali e garantire tutti i requisiti GMP, sicurezza operativa, ambiente e processo
• PMI per progetti di logistica di siti e di rete, con la massima responsabilità per l'attuazione di progetti CAPEX e altri investimenti per sviluppare ulteriormente l'infrastruttura logistica
• Automation Business Owner of Logistics Plants in Three Different Buildings in Kaiseraugst and Responsibility for the Implementation of Infrastructure and Improvement Projects Considerando i requisiti logistici delle unità di produzione e dell'organizzazione globale della catena di approvvigionamento Chi sei
• Il pensiero positivo, la personalità integree e auto-riflettente con passione per la leadership e una pronunciata impostazione “Can-Do”
• Capacità di rafforzare la fiducia nel team attraverso la trasparenza, il trasferimento di responsabilità e l'apertura Speak-up e la cultura degli errori
• Il pensiero imprenditoriale in vista del processo complessivo (fine alla fine), così come la capacità di fornire prestazioni costantemente elevate in un ambiente in continua evoluzione
• Formazione professionale superiore, studio o master

En tant que centre d'emballage le plus grand et le plus moderne de Roche, Kaiseraugst dessert plus de 120 pays et est synonyme d'excellentes normes dans la production pharmaceutique. La possibilité
• Leader principal et responsabilité globale pour une quarantaine d'employés (y compris l'entrepreneur) ainsi que coaching et perfectionnement des employés
• Responsabilité de l'équipe d'excellence de l'installation avec les gestionnaires d'excellence de l'actif, les gestionnaires d'excellence de l'installation et le rôle de spécialiste du changement des systèmes de partenariat; l'équipe de maintenance de Swisslog et le MRP au responsable du soutien à la fabrication
• Assurer la planification et le contrôle prédictifs des ressources selon SQDEC (Sécurité / Qualité / Livraison / Engagement / Coût) dans le cadre de l'équipe de gestion des Services centraux de logistique
• Application de méthodes LEAN pour l'amélioration continue et l'utilisation de la gestion visuelle pour le contrôle des processus à l'aide des KPI;
• Responsable de la planification des investissements logistiques pour le CLS, de la coordination de la feuille de route logistique et de la configuration logistique des nouveaux produits pharmaceutiques sur le site de Kaiseraugst
• Assurer et hiérarchiser les ajustements des systèmes en coordination avec les objectifs locaux et mondiaux et garantir toutes les exigences en matière de BPF, de sécurité opérationnelle, d'environnement et de processus;
• PME pour les projets de logistique de site et de réseau dont la responsabilité principale est la mise en œuvre des projets CAPEX et d'autres investissements visant à développer l'infrastructure logistique

• La pensée positive, l'ingéniosité et la personnalité auto-réfléchissante avec passion pour le leadership et un cadre prononcé axé sur la solution
• Capacité à renforcer la confiance dans l'équipe par la transparence, le transfert de responsabilité et la culture ouverte de la parole et de l'erreur
• La réflexion entrepreneuriale en vue du processus global (fin à fin), ainsi que la capacité à fournir des performances constamment élevées dans un environnement en constante évolution
• Formation professionnelle supérieure, études ou maîtrise
• Expérience de leadership pluriannuelle, idéalement dans l'environnement pharmaceutique et/ou logistique
• Expérience des audits et inspections des BPF par les autorités sanitaires
• Utilisation pratique de la technologie, affinité élevée et très bonnes compétences en communication en allemand et en anglais en paroles et en écriture Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir notre ambition élevée, afin de pouvoir offrir une solution de santé qui change la vie

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe cybersecurity plays a critical role in protecting innovation, safeguarding patient trust, and enabling healthcare transformation globally. As part of our Informatics organization, you will contribute to strengthening Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities in a highly collaborative, global, and complex environment. Your Opportunity As a Cybersecurity Analyst within the Monitoring & Incident Response team, you will lead and support strategic cybersecurity initiatives while partnering with global stakeholders across multiple business and technology domains. You will help drive security best practices, contribute to complex security programs, and support the continuous evolution of Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities. In this role, you will:
• Lead and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives and strategic programs across global and cross-functional environments
• Provide expert guidance and advisory support on complex cybersecurity challenges, incident response activities, and security-related risk considerations
• Partner with stakeholders across Informatics and business teams to align cybersecurity priorities with organizational objectives
• Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of security processes, standards, and best practices
• Analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and recommend effective and scalable security solutions
• Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive alignment, decision-making, and execution across initiatives
• Mentor and support team members while contributing to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence
• Stay informed on industry trends, emerging threats, and evolving cybersecurity practices to help strengthen Roche’s overall security posture Who you are You are a strategic and collaborative cybersecurity professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments, influencing stakeholders, and balancing technical depth with business impact. You are able to work effectively across global teams while bringing a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset. You bring:
• A Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university
• At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, incident response, or related cybersecurity domains within complex enterprise environments
• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and global teams in matrix organizations
• Good understanding of cybersecurity principles, security frameworks, risk management, and enterprise security practices
• The ability to analyze complex technical and business problems and translate them into actionable solutions
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships
• Experience contributing to large-scale initiatives, process improvements, or transformation programs within cybersecurity or technology organizations
• A continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging technologies, cybersecurity trends, and innovation Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Dein neues Team Du verstärkst unseren Bereich Vertrieb Service in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg:innen aus dem Verkauf und anderen Vertriebseinheiten verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine langfristige Kundenbindung sicherzustellen und den Verkauf unserer Roche-Systeme aktiv zu unterstützen. Dabei verantworten wir den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice unter anderem für Analysensysteme und Reagenzien der Molekularen/Gewebediagnostik und IT-Lösungen. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich Als Junior Systembetreuer (m/w/d) bist du das Gesicht von Roche vor Ort. Du stellst die Verfügbarkeit und Sicherheit unserer Roche-Standardgeräte sicher und trägst so maßgeblich zur Kundenzufriedenheit bei. Deine Aufgaben erledigst du sowohl im direkten Kundenkontakt als auch in enger Abstimmung mit deinem Team:
• Du führst fachgerechte technische Fehlerdiagnosen durch und reparierst Roche-Standardgeräte – meist vor Ort beim Kunden, teilweise auch per Remote-Support. Dabei übernimmst du auch die sorgfältige Dokumentation im CRM-System, um nachhaltige Problemlösungen sicherzustellen und die Fakturierung.
• Du bist verantwortlich für die Installation neuer Systeme, führst Testläufe durch und übergibst die Geräte betriebsbereit an den Kunden.
• Du erledigst Wartungen und Modifikationen termingerecht und unter Berücksichtigung wirtschaftlicher Aspekte, basierend auf Serviceverträgen oder Einzelaufträgen.
• Als technischer Ansprechpartner vor Ort erkennst du die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden frühzeitig. Du weist Kunden technisch ein, berätst zu Serviceverträgen oder präventiven Maßnahmen und arbeitest eng mit dem Vertrieb zusammen, um Verkaufschancen für Systemgeschäfte oder Dienstleistungen zu identifizieren.
• Du organisierst deine Einsätze in der Region effizient und eigenverantwortlich. Um die kontinuierliche Versorgung der Patienten sicherzustellen Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Neben einer erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Ausbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in oder ein Studium (z.B. FH) in Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung bringst Du idealerweise erste praktische Berufserfahrung (z.B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeit oder eine technische Ausbildung) im Umgang mit komplexen technischen Systemen mit. Folgende Punkte runden Dein Profil ab:
• Aufgrund der regionalen Einsatzplanung und der Fahrzeiten lebst Du im idealerweise in der Region Augsburg/Landsberg a. Lech. Zudem besitzt du einen gültigen Führerschein und bringst eine hohe Reisebereitschaft mit, um unsere Kund:innen in der Region zu betreuen.
• Du bringst Erfahrung im Umgang mit technischen Systemen mit, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hydraulik, Elektronik und Messtechnik.
• Du besitzt Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Steuerungs- und Betriebssoftware, verstehst die IT-Anbindung moderner IT-Anbindungen und hast idealerweise chemisches Basiswissen.
• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt gute fach- und allgemeinsprachliche Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Niveau B1/B2).
• Du arbeitest eigenständig, ergebnisorientiert nach Zielvorgaben und bringst eine hohe Kundenorientierung mit. Als Teil eines deutschlandweiten Teams schätzt du den kollegialen Austausch und bist bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Pharma India is a fully fledged Roche Country Organization headed by a General Manager, operating across India in a unique cluster-based operating model. This fit-for-purpose model is aligned to realize the huge potential in India that is waiting to be unlocked. Roche India envisions a future role to truly serve patients in India and help uplift and transform the health system. Roche prides itself on bringing first-in-class/ best-in-class products to the market, and India is one of the most important markets to bring its gold-standard portfolio to. Roche India is an organization with just over 300 employees and has yearly sales of approximately CHF 160 million with an aspiration to serve 10x the number of patients by 2035. Every employee at Roche India strives to achieve a triple win (for patients, for the health system, and for Roche) and truly lives up to the ethos of “Doing Now What Patients Need Next”. Roche India is part of Roche Group with more than 100,000 employees across the globe dedicated to advanced science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products globally. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. As the People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner for Roche Pharma India, you will: Act as the vital catalyst, rallying all other P&C chapters around the business priorities and P&C strategy. While this is an individual contributor role, it requires the mindset of a strong and highly influential business leader and entrepreneur. You will thrive by accomplishing things through others and living agility in all its facets. Key Responsibilities
• Influence & Trust: You must have the ability to influence with courageous authenticity, build trust with individuals at all levels, and challenge the status quo when appropriate without relying on formal reporting lines.
• Coaching: You will act as a trusted strategic partner, a credible activist, and a coach to creative leadership and the country leadership team. You will engage in honest, authentic, and open dialogue at all levels to unlock the greatness in our people and organization.
• Strategic Alignment: You will translate business strategy into P&C strategies for the leadership areas and drive fit-for-purpose implementation and pull-through.
• Organizational Transformation: You will be a key enabler of organizational transformation, advancing organizational design and effectiveness, including driving shifts in mindset, behaviors, and ways of working.
• Data-Driven Culture: You will focus on data-driven insights to inform your actions and the overall P&C strategy, aiming to create a high-performance, integrity-driven culture where employees can thrive. Who You Are
• Experienced Professional: You bring 10+ years of broad, progressive HR management or consulting experience in international business environments, recognized for best-in-class HR practices.
• Handles complexity well, can handle multiple tasks and initiatives at the same time - can prioritise and organise your own and the P&C team's time and energy into the most important topics in service of our outcomes. You are someone who can stay calm in chaos and approach charged topics with maturity and objectivity, and propose

The Position The Opportunity Are you a visionary leader passionate about shaping the future of Patient Safety? In this pivotal role, you will lead and manage the PV Regional Center, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacovigilance (PV) and Device Vigilance activities across the Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA) region. You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment. Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.
• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.
• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.
• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.
• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.
• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.
• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched. Who You Are You are a strategic thinker and a servant leader who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape and are motivated by the opportunity to lead large-scale operational changes that have a real impact on patient lives.
• You hold a Health Care Professional Degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent professional experience).
• You bring 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience , with at least 5 years in significant PV leadership roles.
• You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.
• You are a VACC leader , committed to inclusive behaviors and developing high-performing, diverse teams.
• You possess deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).
• You are an exceptional communicator , able to influence stakeholders and convey complex information clearly in English.

You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment. Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.
• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.
• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.
• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.
• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.
• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.
• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched. • You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.
