descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Stell Dir vor, Du bist der entscheidende Kompass, der uns hilft, die Talente von morgen heute schon zu finden. Bei Roche geht es nicht nur darum, Positionen zu besetzen – es geht darum, die Talente aus unterschiedlichen Professionen für unsere Vision zu gewinnen: Das Leben von Patient:innen weltweit nachhaltig zu verbessern. Als Talent Acquisition Partner:in (“TAP”) bist Du kein Recruiter im klassischen Sinne; Du bist strategische:r Berater:in, Data-Enthusiast:in und Botschafter:in in einem. Du gestaltest die Transformation unserer Arbeitswelt aktiv mit und stellst sicher, dass wir genau die Future Skills an Bord holen, die wir für die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft benötigen. Dein neues Team: Wir verstehen uns als Sparringpartner auf Augenhöhe für das Business und agieren als eingespieltes Team, das Wissen teilt und gemeinsam wächst. Bei uns triffst Du auf Expert:innen, die moderne Recruiting-Ansätze leben und Raum für neue Ideen bieten. Du wirst Teil des oneREC Germany Teams bestehend aus mehr als 40 TAPs aufgeteilt auf unsere deutschen Standorte in Mannheim, Grenzach und Penzberg, sowie unsere Kolleg:innen in Budapest und berichtest an unsere REC Lead für R&D, Commercial, Group Functions & New Business. Verantwortlichkeiten | Deine strategische Rolle
• Strategic Partner & Marktexpertise: Du bist der vertrauensvolle Strategic Partner des Business und verantwortest die Talentstrategie Deiner Fachbereiche von der Bedarfsanalyse bis zur Vertragsverhandlung.
• Gestalter der Transformation: Du begleitest die Transformation der Organisation, indem Du Führungskräfte proaktiv zu Future Skills und Mindset-Themen berätst und die "Must-haves" kritisch hinterfragst.
• Datenbasierte Talentakquise: Als Data-Enthusiast:in identifizierst Du Top-Talente proaktiv durch den Einsatz modernster Sourcing-Tools und KI-gestützter Ansätze, um unsere Entscheidungen fundiert zu treffen.
• Excellence in Candidate Experience: Du sorgst für Candidate Experience Excellence und begleitest Bewerber:innen wertschätzend bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss, wobei Du stets faire und attraktive Angebote aushandelst.
• Innovationsmotor & Agile Workflows: Du treibst innovative Projekte voran. Dein Fokus liegt auf der Reduktion von Komplexität und der Gestaltung agiler, schlanker Workflows durch die Implementierung neuester Recruiting-Trends. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du bist eine:r passionierte:r TAP — für Dich ist diese Rolle eine Berufung, nicht nur der nächste Karriereschritt. Du bringst Erfahrung aus einer modernen, agilen TA-Organisation mit. Dein Talent und Dein Mindset sind uns dabei wichtiger als jahrelange Berufserfahrung.
• Du hast bereits aktiv in den strategischen Säulen der Talentakquise gearbeitet: Alignment, proaktives Sourcing und Data-Driven Decisions.
• Du bist versiert im Umgang mit modernen Technologien (z. B. Workday, Phenom People, AI-Chatbots) und nutzt Künstliche Intelligenz als strategischen Hebel.
• Du verbindest Daten und Empathie meisterhaft: Du triffst Entscheidungen fundiert, verlierst dabei aber nie den Menschen aus dem Blick.
• Du verfügst über, idealerweise profunde, Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht und hast Berührungspunkte mit organisationalen Veränderungsprozessen und der Zusammenarbeit mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen.
• Durch regelmäßige Anwesenheit vor Ort in Penzberg arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleg:innen und Stakeholdern zusammen und positionierst Dich so als strategischer Partner
• Du kommunizierst stark und klar auf Deutsch und

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Missions En tant que Spécialiste IT et Workflow (Territoire Ouest), rattaché(e) à un Responsable Territorial des Equipes Services, vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur des missions essentielles pour garantir l'autonomie et la satisfaction de nos clients pour une large gamme de nos solutions de laboratoire. Localisation idéale: Poitiers / La Rochelle / Bordeaux Vos principales responsabilités
• Installer nos solutions informatiques et de workflow et former les clients à l’utilisation du Middleware.
• Assurer le suivi et l’amélioration continue des solutions Roche.
• Apporter votre expertise en avant-vente si nécessaire.
• Réaliser la préparation et la mise à jour des installations Middleware Roche.
• Installer les nouvelles connexions automates validées.
• Installer les e-solutions IT et établir le paramétrage péri-analytique (Pré et post).
• Assurer un reporting exact de votre activité et maîtriser les règles et procédures Qualité Sécurité Environnement impactant votre domaine. Quoi vous êtes:
• Formation niveau Bac +3 ou équivalent en spécialisation informatique et réseaux.
• Double compétence « biologie / informatique médicale » ou une expérience professionnelle dans l’environnement du laboratoire d’analyses médicales ou d’un éditeur de logiciel SIL (Système Informatique de Laboratoire), Middleware, Application médicale est un atout.
• Capacité à installer et configurer les différents composants (systèmes d’exploitation, réseaux, applicatif) des infrastructures informatiques.
• Anglais professionnel
• Permis B (mobilité territoriale indispensable).
• Sens du résultat, de l'écoute, goût du challenge et sens des responsabilités. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Scientist - Reagent Health and Performance/Surveillance Department Summary This is a role in Reagent Health and Performance/Surveillance in the Oncology Assay Development organization. Responsible for reagent product monitoring and risk based testing, including real time stability testing to support expiration dating of Ventana reagents. Work closely across Ventana functions, including: Life Cycle, Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, and Global Organizations. Individual Contributor role: This individual will support commercialization of new products and post-launch monitoring of on-market products, risk evaluation of the on market portfolio, designing fit for purpose testing to assess product risks, drive failure investigations. This role is based in Tucson, AZ, on site . The Opportunity
• Research & Innovation: Executes R&D activities to develop new products or processes, identifying technical challenges and creating potentially patentable components.
• Project Execution: Plans and conducts experiments using advanced scientific knowledge and DOE (Design of Experiments) to meet defined project goals.
• Data Analysis & Improvement: Evaluates experimental results to form conclusions, implementing process improvements and ensuring "Quality First Time" standards.
• Collaboration & Communication: Participates in cross-functional teams, shares expertise with colleagues, and delivers technical presentations to various stakeholders.
• Strategic Support: Contributes to project planning and experimental design under the guidance of senior leadership while suggesting ways to optimize workflows. Who You Are (Required)
• Ph.D. in Biology or related field or
• Master's Degree in Biology or related field + 3 years related experience or
• Bachelor's Degree in Biology or related field + 8 years related experience. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Demonstrates potential for technical proficiency, scientific creativity, collaboration with others and independent thought.
• Strong understanding of scientific principles and concepts.
• Applies advanced technical writing skills to produce reports and documents. Relocation benefits are not offered for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position based on Arizona is 82 700,00 - 153 700,00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Overview Are you interested in how software R&D organizations evolve to integrate AI and stay ahead in a changing technological landscape? We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented R&D AI Transformation Intern to join our strategy team. You won't just be fetching coffee; you’ll be behind the scenes of major structural, cultural, and digital shifts as we embed AI into our engineering DNA, helping us bridge the gap between "traditional development" and "AI-augmented innovation." Key Responsibilities
• Data Analysis & Insights: Gather and analyze R&D performance metrics and AI tool adoption rates to identify bottlenecks and track the progress of ongoing AI transformation initiatives.
• Stakeholder Communication: Assist in drafting internal memos, newsletters, and presentation decks that translate complex AI strategies and LLM implementations into "human" language for our developers and engineers.
• Project Management Support: Maintain project timelines (Gantt charts) and follow up on action items from cross-functional workshops focused on AI integration and automated workflows.
• Research: Conduct competitive benchmarking and research best practices in AI-assisted coding, machine learning operations (MLOps), and organizational design for AI-first R&D teams.
• Workshop Facilitation: Help organize and document brainstorming sessions aimed at improving software delivery pipelines through AI and boosting developer engagement with new intelligent tools. What We’re Looking For
• Curiosity: A genuine interest in the intersection of software business strategy, AI ethics, and engineering culture.
• Communication: The ability to explain a complex technical AI concept or strategic shift simply and clearly.
• Agility: Comfort with ambiguity—navigating the rapid evolution of AI in R&D is rarely a straight line!
• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data visualization) and PowerPoint (storytelling), with an interest in exploring AI productivity tools.
• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Why Join Us? This isn't your typical administrative internship. You will gain a "bird's-eye view" of how a software R&D organization operates at scale and learn the methodologies used to drive meaningful change in the age of AI. We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented R&D AI Transformation Intern to join our strategy team. You won't just be fetching coffee; you’ll be behind the scenes of major structural, cultural, and digital shifts as we embed AI into our engineering DNA, helping us bridge the gap between "traditional development" and "AI-augmented innovation." Key Responsibilities
• Data Analysis & Insights: Gather and analyze R&D performance metrics and AI tool adoption rates to identify bottlenecks and track the progress of ongoing AI transformation initiatives.
• Stakeholder Communication: Assist in drafting internal memos, newsletters, and presentation decks that translate complex AI strategies and LLM implementations into "human" language for our developers and engineers.
• Project Management Support: Maintain project timelines (Gantt charts) and follow up on action items from cross-functional workshops focused on AI integration and automated workflows.
• Research: Conduct competitive benchmarking and research best practices in AI-assisted coding, machine learning operations (MLOps), and organizational design for AI-first R&D teams.
• Workshop Facilitation: Help organize and document brainstorming sessions aimed at improving software delivery pipelines through AI and boosting developer engagement with new intelligent tools. What We’re Looking For
• Curiosity: A genuine interest in the intersection of software business strategy, AI ethics, and engineering culture.
• Communication: The ability to explain a complex technical AI concept or strategic shift simply and clearly.
• Agility: Comfort with ambiguity—navigating the rapid evolution of AI in R&D is rarely a straight line!
• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data visualization) and PowerPoint (storytelling), with an interest in exploring AI productivity tools.
• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Why Join Us? • 월별/분기별 및 연간 매출 목표 달성
• 신규 장비 설치
• 기존 장비에 신규 제품 추가 4. 기술 지원

• 체외진단(IVD)에 대한 이해 및 지식 보유 선호
• 고객지향적 사고 및 커뮤니케이션 능력
• 비지니스 영어 구사 능력 Submission 자유 양식의 국/영문 이력서 및 국/영문 자기소개서 (하나의 MS Word 혹은 PDF 파일로 제출) ※ 이력서 상단에 반드시 현재 연봉과 희망 연봉을 표기하시기 바랍니다. 누락 시 이력서가 검토되지 않습니다. ※ 이력서 내 이메일 주소와 서류전형 지원 사이트의 입력하시는 이메일 주소를 반드시 동일하게 작성해주시기 바랍니다. ※ 국가보훈대상 및 장애인은 관련 서류 제출시 관련 법규에 의거 우대합니다. ※ 이력서에 개인민감정보 (신체적 조건, 출신 지역, 혼인 여부, 가족관계 등)는 기재하지 말아주십시오. ※ 입사 지원 서류에 허위 사실이 발견될 경우, 채용 확정 이후 라도 채용이 취소될 수 있습니다. title: Especialista de planeación de la demanda

titleByLocale.it: Especialista de planeación de la demanda
titleByLocale.de: Especialista de planeación de la demanda
titleByLocale.fr: Especialista de planeación de la demanda

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como parte de la cadena de suministro local de Roche Diagnostics, el especialista, la planificación y optimización de la cadena de suministro desempeña un papel importante en la entrega al garantizar a nuestros clientes niveles superiores de disponibilidad de productos y, al mismo tiempo, cumplir con los objetivos financieros de Roche (inventario, niveles de cancelación y costos de logística). Entiende los requisitos del cliente dentro de un entorno de mercado en constante cambio y, en consecuencia, crea o redefine procesos mediante la incorporación de soluciones innovadoras de cadena de suministro, con el fin de ofrecer una ventaja competitiva y ejecutar los diversos planes de acción con base en los requerimientos comerciales y de mercadotecnia así como en las políticas locales y globales con el objetivo de facilitar el abastecimiento del producto y la toma de decisiones a la coordinación y áreas relacionadas de las divisiones Diagnóstica. (IVD) Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Proporcionar el estimado de la demanda de los reactivos y consumibles planeados por logística en conjunto con el área comercial y mercadotecnia, analizando los reportes estadísticos previos del comportamiento de ventas.
• Crear el forecast para el área comercial y mercadotecnia previamente planeado en meses anteriores, analizando mensualmente reportes DP Light forecast accuracy por producto
• Actualizar el ERP (SAP) Maestro de Materiales módulo de planificación (MPS/MRP), analizando cada 4 o 6 meses los reportes para los productos mediante DP Light, revisando los atributos de ABC code, reorder point, safety stock, rounding value, quantity per tray.
• Ejecutar las estrategias de abastecimiento realizadas por el área, elaborando la requisición de compra y dando seguimiento al embarque con el área de compras hasta su llegada al almacén.
• Programar la Demanda de Instrumentos de acuerdo al programa anual de Instrument Placement, así como la coordinación de rutas de entrega a nivel nacional a usuarios finales.
• Liderar la gestión de la demanda de estándares, introducción/salida, lanzamientos/discontinuaciones, instalaciones/desinstalaciones.
• Optimizar la disponibilidad del producto (parte del cálculo de OTIF), la precisión de las previsiones, el inventario y los niveles de cancelación.
• Asegurar una información constante y transparente flujo entre las áreas comerciales locales y la cadena de suministro global
• Investiga continuamente las tendencias y las causas raíz de los problemas de suministro por área comercial, centro de ganancias y nivel de producto.
• Identifica soluciones, brinda recomendaciones e inicia iniciativas de mejora.
• Asegurar la configuración óptima de los parámetros de planificación. Tu perfil:
• Licenciatura en carreras de logística / planeación o Ingeniero Industrial
• Experiencia en Planeación de Demanda y Gestión de Materiales dentro de la industria de IVD (In Vitro Diagnostica), BOMs Maquilas
• Conocimientos básicos en compras, procesos de importación, trato con almacén, conocimiento en estratégias de abastecimiento, conocimiento de S & OP.
• Conocimiento en altas y mantenimientos de Datos maestros de Materiales.
• Conocimiento avanzado de SAP.
• Manejo avanzado del idioma Inglés. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, e

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Molecular Account Executive - GenMark - South Texas, Utah, New Mexico, Colorado, and Northern Arizona A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity: Are you an experienced sales professional with a talent for solving complex challenges? In this role, you'll use your expertise to navigate diverse issues and make strategic decisions that drive success. You'll manage medium to large accounts, exceeding sales targets while building lasting relationships with key decision-makers. Your goal will be to expand your network, identify new opportunities, and present compelling value propositions. With a deep understanding of our product line, you'll serve as a trusted advisor, continuously improving our quality system through your daily actions. As an Account Executive - GenMark, you will:
• be responsible for promoting GenMark’s products and services.
• contact new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.
• generate demand and maximize product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.
• implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.
• work with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• Conduct and organize necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.
• communicates competitive market information internally.
• networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business. This is a field-based role - the territory is South Texas, Utah, New Mexico, Colorado, and Northern Arizona. Our Ideal candidate would live in Denver, Colorado. Travel expectation: 50% Overnight Who You Are:
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• 3+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience
• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience Preferred Requirements:
• Good oral and written communication skills, including making impactful presentations
• Proven leadership abilities
• Negotiation, contracting, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work in a regulated environment
• Strategic planning and organizational skills Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Texas is $86,700.00 - $169,00.00. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position is eligible to earn incentive compensat

Your primary focus will support the technical aspects of eDiscovery and privacy processes, specializing in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium) and ensuring the defensible identification, collection, and preservation of electronically stored information (ESI) across a wide range of corporate systems and hardware, with a strong emphasis on Apple mobile ecosystems and mixed-OS laptop environments (macOS and Windows). The Opportunity: You will act as a subject matter expert, ensuring that all data is acquired in a legally defensible and forensically sound manner and maintaining a strict chain of custody to support litigation, internal investigations, and regulatory requests. You will also proactively drive and implement prioritized projects that align with business needs. Description of the area: About RDT Group Functions Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-Function As a trusted and agile partner, we, as the Legal, Compliance & Group Communication sub-Functions, are empowered to boost global innovative solutions with our business stakeholders in the Legal and Compliance digital prioritization journey. Job Responsibilities:
• Defensible Data Preservation and Collection: Plan defensible procedures for and execute forensic imaging, end-to-end eDiscovery workflows in Microsoft Purview, and electronic data preservation and collection from company systems and corporate devices, helping to identify, preserve, and retrieve case-critical data globally, specifically focusing on Apple iPhones, iPads, MacBooks, and Windows-based laptops.
• Data Processing: recommend and execute data processing in Relativity and Purview Premium, preparing the data for Legal review by utilizing Boolean searching, culling, and TAR (Technology-Assisted Review) / AI (Artificial Intelligence), preparing productions, and making process and technology recommendations to efficiently and effectively achieve set outcomes.
• Legal Department Support: Act as a trusted IT liaison to internal and external counsel, translating complex technical concepts into clear legal realities and assisting the Legal and Compliance team in scoping preservation and collection efforts based on litigation holds. Develop and maintain trusting relationships with legal stakeholders, IT, and external parties.
• Day-to-Day Operations & Device Management: Handle day-to-day operations by accurately responding to time-sensitive requests. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for electronic data collections from a wide range of company systems, as well as remote and physical device acquisitions, including the secure storage and retirement of physical evidence.
• Device & Hardware Management: Coordinate the logistics of remote and physical device acquisitions. Manage the intake, secure storage, and return/retirement of physical evidence.
• Chain of Custody & Documentation: Generate and maintain meticulous documentation for all preservation, collection, processing, and production activities, ensuring a verifiable chain of custody and adherence to the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM). Organize, log, and maintain accurate internal metrics and process f

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Coordenador de Importação e Exportação você será responsável por gerenciar e supervisionar todas as operações relacionadas ao comércio exterior da Roche, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações aduaneiras e fiscais, além de otimizar custos e prazos de entrega. Você também irá atuar na gestão de fornecedores, transportadoras, despachantes aduaneiros e órgãos regulatórios para garantir eficiência e qualidade nos processos logísticos internacionais. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Gerenciar operações de importação e exportação, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e custos otimizados.
• Assegurar conformidade com legislações nacionais e internacionais, incluindo normas da Receita Federal, Anvisa, MAPA e demais órgãos reguladores.
• Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para redução de custos logísticos e tributários, como utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).
• Negociar com fornecedores, agentes de carga, transportadoras e despachantes aduaneiros para obter melhores condições de frete e serviços em conjunto com a área de procurement, estabelecendo SLAs, indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação para garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e eficiência nos serviços prestados.
• Acompanhar processos de desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo agilidade na liberação de mercadorias.
• Monitorar Performance e KPIs de comércio exterior, como lead time, On time, custos de importação/exportação e eficiência logística, implementando metodologias de melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma ou similares) para acompanhamento contínuo e identificação de oportunidades de otimização.
• Coordenar auditorias e controles internos para garantir conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentos externos.
• Interagir com áreas internas, como Supply Chain, Finanças, Compras, Vendas, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Jurídica e Tributária para alinhar estratégias e demandas operacionais.
• Gerenciar a logística de transporte internacional, garantindo a integridade dos produtos e a eficiência dos modais utilizados (aéreo, marítimo, rodoviário), com foco em estruturação de processos e eliminação de gargalos operacionais.
• Liderar a estruturação e redesenho de processos da área de Comex através de mapeamento de fluxos, implementação de melhorias operacionais e adoção de tecnologias/sistemas que tragam maior eficiência e rastreabilidade às operações.
• Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe de Comex, definindo objetivos de performance alinhados à estratégia da empresa, acompanhando indicadores individuais e coletivos, promovendo capacitação contínua e fomentando uma cultura de excelência operacional e melhoria contínua. Quem é você:
• Graduação completa em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Logística, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.
• Experiência na implementação e utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).
• Experiência sólida em operações de importação e exportação, incluindo desembaraço aduaneiro e regimes especiais.
• Conhecimento avançado em legislação aduaneira, classificação fiscal, Incoterms e tributação de comércio exterior.
• Experiência na negociação com fornecedores logísticos e prestadores de serviços.
• Inglês fluente.
• Habilidade de análise de dados e tomada de decisão estratégica.
• Desejável Certificações em Comércio Exterior e/ou Certificação Lean Six Sigma
• Experiência em empresas do setor de produtos para saúde, farmacêutico ou químico.
• Conhecimento em ge

• Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para redução de custos logísticos e tributários, como utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).
• Negociar com fornecedores, agentes de carga, transportadoras e despachantes aduaneiros para obter melhores condições de frete e serviços em conjunto com a área de procurement, estabelecendo SLAs, indicadores de desempenho e planos de ação para garantir qualidade, confiabilidade e eficiência nos serviços prestados.
• Acompanhar processos de desembaraço aduaneiro, garantindo agilidade na liberação de mercadorias.
• Monitorar Performance e KPIs de comércio exterior, como lead time, On time, custos de importação/exportação e eficiência logística, implementando metodologias de melhoria de processos (Lean, Six Sigma ou similares) para acompanhamento contínuo e identificação de oportunidades de otimização.
• Coordenar auditorias e controles internos para garantir conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentos externos.
• Interagir com áreas internas, como Supply Chain, Finanças, Compras, Vendas, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Jurídica e Tributária para alinhar estratégias e demandas operacionais.
• Gerenciar a logística de transporte internacional, garantindo a integridade dos produtos e a eficiência dos modais utilizados (aéreo, marítimo, rodoviário), com foco em estruturação de processos e eliminação de gargalos operacionais.
• Liderar a estruturação e redesenho de processos da área de Comex através de mapeamento de fluxos, implementação de melhorias operacionais e adoção de tecnologias/sistemas que tragam maior eficiência e rastreabilidade às operações.
• Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe de Comex, definindo objetivos de performance alinhados à estratégia da empresa, acompanhando indicadores individuais e coletivos, promovendo capacitação contínua e fomentando uma cultura de excelência operacional e melhoria contínua. Quem é você:
• Graduação completa em Comércio Exterior, Administração, Logística, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.
• Experiência na implementação e utilização de regimes especiais (Drawback, Ex-Tarifário, depósito especial, entre outros).
• Experiência sólida em operações de importação e exportação, incluindo desembaraço aduaneiro e regimes especiais.
• Conhecimento avançado em legislação aduaneira, classificação fiscal, Incoterms e tributação de comércio exterior.
• Experiência na negociação com fornecedores logísticos e prestadores de serviços.
• Inglês fluente.
• Habilidade de análise de dados e tomada de decisão estratégica.
• Desejável Certificações em Comércio Exterior e/ou Certificação Lean Six Sigma
• Experiência em empresas do setor de produtos para saúde, farmacêutico ou químico.
• Conhecimento em ge

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific Solution Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and applies agreed architecture standards and seeks input from the Senior Architect or architecture governance where required.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems by taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple information sources. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned solution, in alignment with the Senior Architect for the area. Assesses and consults on the impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for the solution and its interfaces. Applies and contributes to reference architectures and patterns, in collaboration with the Senior Architect where broader alignment is needed, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are appropriately recorded..
• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive information clearly and actively works to build consensus among stakeholders. Drives information sharing and exchange about the solution.
• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap. Provides technical guidance and consultation on specific technologies for the assigned product or solution team. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and supports the adoption of new technologies in alignment with the Senior Architect and agreed technology direction. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates within an assigned solution context, with clear accountability for solution architecture in that scope..
• Business / Technical ability: Applies general and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas. Shares architecture knowledge, supports good design practices, and mentors colleagues where relevant. Who you are
• Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within an assigned product or solution context.
• Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for technical solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on risk and application landscapes. Technical Skills
• General and in-depth knowledge in one or two technology areas.
• Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, and Ontologies for solutions a

The Position 1 year contract Mississsauga, ON The Project Manager is accountable for the end-to-end strategy, planning, execution, monitoring, and change management of Patient Support Programs (PSPs) between our partners, ensuring business continuity and an uninterrupted, high-quality patient experience. In this role, the Project Manager will be a key partner to cross-functional teams, responsible for translating Therapeutic Area/Brand strategies into a comprehensive change management strategy that prioritizes patient continuity and operational excellence. This accountability spans the full transition lifecycle, from transition design and vendor onboarding to execution, stabilization, and optimization. The Program Manager will proactively manage risks, timelines, and dependencies while ensuring seamless coordination between outgoing and incoming vendors. The Opportunity: Program & Transition Management
• Lead end-to-end planning and execution of the Patient Support Program transition between vendor
• Develop and manage detailed transition roadmaps, timelines, milestones, and deliverables
• Identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies to ensure uninterrupted patient services
• Coordinate with internal teams (commercial, medical, compliance, finance, legal) and external vendors
• Monitor program performance, track KPIs, and ensure adherence to scope, budget, and timelines Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement :
• Design and implement a structured change management approach to support the transition
• Engage and align key stakeholders, including leadership, vendors, and cross-functional teams
• Develop communication strategies to ensure transparency and clarity throughout the transition Patient Centric Design & Continuous Improvement:
• Apply design thinking principles to optimize patient experience during and after the transition
• Ensure continuity of care by minimizing disruption to patient services and support programs Who you are:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare, Life Sciences, or related field; Master’s degree is an asset
• You possess 5+ years of relevant program management, large-scale transition, or related experience and you have 7+ years of experience in Healthcare, Pharmaceutical, or Patient Services environments
• Strong program management and change management capabilities, with experience leading complex transitions
• Experience managing vendor transitions, outsourcing, or operational transformations preferred
• PSP or patient services is an asset
• Strong stakeholder management skills, including influencing, negotiation, and navigating complex environments
• Ability to translate strategy into execution with strong business and operational acumen
• Ability to work cross-functionally and align internal teams and external partners (including vendors)
• Experience with digital tools, automation, or AI-enabled solutions is an asset
• Bilingual (English/French) is an asset Relocation assistance is not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position The Product IT Specialist is responsible for installing and maintaining Roche Diagnostics IT Products and Roche Instruments’ operating software and workflow at Customer sites. You will play an important role in planning, implementing, creating, organizing and monitoring the activities of workflow & IT Solutions products. Your Responsibilities
• Work with business stakeholders, IT partners and customers to design and build workflow & IT solutions for our customers.
• Install, maintain and troubleshooting Roche IT products at Customer sites.
• Install, maintain, and secure Windows-based environments (physical and virtual) and physical Firewalls to ensure seamless connectivity between devices and servers.
• Lead comprehensive troubleshooting of complex IT ecosystems—including servers, middleware, and integrations.
• Partner with customers' IT and Information Security teams to define access protocols, ensure secure communication, and verify compliance with organizational cybersecurity requirements.
• Provides consultation on connectivity solutions, regulatory compliance, security and virus protection concerns and the implementation of our products.
• Supports first implementation and subsequent implementations or modifications of the designed solutions at customer's sites.
• Supports relevant business opportunities for the assigned portfolio by helping to define tailored solutions based on customers' needs and objectives.
• Ensure activity planning/reporting on the CRM software, keeping data updated. Who You Are
• Hold a diploma in IT, Automation or Networking
• Experience with HL7/ASTM protocols- advantage
• Work experience in data security, IT support, networking or IT product support – advantage
• Work experience in medical laboratories – advantage
• Strong in problem solving and troubleshooting
• Excellent communications and presentation skills, proactive, dynamic, independent, autodidact and able to work under pressure
• Customer focused and a strong team player
• Fluent in English and Hebrew (both oral and written)
• Driving license Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics sta cercando un Global Customer Support (GCS) - Molecular Labs Senior Specialist per unirsi al nostro team in Città del Capo, Sud Africa o St Cugat, Spagna. In qualità di GCS Molecular Labs Senior Specialist sarai il supporto tecnico per una nuova era di ecosistemi diagnostici. Il vostro focus principale sarà il lancio globale e il supporto della piattaforma Roche new sequencer (AXELIOS) e della suite di integrazione cloud Avenio Connect. Questo ruolo è progettato per un professionista IT di alto livello che prospera all'incrocio di calcolo ad alte prestazioni (HPC), networking avanzato e hardware medico. Mentre fornirete supporto per le soluzioni legacy NIPT (AcfS), la vostra missione principale è di progettare e risolvere i percorsi dati ad alta velocità che alimentano il futuro della medicina personalizzata. Principali responsabilità 1. Infrastruttura ad alta efficienza (SBX/AXELIOS Focus)
• Ottimizzazione della linea dati: supporta l'architettura IT e di rete per la piattaforma Roche AXELIOS (SBX) in tutta la regione EMEA.
• Risoluzione dei problemi del collo di bottiglia: ottimizzare i percorsi di dati ad alta velocità dalla gestione della larghezza di banda ai cluster di calcolo e ai nodi di archiviazione.
• Amministrazione di sistema: Gestisci i requisiti operativi specifici per l'ambiente, tra cui Roche Linux (RLX) e Windows Server per il gateway unificato. 2. Connettività digitale e cloud (Avenio Connect)
• Connettività Architettura: supervisionare le integrazioni Avenio Connect, assicurando una comunicazione senza soluzione di continuità tra strumento e strumento-to-LIMS.
• Sicurezza e conformità: Configurare e gestire FortiGate 60F Firewalls , assicurando che i certificati di sicurezza e le regole firewall si allineano con gli standard globali di dati medici.
• Ecosistemi remoti: implementare e supportare interfacce utente remote e protocolli di accesso ai servizi (SSH, RDP, VNC). 3. Rete avanzata e supporto
• Topology Design: Risoluzione dei problemi e ottimizzare le topologie di rete complesse, tra cui VLAN, VPN e SD-WAN , in ambienti clinici ad alto rendimento.
• Escalation Leadership: servire come punto di escalation Tier-2/3 per le squadre di campo regionali, eseguendo analisi approfondite in perdita di pacchetti, latenza e crash di sistema.
• Manutenzione Legacy (NIPT/AcfS): Fornire supporto secondario per l'AcfS (Ariosa Cell-free DNA System) e l'hardware partner associato che si esaurisce nei prossimi anni. Chi sei come candidato ideale Qualifiche e esperienza Requisiti minimi:
• Istruzione: Bachelor o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria di rete, Ingegneria elettronica, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• Esperienza professionale: 7+ anni di supporto IT/Networking e Hardware, gestione ideale dei sistemi integrati in un ambiente regolamentato o clinico.
• Networking Expertise: competenza avanzata in firewall, routing/switching e protocolli di sicurezza (preferito il livello CCNP).
• Flessibilità di viaggio: Capacità di viaggiare fino al 30% per audit e installazioni del sito. La flessibilità di viaggio per gli Stati Schengen è preferita. Competenze Preferite (Bioinformatics, Cloud & Documentation):
• Gestione della conoscenza: Esperienza dimostrata nell'autorizzazione di file tecnici di alta qualità (SOP, guide di preparazione del sito, diagrammi di rete) e nella fornitura di formazione tecnica a team di campo globali e dipartimenti IT del cliente.
• Bioinformatics (BFX): Familiarity with NGS pipelines, data storage (NAS/SAN), e formati di file genomici come FASTQ e VCF .
• cloud ibrido: esperienza con le implementazioni ibride AWS o Google Cloud per i dati diagnostici.
• Conoscenza delle infrastrutture: comprensione della richiesta di dati ad alta velocità

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Le département Facilities Management et SHE de Basel Drug Substance Manufacturing offre un aperçu unique des processus de production de médicaments fabriqués de manière biotechnologique dans les bâtiments 95 et 91. Notre équipe dynamique est responsable de la gestion des bâtiments, de l'habillage, des milieux de haute pureté, de la surveillance environnementale et de la manipulation aseptique dans ces domaines. Vous apprendrez comment mettre en œuvre les exigences actuelles des bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) dans la vie quotidienne en utilisant les produits Roche. Nous proposons un stage dans le domaine de la gestion des installations/surveillance microbiologique. L'opportunité Après une période de formation, votre stage comprend entre autres les tâches suivantes :
• Participation à la mise en œuvre de projets d'amélioration (LEAN) ainsi qu'à divers projets, entre autres. Projets environnementaux et d'amélioration
• Aide à la création et à la documentation des analyses de risques, analyses et interprétation des données ainsi qu'à la création des rapports associés
• Soutien à la création et à la révision de documents (ex. : Procédures Opérationnelles Standard)
• Collaboration au traitement des écarts et des modifications techniques des systèmes
• Analyse et interprétation des données ainsi qu'à la création des rapports associés
• Communication et interaction avec les différentes interfaces internes et externes Qui vous êtes Vous avez vos études (licence ou maîtrise) dans le domaine de l'ingénierie (par exemple biotechnologie, génie pharmaceutique, génie des procédés) ou sciences naturelles (par exemple pharmacie, biologie, microbiologie, chimie) ou un programme d'études comparable complété au cours des 12 derniers mois. Vous souhaitez appliquer vos connaissances dans un environnement de travail moderne et découvrir l'industrie pharmaceutique lors d'un stage d'une durée d'au moins 9 mois. De plus, vous possédez les compétences suivantes :
• Mode de travail très indépendant et structuré
• Bonne connaissance des applications Office et Google
• Capacité à travailler en équipe, flexibilité et prise de décision ainsi que la volonté de travailler de manière indépendante
• Aimer travailler de manière constructive avec des parties prenantes internes et externes
• Expérience antérieure de travail conforme aux BPF dans l'environnement pharmaceutique
• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (écrit et parlé), la connaissance de l'anglais est un avantage La durée minimale du stage est de 9 mois. Ce poste ne convient pas à la rédaction d'un mémoire de licence ou de maîtrise. Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre. Postulez dès maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante ! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent au progrès de la science, garantissant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts ont permis de traiter plus de 26 millions de personnes avec nos médicaments et de réaliser plus de 30 milliards de tests à l'aide de nos produits de diagnostic. Nous nous donnons les moyens d'explorer de nouvelles possibilités, de favoriser la créativité et de maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir proposer des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Bâtissons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a senior team member within the Talent Acquisition group, you will foster a team environment and demonstrate collaborative leadership. You will partner with TA colleagues, Human Resource Business Partners, clients and Talent Acquisition Management to develop and implement staffing plans and strategies. The Opportunity: As a Senior Talent Partner, you will partner with hiring managers and senior management in the full lifecycle recruitment of talent in the Americas- individually managing a portfolio of requisitions and focusing on meeting and exceeding hiring manager's expectations and ensuring a positive candidate experience. Your responsibilities include:
• Strategic Recruitment: Drive hiring processes and develop complex recruiting strategies within assigned requisitions and organizations.
• Full Lifecycle Execution: Recruit talent by sourcing, reviewing applications, screening candidates, and processing offers within Workday.
• Consultative Coaching: Manage stakeholder expectations and coach managers on providing feedback, developing offers, and determining competencies.
• Process Innovation: Contribute to staffing process improvements and ensure recruiting solutions remain consistent with Corporate Talent Acquisition objectives.
• Data & Compliance: Act as the point person for staffing reports and metrics while ensuring strict adherence to internal processes and maintaining the ATS/CRM.
• Talent Management: Partner with client groups on internal talent management, including succession planning, talent reviews, and internal candidate movement.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Educate business leaders on relocation/immigration processes and attend networking events to proactively manage the recruitment escalation process. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Life Science, or equivalent work experience.
• You bring 5+ years of recruiting experience in a corporate or Shared Services environment; Pharma/Biotech industry experience is a plus.
• You are Bilingual , with required fluency in English and Spanish- Portuguese, French are a plus.
• You possess a high level of social competence and the ability to thrive in a multicultural, matrixed environment across borders.
• You are characterized by a growth mindset, end-to-end accountability, and a customer-centric approach to problem-solving.
• You are well known for your independent, yet collaborative working style and your ability to challenge the status quo for continuous improvement.
• Experience with United States, and Canada processes. (experience with pharma companies is a plus) Preferred:
• Demonstrated expertise in progressive sourcing (Direct Sourcing, Web 2.0, networking) and experience recruiting for different regions (US, Canada, LATAM).
• Technical proficiency in Workday or similar enterprise-level recruiting software. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity. R2R

• Handling all accounts payable related matters Master Data
• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Other

• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Internship in Innovation & Sustainability For students in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences fields Our Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) offers a unique opportunity for passionate individuals to gain hands-on experience in the pharmaceutical industry while making a positive impact on the world. Are you ready to join a global network spanning 20+ countries, where bright minds collaborate to tackle real-world challenges in Innovation & Sustainability? Do you want to work on impactful projects, shape the future, and drive change from within? The Position As an intern, you will contribute to a project focused on research on assessing & reducing the environmental impact of synthetic polymer excipients in the Pharmaceutical Industry by identifying and evaluating safer biodegradable alternatives. The project explores how polymers used in pharmaceutical formulations may contribute to microplastic pollution in municipal water systems and aims to support more sustainable product design in light of evolving regulatory expectations such as EU REACH 2026. Within your first 3 months, you are expected to assess target polymers, research promising biodegradable substitute materials, analyze supplier and production feasibility, and contribute to a final technical report and strategic roadmap. Your work will support Roche’s sustainability ambitions by addressing biodiversity and water-related impacts, advancing sustainable products, and encouraging the use of more environmentally responsible raw materials. This internship offers a high-impact opportunity to work on an innovative topic at the intersection of pharmaceutical science, sustainability, and environmental protection. The Opportunity
• Conduct a product-based preliminary analysis of target polymers
• Research and evaluate potential biodegradable alternatives for relevant synthetic polymer excipients
• Assess production feasibility and supply landscape for alternative materials, including scalability, supplier availability, quality standards, and regulatory considerations
• Compare synthetic and biodegradable options across environmental impact, ecotoxicity, pharmaceutical performance, and compliance criteria
• Explore how polymer choice influences product life cycle sustainability, from raw material sourcing through use and disposal
• Support the development of a strategic roadmap for improving or replacing selected synthetic polymers with more sustainable alternatives
• Prepare a final technical report and presentation summarizing findings, trade-offs, and recommendations
• Collaborate with stakeholders across functions to gather input and support a multidisciplinary evaluation process Who You Are You are enrolled or have completed your Master’s or PhD studies at a university, preferably in the field of Environmental Engineering, Sustainability Related Departments, Biochemistry, Materials Science, Biology, Molecular Biology, Bioprocess Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science or related Biotechnology / Life Sciences within the last 12 months and are interested in applying your knowledge in a modern working environment as part of an internship of at least 3 months. Preferred Qualifications Are
• Familiar with bioprocesses, biochemical or biological

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il programma RiSE (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) è un programma di ricerca studentesca altamente competitivo a Roche. Offre agli studenti di laurea e di laurea più talentuosi la possibilità di essere pienamente integrato nel nostro ambiente R&D interdisciplinare e internazionale del settore. Come studente di RiSE aumenterai le tue competenze, acquisirai una preziosa esperienza lavorativa con noi, e alla fine diventerai parte di una rete mondiale di RiSE Alumni. La Neuroscienza e Malattie Rare Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) sta sviluppando farmaci per una serie di gravi malattie neurologiche, tra cui sclerosi multipla, malattia di Alzheimer, malattia di Parkinson, autismo, atrofia muscolare spinale, e la malattia di Huntington. Come studente di RiSE nel NRD DTA si unirà al gruppo Brain Delivery presso il Roche Innovation Center di Basilea, Svizzera, per eseguire l’analisi dei dati omics e il lavoro sperimentale in vitro per mappare il paesaggio normativo degli obiettivi di morbo di Alzheimer. Sarete ospitati e guidati da uno scienziato Roche che vi guiderà attraverso la vostra ricerca e vi fornirà l'infrastruttura di lavoro necessaria e la rete collaborativa. L'opportunità
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli scienziati computazionali per analizzare i set di dati di sequenziamento per guidare intuizioni biologiche.
• Progettazione di rigorosi esperimenti in vitro informati dalla vostra esperienza nell'interpretazione transcriptomica dei dati.
• Applicare un insieme completo di metodi di biologia cellulare molecolare nei modelli derivati da cellule staminali per testare ipotesi biologiche specifiche
• Presentare e discutere il vostro lavoro in riunioni interne.
• Synthesize dati sperimentali per la preparazione e la presentazione di manoscritti ad alto impatto per la pubblicazione peer-reviewed. Chi sei
• Ti sei laureato in un Master nell'ultimo anno
• O sei iscritto a un dottorato o un corso di laurea in un'università
• Stai cercando di espandere la tua esperienza con uno stage nel settore
• Ampia esperienza nella generazione e nell'analisi dei dati scRNAseq
• Esperienza pratica con modelli ingegneristici basati su iPSC di tipi di cellule cerebrali per approcci genomici funzionali (ad es. CRISPR)
• Un ampio set di competenze con saggi di biologia cellulare e molecolare Informazioni aggiuntive La data di inizio preferita dello stage è 11/2026 o su disponibilità. Processo di applicazione Le domande devono includere un CV e una lettera di copertura, così come una lettera del vostro attuale o ex supervisore accademico che supporta la vostra applicazione al programma RiSE. Le lettere di riferimento sono anche benvenuti. Si prega di notare che a causa di regolamenti cittadini non UE/EFTA devono essere iscritti in un dottorato o un corso di laurea in un'università e fornire un certificato dall'università che afferma che uno stage di settore è obbligatorio come parte della formazione universitaria. Curioso, motivato e pronto ad imparare? Richiedi ora il nostro tirocinio RiSE. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The RiSE program (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) is a highly competitive student research program at Roche. It offers the most talented graduate and medical degree students the opportunity to be fully integrated into our interdisciplinary and international industry R&D environment. As a RiSE student you will enhance your competencies, gain valuable work experience with us, and eventually become part of a world-wide network of RiSE Alumni. The Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) is developing medicines for a range of serious neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, autism, spinal muscular atrophy, and Huntington’s disease. As RiSE student in the NRD DTA you will join the Brain Delivery group at the Roche Innovation Center Basel, Switzerland, to perform omics data analysis and experimental in vitro work to map the regulatory landscape of Alzheimer’s Disease targets. You will be hosted and mentored by a Roche scientist who will guide you through your research and provide you with the needed work infrastructure and collaborative network. The Opportunity
• Collaborate closely with computational scientists to analyze sequencing datasets to drive biological insights.
• Design rigorous in vitro experiments informed by your expertise in transcriptomic data interpretation.
• Apply a comprehensive set of molecular cell biology methods in stem-cell derived models to test specific biological hypothesis
• Present and discuss your work in internal meetings.
• Synthesize experimental data for the preparation and submission of high-impact manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication. Who You Are
• You graduated from a Master's program within the last year
• Or you are enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university
• You are looking to expand your experience with an industry internship
• Extensive experience in the generation and analysis of scRNAseq data
• Hands-on experience with engineering iPSC-based models of brain cell types for functional genomic approaches (e.g. CRISPR)
• A broad skill set with cell and molecular biology assays Additional Information The preferred start date of the internship is 11/2026 or upon availability. Application Process Applications need to include a CV and a cover letter, as well as a letter from your current or former academic supervisor supporting your application to the RiSE Program. Reference letters are also welcome. Please note that due to regulations non-EU/EFTA citizens have to be enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university and provide a certificate from the university stating that an industry internship is mandatory as part of the university training. Curious, motivated, and ready to learn? Apply now for our RiSE Internship. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le programme RiSE (Roche Stages for Scientific Exchange) est un programme de recherche étudiant hautement compétitif à Roche. Il offre aux étudiants diplômés et aux étudiants en médecine les plus talentueux la possibilité d'être pleinement intégrés dans notre environnement de R-D interdisciplinaire et international. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE, vous améliorerez vos compétences, gagnerez une expérience de travail précieuse avec nous et finirez par faire partie d'un réseau mondial d'anciens RiSE. La zone de découverte et de traduction des neurosciences et des maladies rares (DNT) met au point des médicaments pour diverses maladies neurologiques graves, dont la sclérose en plaques, la maladie d'Alzheimer, la maladie de Parkinson, l'autisme, l'atrophie musculaire de la colonne vertébrale et la maladie de Huntington. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE au NRD DTA, vous rejoindrez le groupe Brain Delivery au Roche Innovation Center Basel, en Suisse, pour effectuer des analyses de données omiques et des travaux expérimentaux in vitro pour cartographier le paysage réglementaire des cibles de la maladie d'Alzheimer. Vous serez accueilli et encadré par un scientifique de Roche qui vous guidera dans vos recherches et vous fournira l'infrastructure de travail et le réseau de collaboration nécessaires. L'opportunité
• Collaborer étroitement avec les chercheurs en calcul pour analyser les ensembles de données séquentielles afin de générer des données biologiques.
• Concevoir des expériences in vitro rigoureuses en fonction de votre expertise en interprétation des données transcriptomiques.
• Appliquer un ensemble complet de méthodes de biologie cellulaire moléculaire dans des modèles dérivés de cellules souches pour tester des hypothèses biologiques spécifiques
• Présentez et discutez de votre travail lors de réunions internes.
• Synthétiser les données expérimentales pour la préparation et la soumission de manuscrits à fort impact pour publication par des pairs. Qui vous êtes
• Vous avez obtenu votre diplôme de maîtrise au cours de la dernière année
• Ou vous êtes inscrit à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme médical dans une université
• Vous cherchez à développer votre expérience avec un stage dans l'industrie
• Expérience approfondie dans la production et l'analyse de données scRNAseq
• Expérience pratique des modèles iPSC d'ingénierie des types de cellules cérébrales pour les approches génomiques fonctionnelles (par exemple CRISPR)
• Un vaste ensemble de compétences avec des tests de biologie cellulaire et moléculaire Informations complémentaires La date de début préférée du stage est 11/2026 ou selon disponibilité. Processus de demande Les demandes doivent comprendre un CV et une lettre d'accompagnement, ainsi qu'une lettre de votre superviseur scolaire actuel ou ancien appuyant votre demande au Programme RiSE. Les lettres de référence sont également les bienvenues. Veuillez noter qu'en raison de la réglementation des citoyens non membres de l'UE ou de l'AELE doivent être inscrits à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme en médecine dans une université et fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage dans l'industrie est obligatoire dans le cadre de la formation universitaire. Curieux, motivé et prêt à apprendre? Faites votre demande pour notre stage RiSE. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics. What will you do?
• Identify market opportunities and customer needs in order to create value for the customers and patients
• Define an overarching business strategy for the current and future product portfolio
• Develop specific marketing plans for the product portfolio
• Represent marketing group on local and global cross-functional teams driving innovation and market penetration
• Manage resources and budget to target all assigned programs and initiatives
• Organize training programs for the sales team about product specifications, product marketing strategies, and competition
• Co-create and implement customized solutions to meet defined outcomes
• Drive process improvements to deliver higher productivity
• Work in cross-functional teams for the success of projects
• Work closely with Healthcare Consultants, Product Managers and global teams for required projects Who are you?

• Strong project management skills
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Ability to manage multiple projects
• At least an upper-intermediate level of English to collaborate internally across the broader Roche enterprise

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you a Finance or Business student looking to gain hands-on experience in a global corporate environment? We are looking for a motivated Intern to join our Global Procurement Finance team. This is a unique opportunity to see the "inner workings" of a global finance function. You will gain exposure to complex stakeholder management and international reporting standards-all while being part of a supportive, expert team. The opportunity In this role, you won’t just be crunching numbers; you’ll be a key part of a team operating across a global scale. You will work directly under the Finance Functional Partner to support global operations and strategic procurement. As our Intern you will:
• Drive Financial Insights: Assist in preparing monthly financial reports
• Master the Tools: Take ownership of our procurement savings tracking tool (SpendHQ) - validating business cases and savings entered by the procurement organization.
• Business Partnering: Collaborate directly with one function/team to provide financial support.
• Support & Innovate: Help Procurement Finance Business Partners with insight generation, SMC planning, and organizational training. Who you are You are enrolled in or have completed your studies within the last 12 months with a degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s) in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
• Skills: A solid foundation in financial controlling and reporting.
• Communication: Fluent in English; you’re comfortable working in a diverse, international environment.
• Mindset: Proactive, detail-oriented, and ready to take ownership of projects.
• You come with the ability/interest to automate reports and improve processes Additional information Start Date: August 2026 Workload: 100% Duration: 12 months Application process Please submit your complete application, including your CV and a motivation letter. A certificate of enrollment (if you are currently studying) OR recent graduates are also eligible to start an internship with us within 12 months of their graduation date. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking an experienced SAP EWM Specialist who independently leads EWM solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to the architecture for the global Roche ASPIRE EWM System. In this role, you will guide product developments, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product level. By bringing advanced EWM knowledge, expertise within GxP environments, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and the evolution of our warehouse processes across Roche. Description of the area: Job Responsibilities
• Scope: Works and leads independently to deliver solution design with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the EWM area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactively identifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the EWM product life cycle, and leads the development of medium to complex changes. Evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new business processes while providing technical oversight and consultation. Supports larger initiatives as a single point of contact for the EWM system as needed.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major product milestones. Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the product level under limited direction. Analyzes current warehouse processes and recommends SAP EWM enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Manages interfaces between SAP EWM and other systems, like e.g. MES and troubleshoot data flow issues.
• Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product teams within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders from the business and within IT. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across work-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, and facilitating discussions.
• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to the EWM system and its interfaces. Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams. Qualifications Education / Experience
• A minimum of five years of experience is required in independently leading and delivering complex solution designs and products within the Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) domain.
• Background in logistics or supply chain.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams.
• Experience working within a validated environment, including the creation and execution of test scripts and solution documentation. Technical Skills
• SAP EWM certifications.
• Advanced knowledge o
