• Partnerschaft mit Interessenvertretern aus Wirtschaft und Qualität als vertrauenswürdiger Berater zur Erleichterung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und zur Optimierung der Auflösung innerhalb der Produktteams.

• Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Änderungen auf validierte Zustände zum Schutz der Datenintegrität und zur Unterstützung des Wachstums von skalierbaren digitalen Gesundheitslösungen in komplexen Umgebungen.

Wer du bist:

• Ermöglicht eine mindestens sechsjährige Berufserfahrung in CSV, die den Lebenszyklus von COTS und benutzerdefinierter Software in regulierten GxP-Umgebungen unterstützt.

• Einen Hochschulabschluss in Wissenschaft, Technik oder Informatik halten; gleichwertige technische Hintergründe sind ebenfalls hochwertig.

• Vertrautheit mit Produktentwicklungsprozessen, die für Medizinprodukte spezifisch sind, gilt als ein deutlicher Vorteil.

Was Sie bekommen:

• Salary Range 14 175-26 325 PLN brutto auf der Grundlage des Arbeitsvertrags.

• Jährliche Bonuszahlung auf Basis Ihrer Leistung.

• Dediziertes Ausbildungsbudget (Ausbildung, Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, diversifizierte Karrierewege usw.).

• Freitagserneuerung (2 Freitage pro Quartal verfügbar).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit Programm (bis zu 3 Monate Urlaub zu jedem Zweck zu verwenden).

• Urlaubszuschüsse verfügbar.

• Flex Location (Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeit von verschiedenen Orten der Welt für einen bestimmten Zeitraum durchzuführen).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit für Charity (zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaub von maximal 2

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Spécialiste de la qualité des TI

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

En tant que spécialiste de la qualité de l'informatique, vous faites partie d'une communauté mondiale axée sur le développement et la validation de logiciels de pointe et de systèmes COTS au sein de la R-D de diagnostic Roches. Dans ce rôle, vous agissez en tant qu'expert en validation de système informatique (CSV) en matière d'excellence en matière de réglementation grâce à une approche souple et novatrice des solutions de santé numériques.

L'occasion :

• Diriger les efforts de validation à l'échelle mondiale en fournissant des conseils d'experts et en rédigeant des documents essentiels sur le CSV, y compris des plans, des rapports et des évaluations des risques, dans divers cadres d'exécution.

• Assurer un alignement complet sur les normes GxP, ERES et Roche internes tout en surveillant les évaluations périodiques du système afin de maintenir la capacité d'audit continue.

• Établir des partenariats avec les parties prenantes des entreprises et de la qualité en tant que consultant fiable pour faciliter la collaboration interfonctionnelle et rationaliser la résolution au sein des équipes de produits.

• Évaluer l'impact des changements sur les états validés pour protéger l'intégrité des données et soutenir la croissance de solutions de soins de santé numériques évolutives dans des environnements complexes.

Qui vous êtes :

• Posséder un minimum de six ans d'expérience professionnelle en CSV, en soutenant spécifiquement le cycle de vie des COTS et des logiciels personnalisés dans des environnements GxP réglementés.

• Être titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en sciences, en génie ou en informatique; des antécédents techniques équivalents sont également très appréciés.

• Démontrer une expertise approfondie dans la réglementation mondiale, y compris FDA/UE GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, et les principes fondamentaux de l'intégrité des données.

• Navigation experte de diverses méthodologies d'essai et du SDLC de bout en bout dans des cadres Agiles modernes tels que Scrum ou SAFe.

• Un joueur d'équipe collaborative avec des compétences en anglais couramment, des pairs de mentorat confortables et florissant au sein des équipes de projets internationales et interfonctionnelles.

• La connaissance des processus de développement des produits spécifiques aux matériels médicaux est considérée comme un avantage distinct.

Ce que vous obtenez:

• Plage salariale 14 175-26 325 PLN brut sur la base du contrat de travail.

• Paiement de bonus annuel en fonction de votre performance.

• Budget dédié à la formation (formation, certifications, conférences, parcours professionnels diversifiés, etc.).

• Recharger les vendredis (2 vendredis par trimestre disponibles).

• Prendre du temps Programme (jusqu'à 3 mois de congé à utiliser à n'importe quelle fin).

• Allocations de vacances disponibles.

• Emplacement flexible (possibilité d'effectuer notre travail à partir de différents endroits du monde pour une certaine période de temps).

• Prendre du temps pour la charité (congé payé supplémentaire de maximum 2

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Immerse yourself in the fascinating everyday working life at Roche Diagnostics surrounded by beautiful mountains, not far from the scenic Lake Zug and yet close to the cities of Zug, Zurich and Lucerne. Here, where we have been rooted for over 50 years, we develop and produce diagnostic solutions and help to find answers to health questions. The Rotkreuz site, where a wide variety of disciplines work hand in hand, is a meeting place for over 2,700 talented employees from 70 different nations. Our campus invites people to work together, be creative and realise their full potential. We believe that a positive work environment, employee satisfaction, inclusion and sustainability are key to growing together and improving the lives of patients around the world. Welcome to Roche in Rotkreuz. Embark on a transformative learning experience with Roche Diagnostics through our Aligned Internship Program in Rotkreuz. Designed to nurture emerging talent, this program offers a dynamic and immersive opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the field of diagnostics, fostering personal and professional growth.
Want to find out more about our site? Then watch this video .
The Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) team within Sensor and Cartridge Operations ensures the efficient and high-quality production of electrochemical sensors and cartridges by bridging the gap between product development and full-scale manufacturing.

The Opportunity

• You will transform raw manufacturing data into actionable intelligence to ensure the world’s most reliable and rapid patient diagnostics

• Your role involves applying Computer Vision methods for feature extraction on sensor surface scans to uncover deep insights

• You will design and implement Machine Learning and Deep Learning Proof-of-Concepts to optimize complex production processes

• Data-driven discovery guides your work as you use classical statistics and predictive modeling to uncover hidden patterns in imaging and process data

• Collaboration and presentation are key as you share findings with multidisciplinary teams to directly influence process improvements

• Your work focuses on cutting-edge AI projects within a highly regulated and high-stakes medical environment

• The position offers a supportive culture with professional growth, mentorship, and a modern work-life balance including on-site perks and work-from-home options

Who You Are

• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor or Master’s program, or have completed your degree within 12 months of the start date, preferably in a field of Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related technical field.

• You are a tech-enthusiast who enjoys seeing code come to life in physical products and has a genuine interest in how cutting-edge technology meets modern manufacturing.

• You possess hands-on Machine Learning experience, having already applied models to real-world datasets beyond classroom exercises.

• Technical proficiency in Python and its ecosystem, including OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, and Pandas, is essential for this role.

• A strong foundation in statistical data analysis enables you to maintain a consistently analytical mindset.

• Fluency in both English and German is required to collaborate effectively within our team environment.

Application Process

• Please upload your CV, a motivation letter with your application, and a certificate of enrolment (if you are currently studying).

• Non-EU/Non-EFTA

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche is the world’s #1 provider of companion diagnostics and offers unrivaled experience in developing and commercializing predictive diagnostics that enable personalized treatment strategies for cancer patients. We offer unique opportunities for pathologists interested in playing a role in the development and implementation of new assays critical to our goal of providing more patient access to innovative new therapies. You have an opportunity to work with leading edge technologies, such as Immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, immunofluorescence, multiplex assays, digital pathology and more. This position is based onsite in Tucson, AZ

The Opportunity:

• You will provide crucial pathology and slide reading support for assay development, FDA submissions, clinical trials and collaborating with internal and external development teams.

• You will be at the forefront of research and development activities by supporting the development of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes and special stains.

• You will advise on future pathology and medical needs.

• You will be a medical representative on project core teams and contribute to pathology related aspects of specific development projects.

• You will drive continuous improvement in work processes, making a direct impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of our operations.

• You will utilize your expertise to advise on future pathology and medical needs, ensuring that we stay ahead of the curve in our industry

Who you are:

• You have an M.D. or D.O. with US Board Certification in Anatomic Pathology and an active state medical license.

• You are Residency-trained in anatomic pathology with expertise in surgical pathology and a proven ability to assess histopathology, IHC, ISH, and multiplex assays.

• You are experienced in evaluating complex immunohistochemistry assays such as PD-L1, HER2, and Ki-67.

• You are a precision medicine innovator and are Passionate about companion diagnostics (CDx) and the "right drug, right patient, right time" philosophy.

• You are a tech-Forward collaborator: Comfortable utilizing digital pathology scanners, automated algorithms, and advanced staining platforms (VENTANA Benchmark).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
In Roche´s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC), a department within the small molecule research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug candidates from early research into development.

The Opportunity:
As an Intern in our team your main tasks will include:

Option 1 - Oligo synthesis

• Discovery of new techniques for the synthesis of complex oligonucleotides

• Purification and analysis of reactions involving oligonucleotides with state of the art chromatographic techniques.

• Scale up your findings into processes for the preparation of multi-gram quantities of desired target materials.

Option 2 - Oligo Analytical Chemistry

• State-of-the-art analysis of complex synthetic oligonucleotides by LC-MS.

• Development and implementation of innovative analytical methods to support synthesis, development and production.

• Conducting critical in-solution stability and hold-time studies.

Who you are:

• An enthusiastic, motivated and scientifically interested person who enjoys teamwork and has a strong willingness to learn new techniques.

• A BSc or MSc student, or a recent graduate (within the last 12 months prior to the start date), in Chemistry or Biochemistry . Prior hands-on laboratory experience is required .

• Prior experience with oligonucleotide chemistry (solid phase synthesis, conjugation, purification and analysis; Option 1) or LC-MS analytics (Option 2) is desirable.

• Excellent organizational skills and proactive knowledge sharing.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Application process:
Please upload a current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:

• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

• this internship is not suitable for a thesis, nor for PhD students or post-graduates.

If you are eager to contribute and feel you have the dedication to teamwork and innovation that we are seeking, then Roche is the organization for you. Every role at Roche plays a part in making a difference to patients’ lives. If you want to work in a passionate team, make your mark & improve lives, apply now!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high,
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.
In Roche ́s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organizzazione (pRED), facciamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Questa posizione si trova in Chimica Preclinica, Manifattura e Controlli (pCMC), un dipartimento all'interno della piccola organizzazione di ricerca molecola in PRED Therapeutic Modalities, dove pave, in un ambiente diverso, ambizioso e innovativo, il percorso per portare i candidati alla droga dalla ricerca precoce nello sviluppo.

L'opportunità:
Come Interno nel nostro team i vostri compiti principali includono:

Opzione 1 - Sintesi Oligo

• Scoperta di nuove tecniche per la sintesi di oligonucleotidi complessi

• Purificazione e analisi di reazioni che coinvolgono oligonucleotidi con tecniche cromatografiche all'avanguardia.

• Scalare i risultati in processi per la preparazione di quantità multi-gram di materiali target desiderati.

Opzione 2 - Chimica analitica Oligo

• Analisi all'avanguardia di oligonucleotidi sintetici complessi di LC-MS.

• Sviluppo e attuazione di metodi analitici innovativi per sostenere la sintesi, lo sviluppo e la produzione.

• Condurre studi critici di stabilità e tempo di attesa.

Chi sei:

• Una persona entusiasta, motivata e scientificamente interessata che gode del lavoro di squadra e ha una forte volontà di imparare nuove tecniche.

• Uno studente di laurea o MSc, o un recente laureato (entro gli ultimi 12 mesi prima della data di inizio), in Chimica o Biochimica . È richiesta un'esperienza di laboratorio preventiva.

• È auspicabile una prima esperienza con la chimica oligonucleotide (sintesi di fase solida, coniugazione, purificazione e analisi; Opzione 1) o analisi LC-MS (Opzione 2).

• Eccellente capacità organizzative e condivisione di conoscenze proattive.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese.

Processo di applicazione:
Si prega di caricare un CV corrente e una lettera di motivazione, dove si indica la data di inizio preferita dello stage.

Informazioni aggiuntive:

• Si prega di notare che, a causa di regolamenti, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono fornire un certificato dall'università che afferma che un tirocinio è obbligatorio nell'ambito dei documenti di richiesta e deve essere continuamente iscritto nella loro università per tutta la durata di questo stage.

• questo stage non è adatto per una tesi, né per studenti di dottorato o post-laurea.

Se siete desiderosi di contribuire e sentire avete la dedizione al lavoro di squadra e l'innovazione che stiamo cercando, allora Roche è l'organizzazione per voi. Ogni ruolo di Roche gioca una parte nel fare la differenza per la vita dei pazienti. Se vuoi lavorare in un team appassionato, fai il tuo segno e migliora le vite, applica subito!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Wir fördern die Wissenschaft, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.
In Roches Pharma-Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisation (pRED) machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Diese Position befindet sich in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing und Controls (pCMC), einer Abteilung innerhalb der kleinen Molekülforschungsorganisation in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, wo wir in einer vielfältigen, ambitionierten und innovativen Umgebung den Weg ebnen, um Drogenkandidaten aus der frühen Forschung in die Entwicklung zu bringen.

Die Gelegenheit:
Als Praktikant in unserem Team gehören Ihre Hauptaufgaben:

Option 1 - Oligosynthese

• Entdeckung neuer Techniken zur Synthese komplexer Oligonukleotide

• Reinigung und Analyse von Reaktionen von Oligonukleotiden mit chromatographischen Techniken des Standes der Technik.

• Skalieren Sie Ihre Ergebnisse in Prozesse zur Herstellung von Mehrgrammmengen gewünschter Zielmaterialien.

Option 2 - Oligo-Analysechemie

• Modernste Analyse komplexer synthetischer Oligonukleotide durch LC-MS.

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung innovativer analytischer Methoden zur Unterstützung von Synthese, Entwicklung und Produktion.

• Durchführung kritischer In-Lösungsstabilität und Haltezeitstudien.

Wer du bist:

• Eine enthusiastische, motivierte und wissenschaftlich interessierte Person, die Teamarbeit genießt und eine starke Bereitschaft hat, neue Techniken zu lernen.

• Ein BSc- oder MSc-Student oder ein neuer Absolventen (innerhalb der letzten 12 Monate vor dem Startdatum), in Chemie oder Biochemie . Vorherige praktische Laborerfahrung ist erforderlich.

• Vorherige Erfahrungen mit der Oligonukleotidchemie (Festphasensynthese, Konjugation, Reinigung und Analyse; Option 1) oder LC-MS-Analysen (Option 2) sind wünschenswert.

• Ausgezeichnete organisatorische Fähigkeiten und proaktive Wissensvermittlung.

• Ausgezeichnete schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch.

Anwendungsprozess:
Bitte laden Sie einen aktuellen Lebenslauf und einen Motivationsbrief hoch, in dem Sie Ihr bevorzugtes Startdatum des Praktikums angeben.

Weitere Informationen:

• Bitte beachten Sie, dass Nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger von der Universität ein Zertifikat vorlegen müssen, das besagt, dass ein Praktikum im Rahmen der Bewerbungsunterlagen obligatorisch ist und für die gesamte Dauer dieses Praktikums kontinuierlich an ihrer Hochschule eingeschrieben werden muss.

• Dieses Praktikum ist weder für eine Dissertation, noch für Doktoranden oder Postgraduierten geeignet.

Wenn Sie eifrig sind, einen Beitrag zu leisten und das Gefühl haben Sie die Hingabe an Teamarbeit und Innovation, die wir suchen, dann ist Roche die Organisation für Sie. Jede Rolle bei Roche spielt dabei eine Rolle, das Leben der Patienten zu verändern. Wenn Sie in einem leidenschaftlichen Team arbeiten möchten, machen Sie Ihre Marke und verbessern Sie das Leben, bewerben Sie sich jetzt!

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.
Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce de Roche (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Ce poste est situé dans la chimie préclinique, la fabrication et les contrôles (pCMC), un département au sein de l'organisme de recherche sur les petites molécules dans les Modalités thérapeutiques pRED, où nous posons, dans un environnement diversifié, ambitieux et innovateur, la voie pour amener les candidats aux médicaments des premières recherches au développement.

La possibilité :
En tant que stagiaire de notre équipe, vos tâches principales seront les suivantes :

Option 1 - Synthèse de l'oligo

• Découverte de nouvelles techniques de synthèse des oligonucléotides complexes

• Purification et analyse des réactions impliquant des oligonucléotides avec des techniques chromatographiques de pointe.

• Élargissez vos résultats en processus pour la préparation de quantités multigrammes de matériaux cibles souhaités.

Option 2 - Chimie analytique de l'oligo

• Analyse de pointe des oligonucléotides synthétiques complexes par LC-MS.

• Mise au point et application de méthodes analytiques innovantes pour soutenir la synthèse, le développement et la production.

• Mener des études critiques sur la stabilité en solution et le temps d'attente.

Qui vous êtes :

• Une personne enthousiaste, motivée et scientifiquement intéressée qui apprécie le travail d'équipe et est très disposée à apprendre de nouvelles techniques.

• Un étudiant en BSc ou MSc, ou un diplômé récent (dans les 12 derniers mois avant la date de début), en chimie ou en biochimie. Une expérience pratique préalable en laboratoire est requise.

• Expérience préalable de la chimie des oligonucléotides (synthèse en phase solide, conjugaison, purification et analyse; option 1) ou analyse LC-MS (option 2) est souhaitable.

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et partage proactif des connaissances.

• Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et verbale en anglais.

Processus de demande :
Veuillez télécharger un CV actuel et une lettre de motivation, où vous indiquez votre date de début de stage préférée.

Renseignements supplémentaires :

• Veuillez noter qu'en raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent fournir un certificat de l'université indiquant qu'un stage est obligatoire dans le cadre des documents de candidature et doivent être inscrits en permanence dans leur université pendant toute la durée de ce stage.

• ce stage n'est pas adapté pour une thèse, ni pour des doctorants ou des post-universitaires.

Si vous êtes désireux de contribuer et que vous avez le sentiment d'avoir le dévouement pour le travail d'équipe et l'innovation que nous recherchons, Roche est l'organisation pour vous. Chaque rôle de Roche joue un rôle dans la vie des patients. Si vous voulez travailler dans une équipe passionnée, faites votre marque & améliorer la vie, appliquez maintenant!

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées,

The Position
Line Manager at Regional Customer Support Center in Sant Cugat

About the Role

The Sant Cugat Regional Customer Support Center is seeking an experienced, collaborative leader with a strong customer focus to join our Regional Customer Support team.

As a Line Manager, you will lead and empower a team of highly skilled remote specialists providing support across Spain and Portugal customers and to the EMEA-LATAM region. Your mission is to move beyond case resolution to provide proactive support and data-driven insights to improve decision making to attract and retain our customers. You will be a catalyst for a culture of high performance and digital transformation.

In this role, you will be responsible for achieving outstanding team performance and maximizing customer satisfaction, driving remote resolution, overseeing employee and customer training and facilitating local and regional knowledge sharing and escalation support.
You will do this by analyzing results, challenging how support is currently provided, and rapidly incorporating innovations, new digital tools and AI-driven solutions to continuously improve our service. A core priority will be the development of your team members, mentoring them to excel in their current roles while preparing them for the future challenges.

With your experience in Diagnostics or Healthcare, you will put the customer -and ultimately the patient- at the heart of everything we do.

You'll report directly to the Head of the Sant Cugat Regional Customer Support Center and join a team passionate about creating an environment where empowered individuals can flourish and fulfil their potential.

What You'll Own:

Leadership & Talent Development
Coach and empower your team to achieve high performance. You'll manage the full talent lifecycle—from recruiting top talent to performance management and building the capabilities needed for a digital-first organization.

Operational Excellence & Innovation
Lead service delivery by ensuring all processes meet quality and excellence standards sustainably. Leverage AI to shift toward proactive, data-driven support that maximizes system performance and customer value.

Stakeholder Management & Resolution
Connect our remote support team with customers, field and regional/global teams. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex issues, driving them to resolution and delivering first-class service experiences.

Strategic Collaboration
Partner with Sales, Marketing and Service to ensure the technical service offering aligns with broader business goals.

Customer Focus
Maximize customer satisfaction by analyzing feedback and customer relationship management data and turning insights into meaningful actions. Implement innovative approaches to improve service outcomes.

Cross-Regional Leadership
Drive collaboration across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America by leading regional initiatives. As a change agent, you'll shape network structures and implement global strategies with a focus on local impact and service excellence.

Knowledge Management & Learning
Build a strong knowledge-sharing culture, ensuring rapid, well-organized knowledge transfer to both staff and customers to accelerate competency development.

Agile Leadership
Thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment by managing shifting priorities and multiple deadlines effectively. Navigate ambiguity with creativity, keeping your team focused and high-performing.

Who You Are:

You're a resilient leader who excels

titleByLocale.fr: Data Steward – Centre de données médicales

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy team drives data excellence and analytics across Roche Product Development, helping unlock the value of clinical, operational and real-world data to accelerate better decisions and improved outcomes for patients.

Within this team, the Medical Data Hub (MDH) Squad enables trusted, reusable and accessible data across the product development lifecycle.

As a Data Steward , you will help ensure data is properly documented, governed and fit for secondary use, supporting transparency, consistency and scientific rigor across Roche’s development landscape. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of data governance, clinical development and innovation, helping build the foundations for future-ready, AI-enabled healthcare solutions.
You will:

• Support trusted data ecosystems by helping develop tools and processes that enable real-world and secondary use of clinical trial data.

• Contribute to platform excellence by supporting the Medical Data Hub to remain scalable, accessible and fit for purpose.

• Enable data transparency and reuse through metadata standards, cataloguing, classification and stewardship activities.

• Strengthen data quality by assisting with routine assessments across structured and unstructured datasets.

• Build stewardship capability by contributing to knowledge sharing and helping embed good governance practices across teams.

• Enable FAIR data practices by supporting traceability, accessibility and consistency across development data assets.

• Collaborate across functions including Product Development, Research, Medical and Commercial teams with management of secondary use data.

• Support compliance and trust by applying relevant privacy, security and regulatory expectations, including GDPR and HIPAA where appropriate.

Who you are
You are curious, collaborative and passionate about improving how data is managed and used to advance science and healthcare.
You have:

• A degree, advanced qualification or equivalent practical background in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Information Science, Information Management or a related discipline.

• Experience working in data documentation, metadata, quality, governance or stewardship-related environments.

• An understanding of clinical, operational or real-world data structures and foundational stewardship practices.

• Familiarity with documentation tools, spreadsheets, cataloguing approaches or version control systems.

• Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills with the ability to work independently and adapt in evolving environments.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to a broad range of stakeholders.

• A collaborative and inclusive mindset, with respect for different perspectives in a global organisation.

Preferred

• Exposure to healthcare data governance, data catalogues or classification systems.

• Familiarity with FAIR data principles or regulatory documentation expectations.

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality, consistent data practices.

Join Roche and help shape a connected, trusted and future-ready data ecosystem that accelerates innovation for patients worldwide.

Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Welwyn. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il team di Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy guida l'eccellenza e l'analisi dei dati attraverso lo sviluppo di Roche, aiutando a sbloccare il valore dei dati clinici, operativi e reali per accelerare le decisioni migliori e i risultati migliori per i pazienti.

All'interno di questo team, la Medical Data Hub (MDH) Squad consente dati affidabili, riutilizzabili e accessibili attraverso il ciclo di vita di sviluppo del prodotto.

In qualità di Data Steward, vi aiuterà a garantire che i dati siano adeguatamente documentati, regolati e adatti all’uso secondario, supportando trasparenza, coerenza e rigore scientifico attraverso il paesaggio di sviluppo di Roche. Si tratta di un'opportunità per lavorare all'intersezione della governance dei dati, dello sviluppo clinico e dell'innovazione, contribuendo a costruire le basi per soluzioni sanitarie pronte per il futuro e per il futuro.
Lo farai:

• Supportare ecosistemi di dati affidabili aiutando a sviluppare strumenti e processi che consentono l'uso reale e secondario dei dati di prova clinica.

• Contribuisci all'eccellenza della piattaforma supportando il Medical Data Hub per rimanere scalabile, accessibile e adatto a scopo.

• Abilitare la trasparenza e il riutilizzo dei dati attraverso gli standard di metadati, la catalogazione, la classificazione e le attività di stewardship.

• Rafforzare la qualità dei dati aiutando con valutazioni di routine attraverso set di dati strutturati e non strutturati.

• Costruire la capacità di stewardship contribuendo alla condivisione delle conoscenze e aiutando a integrare le buone pratiche di governance tra le squadre.

• Abilitare le pratiche di dati FAIR supportando la tracciabilità, l'accessibilità e la coerenza tra gli asset di dati di sviluppo.

• Collaborare tra funzioni tra cui sviluppo del prodotto, ricerca, team medici e commerciali con la gestione dei dati di uso secondario.

• Sostenere la conformità e la fiducia applicando le aspettative relative alla privacy, alla sicurezza e alle normative, incluso GDPR e HIPAA, se del caso.

Chi sei
Siete curiosi, collaborativi e appassionati di migliorare il modo in cui i dati vengono gestiti e utilizzati per promuovere la scienza e la salute.
Hai...

• Una laurea, una qualifica avanzata o un background pratico equivalente in Scienza dei dati, Bioinformatica, Scienze della vita, Scienza dell'informazione, Gestione delle informazioni o una disciplina relativa.

• Esperienza di lavoro nella documentazione dei dati, metadati, qualità, governance o ambienti correlati alla gestione.

• Una comprensione delle strutture di dati cliniche, operative o reali e delle pratiche di stewardship fondazionali.

• Familiarità con strumenti di documentazione, fogli di calcolo, approcci di catalogazione o sistemi di controllo delle versioni.

• Forte capacità di problem solving e di pensiero critico con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e adattarsi in ambienti in evoluzione.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di spiegare chiaramente i concetti tecnici ad una vasta gamma di stakeholder.

• Una mentalità collaborativa e inclusiva, nel rispetto di diverse prospettive in un'organizzazione globale.

Preferito

• Esposizione alla governance dei dati sanitari, ai cataloghi di dati o ai sistemi di classificazione.

• Familiarità con i principi di dati FAIR o le aspettative di documentazione regolamentare.

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e impegno nelle pratiche di dati di alta qualità e coerente.

Unisciti a Roche e aiuta a plasmare un ecosistema di dati collegato, affidabile e pronto per il futuro che accelera l'innovazione per i pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Welwyn. Se siete interessati a ulteriori posizioni in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Das Team von Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy treibt Datenqualität und Analytik über die Entwicklung von Roche-Produkten an und hilft dabei, den Wert von klinischen, operativen und realen Daten zu entschlüsseln, um bessere Entscheidungen und verbesserte Ergebnisse für Patienten zu beschleunigen.

Innerhalb dieses Teams ermöglicht der Medical Data Hub (MDH) Squad vertrauenswürdige, wiederverwendbare und zugängliche Daten über den gesamten Produktentwicklungs-Lebenszyklus.

Als Data Steward tragen Sie dazu bei, dass die Daten ordnungsgemäß dokumentiert, geregelt und für die sekundäre Nutzung geeignet sind und Transparenz, Konsistenz und wissenschaftliche Ritus in der Entwicklungslandschaft von Roche unterstützen. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, an der Schnittstelle von Data Governance, klinische Entwicklung und Innovation zu arbeiten und die Grundlagen für zukunftsfähige, AI-fähige Gesundheitslösungen zu schaffen.
Sie werden:

• Unterstützung vertrauenswürdiger Datenökosysteme durch die Entwicklung von Werkzeugen und Prozessen, die eine reale und sekundäre Verwendung von klinischen Testdaten ermöglichen.

• Mit der Unterstützung des Medical Data Hubs, um skalierbar, zugänglich und zweckdienlich zu bleiben.

• Datentransparenz und Wiederverwendung durch Metadatenstandards, Katalogisierung, Klassifikation und Stewardship-Aktivitäten ermöglichen.

• Stärkung der Datenqualität durch Unterstützung von Routinebewertungen über strukturierte und unstrukturierte Datensätze.

• Aufbau von Managementfähigkeit durch einen Beitrag zum Wissensaustausch und zur Unterstützung von bewährten Governance-Praktiken in Teams.

• Ermöglichen Sie die FAIR-Datenpraktiken, indem Sie die Rückverfolgbarkeit, Zugänglichkeit und Konsistenz in Bezug auf die Entwicklungsdatenwerte unterstützen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Funktionen wie Product Development, Research, Medical und Commercial Teams mit der Verwaltung von sekundären Nutzungsdaten.

• Unterstützung der Compliance und des Vertrauens durch die Anwendung relevanter Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und regulatorischer Erwartungen, einschließlich der DSGVO und der HIPAA gegebenenfalls.

Wer bist du?
Sie sind neugierig, kollaborativ und leidenschaftlich darüber, wie Daten verwaltet und verwendet werden, um Wissenschaft und Gesundheit zu fördern.
Sie haben:

• Ein Abschluss, eine fortgeschrittene Qualifikation oder ein gleichwertiger praktischer Hintergrund in Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, Information Science, Information Management oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Erleben Sie die Arbeit in Datendokumentation, Metadaten, Qualität, Governance oder leitungsbezogenen Umgebungen.

• Ein Verständnis von klinischen, operativen oder realen Datenstrukturen und grundlegenden Managementpraktiken.

• Vertrautheit mit Dokumentationstools, Tabellenblättern, Katalogisierungsansätzen oder Versionskontrollsystemen.

• Starke Problemlösungs- und kritische Denkfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, selbständig zu arbeiten und sich in sich entwickelnden Umgebungen anzupassen.

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, technische Konzepte klar zu einem breiten Spektrum von Interessenvertretern zu erklären.

• Ein kollaboratives und integratives Denken, in Bezug auf verschiedene Perspektiven in einer globalen Organisation.

Bevorzugt

• Exposition gegenüber Datenverwaltung, Datenkatalogen oder Klassifizierungssystemen im Gesundheitswesen.

• Vertraulichkeit mit den FAIR-Datenprinzipien oder regulatorischen Dokumentationserwartungen.

• Starke Liebe zum Detail und ein Engagement für hochwertige, konsequente Datenpraktiken.

Begleiten Sie Roche und gestalten Sie ein vernetztes, vertrauenswürdiges und zukunftsfähiges Daten-Ökosystem, das die Innovation für Patienten weltweit beschleunigt.

Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Welwyn. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung steht, stellen wir Ihnen die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails zur Verfügung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'équipe Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy pilote l'excellence et l'analyse des données à travers Roche Product Development, aidant à débloquer la valeur des données cliniques, opérationnelles et réelles pour accélérer de meilleures décisions et améliorer les résultats pour les patients.

Au sein de cette équipe, l'équipe du Hub de données médicales (MDH) permet d'obtenir des données fiables, réutilisables et accessibles tout au long du cycle de développement du produit.

En tant que délégué aux données , vous vous assurerez que les données sont correctement documentées, régies et adaptées à une utilisation secondaire, soutenant la transparence, la cohérence et la rigueur scientifique dans le paysage de développement de Roche. C'est l'occasion de travailler à l'intersection de la gouvernance des données, du développement clinique et de l'innovation, en aidant à jeter les bases de solutions de soins de santé prêtes pour l'avenir et adaptées à l'IA.
Vous:

• Soutenir les écosystèmes de données fiables en aidant à développer des outils et des processus qui permettent l'utilisation réelle et secondaire des données des essais cliniques.

• Contribuer à l'excellence de la plate-forme en aidant le centre de données médicales à rester évolutif, accessible et adapté à l'usage.

• Favoriser la transparence et la réutilisation des données grâce aux normes de métadonnées, au catalogage, à la classification et aux activités de gérance.

• Renforcer la qualité des données en facilitant l'évaluation systématique des ensembles de données structurés et non structurés.

• Renforcer les capacités d'intendance en contribuant au partage des connaissances et en aidant à intégrer les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance entre les équipes.

• Permettre les pratiques de données FAIR en soutenant la traçabilité, l'accessibilité et la cohérence entre les données de développement.

• Collaborer à l'ensemble des fonctions, y compris le développement de produits, la recherche, les équipes médicales et commerciales, avec la gestion des données sur l'utilisation secondaire.

• Soutenir la conformité et la confiance en appliquant les attentes pertinentes en matière de confidentialité, de sécurité et de réglementation, y compris le RGPD et le HIPAA, le cas échéant.

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes curieux, collaboratif et passionné par l'amélioration de la façon dont les données sont gérées et utilisées pour faire progresser la science et les soins de santé.
Vous avez :

• Un diplôme, une qualification avancée ou une formation pratique équivalente en sciences des données, bioinformatique, sciences de la vie, sciences de l'information, gestion de l'information ou une discipline connexe.

• Expérience dans la documentation des données, les métadonnées, la qualité, la gouvernance ou les environnements liés à la gérance.

• Une compréhension des structures de données cliniques, opérationnelles ou réelles et des pratiques de gérance fondamentales.

• Familiarité avec les outils de documentation, les feuilles de calcul, les approches de catalogage ou les systèmes de contrôle de version.

• Des compétences fortes en résolution de problèmes et en pensée critique, capables de travailler de façon indépendante et de s'adapter dans des environnements en évolution.

• Excellentes compétences en communication, avec la capacité d'expliquer clairement les concepts techniques à un large éventail de parties prenantes.

• Une mentalité collaborative et inclusive, dans le respect des différentes perspectives d'une organisation mondiale.

Préféré

• Exposition à la gouvernance des données de santé, aux catalogues de données ou aux systèmes de classification.

• Connaissance des principes de données FAIR ou des attentes en matière de documentation réglementaire.

• Une grande attention aux détails et un engagement en faveur de pratiques de données cohérentes et de qualité.

Rejoignez Roche et aidez à façonner un écosystème de données connecté, fiable et prêt à l'avenir qui accélère l'innovation pour les patients dans le monde entier.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
By combining our unique strengths, we’re redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. Discover what it’s like to work at Roche.

ASPIRE is a multi-year program that will define, design, and deploy Future ERP solutions based on SAP S/4 HANA and other cloud/on-premise technology platforms. The program will enable simplified, standardized, and harmonized global business processes by capitalizing on SAP, Life Science Industry and Roche effective practices.

The opportunity:

• Preparation and leading of FIT-to-Template (assessment of the current business processes compared and aligned against the future Aspire Global Template) and scoping workshops for Financial Compliance

• Liaising with local affiliate Finance stakeholders for the implementation of Financial Compliance requirements

• Assessment of localization requirements for Authorization

• Execution of Testing Activities during the deployment (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)

• Go Live & Hyper care (incl. Month end closing ) support

• Ensure template governance within the project including change control management in line with the respective GBPMs/GBPOs and the overall Finance governance concept

Who you are

• You have a university degree in Business Administration, Accounting or a related field and proficiency in English.

• 5+ years related business experience or equivalent Project Management skills in the area of SAP Authorization

• Broad knowledge of business processes, policies and programs

• Strong Project Management , business partner management, communication and change management skills. Experience in Agile Project Methodologies is a plus

• Strong people skill s are required as the role is highly consultative, interacting with staff at all levels across an organization

Relocation benefits are not available for this job opportunity.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche / GenMark Diagnostics’ mission is to revolutionize patient care by providing high-value, simple-to-perform, and clinically relevant multiplex molecular diagnostics, specifically targeting infectious disease testing. We aim to improve patient outcomes, enhance laboratory efficiency, and reduce total cost-of-care through rapid, sample-to-answer solutions.

Roche/Genmark Diagnostics is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer (Sr. Engineer) to join our team. In this role, the Sr. Engineer will be responsible for defining the requirements for new tooling and part designs to deliver high quality plastic injection molded products in a timely and cost-efficient manner. In addition, the Senior Engineer will collaborate with procurement, quality assurance, quality control, operations, document control teams on validation and verification for injection molding tools. This is a highly visible role; allowing the Sr. Engineer to make an immediate impact within the team.

The Opportunity:

• You will create, review, and execute engineering change process for consumable components

• You will complete assembly and part drawings as well as other required documentation from design concept to manufacturing transfer; you will work with production teams to transfer verified designs into full production using principles of DFM/DFA

• You will technically manage projects by identifying, planning, & scheduling technical activities for successful completions.

• You will participate or lead in failure analyses, First Article Inspections, and test method development.

• You will transfer troubleshooting knowledge to Operations, Production, and Contract Manufacturers as new problems arise; you will interact with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure parts and assemblies can be reliably produced against material specifications.

• You will perform and document feasibility, design, verification, validation, and risk analysis activities under design controls within the new product development process potentially working alongside outsourced partners.

• You will develop test and development strategies and plans of substantial scope and duration that may include coordinating contributors across teams and outsourced partners..

• You will provide engineering and troubleshooting support to assay integration and development teams.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a B.S. in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 5+ years of industry experience; or a Master’s in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering (or equivalent area of study) with 3+ years of industry experience; or or Ph. D. level in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, bio-engineering, (or equivalent area of study) w/ 1+ years of industry experience.

• You have demonstrated experience with the engineering change control process, including technical report documentation, quality document management, and validation and verification activities.

• You have demonstrated experience with CAD (SolidWorks preferred), including drafting to ASME Y14.5 and GD&T standards.

• You have demonstrated experience in the design, DFM, and production of injection molded plastics, including rapid prototyping, prototype molding, and multi-cavity production molds.

• You are highly skilled at developing and sustaining medical or in-vitro diagnostics consumables and instrumentation working within an ISO 13485/GMP compliant environment.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, 94,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity, and diversity. We believe every employee makes a difference. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives. We are courageous in both decision and action, we believe that good business means a better world.

You will provide strategic leadership and management to the Cell & Gene Therapy Quality Systems organization within PTQC. Accountable for the establishment and Quality oversight of the global tools, processes and procedures specific to Cell & Gene Therapy. Ensure the Quality tools, processes and procedures used in PTC are fit for purpose, GxP compliant and support Clinical development timelines as well as future commercial launch.

The Opportunity:

• You will partner with senior leadership to set the strategic direction and ensure alignment with Roche Quality and business strategies, developing and maintaining strong collaborations with internal and external partners .

• You will provide quality expertise and oversight for IT tools, business processes, and GxP procedures used by the PTC unit, ensuring they are phase-appropriate and fit for purpose for Cell & Gene Therapy production .

• You will liaise with production activities, including Apheresis collection, AAV plasmid production, Drug Substance/Product manufacturing, analytics, and shipment to treatment centers .

• You will coordinate work across systems, functions, and sites to harmonize workflow and optimize cross-functional team member participation .

• You will lead the development, review, and revision of SOPs and procedural documents, and collaborate on updating curricula based on determined training needs .

• You will monitor the implementation and effectiveness of systems, create Quality Management Review metrics, and foster continuous quality improvement and procedural simplification .

• You will support internal and external audits, manage deviations and complaints, provide timely support and author responses for Health Authority interactions, and ensure pragmatic, patient-centered problem solving .

Who you are :

• You will have a Bachelor’s or postgraduate degree in a Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, or related science discipline.

• You will possess over 10 years of experience in the Pharma/Biopharmaceutical industry, specifically with ATMPs manufacturing, with experience in aseptic operations, Biologics, or analytics being an advantage.

• You will apply strong knowledge of GxP regulations to clinical and commercial products to ensure patient safety and the appropriate level of compliance.

• You will manage ambiguity through effective communication, skillfully removing barriers, and overcoming resistance.

• You will operate autonomously and manage complex situations by successfully coordinating multiple tasks and prioritizing them to deliver optimum results.

• You will demonstrate high integrity and accountability, ensuring your team's actions and decisions are aligned with business objectives.

**Relocation benefits not available for this position**
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 136,936.00 and 179,728.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company.

We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement.

The Opportunity:

• Provide quality and compliance oversight of CDMOs, CROs/PET centers, and in-licensing partners to ensure compliance with cGMP and quality agreement requirements

• Must have expertise and experience in the clinical product development lifecycle, production oversight, and release of clinical supply

• Execute all required activities to assess and release clinical supply. This includes but is not limited to review and approval of specifications, master batch records, methods, method validation reports, and executed batch records.

• Lead resolution of complex investigations, changes and risk assessments.

• Perform disposition of outsourced investigational medicinal products in SAP, including API and Drug Product of Synthetic Molecules and Biologics ​

• Serve as the Quality Point of Contact for CDMOs, CROs and in-licensing partners, and participate as a key member of cross-functional management teams to enable site selection, qualification and implementation, management, and decommissioning

• Oversee and execute all required quality activities during the lifecycle of these GMP suppliers, especially CDMOs, including but not limited to:

• Develop, negotiate and maintain Quality Agreements and associated documents

• Monitor cGMP compliance and report quality performance. Ensure Key Performance Indicators such as on time closure of records are met.

• Identify and mitigate quality risks. Assess impact to Roche clinical product.

• Support Roche audits, ensuring audit responsiveness and CAPA implementation. For Due Diligence audits, directly manage mitigation of findings prior to site implementation

• Tech transfers and process validation, and Inspection readiness for commercial CDMOs as applicable

• Serve as Quality Point of Contact to the technical development team, and lead the Quality subteam as required. Execute the Product Specification File (PSF), intra-company agreements, approve the control system, review CMC sections of Health Authority submissions and related activities.

Who you are:

• You mush have a B.S., M.Sc. or PhD in life sciences or equivalent.

• At least 8 - 10 years Manufacturing and Quality experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industry.

• Must have GMP QA experience in bulk API and Drug Product clinical supply manufacturing operations including release, preferably for Synthetic Molecules as well as Biologics including steriles. Experience with siRNA is a plus.

• Sound knowledge of cGMP, ISO standards and international regulations for pharmaceuticals. Must have the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and quality standards as they relate to clinical GMP product operations.

• Excellent Quality decision making skills in complex environments

• Proven ability to influence across cultures and functional reporting lines, and to drive continuous improvement initiatives

• Ability to operate in a self-managed way of wo

As the Recruiting Lead, Operations & Quality (US), this is your moment to shape how Roche & Genentech brings the deep and exceptional talent into our US operations & quality functions, powering our next chapter of growth. We are at the threshold of exciting strategic expansions in the US, and we need a recruiting leader who thrives in delivering fit-for-purpose talent acquisition strategies that give our business a competitive edge. You will lead a high-impact team of Talent Acquisition Partners (TAPs) in a fluid, networked environment, balancing global consistency with the local agility needed to win in this competitive and critical market. This is a role for a transformational leader, relentlessly inspiring high performance in your team, and continuously raising the bar of excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Mentor and coach a dedicated community of TAPs, elevating the recruiting team to a high-performing advisory group that consistently delivers value through strategic partnership and talent advisory.

• Continuously strive to enable the team by removing barriers, building high-value capabilities, influencing change adoption, accelerating learning, and empowering high performance.

• Move beyond reactive hiring by partnering with functional and geographic senior leaders to ensure proactive recruitment strategies that align directly with our business priorities.

• Turn market insights and hiring data into a competitive advantage, utilizing analytics to drive smarter sourcing and innovative solutions for complex talent gaps across the US Operations & Quality network.

• Ensure our global recruiting standards are upheld while having the autonomy to localize strategies that resonate within the US market.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent on-the-job training / experience gained work experience (6+ years)

• You bring 6+ years of Human Resources/ Recruiting experience

• Previous senior stakeholder management, coaching experience, and demonstrated leadership capabilitie s

Preferred:

• Transformational leadership; Demonstrated experience leading teams through strategic change

• Proven ability to elevate team performance

• Prior experience partnering with senior leadership and successfully recruiting executive level roles (vice presidents, senior directors, etc.)

• Previous recruitment experience with strong business acumen and ideally at senior level

• Experience developing broad and deep recruitment strategies

This will be a campus-based role.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Indianapolis is 135,800.00 - 252,200.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. We leverage external partners in order to offer flexibility to our internal capacity at the right cost and quality. We enable our external partners to reliably deliver compliant, quality products to our supply chain customers, so that we can deliver to patients worldwide. We do this through cross-functional collaborations ensuring quality process excellence and continuous improvement.

The Network Quality Assurance Manager will be a senior and integral part of the Network QA organization, reporting directly to the Network QA Lead. This role is crucial for maintaining stringent quality assurance standards and ensuring the safety, efficacy, and reliability of our products. As our portfolio and network become increasingly diverse and complex, the role of QA oversight is essential to protect patient safety, minimize risks, and maintain the company’s reputation and operational integrity.

The Opportunity:

• You will lead global cross- chapter initiatives for continuous improvement and standardizes QA decision-making processes globally.

• Foster alignment between Site Quality Assurance Heads in defining and implementing Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) based on audit findings and quality issues, ensuring timely and effective resolution across all sites.

• Drive the oversight, identification, and assessment of QA-related high-risk issues in all PT manufacturing sites and create risk mitigation strategies and execute corrective actions.

• Be able to support local functions with compliance , technical issues/ counterfeit investigation and ability to effectively communicate with Health Authorities

• Develop strategies to address and mitigate issues effectively, providing comprehensive data and insights, advising the senior decision-makers.

• Collaborate with senior leadership to implement global strategic and operational guidance on quality oversight, executing strategies in alignment with the PT strategy.

• Take an active role in conducting comprehensive risk assessments for manufacturing processes, proactively identify potential quality risks, and devise strategic mitigation plans in close collaboration with senior leadership.

• Act as liaison between global and local QA team to ensure teamwork in aligning on issues.

​
Who You Are:

• Strategic Foundation: Possess an advanced degree (BA/BS/MS or equivalent) in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Chemistry, serving as a critical base for complex decision-making.

A core function of the role is translating complex business use cases and requirements into standardized, compliant technology solutions, requiring a blend of technical expertise and business acumen. The PO collaborates with cross-functional teams, including Business, IT, and Validation, to ensure that high-quality, innovative solutions are defined, developed, and implemented. The role also involves managing the global master data entity and assisting the organization with expertise during regulatory inspections and the resolution of deviations.

This position requires a collaborative and open-minded individual who is capable of maintaining and transforming integral technologies while valuing continuous learning. The successful candidate must be someone who thoughtfully challenges ideas, prioritizes impactful work, and can be relied upon to operate in the best interest of the team, thriving in a dynamic work environment.

The Opportunity:

• You will standardize and optimize the systems and technology powering Quality operations and data insights.

• You will translate complex business use cases and project requirements into standardized technology solutions.

• You will serve as the Global Product Owner or sub-product owner for applicable technologies used in Pharma Technical Operations (PT).

• You will lead the lifecycle management for multiple products and systems, including upgrades, replacement, and retirement of computerized systems.

• You will manage system enhancement features, act as the Business Data Steward for data governance, and drive continuous improvement opportunities.

• You will drive the product vision, roadmap, and development lifecycle.

• You will provide in-depth global subject matter expertise and support the implementation of fit-for-purpose innovative solutions while ensuring GxP

The Position
Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición.

OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Asegurar la excelencia en el servicio técnico a través de la gestión de acciones proactivas, de mantenimientos y soporte especializado. Apoyar la puesta en marcha de equipos y asesorar a los clientes en el uso óptimo de la tecnología para cumplir con los estándares globales de calidad de la compañía.

Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:

• Ejecutar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos, asegurando el registro, documentación y cierre oportuno de casos en Rexis, así como la correcta trazabilidad de la información técnica.

• Realizar la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos bajo estándares de calidad del fabricante, coordinando con las áreas de Aplicaciones e IT.

• Brindar soporte técnico a clientes, resolviendo consultas, reclamos y problemas de funcionamiento, además de asesorar en el uso adecuado de los equipos.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo la gestión de notificaciones, entrega de evidencias documentales, control de sustancias y residuos peligrosos, y coordinación con logística para su disposición.

• Impulsar el desarrollo técnico continuo, aprobando entrenamientos, transfiriendo conocimiento al equipo y brindando apoyo en actividades de taller según se requiera.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en funciones similares o 2 años en manejo de plataformas Roche.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio.

• Manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Realizar la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos bajo estándares de calidad del fabricante, coordinando con las áreas de Aplicaciones e IT.

• Brindar soporte técnico a clientes, resolviendo consultas, reclamos y problemas de funcionamiento, además de asesorar en el uso adecuado de los equipos.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas y políticas corporativas, incluyendo la gestión de notificaciones, entrega de evidencias documentales, control de sustancias y residuos peligrosos, y coordinación con logística para su disposición.

• Impulsar el desarrollo técnico continuo, aprobando entrenamientos, transfiriendo conocimiento al equipo y brindando apoyo en actividades de taller según se requiera.

Tu Perfil:

• Título universitario o técnico en Electrónica, Mecánica o áreas afines.

• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en funciones similares o 2 años en manejo de plataformas Roche.

• Nivel de inglés intermedio.

• Manejo de herramientas Office a nivel intermedio.

#LI-DC1

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
