descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you a strategic safety and facilities leader ready to make an impact in a fast-paced biotech environment? We're seeking an experienced Director/Associate Director to join our SBX Technology team as the cornerstone of our site's operational resilience and compliance excellence. In this high-visibility role, you'll lead proactive risk management, oversee critical infrastructure, and drive continuous improvement across safety, facilities, and security—all while maintaining inspection readiness around the clock. If you have 8+ years in large-scale industrial environments, proven management expertise, and the drive to anticipate facility demands, we'd like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

• Manages the SHE, Security, and Facilities maintenance to comply with applicable regulatory and company policies, utilizing industry best practices, and identifying and managing risk.

• Works with building management to maintain critical power systems and emergency generators. Serves as the primary internal lead for building power restoration and temporary generators, ensuring building management and external vendors to maintain 100% operational readiness during extended building outage.

• Works cross-functionally to develop and support facilities projects and implementing new technology processes including remodels, new equipment, and reagents, etc . Manages all moves, construction, upgrades, and maintenance for the site.

• Leads hazard identification - determining and implementing necessary risk assessment programs/processes – as well as related facilities changes.

• Responds to and investigates all SHE, Security and Facility issues. Supports post-incident analysis to determine mitigation strategies to reduce future incident frequency and impact.

• Leads, manages, and continuously improves all relevant safety processes in a large generator environment, including hazardous waste management, dangerous goods shipments, chemical safety assessments, spill safety, exposure monitoring, biosafety programs, etc. Identifies and manages risk and ensures compliance.

• Ensures the site complies with applicable regulatory and company policies and is always “inspection ready”. May lead government and company interactions related to SHE, Security, and Facilities requirements including reporting, notification, facilitating inspections, and ensuring closure of corrective actions.

• Establishes monitoring solutions for critical facilities and lab equipment to enable after-hours monitoring and meaningful alerts.

• Prepares clear response plan documents for safety and facilities scenarios that can be executed by on-site personnel outside of standard business hours. Provides transparent documentation of site fail point areas.

Who you are
Education

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in chemistry, safety, industrial hygiene, or other relevant field.

Experience

• 8 years of progressive experience within a large scale industry such as technical manufacturing, diagnostics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, oil and gas industry, or other relevant industries.

• 5+ years of management experience.

Core Competencies

• Emergency Response & On-Call Availability: Demonstrated capability to respond effectively to critical safety, facilities, or security incidents (chemical spills, power outages, facility emergencies) with flexibility for after-hours and weekend availability as needed; track record of minimizing business disruption during safety events

• Self-Direction & Organization: Highly sel

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

We are seeking an SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant to join our team supporting a highly complex, customized SAP solution. This role is ideal for a consultant who thrives in technically challenging environments and is passionate about deep-dive problem-solving and continuous learning. We are looking for a consultant who is not intimidated by complexity but energized by it. This role requires someone who views a non-standard solution as an intellectual challenge rather than an obstacle, and who sees continuous learning as a core part of the job.

The Opportunity

• Provide functional consulting and support for our bespoke SAP solution with extensive custom developments

• Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize complex business processes in the supply chain and logistics space

• Collaborate with development and technical teams to understand non-standard functionality and custom implementations

• Drive system enhancements, testing, and deployment activities in a GxP context

• Deal with uncertainty and make decisions at the product level with guidance from a more senior member. Provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.

• Primarily interact within product teams, squads, and across the Product Line as applicable. Interacts directly with stakeholders on small to medium engagements. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicates the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.

• Travel to Switzerland as needed for on-site support, workshops, and client engagement

Who you are:

• Hands-on experience with SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• General understanding of SAP Transportation Management (TM) concepts and integration points

• Working knowledge of BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) and its application in custom developments

• Familiarity with BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) functionality

• Experience supporting complex, non-standard SAP solutions with custom code

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams

• Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work effectively across technical and functional teams

• Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly

Nice to have:

• German language skills (written and spoken)

• Experience with SAP ABAP or custom object development

• Experience in the Pharmaceutical environment following GxP guidelines

• Familiarity with change management and process improvement methodologies

• Familiarity with agile methodologies like SAFe

• Basic to intermediate level of business process domain knowledge in supply chain

What you get:

• Salary range 10,000 - 18,000 PLN gross based on the employment contract.

• Annual bonus payment based on your performance (target 12%).

• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.).

• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).

• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

• Vacation subsidy available.

• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).

• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice).

• Private heal
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Consulente funzionale – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Stiamo cercando un consulente funzionale SAP EWM/TM per unire il nostro team supportando una soluzione SAP altamente complessa e personalizzata. Questo ruolo è ideale per un consulente che prospera in ambienti tecnicamente impegnativi ed è appassionato di deep-dive problem-solving e apprendimento continuo. Siamo alla ricerca di un consulente che non è intimidito dalla complessità ma stimolato da esso. Questo ruolo richiede qualcuno che vede una soluzione non standard come una sfida intellettuale piuttosto che un ostacolo, e che vede l'apprendimento continuo come una parte fondamentale del lavoro.

L'opportunità

• Fornire consulenza e supporto funzionali per la nostra soluzione SAP su misura con ampi sviluppi personalizzati

• Analizzare, risolvere i problemi e ottimizzare i processi aziendali complessi nella supply chain e nello spazio logistico

• Collaborare con team di sviluppo e tecnici per comprendere funzionalità non standard e implementazioni personalizzate

• Miglioramento del sistema di trasmissione, test e attività di distribuzione in un contesto GxP

• Affrontare l'incertezza e prendere decisioni a livello del prodotto con la guida di un membro più anziano. Fornisce soluzioni a una vasta gamma di problemi difficili.

• Interagire principalmente all'interno di team di prodotti, squadre e attraverso la linea di prodotto come applicabile. Interagisce direttamente con le parti interessate su piccoli o medi impegni. Comunica informazioni, problemi e potenziali soluzioni all'interno dei team di prodotti e comunica chiaramente l'impatto del proprio lavoro nel contesto delle esigenze aziendali.

• Viaggiare in Svizzera come necessario per il supporto in loco, workshop e impegno dei clienti

Chi sei:

• Esperienza pratica con SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Comprensione generale dei concetti e dei punti di integrazione SAP Transportation Management (TM)

• Conoscenze di lavoro di BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) e la sua applicazione negli sviluppi personalizzati

• Familiarità con funzionalità BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call)

• Esperienza di soluzioni SAP complesse e non standard con codice personalizzato

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di navigare ambiguità

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e funzionali

• Volontà e capacità dimostrata di apprendere rapidamente nuovi concetti e tecnologie

Bello da avere:

• competenze linguistiche tedesche (scritte e parlate)

• Esperienza con SAP ABAP o sviluppo di oggetti personalizzati

• Esperienza nell'ambiente farmaceutico seguendo le linee guida GxP

• Familiarità con la gestione dei cambiamenti e metodologie di miglioramento dei processi

• Familiarità con metodologie agili come SAFe

• Livello base a livello intermedio di conoscenza del dominio del processo aziendale nella catena di fornitura

Che cosa si ottiene:

• Salario range 10.000 - 18.000 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro.

• Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 12%).

• Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.).

• Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile).

• Prendere il programma di tempo (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo).

• Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile.

• Flex Location (possibilità di eseguire il nostro lavoro da diversi luoghi del mondo per un certo periodo di tempo).

• Prendere il tempo per la carità ( congedo a pagamento aggiuntivo di massimo 2 settimane per impegnarsi nell'azione di carità di vostra scelta).

• Cura privata
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Functional Consultant – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Wir suchen einen SAP EWM/ TM Functional Consultant, um mit unserem Team eine hochkomplexe, maßgeschneiderte SAP-Lösung zu unterstützen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für einen Berater, der in technisch anspruchsvollen Umgebungen lebt und leidenschaftlich über tiefgehende Problemlösung und kontinuierliches Lernen ist. Wir suchen einen Berater, der nicht durch Komplexität eingeschüchtert, sondern von ihm eingeschüchtert wird. Diese Rolle erfordert jemanden, der eine nicht standardisierte Lösung als intellektuelle Herausforderung betrachtet, anstatt als Hindernis, und der ständiges Lernen als Kernteil der Arbeit sieht.

Die Chance

• Bereitstellung von funktioneller Beratung und Unterstützung unserer maßgeschneiderten SAP-Lösung mit umfangreichen kundenspezifischen Entwicklungen

• Analyse, Fehlersuche und Optimierung komplexer Geschäftsprozesse in der Lieferkette und Logistik

• Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklungs- und technischen Teams, um nicht-Standard-Funktionalität und kundenspezifische Implementierungen zu verstehen

• Antriebssystemerweiterungen, Tests und Bereitstellungsaktivitäten in einem GxP-Kontext

• Umgang mit Unsicherheit und Entscheidungen auf der Produktebene mit Anleitung von einem höheren Mitglied. Bietet Lösungen für eine breite Palette von schwierigen Problemen.

• Grundsätzlich interagieren innerhalb von Produktteams, Teams und über die Produktlinie. Interagiert direkt mit Interessenvertretern über kleine bis mittlere Engagements. Kommuniziert Informationen, Probleme und potenzielle Lösungen innerhalb von Produktteams und kommuniziert eindeutig die Auswirkungen ihrer eigenen Arbeit im Kontext der geschäftlichen Bedürfnisse.

• Reisen in die Schweiz nach Bedarf für Unterstützung vor Ort, Workshops und Kundenbindung

Wer du bist:

• Hand-on-Erfahrung mit SAP EWM (Extended Warehouse Management)

• Allgemeines Verständnis von SAP Transportation Management (TM) Konzepten und Integrationspunkten

• Arbeitswissen von BOPF (Business Object Processing Framework) und dessen Anwendung in kundenspezifischen Entwicklungen

• Vertrautheit mit BGRFC (Background Remote Function Call) Funktionalität

• Erleben Sie komplexe, nicht standardisierte SAP-Lösungen mit benutzerdefiniertem Code

• Starke analytische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Mehrdeutigkeit zu navigieren

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und effektives Arbeiten in technischen und funktionalen Teams

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch und die Fähigkeit, effektiv über technische und funktionale Teams zu arbeiten

• Bereitschaft und demonstrierte Fähigkeit, neue Konzepte und Technologien schnell zu lernen

Schön zu haben:

• Deutschkenntnisse (schriftlich und gesprochen)

• Erfahrung mit SAP ABAP oder benutzerdefinierter Objektentwicklung

• Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Umgebung nach GxP-Richtlinien

• Vertrautheit mit Change Management und Prozessverbesserung Methoden

• Vertrautheit mit agilen Methoden wie SAFe

• Grundlegende bis mittleres Niveau des Business-Process-Domain-Wissens in der Lieferkette

Was Sie bekommen:

• Salary Bereich 10.000 - 18.000 PLN brutto auf der Grundlage des Arbeitsvertrags.

• Jährliche Bonuszahlung auf Basis Ihrer Leistung (Ziel 12%).

• Dediziertes Ausbildungsbudget (Ausbildung, Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, diversifizierte Karrierewege usw.).

• Freitagserneuerung (2 Freitage pro Quartal verfügbar).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit Programm (bis zu 3 Monate Urlaub zu jedem Zweck zu verwenden).

• Urlaubszuschüsse verfügbar.

• Flex Location (Möglichkeit, unsere Arbeit von verschiedenen Orten der Welt für einen bestimmten Zeitraum durchzuführen).

• Nehmen Sie Zeit für Charity (zusätzliche bezahlte Urlaub von maximal 2 Wochen, um sich in die Wohltätigkeitsaktion Ihrer Wahl zu engagieren).

• Private Heilung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Consultant fonctionnel – SAP EWM/TM & Custom Solutions

Nous recherchons un conseiller fonctionnel SAP EWM/TM pour rejoindre notre équipe en soutenant une solution SAP hautement complexe et personnalisée. Ce rôle est idéal pour un consultant qui prospère dans des environnements techniquement difficiles et qui est passionné par la résolution profonde de problèmes et l'apprentissage continu. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un consultant qui ne soit pas intimidé par la complexité mais stimulé par elle. Ce rôle exige une personne qui considère une solution non standard comme un défi intellectuel plutôt qu'un obstacle, et qui considère l'apprentissage continu comme une partie essentielle du travail.

L'opportunité

• Fournir des conseils fonctionnels et un soutien pour notre solution SAP sur mesure avec des développements personnalisés étendus

• Analyser, dépanner et optimiser les processus complexes de la chaîne logistique

• Collaborer avec les équipes de développement et techniques pour comprendre les fonctionnalités non standard et les implémentations personnalisées

• Conduire les améliorations du système, les essais et les activités de déploiement dans un contexte GxP

• Traiter l'incertitude et prendre des décisions au niveau du produit avec l'aide d'un membre plus âgé. Fournit des solutions à un large éventail de problèmes difficiles.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows.

We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a Subject Matter Expert in chemistry and biology . Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables.

The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, developing and executing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles.

Your Role and Responsibilities:

• You will tackle efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems. You will successfully navigate the transition of assays from solution-phase to solid-phase environments and quantify reactions on surfaces.

• You will perform the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.

• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance and troubleshoot issues. You will apply your functional grasp of chemistry to navigate challenges related to chemical compatibility, surface tension, surface passivation, ionic strength, shear forces, and the influence of pH on surface interactions.

• You will conduct early-stage, deep-dive troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will seamlessly connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.

• You will serve as a subject matter expert in molecular biology, sample and library preparation, and sequencing chemistry. You will be a go-to person for explaining complex biological and chemical concepts to a team of talented engineers.

• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide critical, data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware, ensuring chemistry, molecular biology, and engineering are harmonized through iterative feedback cycles.

A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company.

This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role.

Who You Are (Required):

• You have a PhD in Chemist

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Digital Insights
Location: Seoul, South Korea

The role involves developing and executing digital sales strategies to achieve revenue targets, managing sales forecasting and reporting, and leading the virtual team in value-based selling. Key responsibilities also include building and maintaining customer relationships, understanding market needs, and conducting competitive analysis. The role requires strong cross-functional collaboration with customer areas and digital marketing.

The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor's degree or higher in relevant fields, 5+ years of B2B software solution sales experience. A deep understanding of modern software sales methodologies (SaaS, cloud, subscription models) and the diagnostics industry or healthcare IT is plus. The role seeks a leader with a passion for digital transformation in healthcare, who can set challenging targets, and drive results through strong communication and collaboration.

Key Roles & Responsibilities
1. Sales Strategy

• Develop and Execute Digital Sales Strategy: Formulate digital sales strategies aligned with our digital product goals, translating market analysis, customer segmentation, and competitive insights into concrete action plans.

• Achieve Revenue Targets: Take primary responsibility for achieving the divisional revenue quotas, leading and supporting pipeline management, opportunity generation, and contract closures.

• Sales Forecasting & Reporting: Conduct accurate sales forecasting and provide regular performance analysis and reports to maximize sales activity efficiency.

• Value-Based Selling: Understand customer business challenges and lead the virtual team in formulating strategies to convincingly communicate the business value (e.g., ROI, efficiency gains, improved patient outcomes) our software solutions offer.

2. Customer Relationship & Market Insight

• Build Key Customer Relationships: Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key customers and stakeholders, strengthening partnerships for long-term customer success.

• Understand Customer Needs: Keenly observe evolving customer needs and digital transformation trends in the diagnostics industry, incorporating these insights into product development and sales strategies.

• Competitive Analysis: Develop strategies that maximize the unique strengths of our products based on a deep understanding of competing software solutions in the market.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with relevant Customer Areas: Work closely with related Customer Areas like Core Lab, Pathology Lab and so on to effectively convey digital value to customers and support complex solution sales.

• Partner with Digital Marketing: Collaborate with the marketing team to plan lead generation activities and brand awareness campaigns that support sales efforts.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Biotechnology, Medical Informatics, or a related field.

• 5+ years of B2B software solution sales experience.

• Deep understanding and experience with modern software sales methodologies, including SaaS, cloud solutions, and subscription models.

• In-depth understanding of the diagnostics industry or healthcare IT, including relevant experience (e.g., LIS, EMR integration) is preferred.

• Proven experience successfully managing and leading complex, long sales cycles.

• Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about using the power of communications to drive meaninful policy change?
As part of the External Engagement Centre of Excellence within Group Communications, you will join a high-impact team dedicated to leveraging strategic communications tactics to drive meaningful policy change and reinforce Roche’s reputation as a leader in access. This isn't just a strategy role; we are looking for a hands-on builder who moves at the speed of the external world and can translate complex access and policy challenges into bold, persuasive campaigns.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Policy Communications, you will act as a trusted communications advisor and strategic thought partner to the Pharma Global Access Leadership team and Policy teams.

• Narrative & Content Development: Develop compelling public narratives and unified messaging to ensure Roche speaks with a consistent, powerful voice on critical policy topics.

• Communications Strategy Development & Execution: Design and deliver end-to-end communication strategies across digital channels, thought leadership, and media engagement in support of Roche’s policy and access priorities

• Global Presence: Drive Roche’s digital and physical presence at selected global policy and access events

• Reputation Protection: Proactively monitor emerging issues, maintain communication preparedness to mitigate risks and manage issues across sensitive access and policy topics.

• Measuring Success: Establish clear KPIs to track and report the tangible results of external communication tactics

Who you are
You are a strategic thinker who isn't afraid to get your hands dirty in execution. You thrive in multicultural, matrixed environments and possess the business acumen to navigate complex healthcare topics with ease.
Your Experience & Skills:

• Education: Master’s degree from a leading university in a relevant field (e.g. Politics, History, Business, Communications)

• Track Record: 10+ years of experience in policy, public affairs, or communications, with a proven ability to execute integrated campaigns across multiple channels.

• Industry Savvy: Deep experience in the healthcare industry and a strong understanding of the fast-paced external environment impacting our industry

• Communication Mastery: Exceptional writing and presentation skills in English; proficiency in German is an advantage.

• Collaborative Influence: Strong networking skills with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across a global matrix organization.

• Adaptability: The ability to prioritize a high workload in a changing environment, with a willingness to travel up to 20%

We look forward to your application!

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Sei appassionato di usare il potere delle comunicazioni per guidare cambiamenti politici meschini?
Nell’ambito del Centro di Engagement Esterni di Eccellenza all’interno delle Comunicazioni di Gruppo, vi unirete ad un team ad alto impatto dedicato a sfruttare le tattiche di comunicazione strategica per guidare cambiamenti politici significativi e rafforzare la reputazione di Roche come leader nell’accesso. Questo non è solo un ruolo di strategia; stiamo cercando un costruttore pratico che si muove alla velocità del mondo esterno e può tradurre complesse sfide di accesso e di politica in campagne audaci e persuasive.

L'opportunità

Segnalandosi al capo delle comunicazioni politiche, si agirà come consulente di comunicazione di fiducia e partner di pensiero strategico per il team di Pharma Global Access Leadership e Policy team.

• Narrative & Content Development: Sviluppare narrazioni pubbliche convincenti e messaggi unificati per garantire che Roche parli con una voce coerente e potente su argomenti politici critici.

• Communications Strategy Development & Execution: Progettare e fornire strategie di comunicazione end-to-end attraverso i canali digitali, la leadership del pensiero e l’impegno dei media a sostegno della politica di Roche e delle priorità di accesso

• Presenza globale: guidare la presenza digitale e fisica di Roche in una politica globale selezionata e eventi di accesso

• Protezione della reputazione: monitorare attivamente i problemi emergenti, mantenere la preparazione della comunicazione per mitigare i rischi e gestire i problemi attraverso temi sensibili di accesso e politica.

• Misura del successo: Stabilire i KPI chiari per monitorare e segnalare i risultati tangibili delle tattiche di comunicazione esterna

Chi sei
Sei un pensatore strategico che non ha paura di sporcarsi le mani in esecuzione. Tu prosperi in ambienti multiculturali, matrici e possiedi l'acum aziendale per navigare argomenti sanitari complessi con facilità.
La tua esperienza e competenze:

• Istruzione: laurea magistrale da un'università leader in un campo rilevante (ad esempio Politica, Storia, Affari, Comunicazioni)

• Track Record: 10+ anni di esperienza nella politica, negli affari pubblici o nelle comunicazioni, con una comprovata capacità di eseguire campagne integrate su più canali.

• Industria Savvy: Profonda esperienza nel settore sanitario e una forte comprensione dell'ambiente esterno veloce che colpisce il nostro settore

• Mastery di comunicazione: competenze di scrittura e presentazione eccezionali in inglese; la competenza in tedesco è un vantaggio.

• Influenza collaborativa: competenze di networking forti con la capacità di costruire relazioni e influenzare gli stakeholder in un'organizzazione di matrice globale.

• Adaptability: La capacità di priorizzare un alto carico di lavoro in un ambiente in evoluzione, con la volontà di viaggiare fino al 20%

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran, die Macht der Kommunikation zu nutzen, um einen mittleren politischen Wandel zu bewirken?
Im Rahmen des externen Engagement Centre of Excellence in Group Communications werden Sie sich einem hocheffizienten Team anschließen, das sich darauf spezialisiert hat, strategische Kommunikationstaktiken zu nutzen, um einen sinnvollen politischen Wandel voranzutreiben und den Ruf von Roche als Marktführer zu stärken. Dies ist nicht nur eine Strategierolle; wir suchen einen Hand-on-Builder, der sich mit der Geschwindigkeit der Außenwelt bewegt und komplexe Zugriffs- und politische Herausforderungen in mutige, überzeugende Kampagnen übersetzen kann.

Die Chance

Sie werden als vertrauenswürdiger Kommunikationsberater und strategischer Denkpartner des Pharma Global Access Leadership Teams und Policy Teams fungieren.

• Narrative & Content Entwicklung: Entwickeln Sie überzeugende öffentliche Erzählungen und einheitliche Messaging, um sicherzustellen, dass Roche mit einer konsequenten, leistungsfähigen Stimme zu kritischen politischen Themen spricht.

• Communications Strategy Development & Execution: Design und Bereitstellung von End-to-End-Kommunikationsstrategien über digitale Kanäle, Gedankenführung und das Medienengagement von Roche zur Unterstützung von Politik- und Zugangsprioritäten

• Global Presence: Die digitale und physische Präsenz von Roche bei ausgewählten globalen Politik- und Zugriffsereignissen

• Reputation Protection: Proaktiv die aufstrebenden Probleme zu überwachen, die Kommunikationsbereitschaft beizubehalten, Risiken zu mindern und Probleme in sensiblen Zugangs- und Politikthemen zu bewältigen.

• Erfolgsmessung: Stellen Sie klare Kennzahlen fest, um die greifbaren Ergebnisse externer Kommunikationstaktiken zu verfolgen und zu berichten

Wer bist du?
Sie sind ein strategischer Denker, der keine Angst hat, Ihre Hände schmutzig in der Ausführung zu bekommen. Sie blühen in multikulturellen, Matrix-Umgebungen und besitzen das Geschäft, um komplexe Gesundheitsthemen mit Leichtigkeit zu navigieren.
Ihre Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten:

• Ausbildung: Masterstudium an einer führenden Universität in einem relevanten Bereich (z.B. Politik, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Kommunikation)

• Track Record: 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Politik, öffentlichen Angelegenheiten oder Kommunikation, mit einer bewährten Fähigkeit, integrierte Kampagnen über mehrere Kanäle auszuführen.

• Industry Savvy: Tiefe Erfahrung in der Gesundheitsbranche und ein starkes Verständnis der schnelllebigen externen Umwelt, die unsere Branche beeinflusst

• Communication Mastery: Außergewöhnliche Schreib- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Vorteil.

• Collaborative Influence: Starke Netzwerkfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Beziehungen aufzubauen und Stakeholder in einer globalen Matrix-Organisation zu beeinflussen.

• Anpassungsfähigkeit: Die Fähigkeit, eine hohe Arbeitsbelastung in einer sich verändernden Umgebung zu priorisieren, mit einer Reisebereitschaft von bis zu 20%

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben.

Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft.

Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Êtes-vous passionné par l'utilisation du pouvoir de communication pour provoquer un changement de politique significatif?
Dans le cadre du Centre d'excellence pour l'engagement externe au sein des communications de groupe, vous vous joindrez à une équipe à fort impact qui s'emploiera à mettre à profit les tactiques de communication stratégiques pour susciter un changement de politique significatif et renforcer la réputation de Roches en tant que chef de file en matière d'accès. Ce n'est pas seulement un rôle stratégique; nous cherchons un constructeur pratique qui se déplace à la vitesse du monde extérieur et peut traduire des défis complexes d'accès et de politique en campagnes audacieuses et convaincantes.

L'opportunité

Sous l'autorité du chef des Communications en matière de politiques, vous agirez à titre de conseiller en communication de confiance et de partenaire de réflexion stratégique auprès de l'équipe de leadership Pharma Global Access et des équipes de politiques.

• Narratif et développement du contenu : Développer des récits publics convaincants et des messages unifiés pour assurer que Roche parle avec une voix cohérente et puissante sur des sujets politiques critiques.

• Développement et exécution de la stratégie de communication : concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de communication de bout en bout à travers les canaux numériques, le leadership de la pensée et l'engagement des médias à l'appui de la politique de Roche et des priorités d'accès

• Présence mondiale: la présence numérique et physique de Roches lors de certaines politiques mondiales et événements d'accès

• Protection de la réputation : Surveiller de manière proactive les nouveaux enjeux, maintenir la préparation à la communication pour atténuer les risques et gérer les enjeux sur des sujets d'accès et de politique sensibles.

• Mesurer le succès : établir des IPC clairs pour suivre et signaler les résultats tangibles des tactiques de communication externe

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes un penseur stratégique qui n'a pas peur de vous salir les mains en exécution. Vous vous développez dans des environnements multiculturels et matriciaux et possédez l'aumône d'affaires pour naviguer facilement sur des sujets de santé complexes.
Votre expérience et vos compétences :

• Éducation : Maîtrise d'une université de premier plan dans un domaine pertinent (politique, histoire, affaires, communication, etc.)

• Track Record : plus de 10 ans d'expérience dans les politiques, les affaires publiques ou les communications, avec une capacité éprouvée d'exécuter des campagnes intégrées sur plusieurs canaux.

• Industrie Savvy: Une expérience approfondie dans le secteur de la santé et une bonne compréhension de l'environnement extérieur à rythme rapide qui affecte notre industrie

• Maîtrise de la communication : compétences exceptionnelles en écriture et présentation en anglais ; la maîtrise de l'allemand est un avantage.

• Influence de la collaboration : Compétences solides en matière de mise en réseau avec la capacité d'établir des relations et d'influencer les parties prenantes dans une organisation matricielle mondiale.

• Adaptabilité : la capacité de prioriser une charge de travail élevée dans un environnement en évolution, avec une volonté de voyager jusqu'à 20%

Nous nous réjouissons de votre candidature!

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Affiliate: Roche Diagnostics Korea
Division: Diabetes Care
Work location: Seoul, South Korea

Your Key 
• Responsibilities

E-commerce Strategy Planning and Execution
Oversee the day-to-day operations of the e-commerce platform(s) to ensure smooth performance, accuracy, and timely execution of campaigns.
Understand business goals and key priorities to develop an end-to-end e-commerce marketing strategy and campaigns
Monitor inventory, pricing, and product listings to maintain consistency with brand standards and competitive market positioning
Develop strategies to optimize visibility, conversions, and overall performance on owned online platforms
Ensure high-quality customer experience across all digital touchpoints, resolving any operational issues and improving customer satisfaction.
Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Conversion Rate, Average Order Value (AOV), and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), providing regular data-driven reports.

E-shop and Naver Brand Store Management
Plan and manage to develop the whole scope of owned e-shop and Naver Brand Store
Create strategic action plans to attain consumers connected to the brand
Analyze traffic of e-shop and Naver brand store on a regular basis to understand the trend of online consumer's behavior
Closely work with APAC and global team to enhance owned e commerce shop and unified portal

CRM activation
Plan and execute CRM activities based on SFDC & Commercial website analysis
Plan to expand CRM to customers (retail stores/E-commerce/etc,)
Champion the digital customer journey, leveraging CRM strategies and market insights to foster customer loyalty and retention.

Key stakeholder Management
E-commerce distributor management
Other agencies and partners depending on business situations
Collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, supply chain, and IT, to ensure seamless digital operations and efficient inventory management.

Who You Are

Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher
Experience: Minimum of 7 years of proven experience in e-commerce, digital merchandising, or online retail operations
Language Skills: Advanced English proficiency (both written and verbal) required for seamless communication with APAC and global team.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data (e.g., sales history, search trends, customer buying patterns) to drive actionable insights and optimize product visibility.
Platform & Tech Expertise: Solid understanding of e-commerce platforms and proficiency in web analytics tools.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer.

Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story.

As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes.

The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT.

What you will be working on:
You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.

• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals

• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals

• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events

• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience

• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes

• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.

• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics.

Who you are:
You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:

• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity

• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system

The role of the medical enabler is designed to maximize local and cross-country medical and scientific activities to accelerate the delivery of our pipeline, differentiate our portfolio based on data, drive strategic advocacy, community engagement, medical practice adoption, and access to our portfolio. As a Medical Enabler you will contribute towards:

Offer Medical Expertise:

• Medical Expertise: responsible for proactively contributing strong scientific, medical, and therapeutic area expertise within the relevant diseases informing differentiation of our pipeline and portfolio. Acting as a medical expert for the pipeline and portfolio throughout the product life cycle.

• Shape Strategy: Lead the medical part of the integrated strategy, shape a scientifically sound and differentiated value story locally and communicate Roche’s contributions across key disease areas, reflecting an end-to-end business perspective that pulls through the strategy with impact.

Proactive Customer Engagement :

• Proactive Targeted Medical Engagement: As a medical function our ambition is to spend the majority of our time proactively engaging with external customers as partners in the integrated customer engagement strategy. The medical enabler serves as the scientific and medical expert, proactively engaging Therapeutic Area Experts, and other key stakeholders in full strategic and operational alignment with other in-field roles

• Medical enablership & Education: Establish and maintain effective peer-to-peer relationships with external stakeholders and identify/develop science-driven collaborations with TAEs. Provide current, high-quality Medical Education and differentiating scientific information to external customers, support the scientific training of internal teams and ensure continuous education on medical knowledge for PPoC roles. Conduct high-quality, non-promotional Scientific Exchanges to disseminate relevant data, foster physician confidence and clinical endorsement based on differentiating evidence and experience.

• Insight Generation: Based on aligned goals of the team, the medical enabler should systematically collect, analyze, and translate external scientific and clinical practice insights (including patient perspectives) into strategic actionable and differentiating recommendations for the team.

License to operate & Operational Excellence :

• Adherence to Standards: Ensure all medical activities, including customer engagements, research projects, and material co-creation, are executed in line with company policies, procedures, and the highest compliance standards. The Position
Senior Medical Writer
Roche India – Roche Services & solutions
Hyderabad

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2-office days/week).

The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

Position Summary

As a member of the Global Digital Hub Team, you will work to ensure fulfillment of the Global Digital Hub long term outcomes and strategy as well as excellent delivery of content creation priorities. As a Senior Medical writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners across various therapeutic areas and play a crucial role in business development and stakeholder engagement

As a Senior Medical Writer, you will be at the forefront of creating high-quality content for medical communications tailored solutions. The Senior Medical Writer is an experienced subject matter expert, advisor and leader within the chapter. Focussing on specific therapeutic areas in dedicated service teams, Senior Medical Writers are responsible for training and mentoring medical writers, copywriters and content editors within their assigned team - also driving cross-team upskilling and knowledge transfer to grow the capabilities of the chapter overall. This critical position has a global scope and a key component of the role involves acting as a trusted advisor and knowledgeable consultant to our business teams on the topic of medical writing and communications.

The Opportunity

• Apply your broad knowledge of medical writing for the pharmaceutical industry, you will work closely with cross-functional teams, including medical, scientific, and commercial partners, to understand client needs and develop tailored and effective scientific content for digital implementation

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering on agreed timelines

• Ensuring that the content, format and structure comply with regulatory and other guidelines, as well as with Roche best practices

• Monitor assigned tasks and manage own workload, taking ownership and anticipating capacity issues and potential solutions

• As a trained and experienced senior medical writer you will provide mentorship and technical coaching to other medical writers in the team, as well as new writers joining the team

• As a senior medical writer you will be a subject matter expert in pharmaceutical and medical communications as well as lead the team in assigned, specific therapeutic areas.

Key responsibilities:

• Your role will require taking responsibility and ownership for upholding the highest standards of scientific accuracy, quality and compliance with all applicable industry guidelines, local and international

• Exercise excellent interpersonal/communication skills for effective and professional liaison with the internal team, clients, healthcare professionals and other key stakeholders and to obtain compreh

The Position
Medical Writer
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2-office days/week).

The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

Position Summary

As a Medical Writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives.

In addition, you will work with senior medical writers and stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs.

The medical copy and content team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Writer, you will contribute to the growing medical writing team within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. You will develop medical writing and digital content solutions across various therapeutic areas and play an integral role in business development and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Create and edit medical content for various digital channels and platforms, including patient information, educational materials for healthcare professionals (slides, posters, speaker briefs, and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports, study summaries, and materials for public relations.

• May research, write, and edit pre-clinical and/or clinical reports, summarizing data from studies.

• Assist in the development of formats and guidelines for clinical documentation, prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts, and posters.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring timely delivery.

• Ensure content complies with regulatory guidelines and Roche best practices.

• Monitor and manage workload, anticipate capacity issues, and provide solutions.

• Ensure projects meet deadlines and maintain scientific accuracy.

• Prepare content for LMR approval in VVPM, including referencing.

• Collaborate with the Creative Artworker to develop content.

• Contribute creative ideas and suggestions.

• Liaise professionally with internal teams, clients, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and responses.

• Understand customer business needs to create relevant content.

• Engage resources, using both formal and informal networks to achieve goals and work closely with Business Partners.

• Suggest improvements to service and responsivenes

The Position
Medical Writer
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

Roche is a stable and innovative biotechnological company offering exceptional career paths and great benefits for fresh graduates and outstanding professionals. We are continuously expanding, looking for new talents to join our transforming Roche Services & Solutions Center. We offer a flexible working framework (2-office days/week).

The Global Digital Hub growing business line within Roche Services & Solutions Center. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Content Creation, and Creative Design.

Position Summary

As a Medical Writer, you will support the growing medical writing team within Roche Services & Solution Centre in developing medical writing & digital content solutions for our business partners. You will be part of formulating and identifying current and future content needs and support different content creation initiatives.

In addition, you will work with senior medical writers and stakeholders to ensure the effective deployment of resources and tools to support and ensure that writing activities are conducted efficiently, cost-effectively, and in accordance with the business needs.

The medical copy and content team within the Global Digital Hub operates under the Content Creation Chapter. This specialized team focuses on generating commercial content intended for various digital formats (emails, videos, banners, infographics, websites etc.). Their work plays a crucial role in supporting the communication strategies developed by Roche's global and local business teams.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Writer, you will contribute to the growing medical writing team within the Roche Services & Solutions Center. You will develop medical writing and digital content solutions across various therapeutic areas and play an integral role in business development and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

• Create and edit medical content for various digital channels and platforms, including patient information, educational materials for healthcare professionals (slides, posters, speaker briefs, and presentations for conferences), newsletters, medical reports, study summaries, and materials for public relations.

• May research, write, and edit pre-clinical and/or clinical reports, summarizing data from studies.

• Assist in the development of formats and guidelines for clinical documentation, prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts, and posters.

• Manage multiple concurrent projects across therapeutic areas, ensuring timely delivery.

• Ensure content complies with regulatory guidelines and Roche best practices.

• Monitor and manage workload, anticipate capacity issues, and provide solutions.

• Ensure projects meet deadlines and maintain scientific accuracy.

• Prepare content for LMR approval in VVPM, including referencing.

• Collaborate with the Creative Artworker to develop content.

• Contribute creative ideas and suggestions.

• Liaise professionally with internal teams, clients, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders to obtain comprehensive briefs and responses.

• Understand customer business needs to create relevant content.

• Engage resources, using both formal and informal networks to achieve goals and work closely with Business Partners.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Responsable de la implementación y soporte de aplicaciones de soluciones Roche (química, inmunología, molecular, ciencias de la vida y TI) para clientes. Actúa como enlace principal durante el proceso de implementación, abarcando la planificación, coordinación y capacitación de usuarios. Liderando la verificación, calibración y evaluación de equipos y sistemas. Asegura que la solución sea plenamente operativa según las especificaciones y necesidades particulares del cliente, proporcionando retroalimentación técnica a los stakeholders para la mejora de procesos y productos.

La Oportunidad

• Brindar asistencia técnica a clientes mediante instalaciones in situ, resolución de problemas y conectividad de instrumentos y soluciones digitales, garantizando la operatividad de los sistemas

• Instruir a clientes en el uso y mantenimiento de sistemas, actuando como enlace técnico y administrativo en proyectos asignados.

• Colaborar en la elaboración de planes anuales y propuestas de soluciones integrales para laboratorios clínicos.

• Instalar y configurar sistemas de gestión de laboratorio (LIS) y liderar su implementación, coordinando recursos internos y del cliente.

• Gestionar capacitaciones internas y externas sobre el portafolio de productos IT y de laboratorio.

• Interactuar con proveedores de software y hardware según las necesidades de los proyectos.

Quién eres

• Profesional graduado o estudiante en Ingeniería en Sistemas, Bioingeniería, Electromecánica o carreras afines, con experiencia en soporte de soluciones IT aplicadas al entorno de laboratorio clínico.

• Experiencia mínima de 2 años en implementación, soporte o consultoría de sistemas similares.

• Conocimientos en instalación, configuración y soporte de sistemas LIS, así como en integración de infraestructura, hardware y software.

• Habilidades de comunicación, orientación al cliente, trabajo en equipo y liderazgo de proyectos.

• Inglés intermedio.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms
Location: Pune

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud—supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment. As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we provide the hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support required to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable.

As a Senior Security Engineer , you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor, acting as a trusted advisor across distributed teams to drive improvements independently. In this role, you will navigate the complexities of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure to ensure our security solutions meet strict regulatory requirements while maintaining a highly responsive service delivery ethic.

The Opportunity

• Engineer Zero Trust Solutions: Design and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions to protect global corporate resources.

• Manage VPN Infrastructure: Administer and support Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including complex policy management and lifecycle operations.

• Automate Security Workflows: Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and ensure consistency across all security configurations.

• Drive Infrastructure-as-Code: Lead the management of security infrastructure using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations within GitHub.

• Ensure Operational Compliance: Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and strict change management adherence.

• Solve Complex Security Incidents: Independently lead the analysis of cybersecurity incidents, defining problem scopes and driving root cause analysis for vulnerabilities.

• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated capabilities that support a global, regulated workforce.

• Mentor and Standardize: Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to the development of enterprise-wide security best practices.

Who you are

• Experienced Security Engineer: You bring 5–7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, specifically focused on network security and secure access.

• Cloudflare & VPN Expert: You possess demonstrated experience with Cloudflare (Access, Gateway, WAF) and Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN deployment and troubleshooting.

• Infrastructure-as-Code Proficient: You are highly proficient with Terraform and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and automated deployments.

• Regulated Industry Veteran: You have a proven track record working in healthcare, pharma, or finance, with a deep understanding of compliance and audit requirements.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• Automation Mindset: You are skilled in building automation (scripts, workflows, or CI/CD pipelines) to support and scale global security operations.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Security Engineer (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms
Location: Pune

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud—supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment. As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), we provide the hands-on engineering, configuration management, and automation support required to keep access controls robust, auditable, and scalable.

As a Senior Security Engineer , you will design, implement, and operate the technologies that underpin our organization’s remote access, web security, and network protection capabilities. You will be a hands-on contributor, acting as a trusted advisor across distributed teams to drive improvements independently. In this role, you will navigate the complexities of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure to ensure our security solutions meet strict regulatory requirements while maintaining a highly responsive service delivery ethic.

The Opportunity

• Engineer Zero Trust Solutions: Design and operate Cloudflare-based web security and Zero Trust access solutions to protect global corporate resources.

• Manage VPN Infrastructure: Administer and support Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN infrastructure, including complex policy management and lifecycle operations.

• Automate Security Workflows: Build and maintain automation pipelines to reduce manual toil and ensure consistency across all security configurations.

• Drive Infrastructure-as-Code: Lead the management of security infrastructure using Terraform and maintain version-controlled configurations within GitHub.

• Ensure Operational Compliance: Own configuration management processes in ServiceNow, ensuring accurate CMDB records and strict change management adherence.

• Solve Complex Security Incidents: Independently lead the analysis of cybersecurity incidents, defining problem scopes and driving root cause analysis for vulnerabilities.

• Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with network, identity, and cloud teams to deliver integrated capabilities that support a global, regulated workforce.

• Mentor and Standardize: Provide technical guidance to junior team members and contribute to the development of enterprise-wide security best practices.

Who you are

• Experienced Security Engineer: You bring 5–7 years of hands-on technical experience in security engineering, specifically focused on network security and secure access.

• Cloudflare & VPN Expert: You possess demonstrated experience with Cloudflare (Access, Gateway, WAF) and Palo Alto GlobalProtect VPN deployment and troubleshooting.

• Infrastructure-as-Code Proficient: You are highly proficient with Terraform and GitHub for version control, collaboration, and automated deployments.

• Regulated Industry Veteran: You have a proven track record working in healthcare, pharma, or finance, with a deep understanding of compliance and audit requirements.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

• Automation Mindset: You are skilled in building automation (scripts, workflows, or CI/CD pipelines) to support and scale global security operations.

• Strategic Problem Solver: You are a self-motivated leader capable of owning work end-

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• Your key responsibilities
• ● Supply &Demand Planning :
• Manage supply planning parameters and monitor inventory levels to balance supply with demand.
• Lead regular SOP meetings with Sales and Marketing to review forecasts and mitigate risks such as stock-outs or excess inventory.
• ● Order & Distributor Management:
• Oversee order fulfillment for local distributors and manage end-to-end order-to-cash (OTC) processes.
• Act as the primary contact for 3PL warehouse operations to coordinate inbound/outbound schedules and ensure accurate logistics flow.
• ● Inventory & Data Management :
• Oversee the material lifecycle by maintaining accurate master data in SAP. Monitor inventory health by analyzing slow-moving, short-expiry, and obsolete stock to optimize working capital.
• ● Logistics Quality & Claim Handling:
• Manage logistics exceptions by filing claims for shipping damages, short shipments, or temperature excursions (cold chain deviations).
• Coordinate with global vendors and insurers to resolve discrepancies and minimize supply disruptions.
• ● Procurement & Reporting:
• Execute purchase orders (PO) and monitor shipping schedules from global hubs. Prepare SCM KPI reports, including forecast accuracy, service levels (OTIF), and inventory turnover.

Who you are
• Education & Qualification
• ● A Bachelor or Master Degrees in Logistics or Logistics related subjects
• ● Proficiency in both spoken and written English
• ● Good command of MS office software application
• ● Familiar with SAP system in MM and SD modules

Experience & Competencies
• ● A minimum over 3 years’ experience in supply chain operations & distribution.
• ● SAP experience in operation at least 1 years
• ● MS operation / Presentation skill
• ● Planning, Organizing & Commitment
• ● Customer Oriented & Relationship Management
• ● Communication Skill

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
