titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur principal des données - Fusions et acquisitions

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Lead Data Engineer - Mergers & Acquisitions

About Our Team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Join our Partnering Digital Solutions team, a strategic group focused on maximizing partnership impact through digital and AI-enabled ecosystems to advance the Pharma and DIA Partnering business. We are at the forefront of innovation - building scalable data infrastructure, applying advanced data engineering practices, and integrating cutting-edge external capabilities to accelerate decision-making and unlock business value.
Our work spans across multiple high-impact initiatives, from developing intelligent data products to enabling end-to-end AI workflows. Whether it’s structuring complex data ecosystems or collaborating with external research institutions, this is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data and AI at Roche by directly supporting key strategic decisions across our global Partnering organization.

Responsibilities

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will act as a hands-on technical leader- designing and building data solutions while guiding engineering best practices across the team. This is a player-coach role, where you will actively contribute to development while mentoring others and driving high-quality delivery.

You will be a pivotal member of our team, responsible for:

Key Responsibilities:

• Hands-on Data Engineering & Delivery:

• Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and curate structured and unstructured data.

• Write production-quality code in SQL and Python and actively contribute to day-to-day development.

• Troubleshoot, optimize, and improve performance of data workflows and systems.

• Technical Leadership & Data Architecture Ownership:

• Lead by example through hands-on contributions to critical projects.

• Provide technical guidance, code reviews, and mentorship to other data engineers.

• Help drive implementation of best practices in data engineering, testing, and deployment.

• Design and Build Scalable Data Pipelines:

• Architect, develop and oversee development of pipelines to ingest, transform, and curate structured and unstructured data from internal and external sources.

• Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability of data systems

• Data Profiling, Mapping & Standardization:

• Profile data, identify quality issues, and align disparate datasets. Define data models and standardization frameworks to support scalable, reusable, and AI/ML-ready data products.

• Data Product Engineering & API Development:

• Build and maintain reusable data products and APIs to support analytics and AI use cases.

• Ensure solutions are well-documented, secure, and scalable.

• AI/ML Enablement:

• Work closely with data scientists to prepare and deliver high-quality datasets for ML and AI use cases.

• Support data pipelines for LLM and AI-driven workflows.

• Metadata Management & Data Governance:

• Champion data governance, lineage, and metadata management practices

• Ensure compliance with enterprise data security and privacy standards.

• Monitoring and Event Frameworks:

• Implement monitoring, alerting, and event-driven frameworks for data pipelines.

• Ensure robustness, observability, and reliability of data systems.

• Container and Workflow Orchestration:

• Lead adoption of containerized and orchestrated data workloads (e.g., Docker, Amazon EKS)

• Guide orchestration of complex AI/data workflows using modern tooling.

• Cross-functional Collaboration & Influence

• Partner
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Lead Data Engineer - Fusioni e acquisizioni

Informazioni sul nostro team: Partnering Digital Solutions

Unisciti al nostro team di Partnering Digital Solutions, un gruppo strategico focalizzato sulla massimizzazione dell'impatto del partenariato attraverso ecosistemi digitali e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per promuovere il business di Pharma e DIA Partnering. Siamo all'avanguardia nell'innovazione: la costruzione di infrastrutture dati scalabili, l'applicazione di pratiche di ingegneria dei dati avanzate e l'integrazione di capacità esterne all'avanguardia per accelerare il processo decisionale e sbloccare il valore aziendale.
Il nostro lavoro si estende su più iniziative ad alto impatto, dallo sviluppo di prodotti di dati intelligenti per consentire flussi di lavoro AI end-to-end. Che si tratti di strutturare ecosistemi di dati complessi o di collaborare con istituzioni di ricerca esterne, questa è un'opportunità unica per contribuire a plasmare il futuro dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale a Roche sostenendo direttamente le decisioni strategiche chiave in tutta la nostra organizzazione globale Partnering.

responsabilità

Come Lead Data Engineer, si agirà come leader tecnico-progettare e costruire soluzioni di dati mentre guida le migliori pratiche ingegneristiche in tutto il team. Questo è un ruolo di giocatore-coach, dove si contribuirà attivamente allo sviluppo, mentre tutoraggio gli altri e la guida di consegna di alta qualità.

Sarai un membro cardine del nostro team, responsabile per:

Responsabilità chiave:

• Hands-on Data Engineering & Delivery:

• Progettazione, costruzione e mantenimento di datadotti scalabili per ingerire, trasformare e curare dati strutturati e non strutturati.

• Scrivere codice di qualità della produzione in SQL e Python e contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo quotidiano.

• Risoluzione dei problemi, ottimizzazione e miglioramento delle prestazioni dei flussi di lavoro e dei sistemi di dati.

• Leadership tecnica & Data Architecture ProprietÃ:

• Guidare per esempio attraverso contributi pratici a progetti critici.

• Fornire assistenza tecnica, recensioni di codici e mentorship ad altri ingegneri di dati.

• Guidare l'implementazione delle migliori pratiche in ingegneria dei dati, test e distribuzione.

• Progettazione e costruzione di linee di dati scalabili:

• Architetto, sviluppa e supervisiona lo sviluppo di condotte per ingerire, trasformare e curare dati strutturati e non strutturati da fonti interne ed esterne.

• Assicurare elevate prestazioni, scalabilità e affidabilità dei sistemi dati

• Data Profiling, Mapping & Standardization:

• Dati del profilo, identificare problemi di qualità e allineare i set di dati disparati. Definire i modelli di dati e i framework di standardizzazione per supportare i prodotti dati scalabili, riutilizzabili e pronti per AI/ML.

• Ingegneria dei dati e sviluppo API:

• Costruire e mantenere i prodotti e le API di dati riutilizzabili per supportare i casi di analisi e utilizzo di AI.

• Assicurarsi che le soluzioni siano ben documentate, sicure e scalabili.

• AI/ML Abilitazione:

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli scienziati dei dati per preparare e fornire set di dati di alta qualità per i casi di uso di ML e AI.

• Supporta le pipeline di dati per i flussi di lavoro basati su LLM e AI.

• Gestione dei metadati e gestione dei dati:

• pratiche di gestione dei dati campione, lignaggio e metadati

• Assicurare il rispetto delle norme di sicurezza e privacy dei dati aziendali.

• Quadri di monitoraggio ed eventi:

• Monitoraggio dell'esecuzione, allerta e quadro organizzativo per datadotti.

• Assicurare robustezza, osservanza e affidabilità dei sistemi di dati.

• Orchestrazione del contenitore e del flusso di lavoro:

• adozione di carichi di lavoro containerizzati e orchestrati (ad esempio Docker, Amazon EKS)

• Guida orchestrazione di flussi di lavoro complessi AI/data utilizzando strumenti moderni.

• Collaborazione e influenza interfunzionali

• Partner
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Lead Data Engineer - Fusionen & Akquisitionen

Über unser Team: Partner Digitale Lösungen

Begleiten Sie unser Partnering Digital Solutions Team, eine strategische Gruppe, die sich auf die Maximierung der Partnerschaft durch digitale und AI-fähige Ökosysteme konzentriert, um das Pharma- und DIA-Partnering-Geschäft voranzutreiben. Wir sind an der Spitze der Innovation - Aufbau skalierbarer Dateninfrastruktur, Anwendung fortschrittlicher Data Engineering-Praktiken und Integration moderner externer Fähigkeiten, um Entscheidungsfindung zu beschleunigen und Unternehmenswert zu entsperren.
Unsere Arbeit erstreckt sich über mehrere hocheffiziente Initiativen, von der Entwicklung intelligenter Datenprodukte bis hin zu endseitigen KI-Workflows. Ob es um die Strukturierung komplexer Datenökosysteme oder die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Forschungseinrichtungen geht, dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, die Zukunft von Daten und AI bei Roche zu gestalten, indem sie direkt wichtige strategische Entscheidungen in unserer globalen Partnerorganisation unterstützen.

Aufgaben

Als Lead Data Engineer fungieren Sie als Hand-on-Technical Leader-Designing und Aufbau von Datenlösungen, während Sie technische Best Practices im gesamten Team führen. Dies ist eine Player-Coach-Rolle, in der Sie aktiv zur Entwicklung beitragen, während Sie andere Mentoring und das Fahren hochwertiger Lieferung.

Sie sind Mitglied unseres Teams, verantwortlich für:

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:

• Hand-on Data Engineering & Delivery:

• Entwerfen, bauen und pflegen skalierbare Datenpipelines, um strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten zu erfassen, zu transformieren und zu kuratieren.

• Schreiben Sie Produktionsqualitätscode in SQL und Python und tragen aktiv zur Tagesentwicklung bei.

• Fehlerbehebung, Optimierung und Verbesserung der Leistung von Daten-Workflows und Systemen.

• Technische Führung und Datenarchitektur Eigentum:

• Führen Sie zum Beispiel durch praktische Beiträge zu kritischen Projekten.

• Bereitstellung technischer Anleitung, Code-Reviews und Mentorship an andere Dateningenieure.

• Hilfe bei der Umsetzung von Best Practices in der Data Engineering-, Test- und Bereitstellung.

• Entwurf und Aufbau von skalierbaren Datenpipelines:

• Architekt, entwickelt und überwacht die Entwicklung von Pipelines, um strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten aus internen und externen Quellen zu erfassen, zu transformieren und zu kuratieren.

• Hohe Leistung, Skalierbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit von Datensystemen gewährleisten

• Datenprofilierung, Mapping & Standardisierung:

• Profildaten, Qualitätsprobleme zu identifizieren und verschiedene Datensätze auszurichten. Definieren Sie Datenmodelle und Standardisierungsrahmen, um skalierbare, wiederverwendbare und AI/ML-ready Datenprodukte zu unterstützen.

• Data Product Engineering & API Entwicklung:

• Erstellen und pflegen wiederverwendbare Datenprodukte und APIs, um Analytik und KI-Nutzungsfälle zu unterstützen.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Lösungen gut dokumentiert, sicher und skalierbar sind.

• AI/ML Enablement:

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Datenwissenschaftlern zusammen, um hochwertige Datensätze für ML- und KI-Nutzungsfälle vorzubereiten und zu liefern.

• Unterstützung von Datenpipelines für LLM und AI-getriebene Workflows.

• Metadatenmanagement und Datenverwaltung:

• Champion-Daten-Governance, Lineage und Metadaten-Management-Praktiken

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsstandards des Unternehmens.

• Überwachungs- und Veranstaltungsrahmen:

• Implementierung von Monitoring, Alarmierung und ereignisgesteuerten Frameworks für Datenpipelines.

• Gewährleistung von Robustheit, Beobachtungsfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit von Datensystemen.

• Container- und Workflow-Orchestrierung:

• Lead Adoption von containerisierten und orchestrierten Daten-Workloads (z.B. Docker, Amazon EKS)

• Leitfaden für die Orchestrierung komplexer KI/Daten-Workflows mit modernen Werkzeugen.

• Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit & Einfluss

• Partner
descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous présenter comme vous-même, reconnu pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les relations authentiques, où vous êtes valorisé, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de vous épanouir tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel. C’est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd’hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Ingénieur de données principal - Fusions et acquisitions À propos de notre équipe : Solutions numériques de partenariat Rejoignez notre équipe de solutions numériques de partenariat, un groupe stratégique axé sur la maximisation de l'impact des partenariats grâce à des écosystèmes numériques et basés sur l'IA pour faire progresser les activités de partenariat pharmaceutique et DIA. Nous sommes à la pointe de l'innovation - en créant une infrastructure de données évolutive, en appliquant des pratiques avancées d'ingénierie des données et en intégrant des capacités externes de pointe pour accélérer la prise de décision et libérer de la valeur commerciale. Notre travail s'étend sur plusieurs initiatives à fort impact, du développement de produits de données intelligents à la mise en place de flux de travail d'IA de bout en bout. Qu’il s’agisse de structurer des écosystèmes de données complexes ou de collaborer avec des instituts de recherche externes, il s’agit d’une opportunité unique de contribuer à façonner l’avenir des données et de l’IA chez Roche en soutenant directement les décisions stratégiques clés au sein de notre organisation mondiale de partenariat. Responsabilités En tant qu'ingénieur de données principal, vous agirez en tant que leader technique pratique en concevant et en créant des solutions de données tout en guidant les meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie au sein de l'équipe. Il s'agit d'un rôle de joueur-entraîneur, dans lequel vous contribuerez activement au développement tout en encadrant les autres et en assurant une prestation de haute qualité. Vous serez un membre essentiel de notre équipe, responsable de : Responsabilités clés : • Ingénierie et livraison de données pratiques : • Concevoir, construire et maintenir des pipelines de données évolutifs pour ingérer, transformer et conserver des données structurées et non structurées. • Écrivez du code de qualité production en SQL et Python et contribuez activement au développement quotidien. • Dépanner, optimiser et améliorer les performances des flux de travail et des systèmes de données. • Leadership technique et propriété de l'architecture de données : • Montrer l'exemple grâce à des contributions pratiques à des projets critiques. • Fournir des conseils techniques, des révisions de code et un mentorat à d'autres ingénieurs de données. • Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des meilleures pratiques en matière d'ingénierie, de test et de déploiement de données. • Concevoir et construire des pipelines de données évolutifs : • Architecter, développer et superviser le développement de pipelines pour ingérer, transformer et conserver des données structurées et non structurées provenant de sources internes et externes. • Garantir des performances élevées, l'évolutivité et la fiabilité des systèmes de données. • Profilage, cartographie et normalisation des données : • Profiler les données, identifier les problèmes de qualité et aligner les ensembles de données disparates. Définissez des modèles de données et des cadres de normalisation pour prendre en charge des produits de données évolutifs, réutilisables et prêts pour l'IA/ML. • Ingénierie de produits de données et développement d'API : • Créer et maintenir des produits de données et des API réutilisables pour prendre en charge les cas d'utilisation de l'analyse et de l'IA. • Assurez-vous que les solutions sont bien documentées, sécurisées et évolutives. • Activation de l'IA/ML : • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec des data scientists pour préparer et fournir des ensembles de données de haute qualité pour les cas d'utilisation du ML et de l'IA. • Prise en charge des pipelines de données pour les flux de travail LLM et basés sur l'IA. • Gestion des métadonnées et gouvernance des données : • Promouvoir les pratiques de gouvernance, de traçabilité et de gestion des métadonnées. • Assurer la conformité aux normes de sécurité et de confidentialité des données de l'entreprise. • Cadres de surveillance et d'événements : • Implémentez des cadres de surveillance, d'alerte et basés sur les événements pour les pipelines de données. • Assurer la robustesse, l'observabilité et la fiabilité des systèmes de données. • Orchestration des conteneurs et des flux de travail : • Diriger l'adoption de charges de travail de données conteneurisées et orchestrées (par exemple, Docker, Amazon EKS) • Guider l'orchestration de flux de travail d'IA/données complexes à l'aide d'outils modernes. • Collaboration et influence interfonctionnelles • Partenaire

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Information Solutions provides integrated digital solutions to deliver on the promise of affordable, high-quality, and accessible healthcare. RIS is accountable for the development and delivery of digital solutions, common Diagnostics architecture, and data management. Digitalization in healthcare is of increasing importance to deliver customer and patient value, and shape healthcare.
The Platform team is building the foundation on which a myriad of healthcare and research software applications can be delivered to patients, from the cloud to the lab. The Platform Engineering team is responsible for platform services including the development, testing, deployment, and operation of software. In addition, the function manages platform onboarding and developer experience.
Roche’s single vision is to improve the lives of patients, and the RIS Platform team is dedicated to using the latest cloud software technologies as a means to deliver this vision. If you would rather improve health outcomes for millions instead of helping sell ads on the Internet, this is the job for you.

The Position
This position is a key technical leadership role within a team operating across one to two Scrum teams , and is responsible for driving the design, technical direction, and successful implementation of complex, enterprise-scale software systems.
This role is suited for a highly experienced engineer who operates above the Senior Engineer level and combines strong technical depth with leadership in architecture, design execution, and cross-team collaboration. This role is expected to own and drive designs from concept to implementation , ensuring alignment across architects, peers, and engineering teams.
The role includes creating solution designs, leading technical discussions, resolving design and implementation blockers, and guiding teams through execution . This role will work closely with architects, partner teams, and peers to resolve conflicts, gain alignment and approvals, and ensure smooth delivery.
In addition, this role is expected to identify opportunities for introducing new tools, capabilities, and engineering improvements , and to proactively raise concerns and propose changes where processes, practices, or technical approaches can be improved. This role also plays an important part in mentoring engineers, influencing engineering excellence, and ensuring scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

Your Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Design Ownership

• Lead the technical design of complex features, services, and platform capabilities from ideation through implementation.

• Create, drive, and evolve solution designs, ensuring they are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with architectural standards.

• Lead design discussions and provide technical direction to engineering teams during implementation.

• Work closely with architects, peers, and other stakeholders to resolve design conflicts, close gaps, and secure necessary approvals.

• Ensure designs are translated effectively into implementation, supporting teams until successful delivery.

Implementation Guidance & Blocker Resolution

• Act as the primary technical point of contact for the team during implementation.

• Identify and resolve technical blockers faced by implementation teams, providing hands-on guidance where needed.

• Bridge design and execution by ensuring engineering teams understand requirements, trade-offs, and technical decisions.

• Proactively identify risks, dependencies,

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
DESCRIPTION
We are looking for a Principal Data Engineer to join our growing team of Advanced Data Analytics experts. This role calls for a seasoned professional with deep expertise in data engineering, data modeling, and analytics , along with strong technical leadership and architectural thinking.
The ideal candidate thrives on solving complex data challenges—ensuring data quality, integrity, and scalability—and driving data initiatives that enable analytics, machine learning, and evidence-based decision-making. The Data Engineer will work closely with System and Enterprise Architects, Technical Project Managers, Product Owners, and Software Engineers on data-driven initiatives, supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems, and products.
The perfect fit for this role is self-motivated , collaborative, and enthusiastic about advancing Roche’s next generation of products and data initiatives. As Roche advances toward AI-enabled diagnostics, hands-on experience with Generative AI (GenAI) POCs will be considered a plus, especially in leveraging data assets for automation, insight generation, and feature engineering.

Location- Baner, Pune

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design, implement, and optimize data architectures and pipelines using AWS services for scalable, high-performance, and reliable data systems.

• Lead data modeling, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and transformation activities , ensuring high-quality, well-structured data for analytics and machine learning.

• Collaborate with data scientists to support feature extraction and data preparation for AI/ML models.

• Partner with software engineers and architects to integrate data-driven capabilities into Roche’s SaaS and digital health solutions.

• Ensure data governance, lineage, and compliance across cloud environments.

• Stay current with advancements in data engineering, analytics, and emerging AI/GenAI trends , evaluating their applicability to Roche’s data platforms.

• Present data strategies, insights, and technical solutions clearly to both technical and business audiences.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

• 9 + years of experience in data engineering and analytics .

• Expertise in AWS services (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, EMR).

• Strong in data modeling, SQL, Python , and distributed frameworks like Apache Spark .

• Hands-on experience in exploratory data analysis (EDA), data quality improvement , and feature engineering .

• Experience developing SaaS and cloud-native data applications .

• Sound understanding of software architecture patterns and agile methodologies .

• Proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and drive data-centric initiatives.

• Excellent communication skills to bridge technical and business discussions.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in the Healthcare / Diagnostics domain is a plus.

• Familiarity with healthcare data standards (HIPAA, HL7, FHIR).

• Experience designing data lakes, data warehouses , or data mesh architectures .

• Strong knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance in cloud ecosystems.

• Generative AI (GenAI) Experience: Hands-on exposure to GenAI, including POCs for data summarization, feature extraction, or AI-driven insights , leveraging LLMs and AI pipelines in production or experimental setups.

The ideal candidate thrives on solving complex data challenges—ensuring data quality, integrity, and scalability—and driving data initiatives that enable analytics, machine learning, and evidence-based decision-making. The Data Engineer will work closely with System and Enterprise Architects, Technical Project Managers, Product Owners, and Software Engineers on data-driven initiatives, supporting the data needs of multiple teams, systems, and products.
The perfect fit for this role is self-motivated , collaborative, and enthusiastic about advancing Roche’s next generation of products and data initiatives. As Roche advances toward AI-enabled diagnostics, hands-on experience with Generative AI (GenAI) POCs will be considered a plus, especially in leveraging data assets for automation, insight generation, and feature engineering.

Location- Baner, Pune

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design, implement, and optimize data architectures and pipelines using AWS services for scalable, high-performance, and reliable data systems.

• Lead data modeling, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and transformation activities , ensuring high-quality, well-structured data for analytics and machine learning.

• Collaborate with data scientists to support feature extraction and data preparation for AI/ML models.

• Partner with software engineers and architects to integrate data-driven capabilities into Roche’s SaaS and digital health solutions.

• Ensure data governance, lineage, and compliance across cloud environments.

• Stay current with advancements in data engineering, analytics, and emerging AI/GenAI trends , evaluating their applicability to Roche’s data platforms.

• Present data strategies, insights, and technical solutions clearly to both technical and business audiences.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

• 9 + years of experience in data engineering and analytics .

• Expertise in AWS services (e.g., S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, EMR).

• Strong in data modeling, SQL, Python , and distributed frameworks like Apache Spark .

• Hands-on experience in exploratory data analysis (EDA), data quality improvement , and feature engineering .

• Experience developing SaaS and cloud-native data applications .

• Sound understanding of software architecture patterns and agile methodologies .

• Proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and drive data-centric initiatives.

• Excellent communication skills to bridge technical and business discussions.

DESIRED EXPERIENCE, SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in the Healthcare / Diagnostics domain is a plus.

• Familiarity with healthcare data standards (HIPAA, HL7, FHIR).

• Experience designing data lakes, data warehouses , or data mesh architectures .

• Strong knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance in cloud ecosystems.

• Generative AI (GenAI) Experience: Hands-on exposure to GenAI, including POCs for data summarization, feature extraction, or AI-driven insights , leveraging LLMs and AI pipelines in production or experimental setups.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: Account Value Partner
Team: Sales
Report to: Account Value Lead

The opportunity
Purpose of the Job
(overall high level summary of the job)
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
As an Account Value Partner, you are at the forefront of our mission, driving the sales of Roche's innovative diagnostic products within your assigned territory in Thailand. You will be a trusted partner to healthcare professionals, providing them with the solutions and expertise they need to improve patient outcomes. This is a dynamic field-based role where you will build strong relationships, exceed sales targets, and be a key contributor to our success.

Role-Specific Accountabilities
(the primary tasks and responsibilities this job is expected to perform)

• Define and own the medical education event and KOL engagement strategy.

• Gather and analyze insights to co-create solutions with hospital management, KOLs, and key customers.

• Take accountability for achieving budgeted sales while keeping costs under control.

• Seek out opportunities in key accounts and lead/organize promotional activities or product/solution presentations to achieve sales growth.

• Develop and implement territory and key account plans that align with the marketing plan, demonstrating effective time management and prioritization.

• Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction post-sale, including coordinating technical support or addressing initial product inquiries to maintain long-term partnerships.

• Manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiation, closing deals, and contract implementation.

Who you are

Experience and Competencies:

• Deep understanding of business drivers, products, the local market, and competition.

• Ability to influence at all levels, position/sell ideas to client groups, and manage expectations in line with the agreed portfolio.

• Builds trustful and effective relationships.

• Capable of finding creative solutions to complex problems, taking responsibility, driving results, and achieving expected outcomes.

Industry Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Technology.

• 3+ years of work experience in a related sales or clinical field.

• Flexibility to be based in various locations across Thailand, including Bangkok, upcountry provinces, or in a hybrid model, depending on the assigned territory.

• Proficient language skills in Thai and a good command of spoken and written English.

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel frequently are required.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
